articles.title: Quantum optics may turn this rare visual phenomenon into an eye test
articles.title_zh: 量子光学或可将罕见视觉现象转化为眼部检测方法
articles.abstract: Modern life depends on quantum physics. It makes technologies such as GPS navigation, MRI scanners and computer chips possible. Now, the same science may also lead to a new way to test the health of our eyes. A University at Buffalo-led team has used a technique from quantum optics to make a little-known visual pattern produced inside the eye easier to see—potentially opening the door to a new way to test retinal health.
articles.abstract_zh: 布法罗大学领衔团队将量子光学技术用于增强一种在眼内产生、但通常不易观察的视觉图样。该方法可能使这种罕见视觉现象更容易被受试者感知，从而为评估视网膜健康提供新的眼科检测思路。

articles.title: New physics-based machine-learning method speeds search for 2D quantum materials
articles.title_zh: 基于物理的机器学习新方法加速二维量子材料筛选
articles.abstract: Researchers at The University of Manchester have developed a new computational approach to help identify two-dimensional materials that may host unusual quantum behavior. The work, published in Science Advances, focuses on materials with "flat bands," electronic states where electrons have very little kinetic energy. In these materials, interactions between electrons can become much more important, creating conditions linked to phenomena such as magnetism, unconventional superconductivity and topological electronic behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 曼彻斯特大学研究人员提出一种计算方法，用于识别可能具有异常量子行为的二维材料。该工作聚焦含“平带”的材料，即电子动能很低、电子相互作用相对增强的体系。此类条件与磁性、非常规超导和拓扑电子行为等现象密切相关。

articles.title: E-Taste Signal Encoding and Classification via Multi- Attention Residual Networks Using sEMG Streams in Virtual Sensory Systems
articles.title_zh: 基于表面肌电流的多注意力残差网络用于虚拟感官系统中的电子味觉信号编码与分类
articles.abstract: The purpose of this study was to improve the precision of electronic taste (E-Taste) categorization through the use of surface electromyography (sEMG) data. A multi-attention channel block and residual learning approach, called MACB-ResNet, was developed to emphasize the most important features for distinguishing among the several E-Taste classes. Silver electrodes were used to capture sEMG data from the facial muscles stimulated by various E-Taste experience levels (none, salty, sprite, bitter, mint, sour) while delivering these stimuli to the tip of the tongue. Data were detrended and filtered, then converted to spectrograms. All data obtained by the MACB-ResNet classifier were compared with three other standard classifiers: KNN, Random Forest (RF), and DenseNet-201. Model performance was evaluated using multiple means, including accuracy, F1 Score, area under the curve (AUC), confusion matrix analysis, principal component analysis (PCA), t-distributed stochastic neighbor embedding (t-SNE) visualizations, and an ablation study. The results of this study demonstrate that the MACB-ResNet classifier generated the highest classification accuracy (86.32%) compared to KNN (65.11%), RF (78.35%), and DenseNet-201 (81.93%). In addition to high accuracy scores, the class-level analyses demonstrated robust classification of each taste type, with minimal misclassifications among similar feature classes (i.e., confusion between bitter and sour). PCA and t-SNE visualizations supported MACB-ResNet's ability to separate classes, and ablation studies indicated that both residual connections and multi-attention channel blocks significantly affected model performance. The MACB-ResNet model's ability to improve the accuracy of sEMG-based E-Taste classification will be useful for many future applications in personal nutrition, digital health, food technology, neuromarketing, and brain-computer interface systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用面部肌肉表面肌电信号提高电子味觉类别识别精度，刺激类型包括无味、咸味、雪碧味、苦味、薄荷味和酸味。作者提出结合多注意力通道模块与残差学习的 MACB-ResNet，将预处理后的肌电信号转换为谱图进行分类。与 KNN、随机森林和 DenseNet-201 相比，MACB-ResNet 获得最高分类准确率 86.32%，并通过 F1、AUC、混淆矩阵、PCA/t-SNE 和消融实验进行评估。

articles.title: Robust half-metallicity and magnetic stability of half-Heusler alloy NaVSb against atomic disorder: A first-principles study
articles.title_zh: 半赫斯勒合金 NaVSb 在原子无序下的稳健半金属性与磁稳定性：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: Publication date: 25 July 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 272 Author(s): Jiani Wu, Yuhan Dong, Wenjing Wang, Hui You, Yu Feng, Bo Wu
articles.abstract_zh: 该文献条目仅提供题名、期刊卷期和作者等元数据，未给出完整摘要。根据标题，该工作采用第一性原理计算研究半赫斯勒合金 NaVSb 的半金属性和磁稳定性，并重点考察原子无序对其电子与磁性质的影响；具体计算设置和结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Empowering neural network-based quantum Monte Carlo with local pseudopotentials
articles.title_zh: 用局域赝势增强神经网络量子蒙特卡罗
articles.abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01008-7 This study shows that local pseudopotentials boost the efficiency of neural network-based quantum Monte Carlo while preserving accuracy, enabling reliable simulations of large, challenging iron–sulfur clusters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在神经网络波函数量子蒙特卡罗中引入局域赝势，可在保持计算精度的同时显著提高效率。该策略使大尺寸、强关联且计算困难的铁–硫团簇能够得到更可靠的模拟。

articles.title: Nanosecond phase ordering in ultra-large spin Hall nano-oscillator lattices for unconventional computing
articles.title_zh: 用于非常规计算的超大规模自旋霍尔纳米振荡器晶格中的纳秒相位有序
articles.abstract: Nature Nanotechnology, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41565-026-02216-y Ultra-large networks of nano-oscillators can synchronize within tens of nanoseconds, exhibiting high coherence and offering a platform for exploring network science and developing next-generation high-speed unconventional computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究超大规模自旋霍尔纳米振荡器网络的同步与相位有序行为。结果显示，这类纳米振荡器网络可在数十纳秒内实现同步并表现出高相干性，为网络科学研究和高速非常规计算硬件提供了平台。

articles.title: High temperature Nb-Si alloys using data science: optimization of fracture toughness and high-temperature strength
articles.title_zh: 基于数据科学的高温 Nb-Si 合金：断裂韧性与高温强度优化
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75353-6 Nb-Si alloys are candidates for high-temperature use but rarely combine fracture toughness with high-temperature strength. Here, the authors use machine learning to design an alloy surpassing all reported as-cast Nb-Si alloys in both properties.
articles.abstract_zh: Nb-Si 合金具有高温应用潜力，但通常难以同时获得高断裂韧性和高温强度。作者利用机器学习进行合金设计，获得了一种在这两项性能上均超过已报道铸态 Nb-Si 合金的成分方案。

articles.title: A symbiotic skin hydrogel interface enabled by flexible hydrogel network with embedded enhancement structure
articles.title_zh: 嵌入增强结构的柔性水凝胶网络实现共生皮肤水凝胶界面
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75372-3 Hydrogel based electrophysiological monitoring materials are useful for sensor, though it is challenging to optimize mechanical and electronic properties. Here the authors report a breathable conductive hydrogel network for accurate long-term monitoring.
articles.abstract_zh: 水凝胶电生理监测材料适用于可穿戴传感，但其力学适配性、透气性和电子传输性能难以兼顾。该工作报道了一种透气导电水凝胶网络，可用于长期、准确的皮肤电生理信号监测。

articles.title: Observation of giant acoustoelectric currents in graphene on lead magnesium niobate–lead titanate
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯/铌镁酸铅–钛酸铅平台中巨声电流的观测
articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 10 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74813-3 Acoustoelectric devices can convert radio-frequency-driven acoustic signals into electronic responses and are useful for energy harvesting and various sensing applications. Here, the authors report the integration of graphene with a lead magnesium niobate–lead titanate surface acoustic wave platform, showing enhanced acoustoelectric currents and responsivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 声电器件可将射频驱动的声学信号转换为电子响应，在能量收集和传感中具有应用价值。作者将石墨烯集成到铌镁酸铅–钛酸铅表面声波平台上，观察到增强的声电流和响应度。

articles.title: Automated peak detection in grazing-incidence diffraction using transformers
articles.title_zh: 基于 Transformer 的掠入射衍射自动峰检测
articles.abstract: The adoption of grazing-incidence wide-angle x-ray scattering (GIWAXS) has expanded rapidly, as it has proven invaluable for extracting a wealth of structural information from thin films and surfaces on the atomic and molecular scale. The amount of scattering data collected in such experiments creates new challenges associated with relatively slow conventional data analysis due to the need for human input. Existing machine learning-based Bragg-peak detection approaches have demonstrated the potential of automation, but significant challenges such as weak peaks, peaks on top of Debye–Scherrer rings, and difficulties in differentiating closely spaced peaks remain. We introduce a powerful model for GIWAXS peak detection based on a visual transformer that achieves a performance strongly surpassing existing models. We evaluate our new approach using a diverse set of labelled, experimental GIWAXS patterns from perovskite and organic thin films. Notably, we demonstrate for the first time the reliable detection of Bragg peaks superimposed on other peaks and Debye–Scherrer rings, a significant improvement in detecting low-intensity peaks and a substantially stronger overall performance. In addition, we evaluate both pre- and postprocessing latency, confirming that the overall analysis speed is sufficient for real-time applications. With its ability to deliver a fast and high-performance analysis, our approach enables new types of GIWAXS measurements, including closed-loop experiments, that were previously limited by analysis bottlenecks. The studied model could potentially also be applied to other datasets with a large dynamic range and weak signal-to-noise ratio.
articles.abstract_zh: 掠入射广角 X 射线散射已广泛用于解析薄膜和表面的原子/分子尺度结构，但海量数据和人工参与使传统分析效率受限。作者提出基于视觉 Transformer 的 GIWAXS 布拉格峰检测模型，并在钙钛矿和有机薄膜实验数据上验证其性能。该方法在弱峰、相互重叠峰以及叠加在德拜–谢乐环上的峰识别方面显著优于已有模型。
authors: Constantin Völter, Ainur Abukaev, Ekaterina Kneschaurek, Mikhail Romodin, Oleg Gorobtsov, Alexander Hinderhofer, Dmitry Lapkin and Frank Schreiber

articles.title: Calabi–Yau metrics with Kähler moduli dependence
articles.title_zh: 具有 Kähler 模依赖性的 Calabi–Yau 度量
articles.abstract: We present a method to construct approximate analytic expressions for Ricci-flat Kähler metrics on Calabi–Yau (CY) threefolds with explicit dependence on the Kähler moduli. Our strategy combines numerical data obtained from machine learning with an explicit analytic Ansatz for the Kähler potential and symbolic regression methods. Specifically, we use neural networks to learn the Kähler potential at selected points in Kähler moduli space, fit this data to analytic expressions with Kähler moduli-dependent parameters, and determine an analytic form of these coefficients as functions of the Kähler moduli using symbolic regression. In this way, we reconstruct closed-form approximations to the Ricci-flat metric that retain explicit Kähler-moduli dependence. We apply this method to two CY threefolds with , namely a bicubic hypersurface in and a bi-degree hypersurface in , both of which admit nontrivial discrete symmetry groups that simplify the structure of the metric. In both cases, the resulting analytic expressions reproduce the numerically learned Kähler potentials with percent-level accuracy and yield a Ricci-flatness measure that remains sufficiently small across the sampled region. Our results represent a concrete bridge between purely numerical results for CY metrics and analytic constructions, opening the door to a systematic study of their dependence on Kähler moduli.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种构造 Calabi–Yau 三维流形 Ricci 平坦 Kähler 度量近似解析表达式的方法，并显式保留 Kähler 模依赖性。方法结合神经网络学习、Kähler 势解析 Ansatz 和符号回归，在若干 Kähler 模空间采样点拟合解析形式。作者将其应用于两个具有非平凡离散对称性的 CY 三维流形，所得表达式以百分量级精度复现数值学习结果，并在采样区域内保持较小的 Ricci 平坦性误差。
authors: Andrei Constantin, Andre Lukas and Luca A Nutricati

articles.title: Universality and Dynamical Inequivalence in Isospectral Non-Hermitian Anderson Transitions
articles.title_zh: 等谱非厄米 Anderson 转变中的普适性与动力学不等价
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07714v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Hatano Nelson paradigm establishes that extensive bulk nonreciprocity can destabilize Anderson localization via an imaginary gauge flux. Here, we demonstrate that extensive nonreciprocity is not a necessary ingredient: a single non-Hermitian boundary bond in a disordered one-dimensional ring suffices to drive the localization-delocalization transition. More generally, we construct an exactly isospectral family of non-Hermitian Hamiltonians that continuously interpolates between the uniform Hatano Nelson model and the single-bond limit. We show that the universal critical behavior encompassing spectral, eigenstate, and topological diagnostics is gauge invariant and governed solely by the total imaginary gauge flux, regardless of its spatial distribution. Remarkably, despite sharing identical spectra and critical exponents, different configurations within this isospectral family exhibit qualitatively distinct quantum dynamics, establishing a fundamental separation between static and dynamical universality in non-Hermitian systems. Specifically, the single boundary realization features rapid operator scrambling, oscillatory wavepacket acceleration, and a double re-entrant steady state entanglement transition. Finally, we propose an experimentally feasible realization based on multi-terminal topological transport, providing a realistic route toward observing boundary induced non Hermitian criticality and its unconventional dynamical signatures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作表明，一维无序环中仅一个非厄米边界键即可驱动定位–退定位转变，广延体非互易性并非必要条件。作者构造了从均匀 Hatano–Nelson 模型连续插值到单键极限的严格等谱非厄米哈密顿量族。谱、波函数和拓扑诊断的临界行为只由总虚规范通量决定，而不同等谱构型可表现出定性不同的量子动力学，从而区分静态普适性与动力学普适性。
authors: Aziz Hasan, Anant Vijay Varma, Namit Anand, Sourin Das

articles.title: Second-harmonic signal in electric-field-modulated EPR spectra of Fe3 spin triangles
articles.title_zh: Fe3 自旋三角形电场调制 EPR 谱中的二次谐波信号
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present electric-field-modulated electron paramagnetic resonance (EFM-EPR) measurements on centrosymmetric single crystals of the molecular spin triangle mathrm[Fe₃O(O₂CPh)₆(py)₃]ClO₄ḑotpy (bfFe₃). We provide the first observation of second harmonic EFM-EPR signal in polynuclear magnetic molecules. This signal is simulated and explained in terms of an electric-field induced modulation of the isotropic exchange in the molecule, and of their symmetry lowering resulting from a Jahn-Teller effect. Additionally, an unexpected first harmonic EFM-EPR signal is observed. Various plausible symmetry-breaking mechanisms are discussed in an attempt to explain this feature, whose observation is unexpected in a nominally centrosymmetric crystal.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在中心对称单晶分子自旋三角形 [Fe3O(O2CPh)6(py)3]ClO4·py 中开展电场调制电子顺磁共振测量。研究首次在多核磁性分子中观测到二次谐波 EFM-EPR 信号，并将其归因于电场诱导的分子内各向同性交换调制及 Jahn–Teller 效应导致的对称性降低。实验还发现了意外的一次谐波信号，作者讨论了可能的对称性破缺机制。
authors: Jason S. R. McCoombs, Jorge I. Hilari, Jérôme Robert, Balwant Singh Chauhan, Ratnamala Chatterjee, Filippo Troiani, Athanassios K. Boudalis

articles.title: Axion-Induced Casimir Interaction Between Graphene Plates
articles.title_zh: 石墨烯板之间的轴子诱导 Casimir 相互作用
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07757v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Axion dark matter may induce observable electromagnetic effects in resonant cavity systems and potentially lead to modifications of the Casimir interaction. In this context, graphene represents an attractive platform owing to its tunable electromagnetic properties, and the fact that its electromagnetic response can be modelled microscopically from first principles within quantum field theory. The electromagnetic response induced by axion dark matter is investigated in a planar cavity consisting of parallel graphene interfaces in the presence of a homogeneous external magnetic field, incorporating finite temperature, chemical potential and dissipation through the graphene conductivity. Closed analytical expressions are obtained for the induced electric field and the resulting pressure. The pressure exhibits resonant enhancement at a series of plate separations satisfying dₙ₌₍₂π n-φ(r))/mₐ, where mₐ is the axion mass and the phase φ(r) is determined by the reflection coefficient r, which depends on the graphene conductivity evaluated at ømega=mₐ. The resonant structure is strongly influenced by the graphene chemical potential and damping parameter. In particular, increased doping, for example via a gate voltage, sharpens the resonances and amplifies the axion-induced signal. By comparing the resonantly enhanced signal with the conventional Casimir background, the parametric regimes in which the effect could become experimentally relevant are identified, with the strongest sensitivity obtained for highly doped low-dissipation graphene configurations operated near resonance. These results demonstrate that graphene-based Casimir-type configurations may provide a sensitive framework for probing axion-induced electromagnetic phenomena and highlight the interplay between axion electrodynamics, cavity resonances, and material properties in low-dimensional systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究轴子暗物质在外磁场下对平行石墨烯界面平面腔中电磁响应和 Casimir 压力的影响。模型纳入有限温度、化学势和耗散，并基于石墨烯电导率给出诱导电场与压力的解析表达式。结果显示压力在特定板间距处出现共振增强，其位置与轴子质量以及由石墨烯反射系数决定的相位有关，并受化学势和阻尼显著调控。
authors: Ahmad Alachkar, Philippe Brax, Pierre Brun

articles.title: Anisotropic vacancy-induced magnetization textures in altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交错磁体中空位诱导的各向异性磁化纹理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study magnetic textures induced by vacancies in altermagnets using microscopic simulations and low-energy field theory. We show that a vacancy generically produces a real-space anisotropic distortion of the magnetic order, whose structure encodes the symmetry of the underlying altermagnetic state. This impurity response offers a direct route to detecting altermagnetic order with locally resolved probes. We demonstrate this for both classical altermagnets, where vacancies generate anisotropic magnetization textures in a transverse magnetic field, and quantum models, where fluctuations induce longitudinal power-law decaying magnetic distortions even at zero field.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者结合微观模拟和低能场论研究交错磁体中空位缺陷诱导的磁纹理。结果表明，空位通常会产生实空间各向异性的磁序畸变，其结构编码了底层交错磁态的对称性。该缺陷响应可作为局域探针探测交错磁序的途径，并在经典模型和量子模型中分别表现为横向场下的各向异性磁化纹理及零场涨落诱导的纵向幂律衰减畸变。
authors: Ruben Burkard, Mathias S. Scheurer, Urban F. P. Seifert

articles.title: Quantum Dot Moiré from Crossed MoS2 Nanoribbons
articles.title_zh: 交叉 MoS2 纳米带形成的量子点莫尔结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07871v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted atomically thin layers have attracted much attention for Moiré potential and correlated quantum phenomena. However, existing Moiré superlattices have largely been limited to extensive wavefunction without lateral confinement. Here we introduce a new platform where 1D nanoribbons of 2D MoS2 grown by vapor deposition can be easily superposed at various angles from stacking and transferring, to form Moiré quantum dots at their intersections with unique exciton physics. Angle-dependent Moiré intersections show enhanced exciton emission at commensurate angle 22 deg, which demonstrates faster relaxation at the cryogenic temperature. A size-dependent study further exhibits a reduced exciton energy and soften out-of-plane interlayer coupling for smaller Moiré areas. Our results reveal exciton physics turnability via precise overlapping of 1D nanoribbons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种由气相沉积生长的一维 MoS2 纳米带交叉叠放形成莫尔量子点的平台。不同交叉角的莫尔交汇区表现出独特激子物理，其中 22° 公度角附近激子发光增强，并在低温下显示更快弛豫。尺寸依赖研究进一步表明，较小莫尔区域可降低激子能量并软化面外层间耦合。
authors: Xinting Shuai, Hao Zhang, Wenjing Wu, Chongning Wu, Maryam Amiri, T. A. M. Ragib Shahriar, Dian Pan, Zhi Kai Ng, Tymofii Pieshkov, Leeza Dutta, Yijun Zhou, Rohith Narra, Luke Van Leeuwen, Jishnu Murukeshan, Luyao Shi, Jiawei Lai, Atin Pramanik, Bipin Kumar Gupta, Edwin Hang Tong Teo, Robert Vajtai, Xiang Zhang, Hanyu Zhu, Shengxi Huang, Aditya D. Mohite, Pulickel M. Ajayan

articles.title: Directed assembly of tetrahedral patchy particles
articles.title_zh: 四面体斑块粒子的定向组装
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07877v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Colloidal particles with prescribed valency such as the tetrahedral patchy particles have long been seen as a viable route to technologically relevant open lattice structures on the scale of hundreds of nanometers. However, conceptual limitations and resulting competing local bonding configurations often lead to mixed lattice phases. Here, we present a DNA-origami enabled approach to controlling the attachment of tetrapod building blocks in predictable ways. By varying the relative strength of two designed binding configurations we are able to direct the assembly of tetrapod particles into diamond cubic, twinned diamonds, stacking-disordered mixtures, hexagonal diamonds, and sII clathrates. Under specific conditions, the diamond structures are interpenetrated by additional networks, resulting in triple cubic and triple hexagonal diamond structures. The 440 nm large unit cell of the clathrates shifts structural reflections into the visible range, giving these rationally designed, self-assembled crystals structural color.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种基于 DNA 折纸的策略，用于可预测地调控四足构件的连接方式，从而克服四面体斑块胶体组装中局域键合竞争导致的混相问题。通过调节两类设计结合构型的相对强度，作者实现了金刚石立方、孪晶金刚石、堆垛无序混合相、六方金刚石和 sII 笼形水合物结构等多种开放晶格。特定条件下还形成三重立方和三重六方金刚石互穿网络；笼形结构约 440 nm 的大晶胞将结构反射移入可见光范围，产生结构色。
authors: Xin Yin, Ekaterina Kostyurina, Bert Nickel, Tim Liedl, Gregor Posnjak

articles.title: Bulk Boundary Condition for Surface Calculations in Density Functional Theory
articles.title_zh: 密度泛函理论表面计算的体相边界条件
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07894v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a bulk boundary condition formalism for surface calculations in Kohn--Sham density functional theory. The approach exploits the nearsightedness of electronic interactions in real space to restrict the calculation to a localized surface region. Within this region, the electron density is evaluated by leveraging the decay of the density matrix, with bulk values imposed on the density and electrostatic potential in the interior, and the electrostatic potential solved subject to bulk boundary conditions. The energy and atomic forces are computed using density-matrix-based expressions. Through representative calculations of surface and adsorption energies, we demonstrate the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed formalism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出用于 Kohn–Sham 密度泛函理论表面计算的体相边界条件形式化方法，利用实空间电子相互作用的近视性，将计算限制在局域表面区域。方法在区域内部对电子密度和静电势施加体相值，并基于密度矩阵衰减求取电子密度、能量与原子力。通过表面能和吸附能等代表性算例，作者展示了该形式在精度和效率上的优势。
authors: Sayan Bhowmik, Andrew J Medford, Phanish Suryanarayana

articles.title: Gate induced strain on a two-dimensional hole gas in silicon
articles.title_zh: 硅二维空穴气中的栅极诱导应变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07932v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show the effect of gate-induced strain on the valence band of a silicon (Si) metal oxide semiconductor (MOS) confined two-dimensional hole gas (2DHG). Increasing aluminum gate thickness, and thereby the strain in the channel, results in the onset of a second subband contributing to Shubnikov-de Haas oscillations. Temperature-dependent magnetotransport measurements reveal distinct cyclotron masses of m_c^*=(0.36±0.04)m₀ and m_c^*=(0.49±0.02)m₀. The measured cyclotron masses differ from those expected for an idealized heavy-hole (HH)/light-hole (LH) picture, reflecting the combined influence of quantum confinement, strain, and HH-LH mixing on the valence band.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了铝栅极诱导应变对硅 MOS 结构中受限二维空穴气价带的影响。随着铝栅厚度增加、沟道应变增强，Shubnikov–de Haas 振荡中出现第二子带贡献；温度依赖磁输运给出两个不同回旋质量，分别为约 0.36m₀ 和 0.49m₀。实测回旋质量偏离理想重空穴/轻空穴图像，说明量子限域、应变及 HH-LH 混合共同重塑价带结构。
authors: D. van der Bovenkamp, C. S. A. Müller, B. D. Pantiru, I. Bošnjak, M. Cignoni, Q. Torrent Nicolau, M. E. Bal, S. Wiedmann, J. Ridderbos, F. A. Zwanenburg

articles.title: Tunable Emergent Gauge Fields from Skyrmions in a Quasicrystalline Lattice
articles.title_zh: 准晶格中斯格明子产生的可调涌现规范场
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07948v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study magnetic skyrmions in a two-dimensional quasicrystalline lattice using a classical Heisenberg model with Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya interactions and an external magnetic field. The competition between the skyrmion-skyrmion repulsion and an emergent quasiperiodic pinning landscape gives rise to a sequence of distinct skyrmion lattice configurations as a function of field. The resulting hierarchy of quasiperiodic pinning potentials, characterized by closely spaced quasi-degenerate minima, enables a quasi-continuous suppression of the skyrmion density as the saturation field is approached, in sharp contrast to the strongly first-order collapse of skyrmion crystals on periodic lattices. This provides a direct mechanism for controlling the topological charge and, consequently, the emergent gauge field for itinerant electrons. As a consequence, the Hall conductivity can be strongly modified with small changes in the magnetic field and driven smoothly to zero near saturation. This field-controlled tunability, rooted in the underlying multistability, identifies quasicrystalline magnets as a platform for tunable topological textures, with potential applications in magnetic memory and magnetoelectronic response.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在二维准晶格上研究含 Dzyaloshinskii–Moriya 相互作用和外磁场的经典 Heisenberg 模型中的磁斯格明子。斯格明子间排斥与准周期钉扎景观竞争，随磁场产生一系列不同的斯格明子晶格构型；准简并钉扎势极小值的层级结构使斯格明子密度在接近饱和场时可近连续降低，而非周期晶格中常见的强一阶坍缩。由此可通过磁场调控拓扑电荷和传导电子感受到的涌现规范场，使霍尔电导对小磁场变化高度敏感并在饱和附近平滑趋零。
authors: Leandro M. Chinellato, Flavia A. Gómez Albarracín, Cristian D. Batista, Pablo S. Cornaglia

articles.title: Equilibrium in a Reaction Network of Assemblies
articles.title_zh: 组装体反应网络中的平衡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07959v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study a mean-field reaction network whose species are assemblies built from identical atoms by reversible coagulation and fragmentation. Each assembly is an ordered binary tree, so the number of species of a given length grows combinatorially, as the Catalan numbers. The model nonetheless admits an explicit equilibrium and tractable stochastic dynamics. A finite volume V sets a crossover length l_c sim łn V that splits the equilibrium into two sectors. Below l_c each assembly occurs in many copies and the rank-frequency distribution is Zipf-like; above l_c individual species are rare and fluctuation-dominated. The statistical weight of the rare sector decays slowly with volume, controlling the finite-size scaling of diversity, Shannon entropy, and other assembly-weighted observables. The equilibrium also admits a transparent grand-canonical description in terms of a bond energy and an atomic chemical potential. Together these results make the model a controlled neutral baseline against which selection and driving in richer assembly networks can be measured.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究由相同原子通过可逆凝聚与碎裂形成组装体的平均场反应网络，其中每个组装体为有序二叉树，给定长度的物种数按 Catalan 数组合增长。尽管物种空间巨大，模型仍具有显式平衡解和可处理的随机动力学；有限体积 V 引入交叉长度 l_c 约为 ln V，将平衡分为多拷贝、Zipf 型频率分布的短组装体区，以及稀有且由涨落主导的长组装体区。稀有区权重随体积缓慢衰减，并控制多样性、Shannon 熵等量的有限尺寸标度；该模型可作为评估更复杂组装网络中选择与驱动效应的中性基准。

articles.title: Observation of giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in superconductor-ferromagnet hybrids
articles.title_zh: 超导体–铁磁体杂化体系中巨大的非易失磁热开关观测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08005v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magneto-thermal switch is a crucial thermal component which enables heat transfer control by the application of an external magnetic field. Recently, a nonvolatile behavior in magneto-thermal conductivity at zero magnetic field was observed in type-II and phase-separated superconductors owing to magnetic flux pinning nature, leading to an energy-efficient thermal control technology. However, the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching ratio has been much lower than the volatile one in conventional materials. Here, we demonstrate a giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching in ferromagnetic Fe-superconducting Pb hybrids. The dispersion of pure Fe particles realizes increased electron and decreased phonon contributions in the thermal conductivity, which enhances the magneto-thermal switching ratio at the superconducting-to-normal conducting phase transition. Furthermore, in concert with trapped magnetic flux by supercurrent, ferromagnetic moment of Fe breaks the superconductivity of Pb matrix at zero magnetic field, enabling a significantly large nonvolatility even with a slight amount of Fe inclusions. Consequently, the nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching ratio reaches 719% in maximum at the Fe ratio of 8.7 vol%, which is more than twice the previous record value observed in Pb-Sn composites and the volatile one in pure Pb. This work broadens the exploration space and strategy for giant nonvolatile magneto-thermal switching materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在铁磁 Fe–超导 Pb 杂化体系中展示了巨大的非易失磁热开关效应，面向低能耗热流控制。纯 Fe 颗粒的弥散同时增强电子热导贡献并降低声子热导贡献，从而在超导–正常导电相变附近放大磁热开关比。Fe 的铁磁矩与超电流俘获磁通协同作用，可在零外磁场下破坏 Pb 基体超导性，使少量 Fe 掺入也能产生显著非易失性。
authors: Yui Sakamoto, Fuyuki Ando, Keigo Ito, Hossein Sepehri-Amin, Takamasa Hirai, Yuto Watanabe, Poonam Rani, Yoshikazu Mizuguchi, Ken-ichi Uchida

articles.title: Interfacial chirality-induced magnetic-field-free switching with high energy efficiency in all-vdW heterostructures
articles.title_zh: 全范德华异质结构中界面手性诱导的高能效无磁场翻转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08023v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chirality, a central concept across many scientific disciplines, continues to inspire the discovery of novel physical phenomena. In condensed matter physics, structural chirality - defined by the absence of mirror plane symmetries - has primarily been explored in bulk materials. However, new chiral phenomena can emerge uniquely at the interface, distinct from their bulk counterparts, when a chiral material forms a heterostructure. Here, we demonstrate that all van-der-Waals (vdW) heterostructure composed of the chiral Co1/3TaS2 and the achiral vdW ferromagnet Fe3GeTe2 exhibits two distinct and unconventional spin-orbit torques originating from the interfacial chirality. These torques enable magnetic-field-free switching of perpendicular magnetization with ultralow current density ~ 10⁶ A/cm² and minimal power dissipation < 10¹⁵ W/m³. Moreover, by replacing Fe3GeTe2 with a similar vdW ferromagnet, Fe3GaTe2, but of higher Curie temperature, we achieved the magnetic-field-free switching at room temperature in the Fe3GaTe2/Co1/3TaS2 vdW heterostructure. Our findings establish interfacial chirality as a powerful new handle for spintronic control, opening a new pathway to explore chirality-induced phenomena beyond the bulk symmetry constraints - and paving the way toward highly efficient, low-power spintronic devices based on all-vdW heterostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究证明，由手性 Co1/3TaS2 与非手性范德华铁磁体 Fe3GeTe2 构成的全范德华异质结构中，界面手性可产生两类非常规自旋轨道力矩。它们实现了垂直磁化的无外磁场翻转，所需电流密度约为 10⁶ A/cm²，功率耗散低于 10¹⁵ W/m³。进一步将 Fe3GeTe2 替换为居里温度更高的 Fe3GaTe2 后，Fe3GaTe2/Co1/3TaS2 异质结构在室温下也实现了无磁场翻转，表明界面手性是调控自旋电子器件的有效自由度。
authors: Kai-Xuan Zhang, Suik Cheon, Seungbok Lee, Joonyoung Choi, Jihoon Keum, Hyuncheol Kim, Yeochan An, Woonghee Cho, Suhan Son, Jingyuan Cui, Pyeongjae Park, Younjung Jo, Jun Sung Kim, Hyun-Woo Lee, Je-Geun Park

articles.title: Active Particles Imprint Persistent Percolating Networks in Polymer Condensates
articles.title_zh: 活性粒子在聚合物凝聚体中写入持久贯通网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Fluid condensates readily exchange components and reorganize, and in doing so typically erase structural history. Using simulations of sticker-spacer polymers in an active particle bath, we show that activity drives condensates from compact droplets into system-spanning percolated networks by enhancing interchain connectivity, suppressing intrachain collapse, and increasing topological constraints through interchain winding. The network persists after the active particles are removed, despite continued polymer exchange and contact turnover, revealing a fluid-like state with activity-induced topological imprinting. Hence, activity can write long-lived structural organization and memory into fluid condensates.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者通过贴体–间隔体聚合物处于活性粒子浴中的模拟，研究活性如何改变流体凝聚体的结构记忆。活性将紧凑液滴驱动为跨越体系的渗流网络，其机制包括增强链间连接、抑制链内塌缩，并通过链间缠绕增加拓扑约束。即使移除活性粒子后，聚合物交换与接触更新仍持续发生，该网络仍能保持，说明活性可在流体凝聚体中写入长寿命拓扑印记和结构记忆。
authors: Ligesh Theeyancheri, Jennifer L. Ross, J. M. Schwarz

articles.title: Helically Enhanced Chiroptical Response and Symmetry Breaking in Conjugated Polymers
articles.title_zh: 共轭聚合物中螺旋增强的手性光学响应与对称性破缺
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral π-conjugated polymers are an attractive material platform for spin polarized carrier-transport and spectroscopy, but fundamental considerations for how torsional disorder influences the response properties of the material have not been considered. Here we combine atomistic electronic structure modeling with with experimental spectroscopic measurements to examine symmetry breaking in the prototypical π-conjugated polymer polyacetylene, (CH)ₓ. Chiral (CH)ₓ oligomers are generated in distinct conformations which differ in their out-of-plane tonsorial ordering. We find that a helical conformation introduces orders of magnitude enhanced chiroptical activity due to a solenoid effect. This effect is visualized by the Transition Chiral Tensor analysis which shows signatures of domain ordering which eliminates destructive interference between electric and magnetic contributions. These findings highlight the capability to develop a hierarchical interpretation relating local, fragment symmetry breaking to global, nonlocal interactions governing chiroptical response in emerging chiral materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作结合原子尺度电子结构建模与实验光谱，研究原型 π 共轭聚合物聚乙炔中扭转无序和构象手性对光学响应的影响。作者构造了具有不同面外扭转有序性的手性聚乙炔寡聚体，发现螺旋构象可通过类似螺线管的效应使手性光学活性提高数个数量级。跃迁手性张量分析显示，畴有序可消除电偶极与磁偶极贡献之间的相消干涉，从而连接局域片段对称性破缺与全局非局域手性光学响应。
authors: Aaron Forde, Braden M. Weight, Prashanna Poudel, Avadh Saxena, Zeev Valy Vardeny, Christoph Boehme, Alan Bishop, Sergei Tretiak

articles.title: Perpendicular magnetic anisotropy tuning of macrospin-to-vortex transitions in Co-based artificial spin-vortex ice
articles.title_zh: Co 基人工自旋–涡旋冰中垂直磁各向异性对宏自旋到涡旋转变的调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08097v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the macrospin-to-vortex (MS-to-V) transition in Co-based artificial spin-vortex ice (ASVI) in the presence of perpendicular magnetic anisotropy (PMA) by spin-wave spectroscopy. Detailed micromagnetic simulations using mumax3 reveal that the PMA modifies the magnetic energy landscape and facilitates vortex formation, suggesting that PMA can enhance the transition probability. To seek experimental validation of this hypothesis, we prepared Ti (3 nm)/Co (10 nm)/Ti (3 nm)/Pt (2 nm) (TCT) and Ti (3 nm)/Co (10 nm)/Pt (2 nm) (TCP) multilayer stacks. Vibrating sample magnetometry measurements confirm that the TCP film exhibits a larger PMA than the TCT film. Using these stacks, we then investigate the MS-to-V transition probability in ASVIs and found that TCP ASVIs exhibit a higher transition probability than TCT ASVIs, in agreement with the simulation prediction. These findings identify PMA as an effective design parameter for controlling vortex formation in ASVIs and provide a promising route toward task-dependent tuning of fading-memory properties for physical reservoir computing based on artificial spin lattices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用自旋波谱和微磁模拟考察 Co 基人工自旋–涡旋冰中垂直磁各向异性对宏自旋到涡旋转变的影响。mumax3 模拟表明，垂直磁各向异性会改变磁能量景观并促进涡旋形成，从而提高转变概率。实验上，具有更强垂直磁各向异性的 Ti/Co/Pt 多层结构相较 Ti/Co/Ti/Pt 显示出更高的转变概率，与模拟一致；这为按任务调控人工自旋晶格的淡忘记忆特性和物理储备池计算提供了设计参数。
authors: Yu Maruyama (Kyoto Univ), Amrit Kumar Mondal (Univ. Delaware), Bijaya Kharel (Univ. Delaware), Ryo Ohshima (Kyoto Univ, CSRN, Kyoto Univ), Jorge Puebla (Kyoto Univ, CSRN, Kyoto Univ), M. Benjamin Jungfleisch (Univ. Delaware), Masashi Shiraishi (Kyoto Univ)

articles.title: Scalable Simulation of Strongly Correlated Electron-Phonon Systems via Non-Gaussian Matrix Product States
articles.title_zh: 基于非高斯矩阵乘积态的强关联电子–声子体系可扩展模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08176v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate strongly correlated electron-phonon (e-ph) systems via a non-Gaussian matrix product state method. By combining non-Gaussian states with matrix product states, our method efficiently characterizes the intractable entanglement between strongly correlated electrons and phononic modes of unbounded Hilbert space, enabling scalable simulations across broad parameter regimes. In one-dimensional generalized Hubbard--Holstein (HH) models, we identify a pronounced tendency toward phase separation (PS), an instability relevant to recent angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy observations on doped cuprate chain. In two-dimensional HH models, we construct the phase diagram at half-filling featuring a metallic phase emerging from the competition between non-local phonon-mediated attraction and local Hubbard repulsion. Upon doping, we elucidate the role of soft phonons in stabilizing stripe phases. In the antiferromagnet, the stabilization of the fully filled stripe is attributed to a local retardation effect, wherein the charge order is pinned by phonons, leading to a diminished response to spin fluctuations. In the doped charge-density-wave regime, a novel bipolaronic stripe phase with an enlarged unit cell is stabilized via a non-local retardation effect, where long-range phonon-mediated interactions suppress PS. Our work establishes a systematic route to decoding the e-ph interplay that is crucial for superconductivity.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出将非高斯态与矩阵乘积态结合的方法，用于模拟强关联电子–声子体系，并有效处理电子与无界声子 Hilbert 空间之间的复杂纠缠。在一维广义 Hubbard–Holstein 模型中，作者发现明显的相分离倾向，与近期掺杂铜氧化物链的角分辨光电子谱观测相关。二维半填充模型中构建了相图，显示非局域声子介导吸引与局域 Hubbard 排斥竞争可诱导金属相；掺杂后，软声子有助于稳定条纹相，并通过局域延迟效应钉扎电荷有序。

articles.title: Phase stability and ionic transport in post-spinel CaV₂O₄ cathode
articles.title_zh: 后尖晶石 CaV₂O₄ 正极中的相稳定性与离子输运
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08224v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Calcium-ion batteries (CBs) represent an alternative to lithium-ion technology but their advancement is limited by the lack of high-performance intercalation cathodes. Identified via computational screening, post-spinel CaV₂O₄ has emerged as a promising candidate, though its practical application is hindered by limited electrochemical capacity. Hence, we investigate the thermodynamic and ionic transport characteristics of CaₓV₂O₄ (0 łeq x łeq 1) in this work, by integrating the cluster expansion formalism with Monte Carlo simulations and density functional theory based calculations. We construct the temperature-composition phase diagram of CaₓV₂O₄ revealing several stable phases (α through ζ) that can appear during electrochemical operations at different voltages. Importantly, we observe the formation of the ǎrepsilon phase at x sim 0.83 across a 370-590~K temperature window via invariant reactions, which agrees with observations in the experimental voltage profiles. Further, migration barrier calculations confirm that Ca mobility is severely impeded within the α (x sim 0) and γ (x sim 0.5) phases. With the strong Ca-vacancy ordering contributing to the high barrier in γ and the persistent two-phase region stretching across the δ (x sim 0.67) and the γ phases, we expect the accessible electrochemical capacity in the CaV₂O₄ system to be kinetically limited to at most half the theoretical capacity at 298~K, in agreement with experiments. Strategies including cation doping and particle size reduction can be considered to flatten the potential energy landscape of γ and improve Ca mobility. Our computational findings highlight the interplay between stability and transport and provide design strategies that can enable the practical use of CaV₂O₄ as a CB cathode.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对钙离子电池候选正极后尖晶石 CaV₂O₄，结合团簇展开、Monte Carlo 模拟和密度泛函理论，研究 CaₓV₂O₄（0≤x≤1）的热力学相稳定性与 Ca 离子迁移。作者构建了温度–组成相图，揭示电化学过程中可能出现的多个稳定相，并发现 x 约 0.83 的 ε 相可在约 370–590 K 温区通过不变反应形成，与实验电压曲线特征相符。迁移势垒计算表明，α 相（x 约 0）和 γ 相（x 约 0.5）中 Ca 迁移受到严重阻碍，强 Ca–空位有序可能是容量受限的重要原因。
authors: Dereje Bekele Tekliye, Javeed Ahmad Dar, Gopalakrishnan Sai Gautam

articles.title: Anomalous Reflection of Caustic Spin-Wave Beams in a Magnonic Waveguide
articles.title_zh: 磁振子波导中焦散自旋波束的反常反射
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08295v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reflection of waves at interfaces is conventionally governed by Snell's law, which follows from conservation of momentum parallel to the interface. Here we show experimentally that caustic spin-wave beams in anisotropic media obey a fundamentally different reflection mechanism. Applying time-resolved Kerr microscopy to a yttrium iron garnet waveguide, we observe that reflected beams are selected by transitions between caustic points on the anisotropic iso-frequency contour rather than by momentum conservation. As a consequence, the reflected carrier wave vector and wavefront orientation exhibit trends opposite to those predicted by Snell's law. By tuning the magnitude and orientation of an external magnetic field, we continuously control the resulting reflection process and beam routing. Our results establish caustic-point transitions as a distinct reflection law for anisotropic wave beams and provide a route towards reconfigurable magnonic beam steering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在钇铁石榴石波导中用时间分辨克尔显微术观测到，各向异性介质中的焦散自旋波束并不按传统斯涅尔定律反射。反射束由等频轮廓上的焦散点之间的跃迁选择，而非由界面平行动量守恒决定，导致反射载波波矢和波前取向呈现与斯涅尔定律相反的趋势。通过调节外磁场大小和方向，作者实现了对反射过程和波束路由的连续控制，为可重构磁振子束操控提供了机制。

articles.title: Magnetic control of Goos-Hänchen shifts and group delay time in monolayer WSe₂
articles.title_zh: 单层 WSe₂ 中 Goos-Hänchen 位移与群延迟时间的磁场调控
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the influence of an external magnetic field on the Goos-Hänchen (GH) shift and the group delay time (GDT) in monolayer WSe₂ in the presence of a magnetic barrier. The transport properties of Dirac-like carriers are obtained by solving the effective low-energy Hamiltonian and evaluating the corresponding transmission amplitudes. The GH shift and the GDT are subsequently extracted from the phase of the transmission coefficient. We systematically analyze their dependence on the magnetic field strength, incident energy, angle of incidence, and barrier width, with particular emphasis on the spin and valley degrees of freedom associated with the K and K' valleys. Our results show that the magnetic barrier strongly modulates both the GH shift and the GDT, leading to oscillatory behavior and pronounced spin-valley-dependent transport characteristics. Remarkably, the magnetic field enables selective control of the lateral shift and traversal time of carriers for each spin and valley channel, allowing for tunable spatial and temporal separation of electronic wave packets. This provides a mechanism for manipulating fermionic trajectories after transmission through the barrier in a highly controllable manner. Such tunability opens promising avenues for designing nanoscale devices based on spin and valley filtering, as well as for potential applications in information storage and processing within spintronic and valleytronic platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究外磁场和磁势垒对单层 WSe₂ 中类狄拉克载流子的 Goos-Hänchen 位移与群延迟时间的影响。作者通过求解低能有效哈密顿量并由透射振幅相位提取横向位移和延迟时间，系统分析磁场强度、入射能量、入射角和势垒宽度的作用。结果表明磁势垒可强烈调制二者并产生振荡行为，且具有明显自旋-谷依赖性，从而可选择性控制不同自旋和谷通道电子波包的空间与时间分离。
authors: Youssef Fattasse, Rachid El Aitouni, Miloud Mekkaoui, Pablo Díaz, David Laroze, Ahmed Jellal

articles.title: Bond, orbital and spin order in d4/d6/d7 perovskite oxides: successes and limitations of foundation interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: d4/d6/d7 钙钛矿氧化物中的键、轨道与自旋有序：基础型原子间势的成功与局限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08351v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Foundation machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) are rapidly replacing density-functional theory (DFT) for modeling structure and nuclear dynamics, making their fidelity in strongly correlated systems an urgent question. We test three foundation potentials on the low-temperature order of three correlated, isostructural ABO3 perovskite oxides: LaMnO3 (d4), LaCoO3 (d6), and NdNiO3 (d7). We run molecular dynamics for 1 ns on 80- and 160-atom supercells from 50 to 300 K with no system-specific training. These oxides expose three distinct classes of low-temperature order that define a hierarchy of difficulty for the potentials. The scalar class, represented by NdNiO3, has a simple geometric fingerprint and is captured. The vector class, represented by LaMnO3, requires identifying which Cartesian axis carries the long bond at each site, and is captured in magnitude but not in symmetry. The on-site class, represented by the low-spin to high-spin crossover in LaCoO3, is a purely local multiplet population shift with no spatial order parameter and remains inaccessible to present-day MLIPs.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估三种基础型机器学习原子间势在强关联同构 ABO₃ 钙钛矿 LaMnO₃、LaCoO₃ 和 NdNiO₃ 低温有序问题上的可靠性，未进行体系专门训练。分子动力学结果显示，具有简单几何指纹的 NdNiO₃ 标量型有序可被捕捉；LaMnO₃ 中需识别长键方向的矢量型有序可在幅值上再现，但对称性描述不足。LaCoO₃ 的低自旋到高自旋交叉属于纯局域多重态占据变化，缺乏空间序参量，当前机器学习势尚难处理。
authors: Swagata Acharya, Dimitar Pashov, Mark van Schilfgaarde, Alin M. Elena

articles.title: Signature in sound-mode of the exciton bilayer two-dimensional superfluid transition
articles.title_zh: 激子双层二维超流转变的声模特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08353v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Obtaining definitive evidence of exciton superfluidity in electron-hole bilayers in zero magnetic field remains a major longstanding challenge since the condensate is electrically neutral, making its phase coherence difficult to detect directly. We show that the Anderson-Bogoliubov sound velocity provides a dynamical signature of exciton superfluidity. Across the BCS-BEC crossover, the velocity is known to discontinuously drop to zero at the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) transition. The magnitude of the drop has a strong density dependence. We compute this behavior, with the inclusion of finite-temperature screening, and determine the BKT transition using a renormalization-group approach. We further identify a temperature window which is experimentally accessible, where vortex-antivortex excitations strongly renormalize both the sound velocity and the transition temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论工作提出 Anderson-Bogoliubov 声速可作为零磁场电子-空穴双层中激子超流的动力学证据。作者计算 BCS-BEC 跨越区内声速在 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 转变处不连续降为零的行为，并考虑有限温度屏蔽及重整化群确定的转变温度。结果指出声速跃降幅度具有显著密度依赖，并存在实验可达的温度窗口，其中涡旋-反涡旋激发会强烈重整化声速和转变温度。
authors: Giovanni Midei, Filippo Pascucci, Milorad V. Milosevìc, Jacques Tempere, David Neilson, Andrea Perali

articles.title: Bright and Dark Excitons in CrSBr: Local Ligand-Field Character and Band-Coherent Optical Selection Rules
articles.title_zh: CrSBr 中的亮、暗激子：局域配体场特征与能带相干光学选择定则
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08355v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic van der Waals semiconductors such as CrSBr host an intricate exciton landscape whose physical interpretation has converged only recently. A many-body Feynman diagrammatic approach based on quasiparticle self-consistent GW with electron-hole ladder vertex corrections to the screened Coulomb interaction has established the electronic band gap, excitonic orbital character, real-space extent, binding energies, and bosonic-coupling signatures of the bright XA exciton near 1.34 eV and the higher XB manifold near 1.8 eV. These results agree well with ARPES and magneto-optical experiments and supersede the early Rydberg-like assignment of the excitons. What has remained unresolved is why these intense bright excitons coexist, within a few tens of meV, with companion states that are several orders of magnitude darker despite drawing from essentially the same single-particle transition manifold. Here we show that brightness is a band-coherent property of the excitonic eigenfunctions: bright and dark partners are sublattice-symmetric and sublattice-antisymmetric superpositions of the same ligand-field-like Bloch transitions across the two Cr atoms of the orthorhombic primitive cell. The commonly used Frenkel and Wannier-Mott labels describe what an exciton is made of, but brightness requires a symmetry-adapted interference rule between transition dipoles. Disentangling this bare excitonic structure is a prerequisite for interpreting the optical response of CrSBr once magnon, phonon, and photon couplings are included.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对磁性范德华半导体 CrSBr 中强亮激子与能量相近但暗得多的伴随态共存问题，基于准粒子自洽 GW 和含电子-空穴梯形顶角修正的多体方法进行解释。作者指出亮暗性质不是单个跃迁的简单属性，而是激子本征函数的能带相干性质：亮态和暗态分别对应同一配体场型布洛赫跃迁在不同子晶格对称性下的相干叠加。该图像解释了约 1.34 eV 的 XA 亮激子和约 1.8 eV 的 XB 激子流形附近暗伴随态的光学选择规则差异。
authors: Swagata Acharya, Jessica McDivitt, Dimitar Pashov, Mark van Schilfgaarde, Justin C. Johnson, Jeffrey L. Blackburn

articles.title: Polycrystalline ferroelectric croconic acid for multisource environmental energy harvesting
articles.title_zh: 用于多源环境能量收集的多晶铁电方酸薄膜
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The development of organic ferroelectric materials through scalable and simplified fabrication routes remains a major challenge for next-generation energy-harvesting technologies. Here, polycrystalline croconic acid (CA) thin films are fabricated by vacuum sublimation onto Ar plasma-treated flexible substrates and stabilized by in situ encapsulation with an adamantane-based remote plasma polymer. This solvent-free strategy effectively suppresses surface degradation under ambient conditions, providing long-term stability. Piezoresponse force microscopy confirms robust ferroelectricity with an oblique polarization orientation, well-defined domains, and low nanoscale coercive fields. The films were integrated into multilayer piezoelectric and pyroelectric devices. The piezoelectric performance strongly depends on film thickness, while embedding the CA layer between dielectric polymeric films significantly improves the macroscopic response, reaching power densities of up to 37 microW m-2 for ca. 2 micrometer CA films. Despite the common assumption that high crystallinity is required to sustain ferro-, piezo-, and pyroelectricity, these polycrystalline CA films exhibit remarkable RT pyroelectricity, a property not previously demonstrated in CA-based devices. A pyroelectric coefficient of ca. 10 microC m-2 K-1 highlights a functional response comparable to that of well-established organic and inorganic pyroelectric materials, demonstrating the potential of CA thin films for thermal energy harvesting. Beyond their functional performance, the proposed low-T fabrication route combines deposition and encapsulation in a single in situ process, simplifying device fabrication. Its compatibility with scalable vacuum technologies, flexible substrates, and further process optimization makes this approach highly promising for developing low-cost, lead-free, multisource energy-harvesting systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作通过真空升华在 Ar 等离子体处理的柔性衬底上制备多晶方酸薄膜，并以金刚烷基远程等离子体聚合物原位封装，实现无溶剂、可扩展且抗环境退化的有机铁电薄膜制备路线。压电响应力显微术显示薄膜具有稳定铁电性、倾斜极化取向、清晰畴结构和较低纳米尺度矫顽场。器件测试表明压电性能强烈依赖膜厚，将方酸层嵌入介电聚合物层可显著增强宏观响应，约 2 微米薄膜功率密度最高可达 37 μW m⁻²，并显示多晶有机铁电材料也可用于压电/热释电能量收集。
authors: Gloria P. Moreno-Martínez, Hari K. Mishra, Xabier García-Casas, María Alcaire, Vanda Godinho, Juan R. Sanchez-Valencia, Ana Borras, Angel Barranco

articles.title: Theoretical exploration of Be Ag(II) F phases and their magnetic properties using learning algorithms
articles.title_zh: 利用学习算法理论探索 Be-Ag(II)-F 相及其磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08372v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The search for novel silver(II) fluorides is driven by their potential as electronic and magnetic analogues to high temperature cuprate(II) superconductor precursors. Here, we explore the previously uncharted Be Ag(II) F chemical space using global structure prediction algorithms combined with first principles calculations. Focusing on the AgBeF4 stoichiometry, we identify the five lowest enthalpy polymorphs crystallizing in the C2, P minus 1, and P 21/c space groups. All polymorphs show an antiferromagnetic ground state, with AgBeF4₄ and AgBeF4₅ exhibiting unprecedented strong superexchange interactions of J equal circa to minus 460meV and J equal circa to minus 359meV respectively. Those high J values are due to the presence of either [Ag2F7] for AgBeF4₄, or related infinite [AgF2/2+2/1]2 minus chains for AgBeF4₅. Although the phases are found to be metastable with respect to binary difluorides, the thermodynamic analysis suggests that they could be targeted via synthetic routes employing fluorine radicals, with reaction enthalpies reaching minus 370 kJ/mol.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究用全局结构预测算法结合第一性原理计算探索此前未系统研究的 Be-Ag(II)-F 化学空间，重点关注 AgBeF₄ 化学计量比。作者确定了五种最低焓多晶型，空间群包括 C2、P-1 和 P2₁/c，均以反铁磁态为基态。部分结构因含有 [Ag₂F₇] 单元或相关无限链而表现出异常强的超交换相互作用，J 约为 -460 meV 和 -359 meV；尽管相对于二氟化物为亚稳，相图热力学表明借助氟自由基路线可能具有合成可行性。

articles.title: Quantum weight and low-loss EELS signatures of Wannier quantum geometry in black phosphorus
articles.title_zh: 黑磷中 Wannier 量子几何的量子权重与低损 EELS 特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08438v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum geometry is now experimentally accessible in crystalline solids, with black phosphorus providing a key platform through polarization-resolved angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy. We develop a first-principles framework that connects the momentum-resolved quantum metric of black phosphorus to a complementary bulk observable: the direction-resolved quantum weight measurable through low-loss electron energy-loss spectroscopy (EELS). A 32-band DFT--Wannier Hamiltonian is used to compute both single-band and occupied-manifold geometric quantities from analytic momentum derivatives. We show that the raw single-band quantum metric of the top valence band is not globally meaningful in the conventional cell because folding degeneracies and intra-valence near degeneracies produce true isolated-band singularities; masked maps and occupied-manifold projectors are therefore essential. Because semilocal PBE produces near-gap semimetallic pockets and spurious subgap interpolation features, we introduce an experimentally motivated restricted quantum weight Kᵢᵢ(ømega_c), which obeys the corresponding restricted Souza--Wilkens--Martin sum rule and is the appropriate quantity for low-loss EELS once the zero-loss region is excluded. The restricted in-plane quantum weight is nearly isotropic, Kzz/Kₓₓ=0.972±0.005 (armchair/zigzag), despite the strong band-mass anisotropy and armchair-only absorption onset of black phosphorus. Orbital-resolved Hubbard--Hartree corrections leave the absolute quantum weights rigid at the sub-percent level while producing a small but resolved armchair-directed drift of Kzz/Kₓₓ, approximately +0.46% per eV of U. These results identify low-loss EELS spectral moments as a practical probe of integrated quantum geometry in an anisotropic layered material.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作建立第一性原理框架，将黑磷动量分辨量子度量与可由低损电子能量损失谱测量的方向分辨量子权重联系起来。作者基于 32 带 DFT-Wannier 哈密顿量和解析动量导数计算单带及占据流形的几何量，指出常规晶胞中价带顶单带量子度量因折叠简并和近简并存在真实奇异性，需采用掩膜图和占据流形投影。由于半局域 PBE 会产生近带隙半金属口袋和伪亚带隙特征，作者引入实验导向的受限量子权重，以更稳健地连接 Wannier 量子几何与 EELS 响应。

articles.title: Influence of electronic correlations on disorder-induced loop currents in high-Tc superconductors
articles.title_zh: 电子关联对高温超导体中无序诱导环流的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Time-reversal symmetry breaking in superconducting systems can manifest itself in the form of currents which are induced by inhomogeneities in the charge and order parameter distribution. With regard to cuprates such states have been theoretically studied in the overdoped region of the phase diagram where the inhomogeneities are related to out-of plane dopants. In this paper we will extend previous work by including local correlations within the unrestricted Gutzwiller approximation in order to study its impact on the induced loop currents. In addition, we investigate the effect of next-nearest neighbor hopping which extends the TRSB phase towards half-filling. We find that in general correlations lead to a suppression of loop currents, however, the Gutzwiller approach can sustain such states to larger values of the local on-site repulsion as compared to the Hartree-Fock approximation. Our investigations allow for an estimation of the local magnetic moment emerging from impurity-induced loop currents for cuprate superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察高温铜氧化物超导体中由电荷和序参量非均匀性诱导的时间反演对称性破缺环流，并在非限制 Gutzwiller 近似中纳入局域关联。作者还分析了次近邻跃迁的作用，发现其可将时间反演对称性破缺相向半填充方向扩展。总体上电子关联会抑制环流，但相较 Hartree-Fock 近似，Gutzwiller 处理可在更大的局域库仑排斥下维持此类态，并据此估算杂质诱导环流产生的局域磁矩。

articles.title: The charge density fluctuations and the Shrinking Fermi Liquid scenario for strange metallicity in cuprates
articles.title_zh: 电荷密度涨落与铜氧化物奇异金属性的收缩费米液体图像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08476v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We interpret the strange metal (SM) properties of slightly overdoped cuprates in terms of the recently proposed Shrinking Fermi Liquid theory. This is based on the pervading presence in the cuprate phase diagram of charge density fluctuations (CDF), which have been identified and characterized in RIXS. These fluctuations are abundant and have a low energy due to the proximity of the charge density wave quantum critical point hidden under the superconducting dome of cuprates, but have a short range and non-critical character with a finite energy M/γ ~10 meV as measured above Tc. Here M~ ξ⁻² is determined by the short correlation length ξ, while γ encodes the Landau damping ruling the lifetime of the charge fluctuations. Besides these low energy CDF, cuprates also display phonons and a broad continuum of particle-hole excitations, mostly due to spin paramagnons arising from their strongly correlated character. With these experimentally characterized ingredients we show that above Tc the SM properties in transport are well described in terms of fermionic Landau quasiparticles scattering with CDF and phonons. The optical properties can instead be interpreted by the combined effect of low energy CDF determining the temperature dependence, and of the paramagnon continuum determining a linear in frequency scattering rate. Remarkably, the combined effect of these simple ingredients also induces ømega/T scaling properties for frequencies larger than M/γ. When superconductivity is suppressed by strong magnetic fields the SM properties extend down to a few Kelvin. By assuming that the CDF dissipation parameter γ grows logarithmically by lowering T, we account for all anomalous transport and thermodynamic properties of cuprates (specific heat, Seebeck, heat transport, resistivity, and magnetoresistance) thereby providing a consistent scenario for the SM phase of cuprates.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作用近期提出的收缩费米液体理论解释轻度过掺杂铜氧化物的奇异金属性质，核心是相图中普遍存在的电荷密度涨落。RIXS 表明这些涨落源于超导穹顶下隐藏的电荷密度波量子临界点附近，能量低但关联长度短、非临界，典型能标约 10 meV。作者结合实验表征的电荷涨落、声子以及由强关联自旋顺磁振子贡献的粒子-空穴连续谱，说明 Tc 以上的输运可由朗道准粒子与电荷涨落和声子散射来描述，并将该框架推广到光学性质讨论。
authors: Sergio Caprara, Sauri Bhattacharyya, Carlo Di Castro, Giovanni Mirarchi, Götz Seibold, Marco Grilli

articles.title: A crystal-field route to THz-driven magnetization
articles.title_zh: 通过晶体场激发实现太赫兹驱动磁化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08519v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Light carries angular momentum, but the microscopic pathways that transform it into magnetization remain elusive. Here we establish that crystal-field excitations, historically viewed primarily as equilibrium spectroscopic fingerprints of localized 4f electrons, constitute an active microscopic route through which circularly-polarized terahertz (THz) light creates magnetic polarization. Using wavelength-selective ultrafast Faraday spectroscopy on the paramagnetic insulator CeF₃, we show that resonant excitation of localized 4f crystal-field transitions generates a helicity-dependent magnetization that survives for up to about 100 ps. Most strikingly, while the optical helicity is held fixed, the THz-driven response reverses sign as the excitation wavelength is tuned across the crystal-field resonance. The resulting dispersive spectral response follows the crystal-field excitation spectrum rather than that of optical phonons, and is captured by resonant electronic theory of the inverse Faraday effect. Our results identify crystal-field excitations as a previously unrecognized dynamical reservoir for optical angular momentum and broaden the microscopic pathways through which THz light can create and manipulate magnetic states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究证明局域 4f 电子的晶体场激发不仅是平衡谱学指纹，也可作为圆偏振太赫兹光转化为磁化的微观通道。作者在顺磁绝缘体 CeF₃ 中用波长选择超快法拉第光谱发现，共振激发 4f 晶体场跃迁会产生依赖光螺旋度的磁化，并可维持约 100 ps。更关键的是，在光螺旋度固定时，太赫兹驱动响应随激发波长扫过晶体场共振发生符号反转，其色散谱形跟随晶体场激发而非光学声子，并可由共振电子型逆法拉第效应理论解释。
authors: T. Zalewski, M. S. Mrudul, Y. Lee, M. Weissenhofer, A. V. Boris, P. M. Oppeneer, A. Kirilyuk, C. S. Davies

articles.title: Curvature-Controlled Topological Magnon Phases in a Folded Kagome Lattice
articles.title_zh: 折叠 Kagome 晶格中曲率调控的拓扑磁振子相
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08580v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We show that geometric curvature, encoded in the folding angle between two corner-sharing triangles on a kagome lattice, provides a continuous tuning knob for topological magnon phase. Starting from an extended spin Hamiltonian with exchange, Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya (DM) interaction, and a higher-order bow-tie coupling of scalar chiralities, we derive the chirality-mediated hopping amplitude, which depends on the folding and spin canting of the bow-tie triangles. At small folding and canting angles, the bow-tie coupling surpasses DM, establishing a curvature-dominated regime. These results establish curvature as an intrinsic geometric control parameter for topological magnonics and reveal a direct analogy with chirality-induced spin selectivity in molecular systems, pointing to a unified mechanism for chirality driven transport across scales. The mechanism is particularly relevant for chiral crystals where the DM interaction is weak or forbidden by symmetry, as in systems with a six-fold screw axis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论工作表明，Kagome 晶格中两个共角三角形之间的折叠角所表征的几何曲率，可作为连续调节拓扑磁振子相的控制参数。作者从含交换作用、Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 相互作用和标量手性高阶蝴蝶结耦合的扩展自旋哈密顿量出发，推导出依赖折叠角与自旋倾角的手性介导跃迁振幅。在小折叠角和小倾角下，蝴蝶结耦合可超过 DM 相互作用，形成曲率主导区；该机制对 DM 相互作用弱或受对称性禁戒的手性晶体尤其相关。

articles.title: Vortex Dynamics in Magic-Angle Twisted Graphene
articles.title_zh: 魔角扭转石墨烯中的涡旋动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08585v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We use a gate-defined Josephson junction (JJ) device made from twisted-layer graphene for studying vortex dynamics in two dimensions. The JJ sensor signals the presence of individual vortices in the superconducting leads nearby the junction through shifts in the Fraunhofer interference pattern of the magnetic-field-dependent critical current I_c(B) across the junction. Rapid vortex fluctuations manifest as telegraph-type noise in time traces of the junction voltage V(t). Measurements of I_c(B) and V(t) are interpreted in terms of multi-vortex processes where fast vortex fluctuations in the leads are modulated by quasi-stationary vortices trapped in the leads. The different timescales associated with these processes allow for their disentangling and quantitative analysis. Tracking the temperature dependence of the vortex-dynamical rates between T = 7 mK and T = 120 mK, we find that the creep type vortex motion is thermally activated above T approx 100 mK, while the saturation of rates below T approx 80 mK is suggestive of a sharp transition to macroscopic quantum tunneling of vortices.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用由扭转层石墨烯制成的栅定义约瑟夫森结器件研究二维超导中的涡旋动力学。结的临界电流 Fraunhofer 干涉图样位移可探测附近超导引线中的单个涡旋，电压时间迹中的电报噪声反映快速涡旋涨落。通过区分快速涨落涡旋与准静态俘获涡旋的不同时间尺度，作者定量分析多涡旋过程；温度依赖结果显示约 100 mK 以上为热激活蠕变，而约 80 mK 以下速率饱和，提示涡旋宏观量子隧穿的突变转变。
authors: Marta Perego, Peter Koopmann, Clara Galante Agero, Alexandra Mestre Torà, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Vadim Geshkenbein, Gianni Blatter, Thomas Ihn, Klaus Ensslin

articles.title: Barnett effect generated by a rotating electric field in a ferromagnetic film
articles.title_zh: 旋转电场在铁磁薄膜中产生的 Barnett 效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08597v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the space-time evolution of the magnetization induced in a 2D ferromagnetic island by a short pulse of a rotating electric field. The field generates elastic twists that act on the magnetization via the Barnett effect: magnetization by rotation. Analytical studies are conducted within classical electrodynamics of continuous media and continuous elastic theory, while numerical studies are performed using discretized Landau-Lifshitz spin dynamics on the atomic lattice. The effect is studied for typical parameters of magnetic oxides at various field frequencies and amplitudes, and for various strengths of magnetic anisotropy, exchange, and damping. The possibility of reversing the island magnetization with an electric-field pulse is demonstrated.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察短脉冲旋转电场在二维铁磁岛中诱导磁化的时空演化。旋转电场产生弹性扭转，并通过 Barnett 效应即旋转致磁化作用于磁化强度；理论上结合连续介质经典电动力学、连续弹性理论和原子晶格上的离散 Landau–Lifshitz 自旋动力学模拟。作者在典型磁性氧化物参数下分析频率、振幅、各向异性、交换和阻尼的影响，并展示了用电场脉冲反转磁岛磁化的可能性。
authors: Jorge F. Soriano, Eugene M. Chudnovsky

articles.title: Large-scale first-principle simulations of amorphous indium oxide
articles.title_zh: 非晶氧化铟的大规模第一性原理模拟
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08617v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Amorphous indium oxide (a-In₂O₃₎ is a high-electron-mobility semiconductor of central importance in thin-film transistors and a promising photoanode for solar-driven water oxidation. Despite sustained experimental and computational investigations, the structural motifs underlying its unusual transport properties and the existence of O-O peroxide-like bonds within its network have remained unresolved. Here we develop a MACE-based machine-learned interatomic potential trained on first-principles molecular dynamics trajectories and use it to generate and analyze amorphous structures containing up to 5120 atoms, two orders of magnitude larger than those adopted in typical ab initio studies. We find X-ray structure factors in excellent quantitative agreement with experiment and we confirm that In₂O₃ is a poor glass former, with the likely presence of quasi-crystalline regions in amorphous samples. Our large-scale structural analysis reveals extended chains of edge-sharing InOₖ polyhedra providing a concrete structural basis for the high electron mobility of a-In₂O₃. Our results strongly support the formation of O-O peroxide-like bonds in the amorphous network, with a mean length of 1.5 Å{}. We show that these bonds introduce localized in-gap states near the conduction band minimum, acting as a source of intrinsic n-type self-doping and enhancing sub-gap optical absorption. These effects are detectable via a distinct Raman feature near 850 cm⁻¹ that is absent in the IR spectrum. Overall, our results establish a comprehensive structure-property picture of a-In₂O₃, provide directly testable experimental predictions, and suggest that controlled amorphization is a viable strategy for improving the photoelectrochemical activity of a-In₂O₃.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者构建基于 MACE 的机器学习原子间势，并以第一性原理分子动力学轨迹训练，用于生成和分析最高 5120 原子的非晶 In₂O₃ 结构，规模显著超过常规从头算研究。模拟得到的 X 射线结构因子与实验高度一致，并表明 In₂O₃ 是较差的玻璃形成体，非晶样品中可能存在准晶化区域。大尺度结构分析揭示了共边 InOₖ 多面体长链，为非晶 In₂O₃ 的高电子迁移率提供结构基础；结果还支持网络中形成 O–O 过氧化物样键。
authors: Matthew Bousquet, Francois Gygi, Giulia Galli

articles.title: Harnessing orbital Hall effect for energy-efficient magnetization switching in room-temperature van der Waals ferromagnet Fe3GaTe2
articles.title_zh: 利用轨道霍尔效应实现室温范德华铁磁体 Fe3GaTe2 的低能耗磁化翻转
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08618v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: 2D van der Waals (vdW) magnets provide new opportunities for spin-orbit torque magnetoresistive random-access memory (SOT-MRAM) due to their unique properties. Electrically manipulating the magnetization of vdW magnets is key to realizing 2D SOT-MRAM, whereas conventional spin Hall materials such as heavy metals and topological insulators suffer from limitations in torque efficiency and energy consumption. Although recent studies show that the orbital Hall conductivity in light metals greatly exceeds the spin Hall conductivity, direct experimental demonstrations that the orbital Hall effect (OHE) can induce more energy-efficient SOT switching than the spin Hall effect in vdW magnets remain scarce. Here, we utilize Cr as the orbital current source to efficiently manipulate the magnetization of the vdW ferromagnet Fe3GaTe2 at room temperature. In the Fe3GaTe2/Pt (1.5 nm)/Cr (4.5 nm) trilayer structure, the orbital current originating from Cr is converted into the spin current via Pt, which then exerts a torque on Fe3GaTe2. Compared with control samples using 6 nm Pt as the spin current source, the switching current density in OHE-based devices is reduced by 3.9 times, resulting in a 52% reduction in power consumption. This work presents the promising potential of harnessing orbital currents to realize energy-efficient 2D SOT-MRAM.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用 Cr 作为轨道流源，在室温下高效操控范德华铁磁体 Fe3GaTe2 的磁化。Fe3GaTe2/Pt/Cr 三层结构中，Cr 产生的轨道流经 Pt 转化为自旋流并对 Fe3GaTe2 施加自旋轨道力矩。与以 Pt 作为自旋流源的对照样品相比，基于轨道霍尔效应的器件表现出更低的翻转电流密度，说明轨道流可用于降低二维 SOT-MRAM 的能耗。
authors: Chenhui Zhang, Hua Bai, Yuchen Pu, Hyunsoo Yang

articles.title: Magnetophonon Resistance Oscillations in Structures with a GaAs Quantum Well and Barriers of AlAs/GaAsłangleδ-Siångle Superlattices
articles.title_zh: 含 GaAs 量子阱与 AlAs/GaAs〈δ-Si〉超晶格势垒结构中的磁声子电阻振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08682v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetophonon resistance oscillations (MPR) associated with the resonant scattering of electrons by optical phonons at temperatures of 77-240 K, as well as resonant scattering of electrons by acoustic phonons (PIRO) at temperatures of 10-25 K, were investigated in the same samples featuring a GaAs quantum well and AlAs/GaAs superlattice barriers doped with Si. The study of MPR demonstrated that resonant electron scattering occurs on bulk longitudinal optical phonons and does not depend on the dimensionality of the system or inter-subband transitions in systems with two subbands of size quantization. However, the amplitude of the oscillation with number N=1 in two-dimensional structures depends on the interplay of scattering mechanisms, which, in turn, is influenced by the structure of the system. As for PIRO, in samples with two size quantization subbands, resonant electron scattering by longitudinal acoustic phonons is observed against the background of inter-subband transitions (MISO), leading to their interference.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者在同一类含 GaAs 量子阱和 Si 掺杂 AlAs/GaAs 超晶格势垒的样品中研究了两类磁声子电阻振荡：77–240 K 下由光学声子共振散射导致的 MPR，以及 10–25 K 下由声学声子共振散射导致的 PIRO。MPR 结果表明，电子主要与体纵向光学声子发生共振散射，该过程不依赖体系维度或双子带体系中的子带间跃迁。对于 PIRO，双尺寸量子化子带样品中纵向声学声子散射叠加在磁场诱导子带间振荡背景上，并导致二者发生干涉。
authors: I. L. Drichko, I. Yu. Smirnov, M. O. Safonchik, M. A. Shakhov, A. K. Bakarov, A. A. Bykov

articles.title: Complex polar superstructure controlled thermal conductivity in ferroelectric PbTiO3/SrTiO3 superlattices
articles.title_zh: 铁电 PbTiO3/SrTiO3 超晶格中复杂极性超结构调控的热导率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08683v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrating epitaxial thin films of ferroelectric PbTiO3 and paraelectric SrTiO3 into artificially layered periodic superlattices provides a unique platform for tuning strain, depolarization, and interfacial/surface energies, thereby accessing a rich phase diagram of topological polar structures (skyrmions, vortices, merons, or sinusoidal waves) and superstructures (polar supercrystals). Here we show that the 3D arrangement of polar vortices in a supercrystal suppresses thermal conductivity (k) of PTO/STO superlattices (SLs). The temperature dependence of k reflects the evolution of the polar superstructure, as determined by X-ray diffraction and transmission electron microscopy. The comparison with other SLs suggests that the 3D arrangement is crucial for controlling thermal conductivity beyond the usual interfacial scattering. Moreover, we observed an unexpected reduction in thermal conductivity with increasing superlattice thickness, a phenomenon reminiscent of phonon-wave Anderson localization. Our results show that complex polar superstructures can be useful active elements for modulating heat transport in technologies where control over heat dissipation is critical.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在 PbTiO3/SrTiO3 外延超晶格中，极性涡旋在三维极性超晶体中的排列会抑制热导率。热导率的温度依赖与 X 射线衍射和透射电镜确定的极性超结构演化相对应，说明其影响超出通常的界面声子散射。作者还观察到热导率随超晶格厚度增加而异常降低，类似声子波 Anderson 局域化，提示复杂极性超结构可作为主动调控热输运的功能单元。
authors: Noa Varela-Domínguez, Marcel S. Claro, Araceli Gutiérrez-Llorente, Eric Langenberg, Xinxin Hu, Núria Bagués, Anthony Edgeton, Chang Beom-Eom, Jordi Arbiol, José Santiso, Francisco Rivadulla

articles.title: Topology from Decoherence
articles.title_zh: 由退相干产生的拓扑
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07801v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Decoherence is conventionally regarded as an obstacle to realizing topological quantum phases. This has motivated extensive efforts to suppress noise in candidate topological materials and devices. Here, we show that decoherence can instead induce topological phenomena. We demonstrate this in a lattice system subject to environment-induced dephasing. The noise-averaged dynamics, governed by an interacting quantum master equation, realize a topological phase characterized by a winding number and the non-Hermitian skin effect. The dynamical consequence is striking: the correlated nature of the stochastic noise yields asymmetric diffusion, whose direction is fixed by the winding number and is reversible only through a topological phase transition. This effect is induced purely by interactions, distinguishing it from previous studies of free, effectively single-particle systems. It also disappears upon postselecting measurement outcomes, confirming that it is a genuinely open-system phenomenon with no effective Hamiltonian description. Remarkably, the model remains analytically tractable. Our results establish correlated quantum noise as a route to topology in open many-body systems, beyond free-particle and non-Hermitian Hamiltonian paradigms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出退相干并非总是拓扑量子相的障碍，而可诱导拓扑现象。作者研究受环境诱导退相位影响的晶格体系，噪声平均动力学由相互作用量子主方程描述，并实现具有绕数和非厄米趋肤效应的拓扑相。随机噪声的关联性导致方向由绕数固定的非对称扩散，且只能通过拓扑相变反转；该效应源于相互作用，后选择测量结果后消失，表明它是真正开放系统现象而非有效哈密顿量效应。
authors: Alexandre Chaduteau, Derek Lee, Frank Schindler, Abhinav Prem

articles.title: Super-Logarithmic Entanglement Scaling in a Monitored Superconducting Chain
articles.title_zh: 受监测超导链中的超对数纠缠标度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07835v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We develop a Keldysh-replica non-linear sigma model (NLSM) for the entanglement dynamics of a monitored one-dimensional spinful s-wave BCS chain in the rare-measurement regime, γ łl J,Δ. Although the clean spinful s-wave BCS Hamiltonian belongs to symmetry class CI, spin-resolved measurements and projection to a conserved f-sector reduce the effective problem to class C. Starting from the corresponding parent symplectic saddle, we show that measurement backaction and the pairing amplitude impose complementary mass constraints that gap out different fluctuation channels. Their interplay dynamically projects the surviving massless modes onto an SO(R) target manifold in replica space. A one-loop renormalization group analysis of this SO(R) NLSM shows that, in the replica limit R→1, the beta function becomes negative, producing a weak-anti-localization flow. This flow yields a super-logarithmic steady-state entanglement scaling S(L)sim łn² L in the rare-measurement regime. Our field-theoretic result explains the numerical evidence reported in the companion Letter [arXiv:2604.04375] and shows that a topologically trivial monitored s-wave superconductor can realize an SO(R) weak-anti-localizing critical phase without relying on a Wess-Zumino-Witten term.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者为稀疏测量极限下的一维自旋ful s 波 BCS 链纠缠动力学建立 Keldysh-副本非线性 σ 模型。尽管干净体系哈密顿量属于 CI 对称类，自旋分辨测量和投影到守恒 f 扇区后有效问题降为 C 类；测量反作用与配对幅度分别对不同涨落通道加质量，最终将无质量模投影到副本空间的 SO(R) 靶流形。一圈重整化群分析显示，在 R→1 副本极限中 beta 函数为负，产生弱反局域化流，并给出稀疏测量稳态纠缠的超对数标度 S(L)∼ln²L。

articles.title: Quantum Sensors for Chemistry and Materials Science
articles.title_zh: 面向化学与材料科学的量子传感器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07848v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The advancement of chemistry and materials science relies on transformative analytical tools which can overcome the sensitivity, spatial resolution, and throughput limitations of conventional techniques. This review explores the application of quantum sensors - specifically optically pumped magnetometers (OPMs) and nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centers in diamond - as robust platforms for molecular and materials analysis. We contrast the extreme magnetic sensitivity of macroscopic OPM ensembles with the atomic-scale resolution and multimodal capabilities of solid-state NV centers. We highlight their deployment in zero- to ultralow-field and nanoscale NMR spectroscopy, real-time reaction monitoring, and transient radical and pH detection. Furthermore, we discuss their integration into high-throughput chemical assays and non-destructive materials diagnostics, such as operando battery monitoring. With the ongoing commercialization of these technologies and advances in quantum-enhanced sensitivities, quantum sensors are poised to routinely address complex real-world analytical challenges.
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇综述讨论量子传感器在化学和材料分析中的应用，重点包括光泵磁力计和金刚石氮-空位中心。文章比较了宏观 OPM 集合的极高磁灵敏度与固态 NV 中心的原子尺度空间分辨率和多模态能力，并概述其在零至超低场及纳米尺度核磁共振、实时反应监测、瞬态自由基和 pH 检测中的应用。作者还讨论了量子传感器与高通量化学筛选、无损材料诊断和电池原位监测的结合，认为其商业化和灵敏度提升将推动实际复杂分析问题的解决。
authors: Piotr Put, Arjun Pillai, Xuan Hoang Le, Mikhail D. Lukin, Hongkun Park

articles.title: An edge-bicolored graph approach to the Ising model on random regular graphs
articles.title_zh: 随机正则图上 Ising 模型的边二着色图方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07867v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We give an exact solution of the ferromagnetic Ising model on a random regular graph ensemble via analytic combinatorics. Expressing the partition function as the generating function of labeled edge-bicolored graphs, we obtain the free energy in the thermodynamic limit from the asymptotic enumeration of these graphs. A simple analysis of the resulting formula reveals a second-order phase transition with critical exponents of the mean-field universality class.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用解析组合学给出随机正则图系综上铁磁 Ising 模型的精确解。通过将配分函数表示为带标号边二着色图的生成函数，并对这些图进行渐近计数，得到热力学极限下的自由能。所得公式的分析显示体系发生二级相变，临界指数属于平均场普适类。
authors: Michael Borinsky, Shiyue Ren, Maximilian Wiesmann

articles.title: Robust Quantum Learning through Hamiltonian Reservoir Computing
articles.title_zh: 通过哈密顿量储备池计算实现鲁棒量子学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.08037v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum learning provides a versatile paradigm for information processing by exploiting the intrinsic representational capacity of high-dimensional Hilbert spaces. Here, we investigate a Hamiltonian-encoding framework for quantum reservoir computing that simultaneously addresses three key challenges in quantum learning: trainability, hardware efficiency, and information stability. In this framework, input data are directly mapped onto a fixed Hamiltonian and transformed into expressive nonlinear features through quantum dynamical evolution. By employing the reservoir-computing paradigm, the approach naturally circumvents the barren plateau problem in quantum learning landscapes. We validate the framework across two complementary platforms: an analog superconducting array processor and a digital gate-based quantum circuit implementation. Despite their fundamentally different realizations, both platforms exhibit comparable representational power and achieve competitive learning performance, establishing a unified framework for cross-platform quantum learning. While both implementations achieve comparable performance, the analog processor may offer a more hardware-efficient realization by bypassing the temporal overhead of gate-based decomposition and thereby making more effective use of finite coherence times, albeit at the expense of universality.
