articles.title: Potential forage competition between deer and cattle in the Mesopotamian Espinal of Argentina
articles.abstract: The population expansion of native and exotic deer species in livestock systems across South America has heightened concerns about competition with cattle for the use of natural grassland. The objective of this study was to evaluate the potential for forage competition between cattle and deer in two representative environments of the Argentine Mesopotamian Espinal: semixerophytic native forest and riparian forest. To this end, population estimates obtained through camera traps and the REST model were integrated with data on animal consumption and natural grassland productivity. Potential forage intake by Axis axis and Subulo gouazoubira was estimated under a conservative scenario of maximum spatial, temporal, and trophic overlap with cattle. In addition, indices of forage pressure and potential competition were developed based on the relationship between dry matter demand and herbaceous biomass supply. The results showed that potential competitive pressure was strongly determined by environmental productivity and seasonal variation in forage availability. The riparian forest exhibited the highest values of potential competitive pressure, particularly during autumn and winter, whereas the native forest maintained positive forage balances for most of the year. In both environments, total demand was primarily driven by the cattle component. These findings suggest that coexistence between deer and cattle does not necessarily entail intense forage competition under the population densities currently recorded.

articles.title: Robust Sparse Channel Estimator for RIS-Assisted Hybrid MIMO Millimeter Wave Communication Under Impulsive Noise
articles.abstract: The integration of reconfigurable intelligent surfaces (RIS) with millimeter-wave (mmWave) multi-input multi-output (MIMO) architectures has emerged as promising for achievement of ultra-high data rates, and improved coverage in next-generation wireless communication networks. To harness the full potential of RIS-assisted MIMO-mmWave systems, accurate channel state information is crucial for beamforming and reception strategies. However, RIS-assisted links are susceptible to significant path loss and non-Gaussian distortions arising from hardware impairments, that makes channel estimation (CE) task challenging. Conventional CE techniques such as orthogonal matching pursuit and zero-attracting least mean square (ZA-LMS), offer degraded performance in the presence of such non-Gaussian distortions. To address these degradations, a performance evaluation of robust sparse-aware (SA) maximum correntropy criterion (MCC) based CE is proposed for RIS-MIMO-mmWave. The presented simulation results indicate superior performance of the proposed SA-MCC algorithm against state-of-the-art channel estimators.

articles.title: Scalable Microring-Based Interconnects with Channel Equalization and Closed-Loop Stabilization
articles.abstract: Optical interconnects are essential for scaling photonic computing from isolated cores to distributed multi-core systems. In analog photonic processors, however, the interconnect must preserve multiwavelength optical power during inter-core signal transfer, rather than simply reconfigure optical paths. Conventional switching fabrics do not compensate channel-power imbalance, wavelength-dependent loss, or resonance drift, allowing these impairments to accumulate as errors across cascaded computations. Here, we propose and experimentally demonstrate a photonic interconnect unit (PIU) that integrates a 4-by-4 microring-resonator switching fabric, cascaded programmable channel equalizers, and a three-phase field-programmable gate array-assisted feedback controller on a 180-nm silicon photonic platform. The PIU supports reconfigurable wavelength-division-multiplexed redistribution, including multiplexing and demultiplexing, while cascaded equalization, stabilized by closed-loop feedback, suppresses residual channel-power variation to below 0.2 dB. The feedback controller achieves 10.3-bit-equivalent steady-state control precision and maintains signal-to-noise ratio fluctuation below 0.5 dB across a 22 °C temperature variation. Eight-channel multiwavelength optical weight reconstruction reduces the normalized end-to-end error from 0.179 to 0.0193 (9.3-fold). For ResNet-18, hardware-aware inference simulations under a measurement-derived 6.5-dB channel-mismatch model show that equalization recovers network accuracy from 54.33% to the clean hardware-reference level of approximately 94.6%. These results establish actively stabilized photonic interconnects as an analog signal-conditioning layer for scalable multi-core photonic computing clusters.

articles.title: Synthesis, Characterization and DFT Modeling of New Small Fluorescent Organic Molecules Based on tert-Butyl Carbazole
articles.abstract: Two distinct pyridine derivatives, a mono-substituted compound M1 and a tri-substituted star-shaped analogue M2, were synthesized via nucleophilic aromatic substitution (SNAr) and fully characterized by multinuclear NMR and FTIR spectroscopies. Thermal analysis revealed a remarkable enhancement in stability with increasing substitution: M2 exhibits a decomposition onset at 455.7°C and a melting point of 349°C, 124°C higher than that of M1, with no detectable crystallization, highlighting the additive stabilizing effect of the tert-butyl carbazole groups. Cyclic voltammetry showed that M2 possesses a lower oxidation potential (1.48 V) and a shallower HOMO level (− 6.49 eV) than M1 (1.63 V, -6.66 eV), while both compounds share a nearly identical LUMO level ( ≈ − 2.21 eV), resulting in a narrower optical band gap for M2 (3.13 eV vs. 3.25 eV) and validating the donor–acceptor design strategy. DFT calculations (B3LYP/6‑31G(d)) further supported these findings, revealing that M1 adopts a moderately twisted conformation (dihedral angle 71.65°) with a dipole moment of 1.86 D, whereas M2 displays a more complex three-dimensional geometry, a slightly reduced energy gap (3.71 eV), and a significantly lower dipole moment (0.37 D) due to its higher symmetry. Comparison of experimental and theoretical (TD‑DFT) optical data showed good agreement in spectral shape and relative trends, with both approaches assigning the highest emission intensity to M2. Collectively, these results establish that increasing the number of tert-butyl carbazole donors on a halogenated pyridine core systematically enhances thermal stability, modulates frontier orbital energies, and tunes the optical properties, providing a clear structure–property relationship that validates this molecular design strategy for applications in organic electronics.

articles.title: Tuning Structural, Magnetic, and Photocatalytic Properties of Erbium Orthoferrite Nanoparticles via co-substitution of Gd 3+ and Ti 4+
articles.abstract: Erbium Orthoferrite (ErFeO3) nanoparticles are well-known for magnetic and photocatalysis applications, however the crystallite size will play more crucial role to design for particle applications. Scientists were trying to reduce the crystallite size by adopting different synthetic routes or substitution/co- substitution of appropriate atoms or concentration. In these aspects we prepared the ErFeO3 (EFO) nanoparticle by substitution of isovalent ion (Gd3+) at A-site and higher valence ion (Ti4+) at B-site, i.e., Er1−xGdxFe1−xTixO3 (where x = 0, 2.5, 5 and 7.5 mol%) to tune the chemical and physical properties. The optimized concentration of substitution and co-substitution ion concentration was 5 mol%, which is conformed through X-ray diffraction (XRD) studies convoyed through structure refinement method (Rietveld). The synthesized samples up to 5 mol% was found to be single phase with orthorhombic crystal structure of space group of Pnma. space group. The scanning electron microscopy (SEM) was utilized to observe the morphology and also calculate the crystallite size the synthesized materials. BET measurements confirm that the synthesized nanomaterials possess a mesoporous structure, with specific surface areas ranging from 15.978 to 41.465 m2/g. The X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) analysis was carried out to check the Fe oxidation number and to estimate the oxygen vacancy concentration. Nearly two times higher saturation magnetization (MS) value was observed for 5 mol% substituted and co- substituted sample when compared to un substituted sample. These results indicate that nanomaterials substituted with 5 mol% Gd and co- substituted with Ti have strong potential for use in gas sensing and photocatalytic applications.

articles.title: Complexity Reveals the Microscopic Origins of Macroscopic Dynamics
articles.abstract: Real complex systems often exhibit emergent collective behavior arising from interactions across many components. Classical stability theory describes these phenomena in spectral space, where dynamics is organized by spatially extended global eigenmodes that cannot generally be associated with identifiable physical subsystems. Here, we show that spectral localization in empirical and random networks fundamentally alters this picture. As Laplacian eigenvectors concentrate on restricted subsets of nodes, emergent dynamics becomes governed predominantly by the local behavior of dominant nodes together with their e!ective coupling to the surrounding network, producing a mode–node correspondence that restores a direct physical interpretation of spectral instabilities. Exploiting this principle, we develop a node-resolved framework that predicts transition onsets, identifies the microscopic drivers of global behavior, and naturally extends stability analysis to heterogeneous systems where classical modal theories fail. In heterogeneous reaction networks, the same mechanism organizes exotic collective states in which different subsets of nodes develop distinct nonlinear dynamics beyond homogeneous assumptions. Our results show that complex network structures naturally generate the localization patterns that reveal the microscopic drivers of macroscopic dynamics.

articles.title: Solvent-Regulated Hydrogen-Bond Competition in Hyperelastic, Adhesive Organogels
articles.abstract: Hydrogen-bonded polymer gels are attractive because reversible bonding associations dissipate energy, support recovery, and promote adhesion. In the current swollen gels, however, solvent environments often fail to dynamically modulate these interactions, frequently resulting in unbalanced competition among polymer-polymer, polymer-solvent, and solvent-solvent interactions. Consequently, although hydrogen-bonded networks offer a pathway to reversible energy dissipation, their mechanical performance is frequently limited by kinetically trapped, rigid polymer states. Herein, we report a general material design strategy for the synthesis of hyperelastic, high-strength adhesive gels governed by active regulation of solvent-mediated hydrogen-bond competition. By exploring polar aprotic solvents that can effectively regulate the balance between inter-chain polymer–polymer associations and polymer–solvent interactions, we achieve a controlled transition from dense, collapsed network architectures to highly solvated, dynamic systems. Using poly(acrylic acid) (PAA) as a model polymer, we show that dimethylformamide (DMF) acts as an active hydrogen-bond acceptor, facilitating exceptional tensile deformability exceeding 6,000% and exceptional interfacial adhesion. The reported solvent-regulation strategy can be expanded to diverse polar aprotic solvents, yielding a series of gels that retain high stretchability, while offering strong adhesion. Organogels designed and optimized through the reported approach could serve as a new class of gel platform, relevant to soft robotic components, stretchable adhesive joints, damping layers, gel electrolytes, and particle-binding matrices for battery electrodes.

articles.title: Single-Shot Narrowband Link Discovery via Space-Polarization Encoded Metasurfaces
articles.abstract: Wireless networks operating in the millimeter-wave and sub-terahertz regimes typically rely on highly directional pencil beams to overcome severe path loss, making initial access and link discovery a critical bottleneck in the control plane. Existing approaches either employ iterative beam scanning, which incurs substantial latency, or create angle-dependent spectral signatures, which require large bandwidths and additional hardware complexity. Here, we introduce a fundamentally new paradigm for link discovery: single-shot, narrowband beam acquisition enabled by space–polarization encoding. The key insight is to harness anisotropic electromagnetic scattering in a carefully engineered metasurface to encode spatial directions into distinct polarization signatures. Specifically, a transmissive metasurface radiates angle-dependent polarization patterns while a dual-polarized receiver extracts lightweight features from a single narrowband measurement to directly infer the optimal beam direction without any beam sweeping. We establish a physics-grounded framework that links electromagnetic wave manipulation and polarization transformation to link discovery performance, enabling the systematic design of metasurfaces that generate robust and distinguishable polarization signatures across space. We validate this framework through full-wave simulations and extensive over-the-air experiments at 140 GHz, demonstrating accurate localization. Our results show how a deep understanding of electromagnetic can be translated into practical metasurface designs and establish a new pathway for low-latency link adaptation in high-frequency mobile wireless networks.

articles.title: Bounded Rationality and Resilience in Global Rare Earth Supply Chains: An LLM-Powered Multi-Agent Simulation
articles.abstract: Rare earth elements (REEs) rely on highly concentrated trade networks that are structurally vulnerable to geopolitical shocks. Conventional static network models and local optimization algorithms struggle to capture the complex behavioral dynamics—such as strategic hoarding and panic amplification—that drive multi-constraint path disruptions. To bridge this gap, we introduce a novel multi-agent simulation framework integrating large language models (LLMs) to instantiate bounded rationality within sovereign decision-makers. Operating on an empirically calibrated REE trade network, our model employs a Delta-Buffer synchronous market-clearing mechanism to simulate realistic, mass-conserving multi-path routing selections. Extensive Monte Carlo simulations demonstrate a fundamental regime reversal in network resilience. Traditional optimizing agents (Greedy and Rule-based) exhibit severe over-reactivity during low-stress periods, aggressively restructuring paths at unsustainable costs. In contrast, LLM-powered agents dynamically calibrate their routing efforts, maintaining positive Cost Efficiency Ratios (CER) consistent with satisficing theory. Furthermore, their prioritization of multilateral alternative sourcing over passive domestic hoarding aligns directionally with documented historical crisis reactions. These findings reframe bounded rationality as a systemic mechanism for adaptive, cost-efficient network optimization. Ultimately, this computational paradigm provides robust tools for stress-testing complex trade architectures.

articles.title: Experimental Study on Robotic Eddy Current Inspection of Aeroengine Turbine Blades
articles.abstract: This study proposes an automated eddy current inspection technology to address the challenges in detecting subsurface cold-shut defects in aero-engine turbine blades. First, based on the principle of eddy current testing, an optimal bridge absolute probe configuration was designed through electromagnetic field finite element simulation to optimize the magnetic core materials and coil parameters, thereby eliminating blind detection zones in manual operations. Second, a robot-turntable cooperative inspection system is constructed to develop an automated prototype. Finally, trajectory planning was implemented using a standard notched specimen to analyze the influence of the robot motion parameters, defect depth, and orientation on the signal characteristics. A comprehensive verification of the detection capability of the system was conducted via experiments on real cracked blades. This technology significantly enhances the efficiency and reliability of turbine blade defect detection, providing critical assurance for the safe operation of aeroengines.

articles.title: Mixed Neural Rendering: Interactive Mixed Reality Capture and Curation for Neural 3D Reconstruction
articles.abstract: Neural rendering (NR) methods, such as Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS), enable photorealistic novel-view synthesis and 3D reconstruction from casually captured images. However, their practical reliability remains strongly dependent on acquisition quality: users must collect sufficient multi-view coverage and obtain accurate camera poses, typically through offline Structure-from-Motion (SfM), a process that can be slow, fragile, and prone to failures that are often detected only after capture. We introduce Mixed Neural Rendering (MiNeR), a Mixed-Reality (MR) capture-to-reconstruction pipeline that brings acquisition, inspection, curation, and validation into a single interactive workflow. Using HoloLens 2 as both sensing device and immersive interface, MiNeR allows users to capture RGB images with headset-tracked 6DoF poses, inspect acquired viewpoints directly in situ, identify coverage gaps, and refine the dataset through spatially guided curation. To support object-centric reconstruction, MiNeR further integrates promptable multi-view segmentation initialized from a single annotated view, enabling foreground-focused neural rendering under controlled masking conditions.We evaluate MiNeR in a controlled 2 x 2 x 2 technical study across masking, pose source, and neural renderer on a real-world object-centric dataset. The results show that SfM-based poses yield the highest reconstruction fidelity when successful, direct headset poses preserve operability when SfM fails, promptable segmentation improves object-centric reconstruction quality, and 3DGS provides the strongest results in most evaluated settings. MiNeR addresses the capture and reconstruction layers of such systems: it supports the transformation of situated visual fragments into spatially grounded neural assets that can later be inspected, annotated, reused, or integrated into replay-oriented XR experiences.

articles.title: A Dynamical Systems Framework for Mapping Consciousness Models to Neuroelectromagnetic Field Dynamics
articles.abstract: Contemporary consciousness science lacks a shared mathematical language for comparing theories that propose different relationships among biophysical processes, neuroelectric field dynamics, cognition, and subjective experience. Motivated by the problem of how experience relates to physical processes, we introduce a multidimensional framework in which conscious states are represented as vectors with physical (P), cognitive/computational (C), and noetic (N) components. In this framework, physical and cognitive variables are defined operationally in terms of measurable biophysical and neuroelectromagnetic dynamics, including nonlinear EEG or MEG features. The noetic component is introduced as a formal, method-relative dimension that captures structured, reproducible aspects of data or phenomenology that are not accounted for by current physical and cognitive models. It is treated as a latent, empirically testable degree of freedom inferred from structured residuals in dynamical and phenomenological data. Whether this dimension collapses into P and C or constitutes an additional explanatory axis is treated as an empirical question. Using a linear-algebraic analogy, the framework makes explicit how different theories differ in their explanatory assumptions and how these assumptions can be evaluated through perturbation, identifiability, and invariance criteria. Information links field-level organization in the cognitive domain to experiential structure, enabling testable mappings between neuroelectromagnetic dynamics and phenomenology. We outline how theoretical constructs map to measurable neuroelectric dynamical variables, describe empirical prediction classes, and outline perturbational and neurophenomenological protocols that allow competing theories of consciousness to be compared based on empirical findings rather than theoretical claims.

articles.title: Supervised Machine Learning for Predicting Power Conversion Efficiency in Perovskite Solar Cells: A Systematic Review and Quantitative Meta-Analysis
articles.abstract: In recent years, perovskite solar cells (PSCs) have attracted considerable research interest due to rapid efficiency improvements and cost-effective fabrication processes. Despite these advancements, achieving optimal power conversion efficiency (PCE) remains difficult due to complex interactions among material composition, device structure, and fabrication parameters. To address this complexity, supervised machine learning (ML) techniques are increasingly applied for predictive modeling and optimization of PSC performance. This work provides a systematic review combined with a quantitative meta-analysis of supervised ML approaches for PCE prediction in PSCs, covering 36 peer-reviewed studies published between 2015 and 2025. A comparative evaluation framework is developed to assess model performance across different dataset types, sizes, and validation strategies. The meta-analysis of 27 studies indicates that tree-based ensemble methods, such as Random Forest and XGBoost, consistently outperform other models for tabular PSC datasets, achieving average R² values in the range of 0.80–0.90, while neural networks become increasingly competitive with larger datasets. Furthermore, the study examines how feature engineering, dataset quality, and validation strategies influence predictive performance, identifying key challenges such as the lack of standardized datasets, inconsistent benchmarking practices, and limited use of uncertainty quantification. A key contribution of this work is establishing a quantitative relationship between dataset size and optimal model selection strategies. Finally, a structured machine learning roadmap is proposed, integrating dataset curation, feature engineering, model benchmarking, explainable AI, and physics-informed learning to accelerate PSC development. The findings provide actionable insights to improve the reproducibility, reliability, and scalability of ML-driven PCE prediction, supporting next-generation sustainable photovoltaic technologies.

articles.title: A Physics-Informed Hypoplasticity–Machine Learning Framework for Offshore Foundation Design: Comparative Insights from the German North Sea and the Peruvian Pacific Coast
articles.abstract: Background Offshore foundation design increasingly requires constitutive models capable of reproducing the strongly non-linear, rate-dependent, and cyclic response of marine soils, while remaining computationally tractable for iterative design. Hypoplasticity offers a mathematically consistent alternative to classical elastoplastic formulations, and Machine Learning (ML) offers efficient pattern recognition, yet the literature rarely couples the two within an explicit, physically constrained pipeline, and almost never discusses how such a coupling could be transferred from mature offshore markets to emerging ones.Methods We develop a physics-informed hypoplasticity-ML framework grounded in established hypoplastic formulations for sand and clay, define an explicit coupling and validation protocol (k-fold cross-validation, R², RMSE, MAE, confidence intervals), and build a structured comparative matrix contrasting geotechnical, regulatory, and technological conditions in Germany, Peru, and the United States, synthesising quantitative findings already reported in the peer-reviewed literature rather than presenting unverified primary data.Results The comparative matrix identifies which elements of the German hypoplasticity-ML pipeline are directly transferable to Peru (constitutive formulation, ML validation protocol, p-y curve generation methodology) and which require substantial local recalibration (soil database, seismic coupling, liquefaction screening). Free-body equilibrium diagrams for monopile, jacket, and gravity-based foundations are used to make explicit the physical principles that any constitutive-ML coupling must respect.Conclusions A technology-transfer pathway is proposed in which the mathematical core of hypoplasticity-ML coupling developed for German offshore wind conditions can be adapted to Peru through regional recalibration, seismic-liquefaction extensions, and a phased data-acquisition programme, without requiring reproduction of the full German site-investigation infrastructure. The conclusions drawn are explicitly limited to what the synthesised evidence supports; site-specific validation for Peruvian conditions remains an open research need.

articles.title: Residual strength of corroded reinforced concrete beams: Experimental, analytical, numerical and machine learning approach
articles.abstract: The present study aims to quantify the residual flexural capacity of corroded reinforced concrete (CRC) beams using experimental, analytical, numerical, and machine learning approaches. Experimental investigation, which is a conventional practice was conducted on RC beams cast using two concrete grades, M30 and M50. One control beam was maintained for each grade, while the remaining beams were subjected to corrosion levels up to 16%. All beams of size 100 × 150 × 1220 mm were tested under four-point bending to evaluate flexural strength. The experimental results indicated a significant reduction in flexural capacity due to corrosion, where the ultimate load decreased up-to the extent of 44%. However, as the experimental investigations are associated with limitations such as high cost, time intensive procedures, labour intensive setup, and variability in material properties; different analytical formulations have been proposed by various researchers in the literature. The analytical approach based on IS 456:2000 with modifications developed by the authors has been used in the present study. The analytical results showed close correlation with experimental findings. Nevertheless, analytical models being generally limited in applicability, due to much dependency on particular experimental conditions used. Considering the limitations of analytical models, the numerical modelling was carried out using finite element analysis in ABAQUS. A finite element model was developed by incorporating concrete damaged plasticity and reduction in reinforcement properties due to corrosion. Thenumerical results showed close correlation to the experimental results, with an average variation of approximately 6.91%. However, numerical modelling also involves limitations such as idealising the bond-slip behaviour, challenges in accurately capturing localized corrosion effects, and higher computational requirements. To achieve a more rapid and accurate prediction framework, machine learning models were also developed. A dataset comprising 201 RC beams collected from experimental studies was used for training and validation. Four models, the Random Forest, XGBoost, Linear Regression, and Artificial Neural Network (ANN), were trained and evaluated. Among these, the Random Forest model demonstrated the best performance, with a mean prediction error of 0.27, showing very close correlation with experimental results and outperforming other models. The study highlights that while experimental, analytical, and numerical approaches provide valuable insights, machine learning models offer a more efficient and accurate tool for predicting the residual flexural capacity of corroded RC beams. The proposed integrated approach can be effectively used for rapid assessment and future prediction of structural performance under corrosion effects.

articles.title: Non-invasive visualization of boiling from sound using a generative model
articles.abstract: Boiling dissipates large heat loads at low temperature rise and sets the performance and safety limits of the highest-power thermal systems, from two-phase cold plates to the immersion cooling now being adopted for artificial-intelligence (AI) data centers and high-power chips. These limits are governed by fast, near-wall bubble dynamics best resolved by high-speed imaging—yet in most real systems the boiling surface is sealed, opaque or otherwise optically inaccessible, and cannot be seen at all. Here we show that boiling can instead be visualized from sound alone. We formulate acoustic-to-video generation of boiling, generating high-speed videos from a single external acoustic-emission waveform, a static background image and a heating-region mask—all obtainable without optical access. Because one acoustic channel cannot fix every bubble's instantaneous position, the inverse problem is one-to-many: deterministic regression collapses to a blurred average, so we instead learn a conditional velocity field that samples plausible bubble fields. Benchmarked against twenty-three configurations spanning diffusion, adversarial, latent-diffusion, transformer and flow-matching families, our model reproduces the heat-flux-dependent bubble-field evolution with the highest video-level fidelity. Non-invasive acoustic-to-video generation thus provides a virtual high-speed window into boiling surfaces that cannot be directly imaged.

articles.title: Influence of Bottom Electrode Material on the Morphological and Frequency-Dependent Electrical Characteristics of Sputtered HfO₂ Thin-Film Metal-Insulator-Metal Capacitors
articles.abstract: The influence of bottom electrode material on the morphological and frequency-dependent electrical characteristics of RF-sputtered HfO₂ thin-film metal–insulator–metal (MIM) capacitors was systematically investigated. Two capacitor structures, namely Al/HfO₂/Pt and Al/HfO₂/Al, were fabricated by depositing a 100 nm HfO₂ dielectric layer using RF magnetron sputtering on platinized Si and Al-coated SiO₂ substrates, respectively. Further, circular aluminum top electrodes with a thickness of 300 nm and a diameter of 500 µm were deposited by thermal evaporation technique using shadow mask. The surface morphologies were characterized by atomic force microscope (AFM). The electrical properties were measured by Keithley 4200A-SCS semiconductor parameter analyzer by C-V and G-V measurements for voltage sweep ranges ± 2 V, ± 5 V, and ± 10 V with frequencies of 100 kHz to 1 MHz. By AFM measurements, it has been found that HfO₂ thin films had smooth and uniform morphologies with RMS roughness of 4.40 nm and 4.90 nm for Pt- and Al-based structures, respectively. It is found that both capacitors had normal frequency dependence with capacitance, dielectric constant, capacitance density, dielectric loss, quality factor, conductance, and parallel resistance depend strongly on the measurement frequency. On the contrary, the Al/HfO₂/Pt structure showed relatively low dielectric loss, higher quality factor, high parallel resistance, and better surface morphology, indicating good dielectric insulator property and low dissipation of energy. The conclusion drawn from these studies is that bottom electrode material determines the properties of dielectric/electrode interface and controls the frequency dependent electrical characteristics of sputtered HfO₂ thin film MIM capacitors. This knowledge will be helpful in designing HfO₂ based dielectric capacitors for high frequency analog and RF applications.

articles.title: Growth kinetics of proeutectoid ferrite isothermal transformation in a Fe–0.4 C (mass%) alloy under a high magnetic field
articles.abstract: In this study, the effects of a high magnetic field on the growth kinetics of proeutectoid ferrite are investigated. The carbon content at the austenite/ferrite (γ/α) interface with and without a high magnetic field is characterized by a field emission electron probe microanalyzer. The results demonstrate that a high magnetic field increases the carbon content in the austenite at the γ/α interface. In addition, a high magnetic field increases the parabolic length growth rate constant of proeutectoid ferrite by approximately 15%–28% along the magnetic field direction from 993 K to 1033 K. Conversely, it inhibits the parabolic thickness growth rate constant of proeutectoid ferrite by approximately 11%–26% perpendicular to the magnetic field direction from 993 K to 1033 K. At this foundation, relationship between ferrite growth rates with and without a high magnetic field are illuminated, quantitively. The mechanism of the moving γ/α interfaces is discussed from the viewpoint of carbon diffusion in austenite and the carbon content at the γ/α interface with the absence of high magnetic or not.

articles.title: Establishment and parameter calibration of double-layer bonded discrete element model for alfalfa stems at optimal harvest stage
articles.abstract: Accurate discrete element method (DEM) modelling of alfalfa stems is essential for simulating cutting, conveying, stacking, and drying pre-treatment operations. However, conventional DEM models generally treat crop stems as homogeneous materials, thereby neglecting the structural heterogeneity between the epidermis and inner core. This study aimed to establish and calibrate a double-layer bonded DEM model for alfalfa stems at the optimal harvest stage. The physical, mechanical, and contact parameters of alfalfa stems were experimentally measured. A double-layer model comprising epidermis and inner-core regions was developed using the Hertz–Mindlin with Bonding (HMB) contact model. The key bonding and contact parameters were calibrated through Plackett–Burman screening, steepest ascent tests, and Box–Behnken response surface methodology. In addition, a feedforward neural network (FNN) was employed to predict the simulated shear force. The measured average moisture content, shear force, and repose angle were 0.723 ± 0.044 kg/kg, 56.36 N, and 31.62°, respectively. The shear-force response surface model achieved an R² of 0.9036, while the FNN model yielded an R² of 0.9077 and an RMSE of 0.9407. The results from the shear force response surface model and the FNN model are similar. The calibrated DEM model produced a simulated repose angle of 31.46°, corresponding to a relative error of only 0.51%. These results indicate that the proposed double-layer bonded DEM model can accurately represent the anisotropic mechanical behavior of alfalfa stems and provide a reliable simulation basis for optimizing alfalfa harvesting and drying pre-treatment equipment.

articles.title: Pressure transient analysis for detecting leakages along active and abandoned wells
articles.title_zh: 用于识别在役井与废弃井沿线泄漏的压力瞬态分析
articles.abstract: Leakage out of the target formation is a major risk associated with subsurface wellbores. This study explores feasibility of leakage detection with Pressure Transient Analysis (PTA) in multiple potential leakage scenarios, including induced fractures and casing failures in active and legacy wells, which may become conductive from injection‑induced pressure buildup. A mechanistic well-reservoir model based on a representative offshore Norwegian sandstone reservoir was used in the study. The fluid flow simulation study for a single-phase, isothermal, low-compressible fluid (water) has two parts. The first addresses the mechanisms of induced fracturing and fracture propagation through caprocks, creating out-of-zone leakage risks. Then, it proposes an approach to model fracture propagation into cap-rocks and explores feasibility of early detection of the fracture leakage into cap-rocks with PTA of step-rate tests. The second part examines casing-cement-rock integrity failure mechanisms with focus on behind-casing leakage or crossflow detection with PTA. A dedicated modeling approach for behind-casing leakage resulted in revealing pressure derivative signatures associated with the leakage from the flow simulations, confirming feasibility of the leakage detection from PTA of shut-ins responses of active and abandoned wells. The monitoring approach considered in the study relies on real-time pressure data from Permanent Downhole Gauges (PDGs) installed in active wells or wireless PDGs in abandoned wells, interpreted with the PTA methods evaluated. Results from the simulated cases have demonstrated the feasibility of the PTA methods to detect leakage with a possibility to approximately assess leakage rates in some cases, with the assessment accuracy decreasing with declining leakage rate. The feasibility study results are valid for the cases considered and the assumptions taken, and further testing and validation of the PTA methods using field data is a necessary next step in maturation of the interpretation methodology presented.

articles.title: Lyocell fibres from non-wood dissolving pulps gained by organosolv pulping and post-processing of two agricultural residues
articles.title_zh: 由有机溶剂制浆及后处理农业残余物获得的非木材溶解浆制备莱赛尔纤维
articles.abstract: Increasing demand for manmade cellulose fibres (MMCFs) warrants the consideration of non-wood feedstocks as alternatives to wood in dissolving pulp production. This study assesses the New Biorefinery Platform (NBP) process—an oxidative acetosolv approach—combined with post-treatments for producing dissolving pulp suitable for the lyocell process from agricultural residues. Pulps were prepared from two agricultural residues and characterised to identify their post-treatment requirements. Alkaline auto-oxidation was validated as an effective post-treatment to adjust the organic pulp fraction, enabling the production of pulps with properties aligned with lyocell spinning prerequisites. Subsequent spinning trials confirmed that these pulps can be reliably processed into fibres exhibiting characteristic lyocell performance attributes. The NBP-process approach thus demonstrates strong potential for valorising non-wood biomass into high-quality dissolving pulps for advanced cellulose fibre applications.

articles.title: Synergistic Sequential Phosphoric Acid-Deep Eutectic Solvent Pretreatment-Based Biorefinery: Selective Fractionation of Sugarcane Bagasse and Isolation of Structurally Preserved Lignin
articles.title_zh: 基于磷酸—低共熔溶剂协同序贯预处理的生物炼制：甘蔗渣选择性分级与结构保留木质素分离
articles.abstract: The development of selective and sustainable fractionation strategies is critical for advancing lignocellulosic biorefineries. In this study, a synergistic sequential pretreatment approach combining dilute phosphoric acid (PA) and a choline chloride-lactic acid deep eutectic solvent (ChCl-LA DES) was developed for efficient fractionation of sugarcane bagasse (SCB). The initial PA treatment selectively removed ~ 93% of hemicellulose while enhancing cellulose accessibility and lignin extractability. Subsequent DES treatment enabled over 93% lignin recovery and yielded more than 45 wt% cellulose-rich pulp (DES-cellulose) containing ~ 84% α-cellulose. The ChCl-LA DES system was characterized using physicochemical and thermal analyses, confirming its suitability as a stable and effective lignin-solubilizing medium. The recovered DES-lignin exhibited nanoscale features, as evidenced by dynamic light scattering (DLS) and scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Detailed structural characterization using heteronuclear single quantum coherence nuclear magnetic resonance (HSQC-NMR) spectroscopy revealed the preservation of key native lignin linkages (e.g., β-O-4) and the presence of derivatized structures, indicating minimal condensation during pretreatment. This structural integrity highlights the advantage of the sequential PA-DES strategy over conventional approaches that often degrade lignin. X-ray diffraction (XRD) analysis of the cellulose-rich fraction demonstrated disruption of hydrogen bonding and reduced crystallinity, supporting improved downstream processability. Overall, the proposed sequential pretreatment enables controlled and selective deconstruction of lignocellulosic biomass using environmentally benign solvents, achieving high component recovery while preserving lignin functionality. This work provides a promising and scalable pathway for integrated biorefinery applications and lignin valorization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了稀磷酸与氯化胆碱—乳酸低共熔溶剂序贯预处理策略，用于甘蔗渣的可持续选择性分级。稀磷酸步骤优先去除大部分半纤维素并提高纤维素可及性和木质素可萃取性，随后低共熔溶剂处理实现高木质素回收并获得富含 α-纤维素的纸浆。结构表征显示回收木质素具有纳米尺度特征，并较好保留 β-O-4 等天然木质素连接，说明该流程兼具组分分离效率和木质素结构保真度。

articles.title: Coordination-Sphere Perturbations Partition Catalytic Bias Control in a Thermostable [FeFe]-Hydrogenase
articles.title_zh: 配位层扰动分区调控耐热 [FeFe]-氢化酶的催化偏向
articles.abstract: [FeFe]-hydrogenases are among the most efficient biocatalysts for reversible H2 interconversion, yet the molecular mechanisms underlying their catalytic bias remain incompletely understood. Most studies have focused on thermodynamic gating of distal FeSen/ex cluster, with limited attention on the integrated role of the entire electron-transfer chain. In this study, we investigated the first- and second-coordination spheres of FeSen/ex and [4Fe-4S]H cluster along the electron transfer chain of a [FeFe]-hydrogenase from the hydrogen-dependent carbon dioxide reductase (HDCR) of Thermoanaerobacter kivui (TkHydA2). Protein film electrochemistry, EPR spectroscopy, and electrostatic potential mapping reveal that iron-sulfur clusters at distinct positions exhibit functional differentiation and synergistic effects in regulating catalytic bias. These findings support a distributed regulation model in which local coordination-sphere perturbations alter apparent catalytic bias through a combination of kinetic, electrostatic, and redox relay effects. The distal domain functions as a reductive-bias module, where the second-coordination sphere modulates both the interfacial and intramolecular electron-transfer rates via their functional groups, while the first-coordination sphere mainly limits the interfacial electron transfer rates by altering the structures of the iron-sulfur clusters. By contrast, perturbations near the proximal [4Fe-4S]H environment preferentially suppressed proton reduction and enhanced the apparent oxidative bias, consistent with local redox-relay retuning and altered electrostatic coupling to proton-transfer steps. Thus, the catalytic bias of TkHydA2 emerges from the cooperative regulation of multiple variable and flexible components within the entire electron transfer network.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察 Thermoanaerobacter kivui 来源 HDCR 中 [FeFe]-氢化酶 TkHydA2 的电子传递链，重点分析 FeSen/ex 与 [4Fe-4S]H 簇第一、第二配位层对催化偏向的影响。蛋白膜电化学、EPR 光谱和静电势分析表明，不同位置的铁硫簇在调控催化方向性中具有功能分化和协同作用。作者提出分布式调控模型，即局域配位环境扰动通过动力学、静电和氧化还原接力共同改变表观催化偏向。

Sheverdyaeva, Paul Noël, and Pietro Gambardella Bismuth is a promising spin current generator owing to its strong spin–orbit coupling, spin-polarized surface states, and large intrinsic spin Hall conductivity predicted by theory. articles.title_zh: 一种电控螺旋磁结构的新路径
articles.abstract: Advanced magnetic memory and spintronic devices rely on the ability to control magnetic states using electricity. Today, such technologies work by manipulating relatively simple magnetic structures found in ferromagnets, where all the magnetic moments point the same way. However, researchers are becoming increasingly interested in controlling more complex magnetic systems because these could offer higher information density and improved efficiency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻介绍了利用电学手段控制复杂螺旋磁结构的新进展，面向先进磁存储和自旋电子器件。相比所有磁矩同向排列的常规铁磁体，螺旋磁等复杂磁态有望提供更高信息密度和更高能效。摘要未给出具体材料体系和机制细节，需查阅原文了解实验或理论实现路径。

articles.title: Quantum compiling with reinforcement learning on a superconducting processor
articles.title_zh: 在超导处理器上利用强化学习进行量子编译
articles.abstract: Effectively implementing quantum algorithms on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) processors is a central task in modern quantum technology. NISQ processors feature tens to a few hundreds of noisy qubits with limited coherence times and gate operations with errors, so NISQ algorithms naturally require employing circuits of short lengths via quantum compilation. Here, we evaluate a reinforcement learning (RL)-based quantum compiler on a superconducting processor. Our experiments reveal that for two-qubit circuits, the RL-based compiler surpasses conventional methods, demonstrating its ability to discover hardware-amenable circuits with near-optimal lengths. However, for three-qubit circuits, the RL-based compiler does not achieve unity theoretical fidelity. To address this limitation, we integrate a variational strategy with the RL-based compiler, highlighting their complementary strengths. Systematic experiments show that this variational RL-based compiler consistently identifies near-optimal circuits, even under stringent hardware constraints, outperforming conventional techniques. Furthermore, we analyze the impact of decoherence and gate errors, providing critical insights into the practical performance of RL-based compilers on quantum hardware. These findings exemplify the codesign of the software with hardware for efficient quantum compilation, offering valuable insights for the advancement of RL-based compilers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在超导量子处理器上评估了基于强化学习的量子编译器，目标是在含噪中等规模量子器件上生成更短且更适配硬件的量子线路。实验显示，对于双量子比特线路，强化学习编译优于传统方法，能够找到接近最优长度的线路；但在三量子比特情形下，其理论保真度仍受限。作者进一步将变分策略与强化学习编译结合，系统实验表明该混合方法在严格硬件约束下仍能稳定找到近最优线路，并优于常规技术。
authors: Z T Wang, Qiuhao Chen, Yuxuan Du, Z H Yang, Xiaoxia Cai, Kaixuan Huang, Jingning Zhang, Kai Xu, Jun Du, Yinan Li, Yuling Jiao, Xingyao Wu, Xiliang Lu, Huikai Xu, Yirong Jin, Ruixia Wang, Haifeng Yu and S P Zhao

articles.title: BatteryMat: a hierarchical machine-learning and DFT framework for average-voltage screening of lithium-ion cathode materials
articles.title_zh: BatteryMat：用于锂离子电池正极材料平均电压筛选的分层机器学习与 DFT 框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06645v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory (DFT) predicts cathode voltages accurately but does not scale to the combinatorial chemical spaces of modern materials databases, while pure machine-learning surrogates are fast but cannot guarantee thermodynamic consistency. We introduce BatteryMat, a three-tier framework that promotes single-pass average-voltage prediction with the Atomistic Line Graph Neural Network (ALIGNN) as the primary screening signal across JARVIS-DFT, then validates survivors with ALIGNN-FF force-field delithiation profiles and automated PBE+U or optB88-vdW+U supercell DFT. The exchange-correlation functional is selected automatically by spacegroup, and the lithium metal reference is recomputed in the same plane-wave basis as the cathode runs, removing a systematic offset of about 1 V present in tabulated values. Trained on 7,610 ALIGNN-FF delithiation voltages, the ALIGNN predictor reproduces the force-field labels with a mean absolute error of 0.17 V and a coefficient of determination of 0.94; this measures distillation fidelity to the force-field protocol, not agreement with DFT or experiment. On four commercial chemistries (LiFePO4, LiMnPO4, LiMn2O4, LiCoO2) the DFT tier reproduces the experimental average voltage to within 0.3 V and the theoretical volumetric capacity to within 5%; a fifth, non-stoichiometric layered entry is carried as an edge case. The pipeline prioritises, rather than generates, existing structures: it ranks the lithium-containing JARVIS-DFT pool into 71 candidates and a scan of about 4.49 million Alexandria structures into 213, all surrogate-level leads awaiting DFT validation rather than confirmed cathodes. BatteryMat is available at https://github.com/atomgptlab/batterymat with a demo at https://atomgpt.org/battery.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 BatteryMat 三层框架，将 ALIGNN 图神经网络、ALIGNN-FF 力场脱锂电压曲线和自动化 DFT 计算结合，用于大规模筛选锂离子电池正极材料平均电压。框架先用 ALIGNN 进行快速单次预测，再对候选材料进行力场与 PBE+U 或 optB88-vdW+U 超胞 DFT 验证，并通过一致的锂金属参考能计算减少系统电压偏差。基于 7610 个 ALIGNN-FF 脱锂电压训练的预测器相对力场标签达到 0.17 V 平均绝对误差和 0.94 的决定系数，但作者强调这反映的是对力场流程的蒸馏保真度，而非直接等同于 DFT 或实验精度。
authors: Jaehyung Lee, Charles Rhys Campbell, Kent Zhang, Kamal Choudhary

articles.title: Fluctuation-Driven Enhancement of Spin-Orbit Torque near the Curie Temperature of Ultrathin Ferromagnets
articles.title_zh: 超薄铁磁体居里温度附近涨落驱动的自旋轨道力矩增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06703v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate how magnetic fluctuations influence spin-orbit torque in ultrathin-film magnetic heterostructures whose Curie temperature T_C is suppressed by confinement. Above T_C, the damping-like contribution to spin-orbit field is significantly enhanced while the field-like contribution is suppressed, with the two contributions exhibiting opposite field dependencies. We show that these behaviors are consistent with fluctuation driven mixing between the longitudinal and transverse interfacial spin conductances, which enhances absorption of transversely polarized spin current by the ferromagnet. This mechanism can be activated below T_C by engineering the microscopic magnetic state and by harnessing spin current-generated short-wavelength magnons, suggesting a spintronic analog of heat-assisted magnetic recording.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了受限导致居里温度降低的超薄磁性异质结构中，磁涨落对自旋轨道力矩的影响。在高于居里温度时，阻尼型自旋轨道场显著增强，而场型分量被抑制，且二者表现出相反的磁场依赖。作者将这些行为归因于涨落驱动的纵向与横向界面自旋电导混合，从而增强铁磁体对横向极化自旋流的吸收；该机制还可能通过调控微观磁态或激发短波长磁振子在居里温度以下被激活。
authors: Mateusz Szurek, Sergei Ivanov, Sergei Urazhdin

articles.title: Spin-orbit magnetism in altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中的自旋轨道磁性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06730v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The mechanism enabling antiferromagnets, including altermagnets, to exhibit a prominent anomalous Hall effect despite a vanishingly small net magnetization has long remained elusive. Here, by employing oriented spin group theory and spin-orbit-coupling tensor expansion, we systematically disentangle the perturbative behaviors of orbital and spin magnetizations with respect to spin-orbit coupling. Remarkably, we find that only if the opposite-spin sublattices are connected through a fourfold rotation, the orbital and spin magnetizations exhibit distinct perturbative orders. In these altermagnets, we further discover a coaxial Hall effect characterized by the induced spin and orbital magnetizations aligning parallel to the Néel vector, which we further demonstrate by first-principles calculations in the altermagnet KV₂Se₂O. This effect holds great promise for achieving deterministic switching of the Néel order under weak external fields. Our work provides a systematic symmetry approach to identify potential altermagnetic candidates combining a large anomalous Hall effect with minimal net magnetization, paving the way for high-performance, stray-field-free spintronic applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对反铁磁体和交替磁体在几乎零净磁化下仍可表现显著反常霍尔效应的机制，建立了基于定向自旋群理论和自旋轨道耦合张量展开的对称性分析。作者发现，只有当相反自旋子晶格通过四重旋转相连时，轨道磁化与自旋磁化对自旋轨道耦合呈现不同微扰阶数。进一步提出共轴霍尔效应，即诱导的自旋和轨道磁化与 Néel 矢量平行，并通过交替磁体 KV₂Se₂O 的第一性原理计算加以展示。
authors: Ruojia Wang, Yuntian Liu, Renzheng Xiong, Xiaobing Chen, Qihang Liu

articles.title: Microscopic Dynamical Entropy I: Quantifying Hamiltonian Irreversibility in Large and Small Systems
articles.title_zh: 微观动力学熵 I：量化大体系与小体系中的哈密顿不可逆性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06787v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce a Microscopic Dynamical Entropy (MDE) for Hamiltonian systems, defined with respect to a chosen partition of degrees of freedom into a system X and its environment Y. The construction is based on the conditional phase-space volume (CPV), or conditional Boltzmann entropy, associated with the unmonitored degrees of freedom Y. The MDE is a microscopically defined entropy functional of the marginal distribution h̊o_X(t), obtained by discarding conditional microscopic information associated with Y from the Gibbs entropy of the joint XY system, while retaining exact Hamiltonian dynamics. This construction clarifies the microscopic origin of thermal entropy. The dependence of MDE solely on h̊o_X(t) is consistent with the thermodynamic assumption that the entropy increment of a heat bath Y depends on its heat content and temperature, not on details of its probability distribution. Indeed, the MDE recovers dS = dQ/T connecting entropy increments to heat flow between system and environment. More generally, it provides a consistent description of irreversible relaxation under exact Hamiltonian dynamics, while permitting transient entropy decreases in small systems and in spin-echo type protocols. Under time-scale separation between X and Y, the MDE becomes strictly monotonic in time, recovering the familiar structure of irreversible thermodynamics. The MDE can foreshadow thermodynamics even in a small isolated Hamiltonian system, if X is a well chosen subset of its degrees of freedom. An example is the centre of mass of interacting particles confined to a box. Even for as few as N=10 particles, the MDE increases during relaxation towards a maximum at equilibrium, with increasing monotonicity at larger N. Taken together, our results show that the MDE offers a microscopic interpretation of nonequilibrium thermal entropy and its time dependence within exact Hamiltonian dynamics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出用于哈密顿体系的微观动力学熵，其定义依赖于将自由度划分为系统 X 与环境 Y。该构造基于未观测环境自由度的条件相空间体积或条件玻尔兹曼熵，在保持精确哈密顿动力学的同时丢弃与 Y 相关的条件微观信息。作者指出该熵泛函能够澄清热熵的微观来源，并恢复 dS=dQ/T 形式的热流-熵增关系，从而描述精确哈密顿动力学下的不可逆弛豫。

articles.title: Symmetry-Enforced Chiral Phonons in Altermagnets via Magnon-Phonon Coupling
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中由磁振子-声子耦合导致的对称性强制手性声子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06792v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Chiral phonons are attractive for spintronics applications, however, their zero-field generation in conventional antiferromagnets is forbidden by combined parity and time-reversal (PT) symmetry. Here we demonstrate the emergence of chiral phonons in PT-breaking altermagnetic systems at zero field arising from relativistic magnon-phonon coupling. Focusing on the prototypical altermagnet CrSb, we utilize first-principles methods to calculate the hybridized magnon-polarons across the complete Brillouin zone. We show that this coupling imprints an altermagnetic g-wave symmetry directly onto the phonon angular momentum. Furthermore, we demonstrate anomalous spin and phonon angular momentum Nernst responses arising from finite Berry curvatures. These findings establish that chiral lattice dynamics can arise in compensated magnetic ground states without requiring external fields, positioning bulk altermagnets as material candidates for zero-field spin caloritronics and chiral phononics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究表明，在破坏 PT 对称性的交替磁体中，相对论性磁振子-声子耦合可在零外场下产生手性声子，而这在常规反铁磁体中通常被 PT 对称性禁止。作者以典型交替磁体 CrSb 为例，利用第一性原理计算整个布里渊区内的杂化磁振子-极化子，并发现交替磁的 g 波对称性会转印到声子角动量上。研究还展示了由有限 Berry 曲率引起的反常自旋和声子角动量能斯特响应，表明体相交替磁体可作为零场自旋热电子学和手性声子学候选材料。
authors: Philipp Rieger, Markus Weißenhofer, Sergiy Mankovsky, Peter M. Oppeneer

articles.title: Driven square lattice of quantum dots in a magnetic field coupled to a cylindrical FIR-photon cavity
articles.title_zh: 磁场中受驱方形量子点晶格与圆柱形远红外光子腔的耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06812v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a comprehensive computational study of driven quantum dot arrays in a square lattice configuration, subject to an external magnetic field and coupled to a cylindrical far-infrared photon cavity. The driving is introduced through a harmonic modulation of the full electron-photon interaction, therefore including both paramagnetic and diamagnetic contributions. The electron-electron Coulomb interactions are treated within density functional theory, while the electron-photon coupling is modeled using a many-body configuration interaction approach at each iteration of the density functional. By exploiting the unique properties of the cylindrical TE₀₁₁ cavity mode, we demonstrate selective enhancement of diamagnetic two-photon transitions. Our results reveal that the effectiveness of harmonic modulation of the electron-photon interaction is strongly dependent on both the driving frequency and the electron occupation number per dot. When the driving frequency approaches twice the cavity photon frequency, the system exhibits resonant behavior characterized by efficient photon pumping, occupation of higher-order photon replicas, and activation of collective radial Coulomb breathing modes. These findings establish a controllable mechanism for manipulating photon states in coupled quantum dot-cavity systems and provide insights into the interplay among harmonic modulation, photonic excitations, magnetic confinement, and many-body electron correlations in dimensionally reduced nanostructures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作计算研究外磁场下方形量子点阵列与圆柱形远红外光子腔的耦合动力学，驱动通过对完整电子-光子相互作用进行谐波调制引入，同时包含顺磁与抗磁项。电子-电子库仑相互作用用密度泛函理论处理，电子-光子耦合在每次密度泛函迭代中用多体组态相互作用描述。作者利用圆柱腔TE₀₁₁模式的特性实现对抗磁双光子跃迁的选择性增强，并发现调制效果强烈依赖驱动频率和每个量子点的电子占据数；当驱动频率接近两倍腔光子频率时出现有效光子泵浦和高阶光子副本占据等共振行为。
authors: Vidar Gudmundsson, Vram Mughnetsyan, Hsi-Sheng Goan, Jeng-Da Chai, Nzar Rauf Abdullah, Chi-Shung Tang, Wen-Hsuan Kuan, Valeriu Moldoveanu, Andrei Manolescu

articles.title: Synthesis of Bulk Superconducting LiNbO₂ Crystals through CaH₂ Reduction
articles.title_zh: 通过CaH₂还原合成块体超导LiNbO₂晶体
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06819v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We have synthesized layered superconducting LiNbO₂ crystals through a bulk phase transformation from LiNbO₃ single crystals via CaH₂ reduction. As the Nb valence is reduced from 5+ to 3+, the material undergoes a structural transformation to the resulting product, LiNbO₂, which is accompanied by metallic behavior and a superconducting transition, Tc onset, as high as 14.4 K. Secondary ion mass spectroscopy (SIMS) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) show that the resulting phase is hole-doped through de-lithiation during the reduction. Magnetization and AC susceptibility measurements from a tunnel diode resonator confirm the bulk nature of superconductivity with a superconducting volume fraction of approximately 77% and an upper critical field approaching 26 T. Our study demonstrates extreme hydride reduction as an effective method to induce phase transformations with non-topotactic pathways and can be used to synthesize bulk materials with exotic properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以LiNbO₃单晶为前驱体，通过CaH₂强还原实现向层状LiNbO₂晶体的块体相变，Nb价态由5+降至3+，材料转变为金属性并出现最高起始温度14.4 K的超导转变。SIMS和XPS表明还原过程中脱锂导致产物空穴掺杂。磁化和隧道二极管谐振器交流磁化率测量证实超导具有块体性质，超导体积分数约77%，上临界场接近26 T，说明强氢化物还原可用于诱导非拓扑保持相变并制备具有特殊性质的块体材料。
authors: Ryan Paxson, Stephanie J. Hong, Bicky Moirangthem, Parham Kabirifar, Saya Takeuchi, Tianyu Li, Chih-Yu Lee, Haotong Liang, Keenan Avers, Kamal Joshi, Amlan Datta, Makariy Tanatar, Shanta Saha, Peter Zavalij, Ruslan Prozorov, Alexander J. Grutter, Efrain E. Rodriguez, Ichiro Takeuchi

articles.title: Large-scale pseudopotential density functional theory calculations using orthogonalized enriched finite element basis
articles.title_zh: 使用正交化富集有限元基的大规模赝势密度泛函理论计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06848v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present an efficient and scalable computational framework for pseudopotential Kohn-Sham density functional theory (KS-DFT) calculations using an enriched finite element (EFE) basis. The EFE basis is formed by augmenting the classical finite element (CFE) basis with compact atom-centered functions, which we term enrichment functions. The key idea is to combine the completeness of a finite element basis with the efficiency of an atom-centered basis. We orthogonalize the enrichment functions with respect to the underlying CFE basis to simultaneously improve the conditioning of the EFE basis and the efficiency of evaluating the inverse of the overlap matrix. To efficiently solve the Kohn-Sham eigenvalue problem, we employ a residual-based Chebyshev subspace iteration approach that is tolerant to approximations in the evaluation of the inverse of the overlap matrix. We demonstrate the accuracy of the framework as compared to the widely available DFT packages. For benchmark non-periodic calculations, ranging up to 39,083 electrons, the EFE basis offers a 5-7× reduction in degrees of freedom over the CFE basis. As a result of this, EFE achieves a 5-9× reduction in computational cost over the CFE basis. The EFE basis also provides a 4-5× reduction in the required memory compared to the CFE basis, thus allowing for optimal utilization of computational resources. Finally, we demonstrate that the EFE basis affords good parallel scalability. Overall, the EFE basis offers a systematically convergent, fast, scalable, resource-efficient basis for pseudopotential DFT calculations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种用于赝势Kohn-Sham密度泛函理论计算的高效可扩展框架，采用由经典有限元基和紧凑原子中心富集函数组成的富集有限元基。通过将富集函数相对于底层经典有限元基正交化，作者同时改善了基组条件数和重叠矩阵逆的求解效率，并结合残差型Chebyshev子空间迭代求解Kohn-Sham本征值问题。基准非周期体系最高包含39083个电子，富集有限元基相比经典有限元基可减少约5–7倍自由度，并与常用DFT软件结果保持良好精度一致性。
authors: Avirup Sircar, Bikash Kanungo, Sambit Das, Vikram Gavini

articles.title: Disorder signatures in coherent electronic waveguides
articles.title_zh: 相干电子波导中的无序特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06866v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Microscopic disorder in a coherent conductor is encoded in the magnitude of the transmitted current and in the energy- and channel-resolved structure of the scattering response. We develop a conductance-balanced learning framework for identifying microscopic disorder mechanisms from coherent quantum-transport spectra. Using armchair graphene nanoribbons as controlled multichannel tight-binding waveguides, we generate ensembles in which distinct disorder classes occupy the same intervals of integrated transmission, removing the dominant shortcut associated with average conductance. Within this constrained setting, we compare scalar transmission spectra with transmission-eigenvalue spectra, and use supervised classification, scale-normalizing controls, plateau-resolved tests, and principal-component analysis to identify the spectral structures that remain informative. The learned distinctions persist after normalization of the conductance envelope and are strongest in multichannel energy windows, where mode mixing and channel redistribution shape the scattering response. Principal components provide interpretable transport coordinates whose loadings identify the energy and eigenchannel sectors responsible for the dominant spectral deformations. The results establish a controlled AI-assisted protocol for learning disorder signatures from nonlinear quantum-scattering data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种电导平衡的机器学习框架，用于从相干量子输运谱中识别微观无序机制。作者以扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带作为可控多通道紧束缚波导，构造不同无序类别但积分透射处于相同区间的数据集，从而排除平均电导这一捷径特征。结果表明，即使归一化电导包络后，透射本征值谱中的能量与通道分辨结构仍能区分无序类型，尤其在多通道能窗中，模混合和通道重分配提供了主要判别信息。

articles.title: Thermoelectric and Magnetic Properties in Doped Fe₂VAl within a Bipolar Random Anderson Model
articles.title_zh: 双极随机Anderson模型下掺杂Fe₂VAl的热电与磁性性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06878v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the thermoelectric and magnetic properties of Si-substituted n-type and Ti-substituted p-type Heusler alloy Fe₂VAl using the bipolar random Anderson model, which has been introduced recently to study antisite-defect effects associated with the sign change of the Seebeck coefficient in thermally quenched Fe₂VAl. Based on the electronic states of both n-type and p-type compounds, with the rigid-band shift of the Fermi energy and a temperature-dependent scattering rate taken into account, we elucidate how antisite defects simultaneously influence thermoelectric transport and local magnetic moments. We find that the magnetic moments are enhanced in n-type Fe₂VAl, whereas they are suppressed in p-type Fe₂VAl compared with the undoped compound. These contrasting magnetic responses highlight the impact of antisite spin polarization on thermoelectric properties and demonstrate the crucial role of antisite defects in realizing magneto-thermoelectric functionalities in Heusler-type alloys.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作用双极随机Anderson模型研究Si替代的n型和Ti替代的p型Heusler合金Fe₂VAl的热电与磁性性质，并考虑费米能级刚性移动及温度依赖散射率。作者分析了反位缺陷如何同时影响热电输运和局域磁矩。结果显示，与未掺杂体系相比，n型Fe₂VAl中磁矩增强，而p型Fe₂VAl中磁矩受到抑制，表明反位自旋极化对热电响应具有关键作用，并可能用于实现Heusler合金中的磁-热电功能。

articles.title: Scanning tunneling microscopy of resonant-impurity in altermagnets: dual Fano resonance and Landau-quantization-induced nodal spin contrast
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中共振杂质的扫描隧道显微学：双Fano共振与朗道量子化诱导的节点自旋反差
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06885v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using a Green's-function formalism, we study the spin-resolved local spectral function of a resonant impurity coupled to a two-dimensional d-wave altermagnetic substrate. It is found that the interplay between the direct impurity-STM tip tunneling and altermagnet-mediated tunneling leads to dual Fano resonance in the absence of external magnetic field. Moreover, the anisotropic spin-dependent oscillation of the local density of states and/or Fano factor provide the information of the altermagnetic splitting strength from the local/global perspective. In addition, spin-selective tunneling can be achieved by tuning the Fermi energy and the tip position. In the presence of strong magnetic field with Landau level quantization, the dominant STS signature becomes a spin-dependent nodal structure of the real-space pattern: the nodal mismatch between opposite spin channels produces a large local spin contrast. These results establish resonant-impurity STM/STS as a phase-sensitive local probe of altermagnetic band anisotropy.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究基于格林函数方法，考察耦合到二维d波交替磁性基底的共振杂质的自旋分辨局域谱函数。无外磁场时，杂质-STM针尖直接隧穿与经交替磁体介导的隧穿相互作用产生双Fano共振；局域态密度和Fano因子的各向异性自旋依赖振荡可从局域或全局角度提取交替磁劈裂强度。强磁场下朗道能级量子化使主要STS特征转为实空间图案中的自旋依赖节点结构，反向自旋通道的节点失配产生显著局域自旋反差，说明共振杂质STM/STS可作为探测交替磁能带各向异性的相敏局域工具。
authors: Yuan Hong, Zhigang Wang, Zhen-Guo Fu, Feng Chi, Cong Wang, Wei Zhang, Ping Zhang

articles.title: Negative and Zero Linear Compressibility in MCN (M = Ag, Au, Cu): A First-Principles Study
articles.title_zh: MCN（M = Ag、Au、Cu）中的负线压缩性与零线压缩性：第一性原理研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06904v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Negative linear compressibility (NLC) is the counterintuitive phenomenon in which a crystallographic axis expands under hydrostatic pressure. A related phenomenon, zero linear compressibility (ZLC), occurs when an axis shows no length change under pressure. Both responses are rare and arise in materials with highly anisotropic mechanical properties. Motivated by recent reports of anomalous behavior in metal cyanides - including negative thermal expansion and NLC - we use first-principles calculations to investigate the potential of the MCN family (M = Ag, Au, Cu) to exhibit ZLC or NLC. Our simulations reveal three main findings. First, we predict the existence of previously unreported phases: the P6mm phase for AgCN and CuCN, and the R3m phase for AuCN. Second, all six members of the MCN family studied exhibit extreme elastic anisotropy, which indeed leads to ZLC or NLC in each case. Third, we identify a mechanism for these responses distinct from previously reported ones. The mechanism arises from the unique "bamboo forest" geometry of the material: weakly interacting rigid rods whose sparse packing allows pressure to be accommodated through changes in packing density rather than rod compression. This mechanism enables the anomalous response to persist over a wide pressure range, contrasting favorably with other materials that exhibit similar behavior. Our findings expand the relatively small family of materials known to exhibit ZLC or NLC and provide deeper insight into the microscopic origin of these unusual mechanical responses.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作用第一性原理计算研究金属氰化物MCN（M = Ag、Au、Cu）出现零线压缩性或负线压缩性的可能性。计算预言了此前未报道的AgCN和CuCN的P6mm相以及AuCN的R3m相，并发现所研究的六种MCN成员均具有极强弹性各向异性，从而可表现出ZLC或NLC。作者提出一种不同于已有机制的解释：材料中弱相互作用的刚性棒呈“竹林”式稀疏排布，使外压可通过高度各向异性的结构响应被吸收。
authors: Arlies Valdespino, Abduljelili Popoola, Sergey Lisenkov, Inna Ponomareva

articles.title: Visualizing modified spin-wave wavefronts near magnetic defects and domains using nitrogen-vacancy centers
articles.title_zh: 利用氮-空位中心可视化磁缺陷与磁畴附近改性的自旋波波前
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06941v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Direct, real-space imaging of spin-wave propagation and wavefronts in magnetic materials is crucial for advancing both fundamental understanding of spin dynamics and the development of functional devices. This, however, remains a significant challenge, especially in materials with complex magnetic characteristics at the nanoscale. Here, we employ scanning nitrogen-vacancy center spectroscopy to achieve visualization of spin waves in two archetypical magnetic films: yttrium-iron-garnet and lanthanum strontium manganese oxide. We reveal a wavelength-dependent spin-wave filtering effect near point-like magnetic scatterers and a modified spin wavefront in antiferromagnetically coupled stripe domains. The spin-wave characteristics are explained using micromagnetic simulations and analytical calculations. These findings point to possible fine control of spin-wave propagation near complex magnetic structures and extend the scope of spin-wave imaging based on nitrogen-vacancy centers beyond uniform magnets.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用扫描氮-空位中心谱学，在钇铁石榴石和镧锶锰氧化物两类典型磁性薄膜中实现自旋波传播和波前的实空间成像。实验揭示了点状磁散射体附近与波长相关的自旋波滤波效应，以及反铁磁耦合条纹畴中被改性的自旋波波前。结合微磁模拟和解析计算，作者说明复杂磁结构附近自旋波传播可被精细调控，并将NV中心自旋波成像从均匀磁体扩展到更复杂的纳米磁性体系。
authors: Wenxin Cheng, Chang Liu, Dekun Shen, Jiaxin Li, Shangyuan Wang, Hongyu Wang, Miming Cai, Jihao Xia, Peng Chen, Caihua Wan, Ka Shen, Xiufeng Han, Yuelin Zhang, Jinxing Zhang, Yangmu Li

articles.title: Anomalous Hall and Nernst effects driven by static and fluctuating spin chiralities on Kagome lattice
articles.title_zh: Kagome晶格上静态与涨落自旋手征性驱动的反常霍尔效应和能斯特效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06966v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically investigate the anomalous Hall and Nernst effects (AHE and ANE) in a two dimensional Kagome lattice to uncover the distinct roles of static and fluctuating scalar spin chi ralities. Employing Monte Carlo simulations incorporating with a tight binding Hamiltonian via the s-d exchange interaction, we explicitly evaluate the anomalous transport coefficients. A key finding is the systematic disentanglement of the macroscopic responses into an intrinsic contribu tion, governed by momentum space Berry curvature induced by static chirality, and an extrinsic skew scattering contribution driven by real space dynamical spin fluctuations. We demonstrate a pronounced mechanistic crossover: deep in magnetically ordered phases like the skyrmion crystal, the intrinsic Berry curvature dictates the transport behavior. However, approaching the magnetic order-disorder critical regime, strong thermal fluctuations disrupt static noncoplanar spin configu rations, drastically suppressing intrinsic responses. Here, dynamical chiral fluctuations emerge as the dominant driving force. By delineating the phase regimes governed by static versus fluctuating chiralities, this work elucidates the distinct microscopic mechanisms dictating anomalous transport in frustrated magnetic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论工作研究二维Kagome晶格中标量自旋手征性的静态与涨落成分对反常霍尔效应和反常能斯特效应的不同作用，方法结合Monte Carlo模拟、紧束缚哈密顿量和s-d交换相互作用。作者将宏观输运响应区分为由静态手征性诱导的动量空间Berry曲率内禀贡献，以及由实空间动态自旋涨落驱动的斜散射外禀贡献。结果显示，在skyrmion晶体等磁有序相深处，输运主要由内禀Berry曲率控制；接近磁有序-无序临界区时，热涨落破坏静态非共面自旋结构并抑制内禀响应，动态手征涨落转而成为主导机制。
authors: He-Lin Li, Zhen-Gang Zhu, Gang Su

articles.title: AI2Pot: A scalable and unified framework for machine-learning interatomic potential development and large-scale molecular dynamic simulations
articles.title_zh: AI2Pot：用于机器学习原子间势开发与大规模分子动力学模拟的可扩展统一框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06969v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) bridge the accuracy of first-principles calculations and the efficiency required for large-scale molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. However, existing MLIP software remains fragmented across different model architectures, making it difficult to establish unified workflows that support flexible model development, efficient training, and scalable MD deployment. Here, we present AI2Pot, a scalable and unified MLIP framework that seamlessly integrates model training, evaluation, and large-scale MD simulations with PyTorch-compatible ecosystem. Instead of relying on generic automatic differentiation for expensive atomistic operators, AI2Pot re-engineers the core computations of Moment tensor potential (MTP) and Neuroevolution potential (NEP) for both training and inference using hand-crafted C++/CUDA code. These specialized operators constitute a unified computational backend shared by training and inference, improving training-inference consistency and reducing memory usage by avoiding large intermediate caches. As a result, AI2Pot enables fast inference for large-scale atomic systems containing millions of atoms on a single GPU, while retaining the flexibility of PyTorch for model construction, training, and evaluation. Trained models can be deployed in ASE and LAMMPS for MD simulations. Furthermore, AI2Pot provides a companion command-line toolkit (AI2Pot-cli) and Python APIs to facilitate practical MLIP workflows. By unifying high-performance atomistic computing with modern machine-learning ecosystems, AI2Pot offers an user-friendly end-to-end framework for the developing, training, and deploying MLIPs for large scale MD.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出AI2Pot，一个面向机器学习原子间势的统一可扩展框架，集成模型训练、评估和大规模分子动力学模拟，并兼容PyTorch生态。不同于依赖通用自动微分处理昂贵原子算符，AI2Pot用手写C++/CUDA重新实现矩张量势和神经演化势的核心训练与推理计算。共享的专用计算后端提高了训练-推理一致性，并通过避免大型中间缓存降低内存开销，从而支持大规模原子体系的快速推理和分子动力学部署。
authors: Hanyu Liu, Linggang Zhu, Xuanguang Zhang, Ning Yang, Jian Zhou, Zhimei Sun

articles.title: Minimizing propagated density errors of atomic core-electron for simultaneously accurate bandgaps and lattice constants in closed-shell Copper semiconductors
articles.title_zh: 最小化原子芯电子密度误差传播以同时准确预测闭壳层铜基半导体的带隙和晶格常数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07037v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Density functional theory struggles to accurately determine electron density of atoms, whose error is inevitably encoded into the pseudopotential and propagated into solid-state calculations. However, little is known about how this affects accuracy nor how to remedy it. In this work, through a systematic study of the effect of Cu atomic density on bandgap and lattice constants of over 50 Cu-containing simple closed-shell semiconductors, we find that core-electron density can drastically affect nuclear attraction to valence electrons and subsequent charge distribution and energy position of Cu 3d electrons. The error can be eliminated at its source by employing modified Hartree-Fock pseudopotentials for Cu core while retaining (semi-)local functionals for valence electrons. This real-space partitioning approach leads to simultaneous high-accuracy in bandgap and lattice constants across the entire material class.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，密度泛函理论对原子电子密度的误差会写入赝势并传播到固体计算中，从而影响材料性质预测。作者系统考察50多种含Cu简单闭壳层半导体中Cu原子密度对带隙和晶格常数的影响，发现芯电子密度会显著改变原子核对价电子的吸引、后续电荷分布以及Cu 3d能级位置。通过对Cu芯采用修正Hartree-Fock赝势、同时对价电子保留半局域或局域泛函的实空间分区策略，可在该类材料中同时获得高精度带隙和晶格常数。
authors: Kuiyu Ye, Haitao Liu, Yuanchang Li, Shengbai Zhang

articles.title: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya Gradients Unlock Topological Dimensional Reduction in Magnetic Hopfions
articles.title_zh: Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya梯度解锁磁Hopfion中的拓扑降维
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Three-dimensional magnetic solitons retain topological protection only while their spin field remains continuous. Here we show that chemical inhomogeneity can break this protection in a controlled way, converting a hopfion-like toroidal texture into an effectively two-dimensional skyrmion string. Tilt-dependent Lorentz transmission electron microscopy, electron energy-loss spectroscopy, and micromagnetic simulations of pristine, uniformly Y-doped, and nonuniformly Y-doped disordered TiO2 nanoparticles embedded in a FeCrNiMn host reveal two regimes. Uniform Y doping enriches Ti3+/oxygen-vacancy localization centers and stabilizes closed rings with Hopf invariant QH approximately 1. Nonuniform Y doping forms a Ti4+-rich, vacancy-depleted boundary that creates a sharp q=D/(2A) gradient and a weak-moment leakage channel. This coupled mismatch torque and continuity leakage split the ring, leaving a skyrmion-string remnant and a field-sensitive helicity texture.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作表明，化学非均匀性可受控破坏三维磁孤子的连续自旋场拓扑保护，将类Hopfion环形纹理转化为有效二维的skyrmion弦。作者结合倾角依赖洛伦兹透射电镜、电子能量损失谱和微磁模拟，比较了未掺杂、均匀Y掺杂和非均匀Y掺杂的无序TiO₂纳米颗粒/FeCrNiMn基体体系。均匀Y掺杂增加Ti³⁺/氧空位局域中心并稳定Hopf不变量约为1的闭合环；非均匀Y掺杂形成富Ti⁴⁺且缺氧空位的边界，引入尖锐的Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya参数梯度和弱磁矩泄漏通道，使环形结构断裂并留下skyrmion弦残余及场敏感的螺旋度纹理。
authors: Kui Yuan, Hailong Shen, Jiawei Dong, Xin Zhang, Longqing Chen, Yihan Wang, Bo Liu, Qing Zhang, Zhengshang Wang, Wenbin Qiu, Xiaoyi Wang, Bing Han, Yang Qiu, Kun Zhang, Xudong Cui

articles.title: Ethaline deep eutectic solvent under nanoconfinement: Unveiling structural and dynamical changes
articles.title_zh: 纳米限域下的 Ethaline 深共熔溶剂：结构与动力学变化揭示
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07090v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Hybrid nanomaterials incorporating deep eutectic solvents (DES) in porous hosts or at solid interfaces are gaining increasing attention for their potential interest across a wide range of applications. Under these conditions, the performances of DESs may be influenced by interfacial effects and spatial restrictions. In this study, we examined the effects of nanoconfinement on both the structure and molecular dynamics of the prototypical DES ethaline (a mixture of choline chloride and ethylene glycol) when confined within the cylindrical mesopores of SBA-15 (Dp approx 8.1 nm) and MCM-41 (Dp approx 3.5 nm) silicas, using neutron diffraction and quasielastic neutron scattering. It demonstrates that ethaline remains structurally homogeneous under confinement, showing no evidence of core-shell segregation within the pore cross-section. The molecular dynamics of the confined ethaline preserve the key characteristics observed in its bulk state. Translational diffusion follows a jump-diffusion mechanism, with diffusion coefficients that remain remarkably close to the bulk values, showing only a modest reduction in MCM-41. A more pronounced increase in the residence time t0 between translational molecular jumps is observed. It corresponds to roughly a factor of 3-8 under confinement in SBA-15, and reaches up to a tenfold enhancement in MCM-41 relative to bulk. Similarly, the characteristic relaxation time, tL, associated with the localized in-cage motion of ethaline, increases by approximately 20% in SBA-15 and up to 50% in MCM-41. However, the molecular trajectories, modeled from the elastic incoherent structure factor, remain largely preserved under confinement, showing only a marginal reduction in intra-basin motional amplitudes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用中子衍射和准弹性中子散射考察了典型深共熔溶剂 ethaline（氯化胆碱/乙二醇）在 SBA-15 和 MCM-41 二氧化硅介孔中的结构与分子动力学。结果表明，限域 ethaline 仍保持结构均一，未出现孔径截面内的核–壳分离；其平移动力学延续体相的跳跃扩散特征，扩散系数总体接近体相，仅在更小孔径 MCM-41 中有适度降低。工作说明纳米限域对 ethaline 的结构破坏有限，但会对部分动力学过程产生更明显影响。
authors: Kamar Mohammad Nadim (IPR), Mozhdehei Armin (IPR), Lefort Ronan (IPR), Moréac Alain (IPR), Ollivier Jacques (ILL), Appel Markus (ILL), Viviana Cristiglio (ILL), Denis Morineau

articles.title: Floquet-Weyl states at one-photon resonances in three-dimensional topological insulators
articles.title_zh: 三维拓扑绝缘体中单光子共振诱导的 Floquet-Weyl 态
