articles.title: Multi-fidelity multi-objective Bayesian optimisation for laser wakefield acceleration using multi-task Gaussian processes
articles.title_zh: 基于多任务高斯过程的激光尾场加速多保真多目标贝叶斯优化
articles.abstract: The increasing laser powers available for laser-driven particle acceleration have placed greater computational demand on the accompanying simulations. Optimising these simulations is challenging due to their high cost, high-dimensional input spaces, and multiple conflicting output metrics. These competing objectives lead to a range of solutions that may all be considered optimal, depending on the intended application. We propose a method for discrete multi-fidelity, multi-objective Bayesian optimisation, in which lower-cost evaluations of a related function assist the Pareto front optimisation of the primary target function. To enable effective information sharing, we employ a sparse multi-task covariance kernel that transfers information between the related functions while selectively limiting information transfer across objectives. We compare several kernel structures, and find that fitting independent multi-task models to each objective is the most robust across problems with differing objective length scales, noise, and bias. The method is validated using benchmark problems and test functions constructed using data from a laser wakefield acceleration experiment. Its utility is demonstrated through the joint optimisation of brightness and energy of electron beams produced by a 15 J laser, resulting in 3 GeV beams with brightnesses above A m sr , comparable to state-of-the-art free-electron laser injectors. Our approach enables efficient transfer of information between tasks in the multi-objective setting, accelerating identification of optimal trade-offs in complex systems such as laser-plasma accelerators.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出一种离散多保真、多目标贝叶斯优化方法，用低成本相关函数评估辅助主目标函数的 Pareto 前沿优化，以应对激光驱动粒子加速模拟的高成本、高维输入和多冲突指标问题。方法采用稀疏多任务协方差核在相关函数之间传递信息，同时有选择地限制不同目标之间的信息泄漏。基准问题和基于激光尾场加速实验数据构造的测试函数表明，对每个目标分别拟合独立多任务模型在目标长度尺度、噪声和偏差不同的情况下更稳健。
authors: M P Backhouse and Z Najmudin

articles.title: Moiré Phonon Condensation in Magic-Angle Twisted Bilayer Graphene
articles.title_zh: 魔角扭转双层石墨烯中的莫尔声子凝聚
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06711v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Twisted bilayer graphene reconstructs from weak breathing corrugation to large common bending near the magic angle, but the origin of this collective crossover has remained unclear. Here we show that the crossover is a soft-mode condensation of layer-symmetric A₁ moiré flexural phonons: these modes soften on the breathing branch, lose stiffness near the magic angle, and freeze into the bending morphology. We call this mechanism Moiré Phonon Condensation (MPC). At θ=1.08ⁱ̧rc, it is extremely surprising that displacements of all 11164 atoms in the moiré supercell, with a maximum atomic position shift of 2.30 Angstrom, is captured by only two A₁ phonon modes at more than 99.5% spectral weight. A first-harmonic continuum theory identifies a dimensionless control parameter of the phenomenon, showing that as the twist approaches the magic angle, the growing moiré length scale amplifies a smooth stress-bending competition until the flexural stiffness changes sign. Mode-resolved tight-binding calculations further show that the condensed phonon coordinates are electronically active. This work identifies MPC as a twist-controlled structural order parameter for moiré reconstruction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，扭转双层石墨烯在接近魔角时从弱呼吸型起伏转变为显著共同弯曲的结构重构，本质上是层对称 A1 莫尔面外弯曲声子的软模凝聚，作者称之为莫尔声子凝聚。对于 θ=1.08° 的莫尔超胞，包含 11164 个原子的位移场、最大原子位移达 2.30 Å，却可由两个 A1 声子模以超过 99.5% 的谱权重描述。连续理论将该现象归结为随莫尔长度增大而被放大的应力-弯曲竞争，并显示接近魔角时弯曲刚度可变号；模分辨紧束缚计算进一步表明凝聚声子坐标会显著影响电子结构。
authors: Zhanghao Zhouyin, Jyun-jie Jiang, Xianghua Kong, Hong Guo

articles.title: Mesoscopic routers and single-pole double-throw switches for electronic heat
articles.title_zh: 用于电子热流的介观路由器与单刀双掷开关
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06716v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The unavoidable dissipation of heat in electronic nanostructures is a crucial problem, specially when their operation requires low temperatures. It demands finding devices able to control and redirect the excess heat, ideally without perturbing the electrostatic environment. We propose three-terminal junctions working either as thermal routers or as thermal single-pole double-throw switches controlled by a single external knob. Two models are discussed based on resonant tunneling energy filters and different couplings to the heat source: (i) Phase-coherent contact via a scanning tip modulates the relative amount of the two output currents via position-dependent quantum interference; (ii) Coupling via a gate voltage tunable filter selectively switches one of the currents in the presence of dephasing. In the later case, we find that the heat flow using ideal filtering is bounded by fourth the open conductor current.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者提出三端介观结，可作为由单一外部控制量调节的热路由器或热单刀双掷开关，用于在不显著扰动静电环境的情况下控制纳米电子结构中的余热。文中讨论两类基于共振隧穿能量过滤器的模型：一种通过扫描探针相干接触，利用位置依赖的量子干涉调节两个输出热流的比例；另一种在退相干存在时，通过栅压可调滤波器选择性开关某一路热流。对于后一种情形，理想过滤下的热流被限制在开放导体电流的四分之一以内。

articles.title: Topological charge, helicity and vorticity conservation and the reverse spin-current model in the II-nd type multifferoics
articles.title_zh: II 型多铁体中的拓扑荷、螺旋度与涡量守恒及反向自旋流模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06756v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The topological charge and its density are related to the spin vorticity, while the spin vorticity is a part of full vorticity of the medium. The full vorticity is related to an integral of motion called the hydrodynamic helicity. Relation between two integrals of motion (the topological charge and the hydrodynamic helicity) is traced. The role of the spin-current model of the electric polarization formation due to the specific spin distribution in the helicity conservation is demonstrated. The reverse spin-current model is suggested to demonstrate the contribution of the polarization in the spin evolution equation, its importance for the helicity conservation is shown as well. Spin-field model of the electric polarization is the second model for the electric polarization (the deformation, firstly) formation due to the specific spin distribution, which appears from the same principles, but it has nonstationary origin. Moreover, the reverse spin-current model gives a mechanism for the spin structure formation due to the electric polarization in the system. It also appears as the requirement for the conservation of the helicity and the topological charge.
articles.abstract_zh: 该理论工作讨论拓扑荷及其密度与自旋涡量的关系，并将自旋涡量嵌入介质总涡量及其对应的流体动力学螺旋度守恒量中。作者追踪拓扑荷与螺旋度两个守恒量之间的联系，并强调自旋流诱导电极化模型在螺旋度守恒中的作用。文中进一步提出反向自旋流模型，用以描述电极化对自旋演化方程的反馈，并指出该机制可促进体系中自旋结构形成，同时也是维持螺旋度守恒所需的耦合之一。

articles.title: Emergent superconductivity upon disordering a topological insulator
articles.title_zh: 拓扑绝缘体无序化诱导的超导涌现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07163v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the emergence of superconductivity in a quantum spin Hall insulator and identify a disorder-driven enhancement of pairing arising from quantum geometry. Using sign-problem-free quantum Monte Carlo simulations of the attractive Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang (BHZ) Hubbard model, we obtain a quantum phase transition as a function of interaction strength for different impurity densities. In the clean limit, the system develops bulk superconductivity for Hubbard interaction ěrt U ěrt above a finite critical strength. Interestingly, strong impurities significantly reduce such ěrt U ěrt required for the onset of superconductivity. Our calculations indicate that Cooper pairing first nucleates in subgap ring states surrounding the impurities and then evolves into a globally coherent superconducting phase. Our results demonstrate that impurity-generated bound states can promote superconductivity in systems with strong quantum geometry. This mechanism is expected to be relevant in nearly flat-band systems like moiré materials where quantum geometry plays a dominant role.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者研究量子自旋霍尔绝缘体中超导性的产生，发现无序可通过量子几何增强配对。基于无符号问题量子蒙特卡洛模拟的吸引 Hubbard 型 Bernevig-Hughes-Zhang 模型显示，洁净极限下体超导需要吸引相互作用超过有限临界值，而强杂质显著降低超导出现所需的相互作用强度。计算表明 Cooper 配对首先在杂质周围的能隙内环状束缚态中成核，随后发展为全局相干超导相；这一机制可能适用于莫尔材料等量子几何占主导的近扁平能带体系。
authors: Carlos Eduardo S. P. Corsino, Hermann Freire, Anurag Banerjee

articles.title: Wall tension of a Bose-Einstein condensate: Effects of quantum fluctuations and finite-range interactions
articles.title_zh: 玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体的壁面张力：量子涨落与有限程相互作用的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07203v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the effects of quantum fluctuations (QFs) and finite-range interatomic interactions on the ground state and wall tension of a Bose-Einstein condensate (BEC) at zero temperature by means of modified Gross-Pitaevskii equations. The QFs are shown to stiffen the condensate near the hard wall, narrowing the density profile and raising the wall tension above its mean-field value by an amount proportional to square-root of the gas parameter. Finite-range corrections always reduces the wall tension relative to the QFs correction value regardless of the effective range. We find the ordering γ₀ < γₘ̊ II < γₘ̊ I in the dilute regime and identify a crossover condition under which the two beyond-mean-field contributions mutually cancel. These results provide an experimentally accessible way for probing beyond-LHY physics through precision measurements of the wall tension in ultracold Bose gases.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用修正 Gross-Pitaevskii 方程研究零温玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体在硬壁附近的基态和壁面张力，重点考察量子涨落与有限程相互作用的超平均场效应。结果显示，量子涨落会使硬壁附近凝聚体更刚性，缩窄密度剖面，并使壁面张力相对平均场值增加，增量与气体参数平方根成正比。有限程修正则总是相对于量子涨落修正后的值降低壁面张力，并在稀薄极限下给出 γ0 < γMII < γMI 的排序及两种超平均场贡献相互抵消的交叉条件。
authors: Pham Duy Thanh, Nguyen Van Thu

articles.title: Nucleation and Enhancement of Superconductivity under Tip-Induced Strain Fields
articles.title_zh: 针尖诱导应变场下超导性的成核与增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07210v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A metallic point contact formed on a non-superconducting or weakly superconducting material often nucleates or enhances superconductivity confined under the contact. However, no unified theoretical description of the phenomenon exists. We show that the spatially inhomogeneous, predominantly uniaxial nature of the stress field under a point contact is fundamental for such tip-induced and tip-enhanced superconductivity (TISC/TESC). We also show that the coupling of such a stress field to the electronic structure can be estimated through an experimentally measurable uniaxial coupling scale Cexp. Combining Hertzian contact mechanics with a Ginzburg-Landau variational analysis, we derive a criterion for the nucleation of TISC/TESC and determine Cexp for twenty-one materials. For topological semimetals with ungapped band crossings, the framework explains observed critical temperatures with no free parameters and for all others, Cexp provides a direct experimental determination of the uniaxial strain sensitivity and a target scale for microscopic theories.The work predicts TISC in elemental Sb and Y with T_c approx 2.8,K and T_c approx 12,K respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出点接触下空间非均匀、以单轴为主的应力场，是针尖诱导/增强超导性（TISC/TESC）的关键物理因素。作者结合赫兹接触力学与Ginzburg-Landau变分分析，给出超导成核判据，并用可实验测量的单轴耦合尺度 Cexp 表征应变对电子结构的作用。该框架可无自由参数解释若干拓扑半金属的临界温度，并预测元素 Sb 和 Y 中可能分别出现约 2.8 K 与 12 K 的针尖诱导超导。
authors: Ghulam Mohmad, Vishal Tripathi, Goutam Sheet

articles.title: Crossover and Changeover in Spin-1 Kitaev-Γ Chain with Uniaxial Single-ion Anisotropy
articles.title_zh: 具有单轴单离子各向异性的自旋-1 Kitaev-Γ 链中的交叉与转变性质改变
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recent advances in bond-directional spin chains have revealed extensive emergent phenomena and unconventional criticality. Here we investigate the spin-1 Kitaev-Γ chain with uniaxial single-ion anisotropy (SIA) using large-scale density-matrix renormalization group calculations and bosonization analysis. Tuning the SIA strength reveals a crossover from the Kitaev phase to the large-D phase, evidenced by the excitation gap changing from quadratic to linear, the coexistence and smooth evolution of spin-nematic and string order parameters, and the suppression of the double-peak specific heat. For negative SIA, we uncover a changeover from a first-order transition to a continuous one between the dimerized and Haldane phases. The continuous transition belongs to the SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten universality class with central charge c=3/2, a rare instance in a system without continuous symmetry. Our results establish the Kitaev-Γ chain as a minimal platform for controlling crossover and changeover phenomena.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者利用大规模密度矩阵重整化群和玻色化分析研究自旋-1 Kitaev-Γ 链在单轴单离子各向异性调控下的相行为。正单离子各向异性驱动体系从 Kitaev 相平滑交叉到 large-D 相，表现为激发能隙由二次型变为线性、旋量向列序和弦序共存并连续演化，以及双峰比热被抑制。负单离子各向异性下，二聚化相与 Haldane 相之间的转变可由一级转变变为连续转变，后者属于中心荷 c=3/2 的 SU(2)₂ Wess-Zumino-Witten 普适类。
authors: Qiang Luo, Shijie Hu, Wang Yang, Yuhai Liu, Jinbin Li, Jize Zhao, Xiaoqun Wang

articles.title: Entanglement Asymmetry in Random Quantum Automata
articles.title_zh: 随机量子自动机中的纠缠不对称性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the subsystem entanglement asymmetry in random quantum automaton ensembles, which are generated by permuting the basis states in the Hilbert space and applying global phase shifts. We compute the ensemble average of the U(1) subsystem asymmetry in different connectivity geometries, showing that the late-time limit of the ensemble associated to a 2-local circuit geometry coincides with the all-to-all ensemble average. By focusing on different subsystem sizes, we demonstrate that, similarly to Haar-random circuits, the system locally symmetrizes. However, in sharp contrast to the Haar-random setting, the scale at which symmetrization happens depends on the initial state, a phenomenon we associate with the interplay of conservation of the participation entropy and the uniform exploration of charge sectors. Additionally, we connect the growth of the subsystem asymmetry to the subsystem coherence and show that their growth is characterized by the same symmetrization scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究由希尔伯特空间基态置换和全局相位生成的随机量子自动机系综中的子系统纠缠不对称性。作者计算不同连通几何下 U(1) 子系统不对称性的系综平均，发现 2-局域线路几何的长时极限与全连接系综平均一致。与 Haar 随机线路类似，系统会局域对称化，但对称化尺度不同于 Haar 情形，会依赖初态；这一现象被归因于参与熵守恒与电荷扇区均匀探索的共同作用。
authors: Olalla A. Castro-Alvaredo, Dávid Szász-Schagrin, Michele Mazzoni

articles.title: Tunnel-rate controlled local heat distribution in mesoscopic circuits
articles.title_zh: 介观电路中由隧穿速率控制的局域热分布
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07559v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solid-state quantum technologies, including qubits and quantum metrology circuits, demand milli-Kelvin operation to preserve fragile quantum states from classical noise. While the negligible electron-phonon coupling is the major impediment, reaching 50 mK electron temperature is further suffered by the high electrical resistance and sub-micron-scale dimensions of typical devices, limiting conventional heat dissipation. Though the phonons are effectively frozen, thermoelectric techniques could offer a viable path for heat management.This work explores thermally driven electrical transport in a gated quantum dot (QD) on a GaAs-AlGaAs two-dimensional electron gas (2DEG), to control heat flow between the source and drain reservoirs.By exploiting the QD's discrete energy spectrum and tuneable tunnel rates, a precise control over the polarity and magnitude of the resulting thermoelectric current is demonstrated. A temperature difference of 650 mK is maintained across the QD, a separation of 400 nm, by tuning the tunnel-rates. An experimental gate pulsing method is also introduced to directly measure the electron temperature differences across the QD, bypassing the need for any theoretical fits. The results presented here show that tuneable tunnel barriers can be used for local heat control, and could lead to advanced quantum refrigerators that work efficiently in mesoscopic circuits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究 GaAs-AlGaAs 二维电子气中栅控量子点的热驱动电输运，以调控源漏库之间的热流。利用量子点离散能级和可调隧穿速率，作者展示了对热电流极性和大小的精确控制，并在约 400 nm 的量子点两侧维持 650 mK 的温差。文中还提出栅脉冲实验方法，用于直接测量器件局域电子温差，为毫开尔文量子器件热管理提供方案。
authors: Parvathy Gireesan, Umang Soni, Harikrishnan Sundaresan, Giorgio Biasiol, Madhu Thalakulam

articles.title: Geometric Interpretation of Sum Photon Blockade
articles.title_zh: 和光子阻塞的几何解释
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07591v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a geometric interpretation of the sum photon blockade effect in multimode quantum optical systems, such as semiconductor microresonators. The blockade condition (c⁽ⁿ⁾ ḑot v = 0) reflects the orthogonality of the (n)-photon amplitude vector to a target mode vector in an (N)-dimensional Hilbert space, visualized as the confinement of the state to a hyperplane. A key result is the calculation of the maximum probability of the system remaining in the blockade subspace under the influence of decoherence processes (in particular, dephasing), which determines the practical feasibility and robustness of the effect. This approach extends to higher-order correlators (g⁽²⁾_Σ) and cross-correlations, enabling the design of scalable quantum devices. We introduce the concept of "dark-state typicality": as the number of modes (M) increases, the dark subspace annihilated by the collective mode operator asymptotically occupies a unit fraction of the (n)-boson Hilbert space. This allows the transition from fragile, finely tuned mechanisms to macroscopically robust non-classical light in large multimode bosonic architectures. We consider continuum collective modes, hypotheses on correlation zeros and invariant manifolds, as well as the relationship between blockade and entanglement.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者为多模量子光学系统中的和光子阻塞效应提出几何图像：阻塞条件可理解为 n 光子振幅向量与目标模式向量在 N 维希尔伯特空间中正交，即态被限制在某个超平面内。文中估算了在退相干尤其退相位作用下体系保持在阻塞子空间中的最大概率，用以评估效应的稳健性和实验可行性。该框架推广到高阶关联和交叉关联，并提出“暗态典型性”：随模式数增加，被集体模式算符湮灭的暗子空间在 n 玻色子希尔伯特空间中占比趋近于一。

articles.title: Monodromy defects in Chern-Simons theory and Holography
articles.title_zh: Chern-Simons 理论与全息中的单值化缺陷
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06669v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Wilson loop operators in Chern-Simons theory have revealed profound links between quantum field theory, the fractional quantum Hall effect, topology, conformal field theory, and string theory. In Chern-Simons theories with charge conjugation symmetry, we construct a new class of observables: codimension-two monodromy defects around which fields return to themselves up to charge conjugation. Whereas Wilson loops are labeled by integrable representations of an untwisted affine Lie algebra, monodromy defects are labeled by those of the corresponding twisted affine algebra. The modular and fusion data of these two algebras determine the exact correlation functions of Wilson lines and monodromy defects, which together furnish a Z₂₋crossed braided tensor category. The spectrum of line defects in Chern-Simons theory thus gives a physical realization of every algebra in Kac's classification of affine Lie algebras: untwisted for Wilson loops, twisted for monodromy defects. We also determine the exact 't Hooft expansion of monodromy defects in SU(N)ₖ Chern-Simons theory and identify their holographic duals in topological string theory. The insertion of the lightest monodromy defect has a striking effect: it replaces the resolved conifold background of the Gopakumar-Vafa duality by a specific orientifold of the resolved conifold, transmuting the dual theory of oriented strings into one of unoriented strings. Each excited monodromy defect is then realized as a collection of branes in the orientifold background, with the brane content determined by the representation of the twisted affine algebra that labels the defect.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在具有电荷共轭对称性的 Chern-Simons 理论中构造一类新的余维二单值化缺陷，场绕行缺陷后经电荷共轭返回自身。与由非扭仿射李代数可积表示标记的 Wilson 环不同，这些缺陷由相应扭仿射代数的可积表示标记。作者指出 Wilson 线与单值化缺陷的精确关联函数由两类代数的模变换和融合数据决定，共同形成 Z₂-交叉编织张量范畴，并进一步讨论 SU(N)ₖ 理论中的 't Hooft 展开及其拓扑弦全息对偶。
authors: Federico Ambrosino, Jaume Gomis, Suriyah Rajalingam Kannagi

articles.title: Spin singlets are useful
articles.title_zh: 自旋单态是有用的
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06672v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We evaluate the utility of the spin-zero manifold of an exchange-coupled array of N spins for tasks in quantum computation and quantum simulation. Since pairs of electrons can be readily initialized into a product state of singlets in semiconducting quantum dot arrays, the full spin-zero manifold is available with exchange-only control, providing a Hilbert space of approximate dimension 2^N/(N/2)³/², asymptotically close to the 2^N dimension of the full spin Hilbert space. Leveraging the spin-zero manifold enables larger computational space in a given array compared to traditional exchange-only control, in which spin arrays are organized into modular units of n spins comprising N/n encoded qubits, limiting to the exponentially smaller Hilbert dimension 2N/ⁿ. Here we focus on benchmarking metrics for this resource utilization by generalizing cross-entropy benchmarking, mirror benchmarking, and out-of-time-ordered correlators to this system. We show that operating in the spin-zero manifold can accelerate the realization of computational quantum advantage applications in semiconductor-based spin qubits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文评估交换耦合 N 自旋阵列中总自旋为零的流形在量子计算和量子模拟中的资源价值。由于半导体量子点阵列中电子对可较容易初始化为单态乘积态，并可用纯交换控制访问整个自旋零流形，其可用希尔伯特空间维数渐近接近完整自旋空间，显著大于传统编码交换控制方案。作者将交叉熵基准、镜像基准和乱序时间关联函数推广到该体系，认为利用自旋零流形可加速半导体自旋量子比特中的计算量子优势应用。
authors: Silas Hoffman, Edward H. Chen, Matthew Brooks, Stephen Carr, Daniel Volya, Alan Tran, Tyler Keating, Thaddeus D. Ladd, Charles Tahan

articles.title: Universal purification dynamics of monitored Clifford circuits
articles.title_zh: 受监测 Clifford 线路的普适纯化动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06683v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Quantum circuits under sufficiently weak monitoring purify on a timescale T_P exponentially long in the system size. This slowness underlies a universal purification dynamics, whose quantitative description has so far required the replica trick, with a delicate analytic continuation. We show that monitored Clifford circuits on L qudits of prime dimension q bypass this construction entirely: in the scaling limit at fixed x = t/T_P(L), purification reduces to the Markovian decay of the density-matrix rank, an exactly solvable death process descending from infinity. We compute the full scaling functions in compact form: all Rényi entropies collapse onto a universal curve łangle S(x) ångle. Exact stabilizer simulations at q=2,3,5 confirm the predictions, with no fitting parameter for the global model and T_P as the only fitted scale for local brick-wall circuits. Also, the replica problem amounts to a tilted version of the same Markov process, in agreement with exact computations from the Clifford commutant. Finally, the quantization of the rank leaves two hallmarks that distinguish Clifford dynamics from generic monitored circuits: the entropy fluctuations saturate at short scaled times x→0 to an O(1) variance, instead of vanishing, and observables develop a temporal modulation periodic in łog_q x, which cannot be captured by the replica approach.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究弱监测量子线路中随系统尺寸指数增长的纯化时间尺度及其普适动力学。作者证明，对于素数维 q 的 L 个 qudit 组成的受监测 Clifford 线路，在固定 x=t/T_P(L) 的标度极限下，纯化可化为密度矩阵秩的马尔可夫死亡过程，且可精确求解。所得 Rényi 熵标度函数与 q=2、3、5 的稳定子数值模拟吻合，并揭示秩量子化给 Clifford 动力学留下了区别于一般受监测线路的特征。
authors: Beatrice Magni, Federico Gerbino, Xhek Turkeshi, Andrea De Luca

articles.title: A "squeezed polaron" variational wavefunction for the spin boson model
articles.title_zh: 自旋-玻色子模型的“压缩极化子”变分波函数
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06850v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The localization transition of the sub-Ohmic spin-boson model generates boson bath correlations that are, at low frequencies, analytically inaccessible to standard coherent-state-polaron variational ansatzes. In this paper, we introduce a ``squeezed polaron'' wavefunction incorporating generic Gaussian boson-boson correlations induced by the spin impurity. This gives the correct critical power-law scaling of bath observables near the localization transition together with a systematically improved ground state energy and a more accurate determination of the critical coupling. Our wavefunction captures the correct mean-field nature of the transition in the deep sub-Ohmic region. It also displays non-mean-field critical exponents in the shallow sub-Ohmic regime. Using the squeezed polaron as a starting point, we derive scattering phase shifts for bosons, and show how they encode the emergent energy scale that vanishes at the localization transition.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者针对亚欧姆自旋-玻色子模型局域化转变附近标准相干态极化子变分 Ansatz 难以处理的低频浴关联，提出包含一般高斯玻色-玻色关联的“压缩极化子”波函数。该波函数能给出浴观测量在临界附近正确的幂律标度，同时系统性改善基态能并更准确确定临界耦合。它在深亚欧姆区捕捉平均场型转变，在浅亚欧姆区显示非平均场临界指数，并可用于推导玻色散射相移及其对临界消失能标的编码。

articles.title: Explaining the magnitude of Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity via electron-electron exchange
articles.title_zh: 通过电子-电子交换解释手性诱导自旋选择性的量级
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06858v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Chiral molecular structure can couple to electron spin, leading to unexpected spin polarization effects. This Chirality-Induced Spin Selectivity (CISS) was first reported for DNA molecules adsorbed on gold but its microscopic origin remains unclear. We demonstrated though simulation that the exchange arising from electron-electron Coulomb interactions within the self-consistent mean field (Hartree--Fock) approximation can yield significant (sim 2%) spin polarisation for 3-methylcyclohexanone adsorbed on Cu(111) amplifying a much smaller (sim 0.0014%) initial bias, consistent with experiment. Symmetry considerations ensure the result is physically meaningful, while its ab-initio nature ensures all parameters are physically realistic. This amplification is connected to existing studies on spin-symmetry breaking in Hartree--Fock, providing a new pathway for understanding the magnitude of CISS as an emergent phenomenon of interacting electrons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作用从头算模拟表明，在自洽平均场 Hartree-Fock 框架中，电子-电子库仑相互作用产生的交换效应可显著放大手性诱导自旋选择性（CISS）。以吸附在 Cu(111) 上的 3-甲基环己酮为例，计算得到约 2% 的自旋极化，可由约 0.0014% 的初始偏置放大而来，并与实验量级相符。作者强调该结果满足对称性约束且参数具有物理现实性，为将 CISS 视为相互作用电子涌现效应提供了路径。
authors: Bence Csakany, Alex J. W. Thom

articles.title: Bose-Hubbard model with power-law hopping in one dimension
articles.title_zh: 一维幂律跃迁 Bose-Hubbard 模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2412.01571v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the zero-temperature phase diagram of the one-dimensional Bose-Hubbard model with power-law hopping decaying with distance as 1/r^α using exact large scale quantum Monte Carlo simulations. For all 1<αłeq 3 the quantum phase transition from a superfluid and a Mott insulator at unit filling is found to be continuous and scale invariant, in marked contrast with the Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless (BKT) scenario that is recovered only for α>3. By performing finite-size scaling collapses of the superfluid stiffness and extracting dynamical and correlation-length exponents from the low-energy spectrum, we establish that these transitions define a distinct universality class throughout the long-range regime 1<αłe 3. Analysis of the single-particle correlation functions and grand canonical phase diagram further reveals a sequence of ordering regimes within the superfluid phase: true long-range order for αłe 2, anomalous quasi-long-range order for 2<αłe 3, and conventional algebraic decay for α>3. Our exact numerical results provide a benchmark to compare theories of long-range quantum models and are relevant for experiments with cold neutral atom, molecules and ion chains.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者用大规模精确量子蒙特卡罗研究一维 Bose-Hubbard 模型中随距离按 1/r^α 衰减的长程跃迁对零温相图的影响。在单位填充下，对于 1<α≤3，超流-莫特绝缘体量子相变连续且具有标度不变性，不同于仅在 α>3 恢复的 Berezinskii-Kosterlitz-Thouless 情形。有限尺寸标度、低能谱指数和单粒子关联分析表明，长程区形成独立普适类，并在超流相内出现真长程序、反常准长程序和常规代数衰减等不同有序区间。
authors: Tanul Gupta, Nikolay V. Prokof'ev, Guido Pupillo

articles.title: Active motility and wetting cooperatively regulate liquid-liquid phase separation
articles.title_zh: 主动运动与润湿协同调控液-液相分离
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.18077v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Liquid--liquid phase separation in aqueous two-phase systems is fundamental across physical and biological sciences. While well understood for passive mixtures, how it is regulated by active agents such as motile bacteria remains largely unexplored. By combining experiments on Pseudomonas aeruginosa in a dextran--polyethylene glycol mixture with hydrodynamic simulations, we show that the coupling between bacterial activity and interfacial wetting converts self-propulsion into mechanically effective interfacial stresses, giving rise to a robust sequence of morphologies, including self-spinning droplets, elongated droplet chains, and branched capillary-like clusters. More importantly, it gives activity a dual kinetic role: activity suppresses coarsening in the droplet regime through rotation-induced hydrodynamic repulsion, but accelerates coarsening when dextran is the minority phase, where wetting-mediated attraction drives aggregation. To probe the biological relevance of this mechanism, we further show that a biofilm-associated protein can act as an interfacial ``wetting glue,'' promoting bacterial clustering even in dilute suspensions. Our findings establish activity--wetting coupling, rather than activity or wetting alone, as a mechanism by which active motility regulates pattern morphology and coarsening dynamics, and reveal a physical route to enhancing bacterial aggregation from dilute suspensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合铜绿假单胞菌在葡聚糖–聚乙二醇双水相体系中的实验与流体动力学模拟，揭示细菌活性与界面润湿耦合可将自推进转化为有效界面应力。体系由此产生自旋液滴、拉长液滴链和分支毛细状团簇等形貌序列。活性具有双重动力学作用：在液滴区通过旋转诱导的流体排斥抑制粗化，而在葡聚糖为少数相时通过润湿介导吸引加速聚集；生物膜相关蛋白还可充当界面“润湿胶水”，促进稀悬浮液中的细菌成团。
authors: Dixi Yang, Anheng Wang, Chunming Wang, Hajime Tanaka, Jiaxing Yuan

articles.title: Nanoscale imaging of reduced forward bias at V-defects in green-emitting nitride LEDs
articles.title_zh: 绿色氮化物 LED 中 V 缺陷处正向偏压降低的纳米尺度成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2506.18025v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Record wall-plug efficiencies in long-wavelength, III-nitride light-emitting diodes (LEDs) have recently been achieved through improvements in electrical efficiency in devices containing V-defects. Numerical modeling suggests this may be due to reduced barrier heights for charge injection in thinned, low-Indium quantum wells parallel to semi-polar V-defect facets. To test this proposition, a novel approach in which the tip of a scanning tunneling luminescence microscope as a local hole injector, is used to map the optoelectronic properties of commercial, green-emitting LED heterostructures around V-defects with nanoscale spatial resolution. A 1 V reduction in the forward bias necessary for current injection at V-defect rims is observed. This, combined with the observation of small (~10 meV) blue shifts in the locally emitted electroluminescence, unambiguously confirms the charge injection mechanism.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对含 V 缺陷长波长 III 族氮化物 LED 中电注入效率提升的机制进行实验验证。作者利用扫描隧道发光显微镜探针作为局域空穴注入源，以纳米空间分辨率成像商用绿色 LED 异质结构中 V 缺陷附近的光电响应。结果显示 V 缺陷边缘电流注入所需正向偏压降低约 1 V，并伴随局域电致发光约 10 meV 的小幅蓝移，从而支持半极性 V 缺陷侧壁附近低铟量变薄量子阱降低注入势垒的机制。
authors: C. Fornos, N. Alyabyeva, W. Y. Ho, C. Roubert, T. Tak, J. S. Speck, C. Weisbuch, J. Peretti, A. C. H. Rowe

articles.title: Entanglement Growth from Entangled States: A Unified Perspective on Entanglement Generation and Transport
articles.title_zh: 从纠缠初态出发的纠缠增长：纠缠生成与输运的统一图像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.08344v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Studies of entanglement dynamics in quantum many-body systems have focused largely on initial product states. Here, we investigate the far richer dynamics from initial entangled states, uncovering universal patterns across diverse systems ranging from many-body localization (MBL) to random quantum circuits. Our central finding is that the growth of entanglement entropy can exhibit a counter-intuitive non-monotonic dependence on the initial entanglement in many non-ergodic systems, peaking for moderately entangled initial states. To understand this phenomenon, we introduce a conceptual framework that decomposes entanglement growth into two mechanisms: ``build'' and ``move''. The ``build'' mechanism creates new entanglement, while the ``move'' mechanism redistributes pre-existing entanglement throughout the system. Specifically, we demonstrate that MBL dynamics are ``move-dominated'', exhibiting a quantitative agreement with a random SWAP circuit that serves as a model of pure ``move'' dynamics by uniformly distributing pre-existing entanglement. This implies that MBL acts as a redistributor of a hidden entanglement reservoir quantified by the bipartition-averaged entropy. This ``build-move'' framework offers a unified perspective for classifying diverse physical dynamics, deepening our understanding of entanglement propagation and information processing in quantum many-body systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将量子多体系统纠缠动力学从常见的乘积初态推广到纠缠初态，并在多体局域化和随机量子线路等体系中寻找普适规律。核心发现是，在许多非遍历体系中，纠缠熵增长对初始纠缠可呈反直觉的非单调依赖，并在中等初始纠缠时达到峰值。作者提出“构建”和“搬运”两种机制的框架：前者生成新纠缠，后者重分配已有纠缠；多体局域化动力学主要由“搬运”主导，并可由随机 SWAP 线路定量刻画。
authors: Chun-Yue Zhang, Zi-Xiang Li, Shi-Xin Zhang

articles.title: Effective field theory for dissipative photons from higher-form symmetries
articles.title_zh: 基于高阶形式对称性的耗散光子有效场论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.00605v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Recent developments in generalized symmetries have provided new insights into quantum field theories. Within this framework, photons can be understood as Nambu-Goldstone modes associated with a spontaneously broken higher-form symmetry. In this work, we develop an effective field theory that builds on this symmetry structure to describe the real-time dynamics of photons in insulating media at finite temperature. Combining the Schwinger-Keldysh formalism with the generalized coset construction, we formulate a symmetry-based effective action that incorporates both conservative and dissipative effects. The effective theory implements the dynamical Kubo-Martin-Schwinger symmetry, ensuring consistency with the fluctuation-dissipation relation and Onsager's reciprocal relations. Within this framework, we derive the entropy current associated with dissipative photon dynamics and demonstrate the non-negativity of its divergence, in accordance with the second law of thermodynamics. We also clarify the symmetry origin of the gauge redundancy in the unbroken phase within the Schwinger-Keldysh framework, relating it to strong and weak realizations of higher-form symmetries. Our results provide a model-independent effective description of photon dynamics in insulating media at finite temperature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作从广义对称性视角出发，将光子理解为自发破缺高阶形式对称性的南部–戈德斯通模，并构建有限温绝缘介质中光子实时动力学的有效场论。作者结合 Schwinger-Keldysh 形式主义与广义陪集构造，建立同时包含保守效应和耗散效应的对称性有效作用量。该理论实现动态 Kubo-Martin-Schwinger 对称性，从而保证涨落-耗散关系和 Onsager 互易关系，并推导耗散光子动力学的熵流及其非负散度。
authors: Genki Yoshimura, Yukinao Akamatsu, Yuji Hirono

articles.title: Fluctuations of the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick free energy at critical temperature
articles.title_zh: 临界温度下 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自由能的涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02172v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We consider the Sherrington-Kirkpatrick spin glass model at the critical inverse temperature β = 1 with zero external field. We prove that the free energy F_N = FN,β₌₁ of this model has variance [ Var(F_N) = frac16 łog N + O(1),, ] confirming a physics prediction of Aspelmeier i̧teaspelmeier2008free, and that the centered and scaled F_N satisfies a Gaussian CLT. We also identify the critical two-replica overlap scale, proving [ E łangle R₁,₂²ångle asymp N⁻²/³,, ] as conjectured by Talagrand i̧tetalagrand2011mean2, together with a uniform exponential moment bound for N¹/³ |R₁,₂|. The key input is a critical reweighted moment method, in the spirit of the ``small subgraph conditioning'' technique from probabilistic combinatorics, but capable of capturing diverging fluctuations. Through this reweighting, we relate the critical SK model to the BBP critical edge, which determines the overlap and fluctuation scales.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文研究零外场 Sherrington-Kirkpatrick 自旋玻璃模型在临界反温度 β=1 时的自由能涨落。作者证明自由能方差为 (1/6)log N+O(1)，验证了物理预测，并给出中心化、缩放后自由能的高斯中心极限定理。论文还确定了临界双副本重叠尺度，证明 E⟨R₁,₂²⟩ 量级为 N⁻²/³，并建立 N¹/³|R₁,₂| 的一致指数矩界；关键工具是临界重加权矩方法，并将模型与 BBP 临界边缘联系起来。

articles.title: Microsecond-Scale Coherent Control of a Forbidden Clock Transition with Doppler-Free Multiphoton Excitations
articles.title_zh: 利用无多普勒多光子激发实现禁戒钟跃迁的微秒尺度相干控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06789v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We demonstrate two Doppler-free (DF) excitation schemes for coherent manipulation of the {}¹!S₀ - {}³!P₀ clock transition in ⁸⁸Sr that achieve microsecond-scale excitation times. The first approach uses three-photon excitation with distinct phase-coherent spectral components to couple the ground and clock states while canceling the first-order Doppler shift. The second approach is a sequential protocol that combines a single-photon excitation with a two-photon Raman excitation, reducing coherent clock transition manipulation times to below a microsecond. With both methods, we perform high-contrast Ramsey spectroscopy on thermal ensembles of 3 × 10⁶ atoms in free space. We observe three orders of magnitude suppression of Doppler dephasing compared to single-photon excitation, relaxing the need for tight confinement or ultra-low temperatures. These broadly applicable techniques enable fast, coherent manipulation of narrow-line transitions, with implications for optical atomic clocks, matter-wave interferometers, quantum-enhanced metrology, and quantum information processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作演示了两种用于 ⁸⁸Sr 的 ¹S₀–³P₀ 钟跃迁相干操控的无多普勒激发方案，可实现微秒尺度激发。第一种方案使用相干多频谱分量的三光子激发以抵消一阶多普勒频移；第二种顺序方案结合单光子激发与双光子 Raman 激发，将相干操控时间降至亚微秒。两种方法均在自由空间热原子系综中实现高对比度 Ramsey 光谱，并相较单光子激发将多普勒退相干抑制约三个数量级。
authors: Guglielmo Panelli, Erik J. Porter, V. Rose Knight, Shaun C. Burd, Mark Kasevich

articles.title: Exoplanet Detection Using Adaptive Quantum-Optimal Measurement
articles.title_zh: 利用自适应量子最优测量探测系外行星
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06931v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Detecting terrestrial exoplanets in the habitable zones of nearby stars remains a critical challenge. Such planets can be (10⁸) to (10¹⁰) times fainter than their host stars and lie at diffraction-limited angular separations, where starlight strongly obscures the companion signal. Here we present an adaptive quantum measurement method for estimating the number, positions, and brightnesses of mutually incoherent point sources in the sub-Rayleigh, ultra-high-contrast regime, operating at contrasts down to (10⁻⁸) -- five orders of magnitude beyond previous quantum imaging approaches to exoplanet detection. The method adopts a spatial-mode basis that is updated to maximize the quantum Fisher information per detected photon. Estimation is performed by maximum likelihood in log-brightness coordinates, and the source count is determined by Bayesian-information-criterion (BIC) model selection directly from photon-count statistics, without a tunable detection threshold. For point sources within sub-Rayleigh separations and with brightness ratios spanning eight orders of magnitude, the method reconstructs complete scenes with a mean success rate of (72.5%). Furthermore, it is robust to misalignment, maintaining a (71.3%) success rate under offsets of up to six pixels. These results demonstrate that terrestrial exoplanets can be detected below the Rayleigh limit, a regime previously inaccessible to direct imaging.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种自适应量子测量方法，用于在亚瑞利、超高对比度条件下估计互不相干点源的数目、位置和亮度，面向类地系外行星探测。方法通过动态更新空间模基以最大化每个探测光子的量子 Fisher 信息，并在对数亮度坐标中进行最大似然估计。源数目由基于光子计数统计的 BIC 模型选择确定，无需人为可调探测阈值；在亮度比跨越八个数量级的亚瑞利点源场景中，该方法展示出对完整场景重建的能力。
authors: Hyunsoo Choi, Hyoung Won Baac, Zubin Jacob, Haejun Chung

articles.title: Time domain Stokes mechanism of pair correlated k gap solitons in nonlinear photonic time crystal slabs
articles.title_zh: 非线性光子时间晶体薄片中成对关联 k 间隙孤子的时域 Stokes 机制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07340v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Pair generation in time-varying media is commonly attributed to time reflection at temporal boundaries or to amplification inside momentum k gaps. Here we show that these two processes are connected by the time domain Stokes phenomenon. A finite duration photonic time crystal (PTC) slab provides the necessary Stokes connection between the incident vacuum mode, transient k gap amplification, and time boundary scattering. With Kerr nonlinearity, the otherwise unbounded amplification is arrested, spawning Kerr stabilized k gap solitons. When these solitons cross the exit boundary of the time slab, Stokes induced mode conversion produces a secondary pair generation process, yielding four spatially separated and entangled pulse branches. Detection of a backward propagating light pulse therefore heralds its forward propagating partner. We further propose combined Hanbury Brown Twiss and Hong Ou Mandel measurements to test their nonclassical correlations. These results reveal a link between asymptotic Stokes physics and quantum temporal scattering in PTCs, and suggest a route toward ultrafast heralded quantum light sources.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文指出，时变介质中的成对产生通常被归因于时间边界反射或动量 k 间隙内放大，而二者可由时域 Stokes 现象统一联系。有限时长光子时间晶体薄片在入射真空模、瞬态 k 间隙放大和时间边界散射之间提供 Stokes 连接。引入 Kerr 非线性后，无界放大被抑制并形成 Kerr 稳定的 k 间隙孤子；孤子穿越出口时间边界时，Stokes 诱导的模转换产生次级成对产生，形成四个空间分离且纠缠的脉冲分支。作者还提出结合 Hanbury Brown-Twiss 与 Hong-Ou-Mandel 测量检验其非经典关联。
authors: Jiaxiang Sun, Guowei Chen, Liang Zhang, Yiming Pan

articles.title: Experimental evidence of Kelvin wave turbulence along a vortex core
articles.title_zh: 涡核上 Kelvin 波湍流的实验证据
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07535v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wave turbulence is a regime of interacting nonlinear waves occurring in most physical systems. Kelvin waves are helical distortions that propagate along vortex filaments and are believed to play a central role in quantum turbulence up to atmospheric vortices. Yet, Kelvin wave turbulence has remained inaccessible to direct experimental observation. Here, we report the first direct experimental observation of Kelvin-wave turbulence along a single vortex filament in a classical fluid under controlled conditions. Using high-resolution spatiotemporal measurements, we resolve Kelvin-wave dynamics over a broad range of scales and obtain wave-amplitude spectra consistent with the predicted weak-turbulence cascade. We identify six-wave resonant interactions as the mechanism driving this energy transfer, providing direct experimental support for a long-standing prediction of weak-turbulence theory. These results establish an experimental platform for investigating energy transport along vortex filaments, with broader implications for both classical and quantum turbulent systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了在受控经典流体中沿单根涡丝直接观测 Kelvin 波湍流的实验结果。通过高分辨时空测量，作者解析了宽尺度范围内的 Kelvin 波动力学，并获得与弱湍流级联理论相符的波幅谱。实验进一步识别出六波共振相互作用是驱动能量转移的机制，为弱湍流理论的长期预测提供了直接支持。
authors: Jason Barckicke, Christophe Gissinger, Eric Falcon

articles.title: Localized control of large ion crystals in a Penning trap using a spatial light modulator
articles.title_zh: 利用空间光调制器在 Penning 阱中对大型离子晶体进行局域控制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06654v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Penning ion traps as quantum platforms have primarily utilized global control and symmetric Dicke states for quantum simulation and sensing experiments. The introduction of local control greatly increases the power of the platform as a quantum simulator but is technically challenging due to the rapid rotation of the ion crystals. Here we use an ultraviolet-compatible spatial light modulator (SLM) to imprint programmable AC Stark shift patterns with different azimuthal symmetries and gradients that co-rotate with the ion crystals, demonstrating localized coherent control of single plane crystals with greater than 100 ions. Comparisons of the measured ion qubit populations with calculations from independent measurements of the applied AC Stark shift patterns show good agreement, validating the technique and providing a path, with a higher format SLM, for parallelizable, coherent individual ion addressing in Penning traps.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向 Penning 离子阱量子平台中局域控制受离子晶体快速旋转限制的问题，使用兼容紫外光的空间光调制器生成可编程 AC Stark 位移图案。作者实现了具有不同方位对称性和梯度、并与离子晶体共旋的光场图案，对超过 100 个离子的单平面晶体进行局域相干控制。测得的离子量子比特布居与基于独立 AC Stark 位移测量的计算结果吻合良好，验证了该技术，并为更高格式 SLM 实现 Penning 阱中并行化单离子相干寻址提供路径。
authors: Allison L. Carter, Jennifer F. Lilieholm, Bryce B. Bullock, Kurt Thompson, Diep Nguyen, John J. Bollinger

articles.title: A quadratic-scaling algorithm with guaranteed convergence for quantum coupled-channel calculations
articles.title_zh: 用于量子耦合通道计算的保证收敛二次标度算法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.01159v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Rigorous quantum dynamics calculations provide essential insights into complex scattering phenomena across atomic and molecular physics, chemical reaction dynamics, and astrochemistry. However, the application of the gold-standard quantum coupled-channel (CC) method has been fundamentally constrained by a steep cubic scaling of computational cost [O(N³⁾]. Here, we develop a general, rigorous, and robust method for solving the time-independent Schrödinger equation for a single column of the scattering S-matrix with quadratic scaling [O(N²⁾] in the number of channels. The Weinberg-regularized Iterative Series Expansion (WISE) algorithm resolves the divergence issues affecting iterative techniques by applying a regularization procedure to the kernel of the multichannel Lippmann-Schwinger integral equation. The method also explicitly incorporates closed-channel effects, including those responsible for multichannel Feshbach resonances. We demonstrate the power of this approach by performing rigorous calculations on He + CO and CO + N₂ collisions, achieving exact quantum results with quadratic scaling guaranteed by a contour-integral construction. Our results establish a highly scalable computational paradigm, enabling state-to-state quantum scattering computations for complex molecular systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对量子耦合通道方法在散射计算中通常具有 O(N³) 成本的问题，提出求解单列散射 S 矩阵的二次标度 O(N²) 方法。Weinberg 正则化迭代级数展开算法通过对多通道 Lippmann-Schwinger 积分方程核进行正则化，克服迭代技术的发散问题。该方法显式纳入闭通道效应，包括导致多通道 Feshbach 共振的贡献；在 He+CO 和 CO+N₂ 碰撞计算中，作者展示了具有严格量子精度和由轮廓积分收敛分析保证的二次标度性能。
authors: Hubert J. Jóźwiak, Md Muktadir Rahman, Timur V. Tscherbul

articles.title: HPG-Diff: Hierarchical physics-guided diffusion with differentiable connectivity constraints for topology optimization
articles.title_zh: HPG-Diff：面向拓扑优化、带可微连通性约束的分层物理引导扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07233v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep generative models offer a promising paradigm for topology optimization, enabling rapid design exploration. However, these approaches lack intrinsic physics guidance, often leading to poor generalizability across unseen boundary conditions and the formation of floating material artifacts. To address these limitations, we propose Hierarchical Physics-Guided Diffusion (HPG-Diff), a novel diffusion framework that enforces physics consistency through two synergistic mechanisms. First, we introduce a hierarchical physics-guided strategy that aligns different precomputed physics features with the denoising process, guiding material distribution toward optimal load paths to enhance generalizability. Second, we propose a floating material suppression loss as a differentiable connectivity constraint inspired by thermal conduction to improve topological connectivity. By simulating a virtual heat propagation process from load positions, this mechanism explicitly penalizes floating material during training. Quantitative evaluations demonstrate that HPG-Diff achieves average compliance errors of 0.87% (in-distribution) and 5.29% (out-of-distribution), while reducing floating material ratios to 2.90% and 2.44%, respectively. Furthermore, case studies on a 3:1 rectangular domain, including cantilever and bridge benchmarks, provide preliminary evidence that lightweight LoRA fine-tuning with a small dataset can support the adaptation of HPG-Diff to rectangular non-square domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出分层物理引导扩散模型 HPG-Diff，用于改进深度生成模型在拓扑优化中的物理一致性、泛化能力和连通性。模型一方面将预计算的多层物理特征与去噪过程对齐，引导材料沿最优载荷路径分布；另一方面引入受热传导启发的浮置材料抑制损失，作为可微连通性约束，通过从载荷位置模拟虚拟热传播来惩罚孤立材料。定量结果显示，该方法在分布内和分布外条件下均获得较低柔度误差，分别约为 0.87% 和 5.29%。
authors: Jinbo Yang, Mingyue Yuan, Boyuan Zhang, Yoshifumi Kitamura, Shikai Jing

articles.title: DiPhon: Diffusion on Graphons for Scalable Graph Generation
articles.title_zh: DiPhon：用于可扩展图生成的图极限扩散模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.07232v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Diffusion models represent a leading paradigm for graph generation, with notable impact in domains such as molecular design. Yet, scaling these models to large graphs remains an open problem. We approach this question in the dense-graph setting through the lens of graphons, the size-agnostic limit objects of dense graph sequences, to study how structural graph statistics behave across node-size scales. This perspective leads to DiPhon, a diffusion framework for size-scalable graph generation. Specifically, we formulate a continuous diffusion process on the graphon space via a Jacobi stochastic differential equation (SDE), and propose DiPhon, a discretized graph-level process that mimics these dynamics on finite graphs. We further derive the corresponding reverse-time process, which requires access to the marginal score. For the Jacobi process, this score interestingly admits a tractable form, which we estimate from data via graph denoising and plug into the reverse process to generate graph samples. We prove that DiPhon matches exactly the first moment of the marginal distributions induced by the continuous graphon process, and approximates the second moment up to a closed-form discrepancy. Thus, DiPhon inherits key size-agnostic statistical properties of the graphon dynamics, providing a principled route toward scalable graph generation. Empirically, we demonstrate this scalability by training on small graphs and generating progressively larger graphs at inference time, without retraining, while preserving their core topological properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向稠密图的大规模生成问题，引入图极限（graphon）作为与节点数无关的极限对象，用以刻画不同图规模下结构统计量的变化。作者提出 DiPhon：在 graphon 空间上用 Jacobi 随机微分方程定义连续扩散过程，并构造有限图上的离散近似过程。反向生成过程依赖边缘分布的 score；对于 Jacobi 过程，该 score 具有可处理形式，可通过图去噪从数据中估计。理论上，DiPhon 可精确匹配连续 graphon 过程诱导边缘分布的一阶矩，从而支持尺寸可扩展的图采样。
authors: Sergio Rozada, Yiming Qin, Manuel Madeira, Pascal Frossard, Alejandro Ribeiro

articles.title: QANTIS: Hardware-Calibrated Sequential POMDP Belief Updates on IBM Heron
articles.title_zh: QANTIS：IBM Heron 上经硬件校准的序贯 POMDP 信念更新
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06760v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Autonomous systems under partial observability act on beliefs, not raw sensor events. QANTIS treats the quantum processor as a calibrated belief-update service in that loop: it receives a prior and an observation model, estimates the rare-event evidence term, and returns an ordinary posterior to a classical planner. This paper asks whether that service can be reused across a sequential Tiger POMDP horizon on present IBM Heron hardware without corrupting the planner-facing posterior. We answer with a controlled hardware case study rather than an end-to-end autonomy or wall-clock speedup claim. The study compares no amplification, guarded Grover amplification, and all-step fixed-point amplification on the same trajectory, then checks whether the returned posterior would change the downstream action. All-step FPAA preserves the Tiger posterior across the reported 8-step and 12-step primary runs, and the 20-step and 32-step controls remain inside the same operating band. In every reported decision check, the hardware posterior and the exact Bayes posterior select the same immediate action. Boundary-aware BIQAE stabilizes amplitude estimation near zero and near one, while a rare-event sweep maps the logical sample-complexity envelope for one-in-a-million evidence. The result is an operating envelope for a hardware-calibrated belief-update primitive, not a standalone hardware-advantage claim.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将量子处理器视为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程中的“信念更新服务”：输入先验与观测模型，估计稀有事件证据项，并向经典规划器返回后验分布。作者在 IBM Heron 硬件上以序贯 Tiger POMDP 为案例，比较无放大、受保护 Grover 放大和全步骤定点振幅放大等方案。结果显示，全步骤定点放大在多个步长实验中保持后验处于相同工作区间，且硬件后验与精确贝叶斯后验在所有报告的决策检查中选择相同即时动作。该文强调的是受控硬件可用性验证，而非端到端自主系统或实际加速声明。
authors: Bayram Yuksel Eker, Suayb S. Arslan, Ozgur Nazli, Mustafa Serhat Demirgil, Furkan Deligoz

articles.title: SpaR3D-MoE: Adaptive 3D Spatial Reasoning from Sparse Views Meets Geometry-Inductive Mixture-of-Experts
articles.title_zh: SpaR3D-MoE：稀疏视角自适应三维空间推理与几何归纳混合专家模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.06620v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) struggle to bridge the representational gap between 2D semantic understanding and 3D spatial geometry. Existing 3D-aware models either rely on costly 3D-specific data or utilize RGB-only inputs with heuristic sampling and monolithic, shallow fusion, which respectively disrupt essential spatiotemporal connectivity and induce modality contention across diverse spatial tasks. To overcome these bottlenecks, we introduce SpaR3D-MoE, an end-to-end framework that enables adaptive spatial reasoning by equipping MLLMs with geometry-aware capabilities from only sparse RGB inputs. First, we propose an adaptive spatiotemporal manifold sampling mechanism that constructs a geometry-aware spatiotemporal graph to extract informative keyframes, effectively mitigating sequence redundancy while preserving the scene's topological connectivity. Second, we introduce the heterogeneous geometry-inductive Mixture-of-Experts driven by an instruction-pose aware router, which adaptively routes multimodal tokens to specialized experts, resolving the cross-modal contention inherent in monolithic fusion. Extensive experiments on VSI-Bench, ScanQA, and SQA3D demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance. Notably, SpaR3D-MoE achieves the highest average score of 63.5 on VSI-Bench, outperforming the strongest baseline by 7.8 absolute points, alongside relative improvements of 35.4% and 51.4% in Route Plan and Relative Direction tasks, respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对多模态大语言模型难以弥合二维语义理解与三维空间几何之间差距的问题，提出 SpaR3D-MoE 框架，使模型仅依赖稀疏 RGB 输入获得几何感知空间推理能力。方法包括自适应时空流形采样，通过构建几何感知时空图选择关键信息帧，以减少序列冗余并保持场景拓扑连通性。作者还设计了由指令—位姿感知路由器驱动的异构几何归纳混合专家模块，将多模态 token 自适应分配给专门专家，以缓解单体融合中的跨模态竞争。
authors: Haida Feng, Hao Wei, Haolin Wang, Shiwei Li, Chade Li, Yihong Wu

articles.title: Quantum Private Intersection Based on Single Qubits
articles.title_zh: 基于单量子比特的量子私有集合交集协议
articles.abstract: Private Set Intersection (PSI) is a crucial Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC) primitive which enables participants to securely obtain the intersection of their private sets without revealing their individual set information. The advent of quantum computing threatens classical PSI protocols, driving the development of Quantum PSI (QPSI) alternatives. We propose a two-party QPSI protocol based on a semi-honest third party. This protocol achieves set intersection using only single-qubit unitary operations and single-qubit states. Security analysis shows that our protocol can resist common attacks. Validation experiments conducted on the IBM Qiskit simulator confirm the protocol's correctness and feasibility. Furthermore, we compare the proposed protocol with existing QPSI protocols in terms of quantum states, unitary operations, measurements, and fairness, demonstrating gains in quantum resource efficiency, fairness, and practical feasibility.

articles.title: Ligand-stabilized dilithium (C 6 F 5 ) 2 Li 2 featuring two planar tetracoordinate lithium and carbon centers
articles.abstract: The design of planar hypercoordinate Li represents a significant challenge because the stabilization in such molecules arises exclusively from electrostatic interactions, while covalent glue, particularly delocalized π/σ bond, is needed to stabilize a planar conformer. Here, we report a computational study of a novel system, two pentafluorophenyl ligands stabilized dilithium, (C 6 F 5 ) 2 Li 2 , featuring two planar tetracoordinate lithium (ptLi) atoms and two planar tetracoordinate carbon (ptC). The design strategy was inspired by the recent synthesis of tolyl–lithium complexes and refined through systematic structural modifications to achieve a fully planar geometry corresponding to a true minimum on the potential energy surface. Both thermodynamic and kinetic analyses demonstrate that the structure is stable under static and dynamic conditions. A thorough bonding analysis using different methods reveals that the stabilization of the ptLi atoms arises primarily from the electrostatic interactions, while the orbital contributions are comparatively weak. On the other hand, the stabilization of the ptCs is the interplay of both electrostatic and covalent interactions. Aromaticity analysis based on magnetically induced current densities indicates that aromatic character is confined to the benzenoid rings, whereas the Li-containing core is non-aromatic. These findings expand the conceptual framework for hypercoordinate species in s-block elements and highlight the role of selecting proper ligands that can lead to the realization of such planar hypercoordinate Li, not only in the cluster form but also in molecular materials.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Data-efficient multidimensional free energy estimation via physics-informed score learning
articles.abstract: Many biological processes involve numerous coupled degrees of freedom, yet free-energy estimation is often restricted to one-dimensional profiles to mitigate the high computational cost of multidimensional sampling. In this work, we extend Fokker–Planck Score Learning (FPSL) to efficiently reconstruct two-dimensional free-energy landscapes from non-equilibrium molecular dynamics simulations using different types of collective variables. We show that explicitly modeling orthogonal degrees of freedom reveals insights hidden in one-dimensional projections at negligible computational overhead. Additionally, exploiting symmetries in the underlying landscape enhances reconstruction accuracy, while regularization techniques ensure numerical robustness in sparsely sampled regions. We validate our approach on three distinct systems: the conformational dynamics of alanine dipeptide, as well as coarse-grained and all-atom models of solute permeation through lipid bilayers. We demonstrate that, because FPSL learns a smooth score function rather than histogram-based densities, it overcomes the exponential scaling of grid-based methods, establishing it as a data-efficient and scalable tool for multidimensional free-energy estimation.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Exact tunneling splittings of rotationally excited states from symmetrized path-integral molecular dynamics
articles.abstract: We extend our previous symmetrized path-integral molecular dynamics approach to calculate tunneling splittings of molecules in rotationally excited states. In this new formalism, the system is rigorously projected onto selected rotational manifolds and states of a chosen symmetry through an Eckart spring, which connects the two end beads of the ring polymer via a permutation–inversion–rotation operation. In this way, the tunneling splittings for the lowest vibrational states in the projected subspace can be obtained by taking the low-temperature limit. This method is numerically exact within statistical uncertainty once convergence with respect to all simulation parameters has been achieved. Importantly, it enables the simultaneous extraction of tunneling splittings for multiple total angular-momentum quantum numbers J from a single set of simulations, without additional computational cost relative to the original approach. After validating the formalism by computing the rotational levels of water (beyond the rigid-rotor approximation), we apply it to ammonia and obtain rotationally resolved tunneling splittings in excellent agreement with exact variational benchmarks. Except for small errors due to the underlying potential energy surface, the results capture the experimentally observed trend that the tunneling splitting decreases with J .
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Fourth-order extension of multichromophoric Förster energy transfer
articles.abstract: Excited state energy transfer (EET) is an essential process in many systems with optical functionality, such as photosynthetic systems, photovoltaic materials, and light-emitting diodes. Describing EET in large open quantum systems, such as molecular aggregates, is difficult, especially in intermediate parameter regimes. In the limit where the population transfer between molecular aggregates is incoherent, one can make use of the recently implemented time domain Förster resonant energy transfer method to determine the population transfer rates between the aggregates. In this study, we present a fourth-order perturbation theory that extends the Time Domain Multichromophoric Förster Resonance Energy Transfer (TD-MCFRET) method and allows for the more precise calculation of population transfer rates between molecular aggregates in intermediate regimes of coupling and system memory. The fourth-order correction can also be used to improve the accuracy of FRET models. We present a computationally tractable way of determining these higher-order corrections and demonstrate their relevance and validity for two bacterial photosynthetic systems: LH2 and chlorosomes. This new theoretical refinement may improve the interpretation of various experimental techniques such as absorption, fluorescence, and two-dimensional electronic spectroscopies and will deepen our understanding of EET in photosynthetic systems, synthetic devices, and beyond.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Polarizable embedding cluster perturbation theory for a coupled cluster singles and doubles target state
articles.abstract: This study presents the polarizable embedding cluster perturbation framework (PE-CP) and derives the working equations needed to perform calculations in a singles and perturbative doubles excitation space, denoted PE-CPS(D). The method is implemented in the Penguin program through interfaces to the external libraries PyFraMe and CPPE. To obtain the cluster amplitudes and multipliers, which constitute two coupled sets of equations in PE-CCSD, a standard scheme of outer and inner iterations is usually applied. In the PE-CPS(D) model, only the singles excitation space requires this iterative procedure to determine the wave function parameters; the perturbative doubles contributions can be evaluated directly. This feature highlights one of the principal strengths of the PE-CPS(D) approach. Finally, we present numerical tests comparing PE-CPS(D) with PE-CCSD, to which it formally converges. These results demonstrate that PE-CPS(D) provides an efficient route to high-level coupled-cluster accuracy for large quantum-mechanical systems embedded in a classical polarizable environment.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Generation of robust entanglement in plasmonically coupled quantum dots driven by quantum squeezed light
articles.abstract: Can quantum light reliably generate entanglement in systems with dissipation? Our cavity quantum electrodynamics calculations demonstrate that a single-mode squeezed light source can robustly generate steady-state entanglement between a plasmonically coupled pair of quantum dots. The strong coupling of plasmons to the light source and the pairwise nature of squeezed photon generation enable entanglement between quantum dots. This entanglement, measured as concurrence, can be improved by replacing an entangled photon-pair pulsed source of light with continuous pumping of squeezed photons. Unlike previously introduced schemes, the concurrence is robust against variations in the system parameters. Specifically, the generation of entanglement does not rely on fine-tuning of the plasmon–quantum dot coupling. These results provide a new perspective for robust entangled-state preparation in open quantum systems.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Reimagining singlet exciton fission: Insights from dimer architectures
articles.abstract: Singlet fission (SF) is an ultrafast bimolecular photophysical process in which a high-energy singlet excited state redistributes its energy into two lower-energy unbound triplet states, allowing a theoretical triplet quantum yield of up to 200%. Extensive studies over the past decade and a half have shown that SF proceeds through the formation of a spectroscopically detected correlated triplet–triplet pair (TT) intermediate, which subsequently dissociates to form the requisite two independent triplet excitons. Efficient separation and utilization of these triplets requires a detailed understanding of their generation and extraction in molecular aggregates and thin films. However, limited control over film morphology and intermolecular packing often makes it difficult to systematically tune SF rates. In this perspective, we summarize mechanistic insights gained from steady-state and time-resolved spectroscopic investigations of well-defined dimeric chromophore systems. We highlight the key relaxation and loss pathways that emerge subsequent to formation of the TT state, which can lower the effective triplet yield to less than 100% undoing the opportunities that SF presents. We further discuss strategies to promote the dissociation of TT pair into free triplets rather than undergoing annihilation processes, even within such dimeric architectures. Finally, although triplet extraction from dimers is commonly viewed as inefficient, we outline possible approaches for enabling effective harvesting of triplet excitons in relevant timescales from these molecular architectures.
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: A Machine-Checked Cost Analysis of the BMSSP Recurrence in Isabelle/HOL With a Non-Vacuous Size-Parametric Runtime Witness
articles.title_zh: 在 Isabelle/HOL 中对 BMSSP 递归进行机器检验的代价分析及非空尺寸参数化运行时间见证
articles.abstract: In 2025 Duan, Mao, Mao, Shu and Yin broke the long-standing O(m + n log n) “sorting barrier” for directed single-source shortest paths (SSSP) with a deter- ministic O(m log2/3 n) algorithm whose engine is a recursive subproblem, the Bounded Multi-Source Shortest Path (BMSSP) recurrence. We present what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first mechanized formalization of this recurrence and its running-time analysis, in Isabelle/HOL. The development is layered: an abstract semantic model with a machine-checked recursive correctness proof and an executable shortest-distance function; an amortized cost model built over an abstract Insert/BatchPrepend/Pull partition interface, realized by a paper-faithful bucketed data structure with the critical O(log(N/M )) insert scale; and a size-parametric layer over an unbounded graph family. Our headline result is a size- parametric validation layer for this cost model—a fully unconditional, non-vacuous running-time theorem witnessing that, on the unbounded unit-weight directed path family, the charged running time of the BMSSP loop is O |V |·(ln|V |)2/3 in the genuine graph size, with no hypotheses, on a family whose size tends to infinity and for which a complete run provably exists. We are deliberately precise about scope: this is a formalization of the BMSSP recurrence—its correctness and its charged operation-cost analysis—and not a machine-step verification of the full Duan–Mao–Mao–Shu–Yin SSSP implementation; the asymptotic theorems bound an exact operation count, and the size-parametric headline bounds the 1least-cost run of a specific unbounded family. As a separate contribution we for- mally diagnose a stronger coupling we attempted: a faithful per-step cost relation that we machine-check to be non-total over its intended inputs, which the decou- pled charged relation of the headline avoids. The entire development is checked by the Isabelle kernel with no sorry, oops, or axiomatization, and builds under Isabelle2025-2 importing only HOL and HOL-Library.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在 Isabelle/HOL 中形式化了 Duan 等人 2025 年突破有向单源最短路“排序壁垒”算法中的 BMSSP 递归及其运行时间分析。工作包含抽象语义模型、递归正确性证明、可执行最短距离函数、基于分摊代价的分区接口，以及忠实于论文的桶式数据结构实现。核心结果是在无界单位权有向路径图族上给出非空、无条件的尺寸参数化运行时间定理，证明 BMSSP 循环的计费运行时间随真实图规模满足 O(|V|(ln|V|)²/³)。

articles.title: From Instrumented Towers to Vulnerable Blocks: A Physics-Informed Federated Edge Digital-Twin Framework for Translational Seismic Damage Assessment in Andean Emerging Economies (NSET-Andes)
articles.title_zh: 从仪器化高塔到脆弱街区：面向安第斯新兴经济体平移式地震损伤评估的物理信息联邦边缘数字孪生框架 NSET-Andes
articles.abstract: Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) in seismic megacities faces a persistent trade-off between the fidelity of centralized cloud-based Digital Twins (DT) and the latency, bandwidth, and single-point-of-failure risks these architectures incur during network-congested disaster scenarios. This paper proposes NSET-Andes, a physics-informed Federated Learning (FL) and edge-computing framework for real-time seismic damage estimation, and — as its central contribution — a structured translational methodology for adapting instrumentation practices developed for Tokyo's high-rise steel moment-resisting frames to Peru's markedly different, largely undocumented building stock. The framework embeds verified structural-dynamics formulations — the multi-degree-of-freedom (MDOF) equation of motion integrated via the Newmark-β method, the Bouc-Wen hysteretic model, the Park-Ang damage index (DPA), and Gazetas' frequency-dependent soil-structure interaction (SSI) impedance functions — as physics residual penalties inside a federated training loop (FedAvg), so that gradient-only communication replaces raw-data transmission. Performance figures reported here (inference latency, bandwidth reduction, drift-prediction accuracy) are derived from a synthetic Nankai Trough-calibrated benchmark scenario and are presented as preliminary, simulation-based indicators — not as field-validated measurements — pending instrumented pilot testing. The principal gap this work addresses is the absence, in the current SHM/DT literature, of an explicit adaptation pathway from data-rich, high-instrumentation contexts to low-resource, connectivity-constrained, typologically heterogeneous contexts such as metropolitan Lima. Accordingly, the paper develops a normative harmonization layer under Peru's NTE E.030-2016 seismic code, a hybrid-typology digital-twin library covering confined masonry and adobe-RC hybrid systems, and an asynchronous, connectivity-tolerant federated protocol informed by the connectivity disruptions documented after the 2007 Pisco earthquake. The framework is offered as a research and institutional roadmap — requiring CISMID/SENCICO empirical validation — rather than as a deployed or field-tested system.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 NSET-Andes 框架，用于地震巨型城市中低延迟、低带宽且更具鲁棒性的实时结构损伤评估。方法将多自由度结构动力学方程、Newmark-β 积分、Bouc-Wen 滞回模型、Park-Ang 损伤指标和 Gazetas 土-结构相互作用阻抗等物理模型嵌入联邦学习训练，以梯度通信替代原始数据上传。其重点贡献是将东京高层钢框架的监测经验转译到秘鲁等安第斯地区资料不足、类型差异显著的建筑存量中。

articles.title: Synergistic effects of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides on methylene blue adsorption by magnetic biochar
articles.title_zh: 壳聚糖与铈-铁氧化物对磁性生物炭吸附亚甲基蓝的协同作用
articles.abstract: Biochar is a promising adsorbent for wastewater treatment, but its adsorption performance is often limited by the insufficient abundance of active surface functional groups. In this study, a chitosan-loaded Ce–Fe oxide magnetic biochar (CCFBC) was synthesized to investigate the synergistic effects of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides on methylene blue (MB) adsorption. FT-IR, SEM–EDX, BET, and XPS analyses confirmed the successful incorporation of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides onto the biochar surface, providing diverse adsorption sites and surface functionalities. The highest MB removal efficiency (95.2%) was achieved at pH 10 within 180 min using 0.5% (w/v) CCFBC. Adsorption performance increased with chitosan loading, indicating a synergistic contribution from amino functional groups and metal-oxide surface sites. Adsorption kinetics were better described by the pseudo-second-order model than by the pseudo-first-order model, while both Langmuir and Freundlich isotherms adequately fitted the experimental data. The maximum adsorption capacity estimated from the Langmuir model was 142.8 mg·g⁻¹. Spectroscopic analyses suggested the involvement of amino-, oxygen-containing, and metal-oxide surface groups in MB adsorption. These findings demonstrate that the synergistic integration of chitosan and Ce–Fe oxides effectively enhances the adsorption performance of magnetic biochar for dye-contaminated wastewater treatment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究制备了负载壳聚糖和 Ce–Fe 氧化物的磁性生物炭 CCFBC，用于提升废水中亚甲基蓝的吸附去除能力。FT-IR、SEM–EDX、BET 和 XPS 表征证实壳聚糖与金属氧化物成功引入生物炭表面，提供了氨基、含氧官能团和金属氧化物位点等多种吸附中心。在 pH 10、180 min、0.5% CCFBC 条件下去除率达到 95.2%，Langmuir 模型估算最大吸附容量为 142.8 mg·g⁻¹，动力学更符合准二级模型。

articles.title: PV-YOLO: Collaborative Lightweight Improved YOLOv8 for Micro-Defect Detection of Photovoltaic Cells in UAV Edge Inspection
articles.title_zh: PV-YOLO：面向无人机边缘巡检中光伏电池微缺陷检测的协同轻量化改进 YOLOv8
articles.abstract: Detecting tiny micro-defects on photovoltaic cells is essential to guarantee power generation efficiency, yet mainstream detection models frequently fail to balance detection precision and inference speed. This study proposes PV-YOLO, a lightweight improved YOLOv8n model embedded with four custom-designed modules to elevate micro-defect recognition while lowering model parameters and computational overhead. The C2f_faster backbone optimizes gradient transmission and reduces redundant computation; GhostConv replaces ordinary convolutions to compress feature duplication; an efficient multiscale attention (EMA) module strengthens feature extraction for faint micro-cracks and hotspots; the adaptive feature pyramid network (AFPN) realizes dynamic multi-scale feature fusion for small targets. Comparative experiments are conducted on a public dataset containing 4500 EL and infrared PV cell images. The proposed PV-YOLO reaches 72.3% mAP@0.5, 3.13% higher than original YOLOv8n, with FLOPs reduced by 2.46%. Especially, the recall of microcracks rises by 7.2%. Deployed on NVIDIA Jetson Orin with CUDA and TensorRT acceleration, the model runs at 140 FPS to support real-time edge detection. Industrial tests under variable illumination and cell textures verify that PV-YOLO achieves stable and reliable micro-defect detection for practical photovoltaic inspection scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出轻量化 PV-YOLO 模型，在 YOLOv8n 中引入 C2f_faster 主干、GhostConv、高效多尺度注意力模块和自适应特征金字塔网络，以兼顾光伏电池微缺陷检测精度与推理速度。基于 4500 张 EL 和红外光伏图像的公开数据集，PV-YOLO 的 mAP@0.5 达到 72.3%，较原 YOLOv8n 提高 3.13%，FLOPs 降低 2.46%，微裂纹召回率提升 7.2%。在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin 上结合 CUDA 和 TensorRT 部署后可达 140 FPS，适用于实时边缘检测。

articles.title: Machine Learning Classification for Irradiated Material Gamma Ray Spectra
articles.title_zh: 用于辐照材料伽马射线谱分类的机器学习方法
articles.abstract: This work presents a preliminary evaluation of Machine Learning (ML) methods for automated gamma-ray spectroscopy classification across two levels of spectral complexity and three levels of detector resolution. Samples analyzed include both single isotope sources and materials irradiated at the University of Texas at Austin Research Reactor. Sample collection was conducted with Sodium Iodide (NaI(Tl)), Cadmium Zinc Telluride (CZT), and High Purity Germanium (HPGe) detectors. A collection of ML techniques was used and compared to classify spectra according to their correct identity; contrastive techniques were first applied to the single isotope sources before application to the complex irradiated samples with changing activities. Activated samples included NIST-certified coal, soil, tomato leaves, and natural uranium oxide (U3O8) irradiated at the UT Austin TRIGA reactor. A five-step preprocessing pipeline consisting of counts-per-second normalization, interpolation onto a common energy grid, total-area normalization, log1p transformation, and Poisson noise augmentation was applied to place all spectra on a physically meaningful, detector-agnostic representation. Principal Component Analysis (PCA) reduced the 3001-dimensional feature vectors to between 4 and 13 components prior to classification. Three classifiers were evaluated under Leave-One-Out Cross-Validation (LOO-CV): Random Forest (RF), Support Vector Machine with RBF kernel (SVM), and k-Nearest Neighbors (KNN). For single-isotope sources, all three classifiers achieved no observed failures across all detector types. For the complex irradiated samples, RF and KNN achieved no observed failures (accuracy 1.000, Matthews Correlation Coefficient 1.000) on all three detectors, with SVM reaching 0.974 on HPGe due to cooling-time-dependent spectral drift in the tomato leaf class. Clopper-Pearson 95% confidence intervals and per-class prediction confidence analysis indicate that observed accuracy and prediction reliability diverge for low-statistics measurements, most notably for short-count CZT spectra. These results establish a validated preprocessing and classification baseline for experimental gamma spectroscopy datasets with variable acquisition times, detector types, and post-irradiation histories, and provide a framework for extension into more complex identification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作初步评估了多种机器学习方法在不同谱复杂度和探测器能量分辨率下进行伽马能谱自动分类的能力。样品包括单一同位素源以及在德州大学奥斯汀研究堆中辐照的煤、土壤、番茄叶和天然铀氧化物等材料，探测器涵盖 NaI(Tl)、CZT 和 HPGe。研究采用计数率归一化、统一能量网格插值、总面积归一化、log1p 变换和泊松噪声增强等预处理流程，以构建更具物理意义且相对探测器无关的谱表示。

articles.title: NEP89: universal neuroevolution potential for inorganic and organic materials across 89 elements
articles.title_zh: NEP89：覆盖89种元素的无机与有机材料通用神经演化势
articles.abstract: Nature Computational Science, Published online: 08 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s43588-026-01009-6 The researchers developed NEP89, a foundation model for large-scale molecular dynamics across 89 elements with near-quantum-level accuracy and high efficiency. It can be rapidly adapted to address complex challenges in inorganic and organic materials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 NEP89，一种面向大规模分子动力学模拟的基础型神经演化势模型，覆盖89种元素。模型旨在以接近量子力学计算的精度和较高效率处理无机与有机材料体系，并可快速适配复杂材料问题；更多基准测试与应用细节需查阅原文。

articles.title: CLAWDIA: a dictionary learning framework for gravitational-wave data analysis
articles.title_zh: CLAWDIA：用于引力波数据分析的字典学习框架
articles.abstract: Deep-learning methods are becoming increasingly important in gravitational-wave data analysis, yet their performance often relies on large training datasets and models whose internal representations are difficult to interpret. Sparse dictionary learning (SDL) offers a complementary approach: it performs well in scarce-data regimes and yields physically interpretable representations of gravitational-wave morphology. Here we present clawdia (Comprehensive Library for the Analysis of Waves via Dictionary-based Algorithms), an open-source Python framework that integrates SDL-based denoising and classification under realistic detector noise. We systematise previously isolated SDL workflows into a unified, modular environment with a consistent, user-friendly interface.
