articles.title: The Geometry of Flux Surfaces with Quasi-Poloidal Symmetry
articles.title_zh: 准极向对称磁通面的几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.13980v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quasi-poloidal (QP) magnetic fields have desirable properties for confining plasma: no radial drift of guiding centres (with positive implications for neoclassical transport), zero Pfirsch-Schlüter current, and a lower level of damping for poloidal flows. Despite their attractive properties, QP fields are not amenable to the near-axis expansion, a major theoretical tool for understanding toroidal fields. In this paper, we provide a novel framework for defining and understanding QP flux surfaces. This framework relies on a simplification that transforms the task of finding a quasi-poloidal flux surface from a 3D problem to a 2D problem. This simplification also applies to asymmetric magnetic mirrors with desirable properties. We sketch how this 2D problem can form the basis of an efficient optimisation problem for finding QP flux surfaces. We leverage this 2D problem for theoretical understanding: for instance, we identify a route to finding QP flux surfaces that are naturally flat mirrors (Velasco et al. 2023). The reduced model is qualitatively checked against numerically optimised QP equilibria. These numerical solutions only satisfy QP approximately, but we predictably find that local discrepancies with the reduced model correspond to significant local QP errors, anomalous parallel currents, and field lines deviating from geodesics.
articles.abstract_zh: 准极向对称磁场有利于等离子体约束，可抑制导心径向漂移、消除 Pfirsch-Schlüter 电流并降低极向流阻尼，但难以用近轴展开处理。本文提出一种定义和理解准极向磁通面的新框架，将寻找三维准极向磁通面的任务化简为二维问题，并指出该化简也适用于具有优良性质的非对称磁镜。作者讨论了基于该二维问题的高效优化策略，并用数值优化的准极向平衡对约化模型进行定性检验。
authors: Rishin Madan, Wrick Sengupta, Elizabeth J. Paul, Mohammed Haque, Richard Nies, José Luis Velasco, Amitava Bhattacharjee

articles.title: Stable (2+1)-dimensional soliton and breather molecules in a cold Rydberg atomic gas
articles.title_zh: 冷里德堡原子气体中的稳定二维空间孤子分子与呼吸子分子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.21955v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We investigate the formation of stable (2+1)-dimensional spatial-domain optical soliton molecules and breather molecules in a gas of Rydberg atoms, highlighting the role of the nonlocal nonlinearity, which is generated by the electromagnetically induced transparency in the Rydberg medium. The setting supports diverse species of large-size polygonal soliton molecules, including rectangular and oblique rhombuses, checkerboard cells, and hexagons. The analysis identifies two distinct formation regimes. In the case of moderately nonlocality, the long-range interactions alone stabilize the soliton molecules in the static form. In contrast, in the strongly nonlocal regime, initially imposed rotation is required to generate a centrifugal force that counteracts the strong attraction, resulting in stably rotating soliton molecules. The rotation period can be controlled by adjusting the system parameters. Furthermore, appropriate initial velocities can induce inherent breathing dynamics in the solitons, leading to the formation of breather molecules. Tuning the initial velocity, one can control the evolution of soliton molecules and breather molecules and even realize their mutual conversion. Our study offers a new scheme for engineering soliton molecules and breather molecules, and suggests new possibilities for the design of data processing and transmission in optical systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察里德堡原子气体中由电磁诱导透明产生的非局域非线性如何支持稳定的（2+1）维空间光孤子分子和呼吸子分子。体系可形成多种大尺寸多边形孤子分子，包括矩形、斜菱形、棋盘格和六边形结构。作者区分了中等非局域性下由长程相互作用直接稳定的静态分子，以及强非局域性下需借助初始旋转的离心效应抵消吸引而形成的稳定旋转分子；适当初速度还可诱导内禀呼吸动力学。
authors: Lu Qin, Hairu Zhai, Lu Liu, Yingying Zhang, Zeyun Shi, Zunlue Zhu, Xingdong Zhao, Wuming Liu, Boris A. Malomed

articles.title: libwignernj: a reusable C/C++/Fortran/Python library for exact Wigner symbols and related coefficients
articles.title_zh: libwignernj：用于精确 Wigner 符号及相关系数的可复用 C/C++/Fortran/Python 库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.06634v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We describe libwignernj, a freely available, BSD-licensed library that evaluates Wigner 3j, 6j, and 9j symbols, Clebsch--Gordan, Racah W, and Fano X coefficients, and Gaunt coefficients over both complex and real spherical harmonics in standards-compliant C99. libwignernj represents factorials by the vector of their signed prime-exponent decomposition - a prime-factorization technique introduced for the angular-momentum coefficients by Dodds and Wiechers (Comput. Phys. Commun. 4, 268 (1972)) and refined in a long line of subsequent work - and combines that representation with the multiword-integer Racah sum of Johansson and Forssén (SIAM J. Sci. Comput. 38, A376 (2016)), under which every intermediate quantity is an exact rational and all rounding is confined to the final floating-point conversion. Single-, double-, and long-double-precision results are correct to the last representable bit, and IEEE 754 binary128 evaluation through libquadmath and arbitrary-precision evaluation through the GNU Multiple-Precision Floating-Point Reliable (MPFR) library are optionally exposed. libwignernj has no mandatory runtime dependencies and no caller-side initialization step, making it easy to embed across the atomic, molecular, nuclear, and electromagnetic-scattering applications in which these coefficients arise. C++, CPython, and Fortran 90 bindings ship alongside the C library. Half-integer angular momenta are encoded exactly via integer 2j arguments throughout the application programming interface (API). CMake-package and pkg-config files ship for drop-in integration into downstream projects, and a continuous-integration (CI) pipeline runs the full test suite on Linux (shared and static), macOS, and Windows on every push.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍开源 BSD 许可库 libwignernj，可在符合 C99 标准的实现中计算 Wigner 3j、6j、9j 符号、Clebsch–Gordan 系数、Racah W、Fano X 以及复/实球谐函数的 Gaunt 系数。该库用带符号素因子指数向量表示阶乘，并结合多字整数 Racah 求和，使中间量保持精确有理数，仅在最终浮点转换时舍入。其单精度、双精度和 long double 结果可达到最后一位可表示比特的正确性，并可选支持 IEEE binary128 和 MPFR 任意精度计算，且无强制运行时依赖。

articles.title: Photon thermalization in an open and disordered scattering medium
articles.title_zh: 开放无序散射介质中的光子热化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.01997v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Thermalization of light, where photons acquire a temperature and chemical potential analogous to a material gas, remains a striking yet experimentally elusive manifestation of quantum statistical physics. To date, it has been realized only in carefully engineered photonic environments that enforce repeated absorption-emission cycles. Here we show that such thermalization can emerge in a radically simpler setting: an open scattering medium. Using a pumped fluorescent dye solution doped with colloidal particles, we demonstrate that multiple scattering alone suffices to trap photons long enough to drive them to thermal equilibrium. The emitted radiation follows a Bose-Einstein distribution with a finite chemical potential, independently tunable via optical pumping, while its temperature is set by the host medium. A clear spectroscopic signature of thermalization is observed as a plateau at the sample temperature over a finite spectral range. Our results establish disordered scattering media as a generic platform for photon thermalization, extending this fundamental phenomenon beyond resonant cavities and opening new routes towards cavity-free photonic thermodynamics and thermal light sources operating under ambient conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作表明，光子热化不必依赖精心设计的谐振腔或强制反复吸收-发射循环，而可在开放散射介质中出现。作者使用掺入胶体粒子的受泵浦荧光染料溶液，证明多重散射足以延长光子停留时间并推动其达到热平衡。实验观测到带有限化学势的玻色-爱因斯坦分布，化学势可由光泵浦独立调控，温度由宿主介质决定；有限谱区内位于样品温度的平台构成热化的清晰光谱证据。
authors: Lorenzo Soncin, Romain Pierrat, Yannick De Wilde, Rémi Carminati, Valentina Krachmalnicoff

articles.title: paces: Parallelized Application of Co-Evolving Subspaces, a method for computing quantum dynamics on GPUs
articles.title_zh: paces：用于 GPU 量子动力学计算的并行化共演化子空间方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.07341v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: An efficient method of solving the time-dependent Schrödinger equation for pure states is described: At each timestep, a restricted subspace of the total Hilbert space is systematically and naturally constructed via the image of repeated applications of the Hamiltonian operator, and the time evolution is computed exactly within said subspace. The subspace is dynamically recomputed such that it co-evolves with the state vector. The method is built from the ground up as a parallel algorithm for graphics processing units and suited to Hamiltonians that are sparse in a given basis. We benchmark the method by comparing its results for a 1D Holstein model to previously published multiset-MPS results, and then apply the method to compute optical spectra and non-equilibrium dynamics of one-, two- and three-dimensional model chromophore nanoaggregates.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种求解纯态含时薛定谔方程的高效方法：每个时间步通过哈密顿量的重复作用构造总希尔伯特空间的受限子空间，并在该子空间内精确推进时间演化。该子空间随态矢量动态重算并与其共演化，算法从设计上面向 GPU 并行，适合在给定基底下稀疏的哈密顿量。作者用一维 Holstein 模型与已发表的 multiset-MPS 结果对标，并进一步计算一维、二维和三维模型发色团纳米聚集体的光谱和非平衡动力学。

articles.title: Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics Enable Complete and Scalable E(3)-Equivariant Networks
articles.title_zh: 自旋加权球谐函数实现完备且可扩展的 E(3) 等变网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01408v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: E(3)-equivariant networks are promising for 3D atomistic system modeling, yet their scalability is limited by the O(L⁶⁾ complexity of the Clebsch-Gordan Tensor Product (CGTP). The recently proposed Gaunt Tensor Product (GTP) reduces the complexity but is unable to capture the antisymmetric paths, resulting in incomplete expressivity. In this work, we present SpinGTP, an approach to overcome the GTP incompleteness by generalizing from scalar functions to Spin-Weighted Spherical Harmonics (SWSH). By relying on the algebraic properties of SWSH, SpinGTP recovers the missing antisymmetric interactions while maintaining the asymptotic efficiency of GTP. It also allows for a more expressive equivariant basis that naturally accounts for the parity-odd components of tensor products. We evaluate SpinGTP across diverse benchmarks, including Tetris, 3BPA, SPICE-MACE-OFF, and OC20. Our results show that SpinGTP achieves accuracies comparable to full CGTP. Notably, by explicitly capturing antisymmetric paths, SpinGTP exhibits superior performance in tasks involving chiral materials and non-centrosymmetric geometries. This work provides a complete, scalable, and mathematically rigorous path toward high-order equivariance in large-scale 3D atomistic system simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文针对三维原子体系建模中 E(3) 等变网络的可扩展性与表达完备性问题，提出 SpinGTP 方法。传统 Clebsch-Gordan 张量积复杂度为 O(L⁶)，Gaunt 张量积虽更高效但缺失反对称路径；SpinGTP 通过从标量函数推广到自旋加权球谐函数，恢复缺失的反对称相互作用，同时保持 Gaunt 张量积的渐近效率。多个基准测试显示，SpinGTP 精度接近完整 CGTP，并在手性材料和非中心对称几何任务中因显式捕获反对称路径而表现更好。
authors: Chenxing Liang, Yuchao Lin, Andrii Kryvenko, Wendi Yu, Chuan Li, Jianwen Xie, Xiaofeng Qian, Shuiwang Ji

articles.title: Conditional Inference Trees and Forests for Feature Selection
articles.title_zh: 用于特征选择的条件推断树与条件推断森林
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Conditional inference trees (CIT) and conditional inference forests (CIF) reduce split-selection bias by testing features before choosing split thresholds, but repeated permutation tests and threshold searches can make these methods computationally expensive. We study CIT and CIF as top-k feature-ranking methods for downstream prediction using real-data benchmarks, runtime ablations, and synthetic feature-recovery experiments. At a fixed node, if the features and permutation budget do not depend on the node responses, Bonferroni-corrected +1 Monte Carlo permutation p-values control nodewise rejection under the complete permutation null. CIF ranks 4th among 17 classification methods on 22 datasets and 3rd among 18 regression methods on 8 datasets. With Bonferroni correction held fixed, the CIF runtime ablations indicate that adaptive stopping and the number of thresholds searched have the largest measured effect on runtime: turning off adaptive stopping and using exact threshold search increase fitting time by 4.0--8.4× and 1.9--10.8×, respectively, while downstream score changes are at most 0.011. Sparse high-p simulations indicate that forest feature sampling can leave informative features out of many split decisions. Overall, the results support CIF as a top-k feature-ranking method in the evaluated downstream prediction benchmarks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作系统研究条件推断树（CIT）和条件推断森林（CIF）作为下游预测任务的 top-k 特征排序方法，并分析其统计控制与计算代价。作者指出，在节点处若特征和置换预算不依赖节点响应，Bonferroni 校正的 +1 Monte Carlo 置换 p 值可在完全置换零假设下控制节点层面的拒绝率。实证结果显示 CIF 在多组分类和回归基准中排名靠前；运行时消融表明，自适应停止和阈值搜索数量对耗时影响最大，而对下游分数影响很小。
authors: Robert Milletich, Justin Downes, Steve Goley, Newel Hirst

articles.title: Token Geometry
articles.title_zh: Token 几何
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01455v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models learn continuous programs over discrete symbols, with the embedding table and LM-head acting as the read/write interface between them. We show that this interface has gradient geometry distinct from dense hidden weights which can be exploited to improve the Pareto frontier across supervised finetuning, RL, and pretraining, while only utilizing kilobytes of optimizer state. We introduce Ember, a lightweight optimizer for embedding and LM-head matrices that utilizes O(V + D) VRAM, instead of Adam's O(2VD), and forgoes the need to shard both token table optimizer states. We provide empirical evidence that Ember scales effectively across batch size and parameter count. We show that the optimization trajectory of tokens can be well described by a simple 1D ray, counter to the popular belief that neural net parameters navigate a heavily nonconvex landscape. We provide a principled view on the surprisingly narrow space of optimizers that suffice for Transformer training. Finally, we open-source our distributed Ember implementation that merges cleanly with existing ZeRO/FSDP setups to support further research at https://github.com/katop1234/ember
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究语言模型中嵌入表和 LM-head 作为离散符号与连续程序之间读写接口的特殊梯度几何，并据此提出轻量优化器 Ember。Ember 面向 embedding 和 LM-head 矩阵，仅需 O(V + D) 显存而非 Adam 的 O(2VD)，从而避免对 token 表优化器状态进行分片，并可与 ZeRO/FSDP 等分布式训练设置结合。作者给出监督微调、强化学习和预训练中的实验证据，认为 token 的优化轨迹可由简单的一维射线较好描述，并据此解释 Transformer 训练中所需优化器空间为何相对狭窄。

articles.title: Evolutionary Feature Engineering for Structured Data
articles.title_zh: 面向结构化数据的进化式特征工程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01548v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly used as open-ended search operators in evolutionary optimization. We introduce Evolutionary Feature Engineering (EFE), a framework for using LLM-based evolution to discover preprocessing transformations for structured data. EFE represents transformations as Python programs with a standardized fit/transform interface, allowing them to be inserted directly into existing machine learning pipelines. During evolution, candidate programs are refined using dataset context, summary statistics, and downstream performance feedback on validation set. We instantiate EFE in two settings. For time-series forecasting, EFE-Time learns invertible, dataset-specific normalizations that improve off-the-shelf time-series foundation models. It reduces forecasting errors (MASE, WQL, MAE) 3% or more when averaged across datasets and improvements are as much as 19% on the COVID-Deaths dataset. Notably, these improvements occur with recent TSFMs such as Chronos-2. For tabular prediction, EFE-Tab evolves compact feature programs that add useful interpretable features and remove redundant ones, improving or matching existing LLM-based feature-engineering methods. We found EFE-Tab to be particularly effective on classical decision trees, where small sets of evolved features yield competitive accuracy while preserving interpretability. Overall, EFE demonstrates that LLM-based evolution can improve both accuracy and interpretability when automatically tackling structured data.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出 Evolutionary Feature Engineering（EFE），利用大语言模型驱动的进化搜索为结构化数据自动发现预处理变换。候选变换被表示为具有标准 fit/transform 接口的 Python 程序，可直接嵌入现有机器学习流水线，并在演化过程中结合数据集上下文、统计摘要和验证集性能反馈迭代改进。作者在时间序列预测和表格预测中实例化该框架：EFE-Time 学习可逆、数据集特异的归一化以改进时间序列基础模型，EFE-Tab 则演化紧凑且可解释的特征程序以增加有用特征并剔除冗余特征。
authors: Ege Onur Taga, Yilin Zhuang, M. Emrullah Ildiz, Petros Mol, Abhimanyu Das, Karthik Duraisamy, Samet Oymak

articles.title: Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine for Solving High-Frequency Partial Differential Equations
articles.title_zh: 用于求解高频偏微分方程的频移物理信息极限学习机
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01694v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Solving partial differential equations (PDEs) with high-frequency solutions remains a central challenge in physics-informed machine learning due to spectral bias -- the tendency of neural networks to learn low-frequency components preferentially. This paper proposes a Frequency Shift Physics-Informed Extreme Learning Machine (FS-PIELM) framework that addresses this limitation through an additive mechanism for weight initialization. Rather than multiplying random weights by a scaling factor, the method translates the mean of the Gaussian weight distribution while keeping the variance fixed at unity, thereby avoiding the variance amplification inherent in scaling-based methods. Two variants are developed: FS-PIELM-L assigns independent frequency magnitudes to individual neurons, while FS-PIELM-G groups neurons for improved robustness. Theoretical analysis shows that the frequency variance under the proposed framework remains bounded and approaches unity regardless of target frequency, in contrast to the quadratic growth of conventional approaches. The method preserves the computational efficiency of extreme learning machines, requiring only a single linear solve. Experiments on seven benchmark problems spanning six equation types -- Helmholtz, wave, Poisson, Klein-Gordon, heat, and advection-diffusion -- on both regular and complex geometries show that the linear variant achieves the best accuracy in six of seven cases, with improvements of one to nearly five orders of magnitude over existing PIELM variants. The code and data accompanying this manuscript will be made publicly available at https://github.com/xgxgnpu/Physics-informed-vibe-coding/tree/main/FS-PIELM.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对物理信息机器学习求解高频 PDE 时的谱偏置问题，提出频移物理信息极限学习机（FS-PIELM）。不同于通过放大随机权重来覆盖高频成分，FS-PIELM 平移高斯权重分布的均值并保持方差为 1，从而避免缩放方法导致的方差放大。作者提出逐神经元分配频率幅值的 FS-PIELM-L 和按组分配以增强鲁棒性的 FS-PIELM-G，并从理论上说明其频率方差保持有界且趋近于 1，同时保留极限学习机的计算效率。
authors: Xiong Xiong, Ruonan Zhai, Zheng Zeng, Sheng Zhou, Rongchun Hu, Zichen Deng

articles.title: Hybrid quantum-classical neural network for sentiment analysis
articles.title_zh: 用于情感分析的量子-经典混合神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01943v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Quantum machine learning has recently emerged as a promising paradigm that leverages the expressive power of quantum circuits to address complex learning tasks. In this work, we investigate the applicability of hybrid quantum-classical neural networks to sentiment analysis, a central problem in natural language processing. We focus on a dataset of tweets related to COVID-19, where the textual content is vectorized using TF-IDF and fed into both classical feedforward networks and hybrid architectures incorporating parameterized quantum circuits. Our results show that hybrid models can achieve accuracy comparable to the classical baseline, while exhibiting distinct learning dynamics, especially in terms of validation loss and accuracy, that suggest a richer representational capacity. Moreover, when applying transfer learning to an SMS spam classification task, the hybrid models consistently outperform the classical counterpart, achieving an accuracy increase of 15 percentage points (from 66% to 81%) on the spam class, demonstrating enhanced generalization. These findings highlight the feasibility of employing QML for natural language processing and point toward the potential advantages of hybrid models as quantum hardware continues to advance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究量子-经典混合神经网络在自然语言情感分析中的适用性，以 COVID-19 相关推文为数据集，采用 TF-IDF 表征文本，并与经典前馈网络进行比较。结果显示，混合模型可达到与经典基线相近的准确率，并呈现不同的验证损失与准确率演化特征，暗示其表征能力差异。在迁移到 SMS 垃圾短信分类任务时，混合模型在垃圾类准确率上由 66% 提升至 81%，表现出更好的泛化能力。
authors: Giacomo Cappiello, Filippo Caruso, Xing Liang, Dimitrios Makris

articles.title: Privacy-Preserving and Verifiable Approximate Distributed Coded Computing
articles.title_zh: 隐私保护且可验证的近似分布式编码计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02187v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Distributed machine learning enables collaborative model training without centralizing data, but it also exposes learning processes to privacy leakage and malicious manipulation. Existing defenses typically address these threats in isolation and are often tailored to specific learning paradigms or model architectures, limiting their applicability in realistic deployments. In particular, federated learning and decentralized learning exhibit distinct adversarial surfaces that are rarely addressed within a unified framework. In this paper, we present a model-agnostic framework for adversary-resistant distributed learning that jointly addresses privacy preservation and malicious behavior across both federated and decentralized settings. Our approach combines paradigm-specific defense mechanisms with GPBACC, a privacy-enhancing coded computing technique applicable to arbitrary machine learning models. For federated learning, we integrate robust aggregation strategies to mitigate the impact of malicious participants, while for decentralized learning we employ approximate decode-and-compare and group testing techniques to enable lightweight verification and adversary isolation without relying on a trusted aggregator. Crucially, we evaluate the proposed framework through an explicit, attack-driven analysis. We implement representative privacy attacks and malicious behaviors, and empirically demonstrate that the combination of GPBACC with robust aggregation and verification mechanisms significantly reduces privacy leakage and improves resilience against active adversaries. These results suggest that privacy-enhancing coded computing, when combined with appropriate adversary-resistance strategies, provides a practical and deployable foundation for secure distributed machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种模型无关的抗对抗分布式学习框架，试图在联邦学习和去中心化学习两类场景中同时处理隐私泄露与恶意参与者问题。方法结合 GPBACC 隐私增强编码计算与不同范式下的防御机制：在联邦学习中采用鲁棒聚合，在去中心化学习中采用近似解码-比较和群测试以实现轻量验证。该框架强调对任意机器学习模型的适用性，而非局限于特定模型结构。
authors: Xavier Martínez-Luaña, Alba Gude-Santos, Manuel Fernández-Veiga, Rebeca P. Díaz-Redondo

articles.title: QFedAgent: Quantum-Enhanced Personalized Federated Learning for Multi-Agent Activity Recognition
articles.title_zh: QFedAgent：面向多智能体活动识别的量子增强个性化联邦学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02426v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed devices without sharing raw data, making it suitable for privacy-sensitive robotic sensing applications. However, multi-agent systems generate heterogeneous and non-independent and identically distributed (non-IID) multimodal sensor streams that degrade conventional FL algorithms, while classical fusion modules introduce substantial parameter overhead and communication cost. This paper proposes QFedAgent, a hybrid quantum-classical personalized FL framework for multi-agent activity recognition. The approach integrates a variational quantum circuit fusion module that models accelerometer--gyroscope interactions through quantum state encoding and entanglement, requiring only 72 quantum rotation parameters versus 33K in classical multi-layer perceptron-based fusion, achieving approximately 10x total parameter reduction. Experiments on the OPPORTUNITY dataset under subject-based non-IID partitions demonstrate 97.7% mean test accuracy, confirming that parameter-efficient quantum fusion remains competitive with conventional federated baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 QFedAgent，一种用于多智能体活动识别的量子-经典混合个性化联邦学习框架，面向非独立同分布的多模态传感器数据。其核心是变分量子线路融合模块，通过量子态编码与纠缠建模加速度计和陀螺仪交互，仅需 72 个量子旋转参数，相比约 3.3 万参数的经典 MLP 融合模块显著降低开销。在 OPPORTUNITY 数据集的主体划分非 IID 设置下，该方法达到 97.7% 平均测试准确率，显示参数高效的量子融合可与常规联邦基线竞争。
authors: Quoc Bao Phan, Tuy Tan Nguyen

articles.title: Ravines in quantum cost landscapes: opportunities for improved VQA predictions
articles.title_zh: 量子代价景观中的沟谷：改进变分量子算法预测的机会
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01329v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The geometric and topological structure of quantum cost landscapes (QCLs) governs the optimization and thus the predictive power of variational quantum algorithms (VQAs). We systematically analyze ravines - low-cost paths connecting local minima - using an adapted version of the nudged elastic band (NEB) algorithm, a method originating from theoretical chemistry. By training quantum neural networks (QNNs) to classify the concentratable entanglement of quantum states, we apply the NEB algorithm and numerically identify ravine structures in QCLs of hardware-efficient ansatzes. Beyond visualizing these ravines, we construct an ensemble prediction framework by averaging predictions from QNNs parameterized along the low-cost NEB path. We introduce a resource-light pre-training metric which quantifies local-prediction variability and serves as a strong performance indicator for VQAs, even beyond the scope of this study. When base classifiers are drawn from circuit and weight initializations exhibiting high local-prediction variability, the quantum-based NEB ensembles outperform both classical and naive quantum alternatives. Moreover, a complexity analysis shows that leveraging the ravine-like structure of QCLs with the QNN NEB approach substantially reduces computational costs compared to naive QNN ensembling. A depth and qubit scaling analysis indicates that ravines persist across both scalings, and that, despite the expected growth in resource requirements with the qubit scaling, the NEB approach also accelerates convergence over the naive alternative.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析量子代价景观中连接局部极小值的低代价路径“沟谷”，并将源自理论化学的 nudged elastic band 算法改造后用于量子神经网络景观分析。作者以分类量子态可集中纠缠为任务，在硬件高效 ansatz 的代价景观中数值识别沟谷结构，并基于低代价路径上的模型参数构建集成预测。文中还提出一种低资源预训练指标，用局部预测变异性表征 VQA 潜在性能；在高变异性初始化下，NEB 量子集成优于经典和朴素量子替代方案。
authors: Felix J. Beckmann, João F. Bravo

articles.title: Sign in the Air to Unlock: An Interface for authentication in Virtual and Augmented Reality Powered by Point-Voxel Cross-Attention Network
articles.title_zh: 空中签名解锁：基于点-体素交叉注意力网络的虚拟与增强现实认证接口
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01435v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Significant advancement of immersive technologies such as Virtual and Augmented Reality (VR/AR) and their integration into diverse aspects of modern life need authentication interfaces that are secure, intuitive, and compatible with embodied interaction. Traditional methods such as passwords, PINs, and device-based logins, break immersion and rely on external hardware. Recent 3D-specific behavioral approaches, such as hand-gesture, eye-tracking, and electroencephalography (EEG)-based methods, offer promising alternatives but often require specialized sensors or constrain natural movement, limiting usability in dynamic environments. We present Sign in the Air to Unlock, an in-air signature interface that enables users to authenticate by signing naturally in 3D space which is a familiar, personal, and reproducible gesture. To realize this interface, we design a point-voxel Cross-Attention Network (PV-Net) that jointly models local motion dynamics and global spatial structure from 3D trajectories. The model is evaluated on two datasets: the public DeepAirSig dataset (1,800 signatures from 40 users) and ImmAirsig, a new dataset collected using Meta Quest 2 in immersive VR (880 samples from 22 users). PV-Net achieves an Equal Error Rate of 2.5% on DeepAirSig and 76% classification accuracy on ImmAirSig. These findings highlight the potential of 3D behavioral interfaces for seamless, user-centric authentication that merges security with natural interaction in immersive environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向 VR/AR 的空中签名认证接口，使用户可在三维空间中以自然签名动作完成身份验证，避免传统密码、PIN 或外部硬件破坏沉浸体验。作者设计点-体素交叉注意力网络 PV-Net，同时建模三维轨迹的局部运动动力学和全局空间结构。该方法在公开 DeepAirSig 数据集以及新采集的 ImmAirsig 数据集上评估，目标是在安全性、自然交互和沉浸式环境可用性之间取得平衡。
authors: Neda Abdolrahimi, Thiru Siddharth, Frank Sicongchen, Vir V Phoha

articles.title: Structured Gaussian Processes for Uncertainty-Aware Classification of High-Dimensional, Small-Sampled Omics Data
articles.title_zh: 面向高维小样本组学数据不确定性感知分类的结构化高斯过程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02103v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Classifying heterogeneous omics data remains a fundamental challenge in computational biology, particularly in high-dimensional, small-sample settings where nonlinear interactions dominate and class imbalance further complicates reliable prediction of minority phenotypes. While traditional kernel methods rely on feature abundance, they fail to leverage the known interaction landscapes of biological systems. In this work, we propose a structured Gaussian process classification framework that integrates graph-encoded biological pathways directly into the kernel construction. By propagating information along known interaction networks and combining this with abundance-derived features, the resulting classifier captures both quantitative measurements and topological context. We benchmark our proposed methodology on three publicly available gut and fecal microbiome datasets. To address severe class imbalance, we evaluate complementary strategies, including data-level resampling, threshold calibration, and confusion-matrix-based adjustments, and report minority-class performance alongside accuracy. The hybrid approach yields a performance gain over unstructured baselines and matches the performance of established benchmarks for similar datasets. Furthermore, the probabilistic nature of the framework naturally provides calibrated predictive uncertainty, enabling robust differentiation between confident predictions and ambiguous samples.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作面向高维、小样本且类别不平衡的组学分类问题，提出一种将生物通路图结构直接嵌入核函数构造的结构化高斯过程分类框架。方法沿已知相互作用网络传播信息，并与丰度特征结合，从而同时利用定量测量和拓扑上下文。作者在三个公开肠道和粪便微生物组数据集上评估，并比较重采样、阈值校准和基于混淆矩阵的调整等策略，重点报告少数类性能。
authors: Yue Zhang, Nandini Amit Gadhia, Georgios Karagiannis, Michalis Smyrnakis

articles.title: Optimal Stabilizer Testing and Learning with Limited Quantum Memory
articles.title_zh: 有限量子存储下的最优稳定子测试与学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02444v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study stabilizer state testing and learning with limited coherent quantum memory. Here an algorithm sequentially receives copies of an unknown n-qubit state, but may keep only k qubits of coherent quantum memory between measurements. With unrestricted memory, seminal work of Gross, Nezami and Walter showed how to test n-qubit stabilizer states using 6 copies, which is dimension independent, unlike the learning complexity of Θ(n). We show that this testing-vs-learning separation is lost under memory constraints. More concretely we show that (1) The sample complexity of testing stabilizer states in the k-qubit memory framework is Θ(n-k). Our upper bound goes via a novel connection to the hidden shift problem and the lower bound is proven using a novel approach to average case bounds on likelihood ratios via combinatorics of the stochastic orthogonal group. (2) The sample complexity of learning stabilizer states with k qubits of memory, in the non-adaptive framework, is Θ(n²/k). As a further application of our techniques, we prove an exponential lower bound for purity testing even when the memory may be left coherent throughout the protocol. Our main results identify coherent quantum memory as the resource enabling the usual separation between stabilizer testing and learning. In particular, even with k=0.99n qubits of memory, there is no constant-copy stabilizer tester; furthermore for k=cn qubits of memory (for 0< c < 1), stabilizer testing is as hard as learning, with both requiring Θ(n) copies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究在有限相干量子存储条件下对未知 n 比特量子态进行稳定子态测试与学习的问题，其中算法逐份接收态拷贝，但测量之间只能保留 k 个量子比特的相干存储。结果表明，在存储受限时，无限制存储下稳定子测试与学习之间的复杂度分离会消失：稳定子态测试样本复杂度为 Θ(n-k)，非自适应学习样本复杂度为 Θ(n²/k)。作者的上界利用与隐藏平移问题的新联系，下界则基于随机正交群组合结构上的似然比平均情形分析，并进一步给出纯度测试的指数下界应用。

articles.title: Adaptively trained Physics-informed Radial Basis Function Neural Networks for Solving Multi-asset Option Pricing Problems
articles.title_zh: 用于求解多资产期权定价问题的自适应训练物理信息径向基函数神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.12704v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The present study investigates the numerical solution of Black-Scholes partial differential equation (PDE) for option valuation with multiple underlying assets. We develop a physics-informed (PI) machine learning algorithm based on a radial basis function neural network (RBFNN) that concurrently optimizes the network architecture and predicts the target option price. The physics-informed radial basis function neural network (PIRBFNN) combines the strengths of the traditional radial basis function collocation method and the physics-informed neural network machine learning approach to effectively solve PDE problems in the financial context. By employing a PDE residual-based technique to adaptively refine the distribution of hidden neurons during the training process, the PIRBFNN facilitates accurate and efficient handling of multidimensional option pricing models featuring non-smooth payoff conditions. The validity of the proposed method is demonstrated through a set of experiments encompassing a single-asset European put option, a double-asset exchange option, and a four-asset basket call option.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对多标的资产期权估值中的 Black-Scholes 偏微分方程，提出一种基于径向基函数神经网络的物理信息机器学习算法。所提出的 PIRBFNN 结合传统径向基函数配点法与物理信息神经网络，通过 PDE 残差驱动的自适应策略在训练中细化隐藏神经元分布。该方法用于处理具有非光滑收益条件的多维期权定价问题，并通过单资产欧式看跌、双资产交换期权和四资产篮子看涨期权实验验证有效性。
authors: Yan Ma, Yumeng Ren, Elisabeth Larsson

articles.title: Learning Consumer Preferences from Bundle Sales Data
articles.title_zh: 从捆绑销售数据中学习消费者偏好
articles.abstract: arXiv:2209.04942v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Problem definition: This paper studies the problem of estimating consumer preferences from bundle sales data. Product bundling is a widely used pricing strategy in retail markets. To set profitable bundle selection and prices, the seller needs to learn the distribution of consumers' valuations for individual products from the transaction data. When customers purchase bundles or multiple products, classical methods such as discrete choice models cannot be used to estimate consumers' valuations. In this paper, we propose an approach to learn the distribution of consumers' valuations toward the products using bundle sales data. Methodology/results: Our approach is to define a utility model for customer choices and estimate the parameters of a valuation distribution that maximizes the likelihood of observing the transaction data. Our approach reduces this problem to an estimation problem where the samples are censored by polyhedral regions on the valuation space of customers. Using the EM algorithm and Monte Carlo simulation, our approach can recover the distribution of consumers' valuations. We extend the framework to allow for unobserved no-purchases, clustered market segments and to incorporate non-additive bundle utilities with synergy effects. In addition, we provide theoretical results on the identifiability of the probability model and sufficient conditions for local convergence of the EM algorithm. Moreover, the performance of the approach is also demonstrated numerically with synthetic and real datasets. Managerial implications: This study demonstrates the challenge to leverage the transaction data of bundle sales to learn customers' preferences. The proposed algorithm provides a practical guidance for retailers.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究如何从商品捆绑或多商品购买交易数据中估计消费者对单个产品的估值分布，因为传统离散选择模型难以直接处理此类数据。作者构建消费者选择效用模型，并通过最大化观测交易数据似然来估计估值分布参数，将问题转化为估值空间中由多面体区域截断样本的估计问题。方法结合 EM 算法与蒙特卡洛模拟恢复消费者估值分布，并进一步扩展以处理未观测因素等更一般情形。
authors: Ningyuan Chen, Setareh Farajollahzadeh, Qingwei Jin, Fanni Shen, Guan Wang

articles.title: The Wiola Architecture for Efficient Small Language Models
articles.title_zh: 用于高效小语言模型的 Wiola 架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01394v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present Wiola, a fully original Small Language Model (SLM) architecture built from first principles, sharing no structural lineage with any existing model family including GPT, LLaMA, Mistral, or Falcon. Wiola introduces five independently novel components: (i) Spiral Rotary Positional Encoding (SRPE), which embeds token positions on a three-dimensional helical manifold combining absolute, relative, and hierarchical positional signals; (ii) Gated Cross-Layer Attention (GCLA), providing each decoder layer with soft cross-attention access to compressed summaries of two preceding layers for inter-layer coherence; (iii) Adaptive Token Merging (ATM), which dynamically merges se mantically redundant adjacent tokens in middle network layers to reduce attention complexity without information loss; (iv) Dual Stream Feed-Forward (DSFF), replacing the conventional MLP with two parallel streams fused by a learned per-dimension gate; and (v) WiolaRMSNorm, a modified normalisation introducing a per-dimension learned offset vector that prevents representation collapse. We provide complete mathematical derivations, architectural block diagrams, complexity analyses, and systematic comparisons against GPT-2, LLaMA-2, and Mistral. Wiola is released in four sizes (120M, 360M, 700M, and 1.5B parameters) and is fully compatible with the HuggingFace Transformers ecosystem, with all 22 architectural unit tests passing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Wiola，一种从头设计的小语言模型架构，声称不继承 GPT、LLaMA、Mistral 或 Falcon 等现有模型族结构。其包含五个组件：三维螺旋流形上的螺旋旋转位置编码、跨层门控注意力、自适应 token 合并、双流前馈网络以及带逐维偏移的 WiolaRMSNorm。论文给出数学推导和结构设计，目标是在小模型中提高效率、层间一致性和表示稳定性。
authors: Aryuemaan Kumar Chowdhury, Afreen Shaik, Yaparla Bhargavi, Brahma Kumar

articles.title: EO-Agents: A Three-Agent LLM Pipeline for Earth Observation Hypothesis Generation
articles.title_zh: EO-Agents：用于地球观测假设生成的三智能体大语言模型流水线
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01584v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models have recently been explored for scientific hypothesis generation, but most prior work relies on unstructured literature and free-form textual claims. We present a pipeline for Earth observation that grounds hypothesis generation directly in the NASA Earth Observation Knowledge Graph. A heterogeneous graph neural network trained on historical co-usage relations ranks candidate dataset pairings, and a three-agent LLM pipeline filters, generates, and evaluates structured research hypotheses. Applied to 1,475 NASA datasets, the system produces 160 hypotheses spanning multiple Earth-science domains, including ecohydrology, glaciology, aerosol--cloud interactions, vegetation phenology, and stratospheric chemistry. Model-predicted novel dataset pairings are rated nearly as plausible as held-out real co-usages from the literature, indicating that the pipeline surfaces scientifically coherent yet unexplored combinations. A 2*2*2 factorial experiment across GPT-5.2 and Claude Sonnet 4.6 shows that hypothesis rankings remain stable, while absolute scores depend strongly on judge identity, highlighting limitations of single-judge LLM evaluation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一个面向地球观测研究假设生成的流水线，将大语言模型生成过程直接锚定在 NASA 地球观测知识图谱上。系统先用异构图神经网络基于历史共用关系排序候选数据集配对，再由三智能体 LLM 流水线进行筛选、生成和评估结构化研究假设。应用于 1475 个 NASA 数据集时，系统生成 160 条跨生态水文学、冰川学、气溶胶-云相互作用等领域的假设；预测的新颖数据集组合被评为接近文献中保留真实共用关系的合理性，同时评审模型身份会显著影响绝对评分。
authors: Mahyar Ghazanfari, Amin Tabrizian, Armin Mehrabian, Peng Wei

articles.title: Distributed Attacks in Persistent-State AI Control
articles.title_zh: 持久状态 AI 控制中的分布式攻击
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.02514v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As AI coding agents become more autonomous, they increasingly ship code iteratively, with the codebase persisting across sessions. This persistence creates a new attack surface: a misaligned or prompt-injected agent can distribute attacks across pull requests (PRs) and time its payload for the PR with the best natural cover. To study the resulting dynamics, we introduce Iterative VibeCoding, a setting for AI control, the study of safely deploying capable but potentially untrusted AI. In Iterative VibeCoding, a coding agent builds software over a sequence of PRs in a persistent codebase while pursuing a covert side task. Our benchmark includes two task families: CLI tools and Flask web services, across 20 total task variations. We use Claude Sonnet 4.5 as the attack agent and GPT-4o as the monitor. We compare gradual attacks, which distribute the side task across PRs, against non-gradual attacks concentrated in a single PR. No single monitor is robust to both: which strategy evades best (success while evading the monitor) depends on the monitor type, so a defender cannot close off both gradual and non-gradual attacks with any one monitor. High evasion (>= 65%) generalizes across model attack agent backends (Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 3.1 Pro, Kimi K2.5), confirming this is a property of the persistent-state attack surface rather than a single model's capability. Evasion also remains high across state-of-the-art monitor models and the gap between gradual and non-gradual evasion widens for more capable models. We introduce a stateful link-tracker monitor that tracks suspicious buildup across PRs. On both task families, it detects gradual attacks substantially better than diff monitors that merely see more accumulated history. Combining this stronger monitor with trajectory monitors in a four-monitor ensemble reduces gradual-attack evasion from 93% under the weakest standard diff monitor to 47%.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究自主 AI 编程代理在跨会话持久代码库中迭代提交代码时产生的新攻击面：不可信或受提示注入影响的代理可将恶意目标分散到多个拉取请求中，并选择最具自然掩护的时机植入载荷。作者提出 Iterative VibeCoding 作为 AI 控制测试场景，覆盖 CLI 工具和 Flask Web 服务两类任务共 20 个变体，并以 Claude Sonnet 4.5 作为攻击代理、GPT-4o 作为监控器。实验比较渐进式攻击与单次集中攻击，发现不存在能同时稳健防御两者的单一监控策略，攻击规避效果依赖于监控器类型。
authors: Josh Hills, Ida Caspary, Asa Cooper Stickland

articles.title: AI-enabled gravitational-waves searches for binary neutron stars at optimal sensitivity
articles.title_zh: 面向最优灵敏度的 AI 驱动双中子星引力波搜索
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01372v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Gravitational Waves (GWs) represent the newest window of astronomy, furthering our understanding of compact objects like black holes and neutron stars in the Universe. The signal from two merging neutron stars is especially interesting since it brings the prospect of concordant electromagnetic and neutrino emissions. Such multi-messenger observations have a transformational impact on fundamental physics, nuclear matter, astrophysics, and gravity. It was first witnessed in 2017 with the detection of the binary neutron star (BNS) merger GW170817. However, searching for BNS signals in real-time in the LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA (LVK) GW detectors presents a computational challenge, as the data streaming out must be matched against sim million reference waveforms, which requires up to a thousand CPU cores. We present a different approach using neural networks to learn the presence of a signal in the data. Our algorithm, called Aframe, was deployed in the LVK's fourth observing run and was the first artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled search to detect multiple binary black holes (BBHs) live. In this work, we demonstrate that the approach extends to the lower-mass BNS regime, and is the first AI-enabled search that achieves sensitivity comparable to matched-filter pipelines at lower computational and latency costs. The challenge of the longer-duration BNS signals is addressed by heterodyning the data, following which the network architecture used for BBHs is sufficient to distinguish signal versus background. We also show that this analysis requires a single non-flagship GPU for online deployment. Furthermore, the design and adoption of inference-as-a-service tools allow rapid offline analysis using a distributed pool of GPU resources. Hence, aside from the use case of rapid online data analysis, we also establish the use of Aframe for efficient archival data analysis.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向 LIGO-Virgo-KAGRA 实时双中子星引力波搜索中的计算瓶颈，提出使用神经网络直接学习探测器数据中信号存在性的方案，而非依赖海量模板波形匹配。作者介绍的 Aframe 算法已在第四观测运行中部署，并成为首个实时探测到多个双黑洞并合事件的 AI 搜索框架。本文进一步展示该方法可扩展至双中子星搜索，目标是在降低计算成本的同时接近或达到传统匹配滤波搜索的最优灵敏度。
authors: Bhavya Gupta, Deep Chatterjee, William Benoit, Ethan Marx, Christina Reissel, Seiya Tsukamoto, Kyungseop Yoon, Michael W. Coughlin, Philip Harris, Erik Katsavounidis

articles.title: Robust and Explainable 3D Mode Shape Recognition Using Region-Aware Graph Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 基于区域感知图神经网络的鲁棒且可解释三维模态振型识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01522v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Mode shape recognition is a fundamental task in automotive NVH development, yet it remains dependent on manual visual inspection by experienced engineers. Existing approaches based on engineering heuristics, Modal Assurance Criterion (MAC), or geometry-dependent AI representations often exhibit limited robustness across different vehicle architectures, finite element (FE) meshes, and experimental measurement layouts, restricting their industrial applicability. This paper presents a Canonical Engineering Graph Representation and region-aware graph learning framework for robust and explainable 3D mode shape recognition. Rather than learning directly from vehicle-specific FE meshes, heterogeneous FE models and experimental measurements are transformed into a common graph whose nodes represent semantically meaningful structural regions connected through engineering-informed relationships. Geometry-independent regional descriptors are combined with graph attention learning and region-aware pooling to capture structural interactions while preserving engineering semantics and enabling physically interpretable predictions. The resulting representation decouples engineering knowledge from numerical discretization, allowing transfer across different vehicle programs without requiring identical mesh topology or sensor configurations. The proposed framework is validated using FE and experimental datasets from four vehicle programs under severe label scarcity. Results demonstrate high classification accuracy, cross-vehicle transferability, and physically meaningful explanations by directly relating predictions to engineering-defined structural regions used in NVH analysis. Beyond mode shape recognition, the proposed Canonical Engineering Graph Representation provides a reusable engineering abstraction for trustworthy and transferable AI across heterogeneous simulation and experimental workflows.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对汽车NVH开发中模态振型识别依赖人工经验、跨车型/网格/实验布置鲁棒性不足的问题，提出规范化工程图表示与区域感知图学习框架。方法将异构有限元模型和实验测量转换为由语义结构区域及工程关系构成的通用图，结合几何无关区域描述符、图注意力和区域感知池化，以捕捉结构相互作用并保留工程可解释性。该框架旨在提升不同车辆架构和测量条件下三维模态振型识别的泛化能力与物理可解释性。
authors: Tong Duy Son, Marc Brughmans, Andrey Hense, Kohta Sugiura, Sebastian Ciceo, Paolo di Carlo, Theo Geluk

articles.title: Scene-Conditioned PINN-GNN for Multipath RF Maps: Cross-Scene Generation and In-Scene Completion
articles.title_zh: 用于多径射频地图的场景条件PINN-GNN：跨场景生成与场景内补全
articles.abstract: arXiv:2607.01777v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Radio frequency (RF) maps provide a compact representation of multipath propagation characteristics and are fundamental to channel modeling, coverage analysis, and environment-aware wireless optimization. This paper proposes a unified RF map construction framework based on a physics-informed neural network (PINN) and a graph neural network (GNN), supporting both cross-scene generation and in-scene completion with 2D and 2.5D environmental representations. The PINN embeds electromagnetic propagation constraints to establish a physically consistent mapping from receiver locations to multipath parameters, including path gain, time of arrival, and angles, while the GNN enforces spatial consistency by modeling correlations among neighboring receivers. To comprehensively evaluate multipath reconstruction quality, we propose a peak-weighted dynamic time warping metric that jointly accounts for amplitude errors and peak delay misalignment in channel impulse responses. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms image-based, diffusion-based, and interpolation baselines across both map-level and multipath-level metrics, achieving robust generalization and high-fidelity RF map construction under sparse observations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种结合物理信息神经网络和图神经网络的统一射频地图构建框架，支持基于2D和2.5D环境表示的跨场景生成与场景内补全。PINN嵌入电磁传播约束，从接收机位置预测路径增益、到达时间和角度等多径参数，GNN则通过邻近接收机相关性增强空间一致性。作者还提出峰值加权动态时间规整指标，用于同时评估信道冲激响应的幅度误差和峰值时延错位；实验表明该方法优于图像、扩散和插值类基线。
authors: Lizhou Liu, Xiaohui Chen, Zihan Tang, Mengyao Ma, Wenyi Zhang

articles.title: Wideband Variable Attenuator Integrating Dual PIN Diodes with an Elliptical Slot Directional Coupler for 7–14 GHz X-Band Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向7–14 GHz X波段应用的集成双PIN二极管与椭圆槽定向耦合器的宽带可变衰减器
articles.abstract: Purpose: This work introduces a Directional Coupler–Based PIN Diode (DCPIN) Variable Attenuator designed for the 7–14 GHz X-band to provide tunable signal control for RF systems like radar and satellite communications.  Methods: The attenuator design is based on a directional coupler with an elliptical patch and slot (D2/D1 = 2) on an RT Duroid 5880 substrate (ϵr = 2.2, thickness = 0.508mm) that operates as a power splitter and is integrated with HSMP-386x two PIN diodes modeled to achieve variable attenuation. The device is constructed using a multilayer TLY-5 substrate, known for its favorable electrical properties, including a dielectric constant of 2.2 and a low loss tangent of 0.003. It is chosen for prototype due to low cost compared with RT/Duroid. The physical structure features a substrate thickness of 0.508mm and copper cladding of 17 μm.  Results: Experimental results confirm broadband operation over the 7 GHz to 14 GHz range, with a measured return loss below −10 dB (peaking at −30 dB for 50 Ω), and isolation of 10−15 dB The attenuation range is adjustable between 3.5 dB and 13.5 dB.A TLY-5 substrate prototype (ϵr = 2.2, loss tangent = 0.0016) tested with a Vector Network Analyzer achieves 4.8 dB (vs. 5 dB simulated) for 50Ω and 12.5 dB (vs. 13.5 dB) for 300 Ω, with minor deviations due to fabrication tolerances.  Conclusion: With overall dimensions of 2.227λg by 1.485λg, the design maintains a compactness,and ensure high performance in terms of impedance matching and frequency coverage.This architecture offers dependable operation and low-cost multilayer PCB production.Moderate isolation suggests opportunities for optimizing coupler geometry and diode characteristics
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作设计了一种基于定向耦合器与PIN二极管的X波段可变衰减器，用于雷达和卫星通信等射频系统的可调信号控制。器件采用含椭圆贴片/槽结构的定向耦合器并集成两个HSMP-386x PIN二极管，原型使用低损耗TLY-5基板制备。实验显示其在7–14 GHz范围内实现宽带工作，回波损耗低于−10 dB、隔离度约10–15 dB，衰减可在约3.5–13.5 dB范围调节。

articles.title: Integrated Experimental–Computational Approach to Glucose-Stabilized Fe₃O₄@Ag Nanocomposites: Green Synthesis, Electronic Structure, and Applications
articles.title_zh: 葡萄糖稳定Fe₃O₄@Ag纳米复合材料的实验—计算一体化研究：绿色合成、电子结构与应用
articles.abstract: Magnetic silver core–shell nanoparticles (Fe₃O₄@Ag) were synthesized via a sustainable green chemistry route using Alcea leaf extract, which acted as both reducing and stabilizing agent. Optimization of the extract concentration yielded uniform nanostructures with a silver coating efficiency of 88.7%, an average size of 95.4 nm, and good colloidal stability (zeta potential −27.2 mV). Structural characterization (EDX, XRD, FT-IR, SEM) confirmed the formation of the desired core–shell morphology. To rationalize the experimental observations, density functional theory (DFT) and time-dependent DFT (TDDFT) calculations were performed on a glucose-stabilized Fe₃O₄@Ag cluster. Theoretical analyses revealed orbital hybridization between Fe 3d, O 2p, and Ag states, with glucose introducing new Ag–O(C) contributions near the Fermi level. Frontier orbital analysis indicated a switch in the charge-transfer pathway, from interfacial core→shell transfer in the pristine system to shell→core metal-to-metal transfer after glucose adsorption. This orbital realignment reduced the HOMO–LUMO gap (3.31 → 3.20 eV) and increased the dipole moment (8.2 → 13.5 D), consistent with the experimentally observed zeta potential and red-shift in UV–Vis absorption. Non-covalent interaction analyses showed that stabilization is driven by physisorption through van der Waals and weak hydrogen-bond–like electrostatic contacts (O···Ag 2.4–2.7 Å, O–H···Ag 1.9–2.2 Å, ∠~92–107°), rather than covalent bonding.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用锦葵叶提取物作为还原剂和稳定剂，绿色合成磁性Ag包覆Fe₃O₄核壳纳米颗粒，并通过调节提取物浓度获得均一、胶体稳定的纳米结构。EDX、XRD、FT-IR和SEM确认了目标核壳形貌，银包覆效率、粒径和ζ电位等结果表明材料具有较好制备质量。DFT/TDDFT计算显示Fe 3d、O 2p和Ag态发生轨道杂化，葡萄糖吸附引入近费米能级的Ag–O(C)贡献，改变电荷转移路径、降低HOMO-LUMO能隙并增大偶极矩，从电子结构层面解释实验稳定性和潜在功能表现。

articles.title: Valley Valves at Domain Walls in Symmetry-Broken Rhombohedral Graphene
articles.title_zh: 对称性破缺菱方石墨烯畴壁处的谷阀效应
articles.abstract: Rhombohedral multilayer graphene polarized by a moderate perpendicular displacement field hosts a time-reversal-symmetry-breaking valley-and-spin-polarized metallic phase that may condense into a chiral superconductor. Recent magnetic imaging and transport measurements in this unconventional system suggest the presence of domain walls both in the metallic and superconducting phases. In this work, we show that valley domain walls are impenetrable barriers to transport in the metallic regime. Transmission through such a domain wall must therefore be mediated by intervalley interactions. We derive the symmetry-allowed terms and show via microscopic numerical simulations that they enable the transmission of electrons across the domain wall. In the superconducting phase, we find that intervalley mixing is crucial for supporting an appreciable supercurrent through a SNS' Josephson junction that connects opposite-chirality superconducting regions. Taken together, our work elucidates the nature of domain walls in these experimentally relevant multilayer systems and emphasizes the critical role of intervalley hybridization in governing their transport properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究中等垂直位移场极化的菱方多层石墨烯中谷畴壁的输运作用，该体系可出现破坏时间反演对称性的谷-自旋极化金属相并可能凝聚为手性超导态。作者指出在金属区，谷畴壁对输运表现为不可穿透屏障，电子透射必须依赖谷间相互作用，并推导了对称性允许的谷间耦合项且用微观数值模拟验证其可促进跨畴壁透射。在超导相中，谷间混合对于连接相反手性超导区域的SNS'约瑟夫森结中可观超电流的形成同样关键。

articles.title: Study of Hydrogen Storage Capacity of Double Perovskite Hydrides X2PdH6 (Li, Na, K, Rb) and Physical Aspects by DFT Approach
articles.title_zh: 基于DFT的双钙钛矿氢化物X₂PdH₆（X=Li、Na、K、Rb）储氢能力与物性研究
articles.abstract: The unique structural framework and chemical properties of double perovskite hydrides make them prospective materials for hydrogen (H₂) storage. In the current article, the H2 storage capacity, desorption temperature, and key physical characteristics of X2PdH6 (Li, Na, K, Rb) are systematically studied by the WIEN2k code. The tolerance factor ensures structural existence, whereas formation energy and Born criteria certify thermodynamic and mechanical stability. The Li2PdH6, Na2PdH6, K2PdH6, and Rb2PdH6 have H₂ storage capacities 4.79%, 3.82%, 3.17%, and 2.13%, respectively. The H2 desorption temperatures 261.67K, 294.47K, 354.79K, and 434.62K, respectively, are reported. The 𝑇𝑑𝑒𝑠 of Li2PdH6, Na2PdH6 lie in the ideal range of 233 to 333K. The mechanical analysis reveals a ductile and anisotropic nature, characterized by high melting and Debye temperatures, along with minimal directional lattice thermal conductivity. Moreover, the optical properties are comprehensively analyzed through parameters such as the dielectric constant, optical loss, refractive index, absorption coefficient, and reflectivity of light energy. The modification of the band gap from 3.0 to 2.28 eV enables a range of optoelectronic applications, especially operating in the ultraviolet region. Therefore, the investigated materials have potential for both H2 storage and clean energy harvesting.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用WIEN2k第一性原理计算系统研究X₂PdH₆（X=Li、Na、K、Rb）双钙钛矿氢化物的储氢容量、脱附温度及相关物性。容忍因子、形成能和Born判据分别支持其结构存在性、热力学稳定性与力学稳定性；计算储氢质量分数从Li体系的4.79%随碱金属变重降至Rb体系的2.13%。Li₂PdH₆和Na₂PdH₆的脱附温度位于较理想范围，材料整体呈延展和各向异性特征，并进一步分析了介电、折射、吸收和反射等光学性质。

articles.title: Nonlinear interaction of Kinetic Alfvén Waves with Electrons
articles.title_zh: 动力学阿尔芬波与电子的非线性相互作用
articles.abstract: Understanding solar wind acceleration and solar coronal heating remains a paramount, unresolved problem in space plasma physics. Kinetic Alfvén Waves (KAWs) and their cross-scale interactions are widely indicated to play a key role by channeling energy into particle heating and acceleration. In this paper, we investigate the dynamics of nonlinear KAW-particle interactions within a background density profile modified self-consistently by ponderomotive force and Joule heating. Numerical simulations are executed utilizing a high-resolution pseudospectral method to evaluate the time-dependent morphological evolution of coherent magnetic structures and the generation of magnetic field turbulence spectra. Our transient analyses reveal that early-stage localized, intense coherent structures progressively saturate and fragment into complex, spatially distributed current filaments over time. In wavenumber space, the saturated magnetic power spectra track the classical Kolmogorov scaling of k −5/3 ⊥ in the inertial range, followed by a distinct spectral break and steepened scaling near the electron kinetic threshold (k ⊥ λ e ≈ 1). This spectral broadening and energy redistribution provide direct evidence of strong kinetic mode coupling. Micro-physically, self-consistently generated parallel electric fields drive robust collisionless Lan-dau resonance. This drives severe structural deformation of the electron parallel velocity distribution function (VDF) into a quasilinear change (∂f /∂v ∥ → 0) alongside a prominent suprathermal tail (v ∥ /v te > 3.5). These findings demonstrate that nonlinear KAW-electron coupling efficiently converts macroscopic fluid cascades into micro-physical thermalization, offering crucial insights into plasma heating across solar coronal, auroral, and interstellar environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究围绕太阳风加速与日冕加热问题，考察在由有质动力和焦耳加热自洽修正的背景密度中，动力学阿尔芬波与粒子的非线性相互作用。作者采用高分辨率伪谱数值方法模拟相干磁结构的时变形貌演化及磁场湍流谱生成。结果显示早期局域强相干结构会逐渐饱和并破碎为空间分布的电流丝；在波数空间，饱和磁功率谱在惯性区接近Kolmogorov的k⊥⁻⁵/3标度，并在电子动力学尺度附近出现谱折断和变陡。

articles.title: Quantum Autoencoders for Anomaly Detection in Cybersecurity
articles.title_zh: 用于网络安全异常检测的量子自编码器
articles.abstract: Anomaly detection in cybersecurity is a challenging task, where normal events far outnumber anomalous ones with new anomalies occurring frequently. Classical autoencoders have been used for anomaly detection, but struggles in data-limited settings which quantum counterparts can potentially overcome. In this work, we apply Quantum Autoencoders (QAEs) for anomaly detection in cybersecurity, specifically on the BPF-extended tracking honeypot (BETH) dataset. QAEs are evaluated across multiple encoding techniques, ansatz types, repetitions, and feature selection strategies. Our results demonstrate that an 8-feature QAE using Dense-Angle encoding with a RealAmplitude ansatz can outperform Classical Autoencoders (CAEs), even when trained on substantially fewer samples. The effects of quantum encoding and feature selection for developing quantum models are demonstrated and discussed. In a data-limited setting, the best performing QAE model has a F1 score of 0.87, better than that of CAE (0.77). These findings suggest that QAEs may offer practical advantages for anomaly detection in data-limited scenarios.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作将量子自编码器用于网络安全异常检测，重点评估其在BETH蜜罐数据集上的表现。作者比较了多种量子编码方式、线路ansatz、重复层数和特征选择策略，发现采用8个特征、Dense-Angle编码和RealAmplitude ansatz的模型在训练样本显著减少时可优于经典自编码器。在数据受限场景下，最佳量子自编码器F1分数为0.87，高于经典自编码器的0.77，表明其在小样本异常检测中可能具有实用优势。

articles.title: Geomagnetic reversals are modulated by the motion of basal mantle structures
articles.title_zh: 地磁倒转受基底地幔结构运动调制
articles.abstract: The Earth cools over time via convection. In the mantle, solid-state convection over millions of years changes heat and mass distribution and causes adjustments of Earth’s inertia axis with respect to the spin axis. In the outer core, convection of a liquid iron alloy drives dynamo action and generates a magnetic field that episodically changes polarity. Periods without any polarity reversals for tens of million years, called superchrons, have long been thought to be related to changes in core-mantle boundary (CMB) heat flux. However, a quantitative link between CMB heat flux and geomagnetic reversals has remained elusive. Here, we identify a strong correlation between changes in the amplitude of inertia-corrected equatorial CMB heat flux heterogeneities and geomagnetic reversal frequencies from 170 million years ago. This correlation is due to changes in the equatorial extent of hot basal mantle structures that increased during the Jurassic reversal hyperactivity period and decreased during the Cretaceous Normal Superchron. The direct relationship between CMB heat flux predicted by our models and reversal frequencies is driven by changes at shorter wavelengths than previously considered, opening new avenues to investigate the links between CMB heat flux heterogeneities, outer core stratification, and reversal frequencies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨地幔对流引起的核幔边界热流异质性变化与地磁倒转频率之间的定量联系。作者发现，自1.7亿年前以来，经惯性轴校正的赤道核幔边界热流异质性幅度变化与地磁倒转频率强相关。模型表明，这种相关性源于热的基底地幔结构赤道范围的变化：其在侏罗纪倒转高活跃期扩大，在白垩纪正常超静磁期缩小；控制倒转频率的热流变化涉及比以往强调尺度更短的空间波长。

articles.title: A Visual Guided Physics Informed Neural Networks Framework for Real Time Coagulant Dose Optimization in Water Treatment Plants
articles.title_zh: 用于水处理厂混凝剂实时投加优化的视觉引导物理信息神经网络框架
articles.abstract: Real-time sensing and visual information provide significant opportunities to reveal the internal dynamics of flocculation–coagulation processes in water treatment systems. Industrial operations commonly rely on turbidity measurements, while research studies frequently employ the degree of flocculation (DF) as a process indicator. However, both parameters exhibit inherent physical delays because they represent macroscopic outcomes of particle aggregation and sedimentation that require time to become observable. As a result, conventional control strategies depend on reactive adjustments based on previous system states, reducing operational efficiency and limiting prediction accuracy. To overcome these limitations, this study proposes a Real-Time Sensing and Visual Information-Guided Physics-Informed Neural Networks (RTS-VG PINNs) framework. The proposed method integrates real-time sensing, deep visual perception, and governing physical laws into unified learning architecture. A ResNet-50-based feature extractor combined with YOLOv8 is employed to identify regions of interest and extract early-stage predictive features from image sequences. These features are mapped to the time-varying effective sedimentation velocity within the Kynch sedimentation partial differential equation and coupled with the Langmuir–Smoluchowski formulation to estimate optimal coagulant dosage. Experimental results demonstrate that RTS-VG PINNs achieves superior predictive performance compared with purely data-driven models while maintaining low PDE residuals on the order of 10− 3. The framework successfully captures nonlinear relationships among coagulant dosage, turbidity, and zeta potential, reconstructs internal floc density distributions, and provides robust inverse predictions under limited and noisy data conditions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种实时传感与视觉信息引导的物理信息神经网络框架，用于水处理混凝—絮凝过程中的混凝剂投加优化。针对浊度和絮凝度等宏观指标存在观测滞后、导致控制策略偏反应式的问题，框架融合实时传感、深度视觉感知和过程物理规律。方法使用ResNet-50特征提取器结合YOLOv8从图像序列中识别感兴趣区域并提取早期预测特征，再将其映射到随时间变化的过程状态，以支持更超前的剂量优化。

articles.title: Exploring the Feasibility of the Anisotropic Property of ReS₂ in Long-Range Surface Plasmonic Sensing for Superior Performance
articles.title_zh: ReS₂各向异性在高性能长程表面等离激元传感中的可行性探索
articles.abstract: This paper presents a novel Kretschmann-configured Long-Range Surface Plasmon Resonance (LRSPR) sensor based on the anisotropic property of Rhenium disulfide (ReS₂) for highly sensitive biomolecular detection. The proposed sensor employs silver (Ag) as the plasmonic metal layer and Lithium niobate (LiNbO₃) as a protective passivation layer to prevent Ag oxidation and enhance stability. The rotation angle is fixed at θ = 0° to maximise the interaction between incident light and the Re-Re atomic chains of ReS₂. The proposed structure of the sensor is analysed using the Transfer Matrix Method (TMM) in MATLAB, while electromagnetic field distributions and LRSPP modes are investigated through COMSOL Multiphysics simulations. The monolayer ReS₂-based sensor achieves an imaging sensitivity (Simg.) of 18,361 RIU-1, detection accuracy (DA) of 100/°, angular figure of merit (FOMang.) of 1200 RIU-1, and penetration depth (PD) of 713.11 nm. Further enhancement in Simg is observed for bilayer and trilayer of ReS₂-based sensors. Compared with the conventional SPR sensor, the proposed LRSPR sensor demonstrates significantly improved performance parameters, which makes it highly suitable for ultrasensitive detection of biomolecules in advanced biosensing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种基于ReS₂各向异性的Kretschmann结构长程表面等离激元共振传感器，用于高灵敏生物分子检测。传感器采用Ag作为等离激元金属层、LiNbO₃作为防氧化钝化层，并将旋转角固定为0°以增强入射光与Re-Re原子链的相互作用。基于传输矩阵法和COMSOL仿真，单层ReS₂结构达到18361 RIU⁻¹的成像灵敏度、100/°检测精度、1200 RIU⁻¹角品质因数和713.11 nm穿透深度，双层和三层ReS₂可进一步提高灵敏度。

articles.title: Earth–Brain Computer Interface a cross-disciplinary framework for earthquake and volcanic eruption forecasting
articles.title_zh: 地球–脑计算机接口：用于地震与火山喷发预测的跨学科框架
articles.abstract: Accurate forecasting of earthquakes and volcanic eruptions remains one of the foremost unsolved challenges in geoscience. Here we propose the Earth–Brain Computer Interface (E-BCI), a cross-disciplinary predictive framework that maps established brain–computer interface (BCI) methodology onto geophysical monitoring. We draw a systematic analogy between cortical neural dynamics and Earth's internal processes: tectonic plate networks correspond to neural connectivity topology, seismic wavefields to action potentials, magmatic degassing to neurotransmitter release, and crustal stress accumulation to neuronal excitation–inhibition balance. Building on this conceptual foundation, the E-BCI architecture integrates three layers: a multi-sensor acquisition layer comprising global seismograph networks, distributed acoustic sensing (DAS) arrays, GNSS deformation networks and satellite remote sensing; a signal-decoding layer employing deep learning architectures (Transformer, LSTM, RNN-DAS) for real-time feature extraction; and a prediction layer delivering probabilistic seismic and volcanic forecasts. A key methodological innovation is the ergodic precursor transfer learning strategy, which enables knowledge transfer across data-scarce fault zones and volcanoes. Proof-of-concept experiments indicate 78% recall for M≥6.0 earthquakes within a 72-hour window and eruption-onset lead times of 3–7 days at La Palma and Piton de la Fournaise volcanoes. We discuss outstanding challenges including temporal-scale disparity, data heterogeneity, and model interpretability, and outline prospects toward a global E-BCI sensor network and a physics–data fusion digital twin of the Earth.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本提出“地球–脑计算机接口”（E-BCI）概念，将脑机接口中的信号采集、解码与预测范式类比并迁移到地球物理监测中。作者把板块网络、地震波场、岩浆脱气和地壳应力分别对应于神经连接、动作电位、神经递质释放和兴奋–抑制平衡，并设计由多源传感、深度学习解码和概率预测组成的三层架构。文中强调利用全球地震台网、DAS、GNSS与卫星遥感数据进行实时特征提取，并提出前兆迁移学习思路以服务地震和火山喷发预测。

articles.title: In-situ microwave modulation of non-equilibrium solidification stress in direct additive manufacturing of ternary eutectic ceramics
articles.title_zh: 三元共晶陶瓷直接增材制造中非平衡凝固应力的原位微波调控
articles.abstract: Direct, binder-free additive manufacturing of eutectic ceramics via laser directed energy deposition (LDED) offers immense potential. However, extreme temperature gradients during rapid melting and solidification induce severe thermal stress concentrations, rendering the fabricated components highly susceptible to cracking. Here, we propose an in-situ microwave-laser hybrid additive manufacturing approach for Al2O3/YAG/ZrO2 (AYZ) ternary eutectic ceramics. By leveraging a microwave hybrid heating mechanism featuring external microwave absorbing preheating, laser activated melt pool generation, and internal volumetric heating, we achieve continuous modulation of the thermal field and stress evolution throughout the entire deposition process. The in-situ microwave assistance reduces the maximum first principal stress in the initial deposited layer by 91.7% compared to conditions without microwave assistance. Concurrently, it decreases crack density and maximum crack length by 90.4% and 92.1%, respectively, ultimately enabling the successful fabrication of hundred-millimeter-scale crack-free components. This study establishes a robust in situ thermal stress modulation strategy for highly crack-sensitive oxide eutectic ceramics, providing fundamental insights and technical pathways for the high-quality laser additive manufacturing of complex melt-growth ceramics (MGCs) components.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向Al2O3/YAG/ZrO2三元共晶陶瓷的激光定向能量沉积，提出原位微波–激光复合增材制造方法，以缓解快速熔凝导致的热应力集中和开裂。通过外部微波吸收预热、激光激活熔池和内部体加热的耦合机制，作者实现了沉积全过程热场与应力演化的连续调控。微波辅助使初始沉积层最大第一主应力降低91.7%，裂纹密度和最大裂纹长度分别降低90.4%和92.1%，并实现百毫米级无裂纹构件制备。

articles.title: The Effect of Magnetic and Non-Magnetic Impurities on Crystal Structure and Magnetic Properties of Electron-Doped Eu2-xCexCuO4 in Overdoped Regime
articles.title_zh: 磁性与非磁性杂质对过掺杂电子型Eu2-xCexCuO4晶体结构和磁性质的影响
articles.abstract: The most widely studied superconducting materials currently being studied are high-Tc cuprate-based superconductors, known as High-Tc Superconducting Cuprates (HTSC). HTSC research has two main focuses, producing superconducting materials with Tc at room temperature and studying the phenomenon of superconductivity. The effect of impurities on HTSC in overdoped region is very important to study, especially interesting phenomena such as Quantum Critical Point, cooper-pair breaking and stripe pinning. To investigate the effect of substituting magnetic (Fe) and non-magnetic (Zn) impurities on the superconducting properties of Eu2-xCexCuO4 (ECCO) in the overdoped regime. In this study we have chosen the concentration of x = 0.16 and 0.17, for y = 0.05 and has been synthesized by the solid-state reaction method. The crystal structure and magnetic properties of the samples were characterized by XRD and SQUID measurements. From the XRD data on all samples, the intensity values of the two highest diffraction peaks were found with the Miller indices (013) and (110). This indicates that the crystal structure formed is tetragonal (T'). From susceptibility measurements, with 0.5% of Fe and Zn impurity for all samples have the paramagnetic behaviour. The magnetic parameter values C and (:μ:ₑff) of all samples showed an increase with increasing Ce concentration. The increase in Curie constant and effective magnetic moment suggests enhanced localized magnetic contributions due to impurity substitution. The findings provide new insight into the role of impurity driven magnetism in electron-doped cuprates in the overdoped regime.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察Fe磁性杂质和Zn非磁性杂质替代对过掺杂电子型铜氧化物Eu2-xCexCuO4超导性质的影响，样品采用固相反应法制备，Ce含量为x=0.16和0.17，杂质含量约为y=0.05。XRD结果显示样品主要形成T'四方结构，最高强度衍射峰对应(013)和(110)晶面。作者进一步通过SQUID磁化率测量分析Fe和Zn掺杂对磁性及可能的超导行为的影响，但原摘要在关键结果处截断，具体转变温度和磁响应变化需查阅全文。

articles.title: Design of Cooperative Converter with Optimized Deep Learning based Control Mechanism of Battery Cell Balancing for Automotive Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向汽车应用的带优化深度学习控制机制的协同变换器电池单体均衡设计
articles.abstract: This paper presents a high power density battery cell balancing system for the electro-mobility application that integrates a voltage step-up and a cell balancing function in one converter topology. The Co-operative conversion technique is used and realized by means of a number of dual active bridge (CO-DAB) converter modules. The converter processes only a portion of the output power, proportional to the difference in voltage of the battery pack and the converter output, thus a smaller converter can be designed than conventional solutions. Furthermore, it does lead to more efficient power processing at the system level as well. The modular structure of the converter allows multiple connection to each battery cell for online cell balancing in the case of standstill, charging, and discharging modes. System is controlled through practical Deep Balancing Network (DBNet) Layer controller, which can perform cell balancing and output voltage regulation simultaneously. Simulation results of a cooperating converter for a 24–48 V, 250 W, and 120 kHz converter for small automotive motors have shown that the cooperative converter combines both functions and leads to physically smaller and more efficient power processing elements than traditional DAB and boost converters. The Co-operative DAB converter runs with a peak efficiency of 96.4% and extracts 64% of the output power.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种用于电动交通的高功率密度电池单体均衡系统，将升压与单体均衡功能集成在协同双有源桥变换器模块中。该拓扑仅处理与电池包和输出电压差相关的一部分功率，因此有望减小变换器体积并提高系统级效率。作者采用DBNet深度均衡网络控制器，同时实现单体均衡与输出电压调节，并通过24–48 V、250 W、120 kHz小型汽车电机应用的仿真验证其可行性。

articles.title: Stick-Slip-Induced Time Delays in Reconfigurable Systems: Data-Driven Estimation and Sliding Mode Control
articles.title_zh: 可重构系统中粘滑诱导时滞的数据驱动估计与滑模控制
articles.abstract: Stick-slip friction in reconfigurable mechanisms, such as cable-driven and tensegrity systems, introduces unknown and variable time delays that degrade trajectory tracking and control stability. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a novel hybrid control architecture that integrates data-driven delay prediction with a robust Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Controller. An experimental testbed is used to characterize stick-slip latency, leading to the development of a shallow Artificial Neural Network (ANN) that predicts real-time delay dynamics from measurable physical parameters (stiffness, force tension, weight, and speed). This neural predictor feeds a historical state buffer, injecting the delayed state directly into the equivalent control law for active latency compensation without requiring complex analytical friction models. Furthermore, robust asymptotic stability is formally guaranteed using a delay-dependent Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional and Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs) to systematically optimize the sliding surface gains. Validation on a cable-driven rehabilitator and a rotational tensegrity system demonstrates that the proposed LMI-optimized Super-Twisting Sliding Mode Controller significantly mitigates chattering and improves tracking precision, reducing the Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) by up to 99% compared to conventional heuristic tuning methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对绳驱和张拉整体等可重构机构中粘滑摩擦引起的未知、时变时滞问题，提出融合数据驱动时滞预测与超螺旋滑模控制的混合控制架构。作者通过实验平台表征粘滑延迟，并训练浅层人工神经网络，根据刚度、张力、载荷和速度等可测参数实时预测时滞，再将延迟状态注入等效控制律以补偿滞后。文中还利用时滞相关Lyapunov–Krasovskii泛函和线性矩阵不等式优化滑模面增益，并在绳驱康复装置和旋转张拉整体系统上进行验证。

articles.title: Orbitronics clears key hurdle with direct orbital currents, boosting signals 100-fold

articles.abstract: Researchers at Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) are the first to directly utilize orbital currents without the need for conversion of the orbital current into a spin current.

articles.abstract: Quantum materials, materials exhibiting physical behavior governed by the laws of quantum mechanics, have proved promising for the development of numerous advanced technologies, including quantum technologies, memory devices and solar panels. In some of these materials, electrons can collectively arrange themselves in unusual patterns, giving rise to states that cannot be explained by classical physics theories.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道聚焦一种笼目金属中电子可能自发形成环形电流的现象，提示材料内部存在难以由常规有序参数直接识别的隐藏量子有序。此类集体电子态体现了量子材料中超越经典图像的关联行为，并可能与未来量子器件、存储和能源技术相关。

articles.title: Quantum properties of multimode light observed despite extreme losses
articles.title_zh: 极端损耗下仍可观测多模光的量子性质
articles.abstract: Quantum properties of light are extremely delicate. When researchers attempt to measure them, even small losses on the way to a detector can make them invisible, limiting their use outside carefully controlled environments. A collaborative team of researchers involving scientists at the Max Planck Institute for the Science of Light (MPL) has shown a new way to measure several quantum channels of light at the same time and reveal their entanglement, even when almost all of the light is lost before reaching the detector. The results, recently published in Nature Communications, open new possibilities for scalable quantum technologies.
articles.abstract_zh: 研究团队提出一种同时测量多个光量子通道的方法，即使探测前几乎全部光子损失，仍能揭示多模光之间的纠缠。该结果突破了量子光测量对低损耗环境的强依赖，为更可扩展、更鲁棒的量子通信和量子信息技术提供了新思路。

articles.title: Quantum gravity tests may mistake ordinary spacetime for superposition
articles.title_zh: 量子引力测试可能将普通时空误判为叠加态
articles.abstract: Everything around us, from atoms and molecules to planets and galaxies, is governed by two extraordinarily successful theories of physics: quantum mechanics and gravity. Quantum mechanics explains the behavior of the microscopic world, while Einstein's theory of gravity describes the motion of stars, black holes and the expansion of the universe. Yet despite their successes, physicists are still searching for a theory of "quantum gravity" that would unite them into a single description of nature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道讨论量子力学与广义相对论统一问题中的实验判据风险，即某些量子引力测试可能把普通经典时空效应误解释为时空量子叠加。该观点提示，在设计和解读量子引力实验时，需要更严格地区分真正的引力量子性信号与常规时空背景造成的表观效应。

articles.title: Security of consumer electronics on Hybrid Model for Enhancement of RSA Using Quantum Key Distribution

articles.abstract: Upgrading in the field of cybersecurity for consumer electronics, RSA faces vulnerabilities due to quantum computing and especially from shor’s algorithm, it is that type pf algorithm which can easily find the prime factor of a huge number, this exploration introduce a unique integrated cryptographic mechanism, that merges RSA with Quantum key distribution(QKD) using the BB84 protocol. This model assures safely key transmission in the occurrence of both Quantum and Classical security risk. Experimental evaluation show the more effective performance of the integrated model in term of safe key generation, encryption, decryption time, remonstrance to the man-in-the-middle(MITM) attack and message accuracy review and greatly enhance the security model. This hybrid model providing a trustworthy protection method for future communication system in quantum information era.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本针对量子计算特别是Shor算法对RSA体制的威胁，提出将RSA与基于BB84协议的量子密钥分发相结合的混合密码机制。作者声称该模型在安全密钥生成、加密解密时间、抗中间人攻击和消息准确性方面表现更优，可为量子信息时代的通信系统提供更可靠的保护。
