articles.title: Physics-Informed and Surrogate-Assisted Cost Optimization of Fire Protection Materials
articles.title_zh: 基于物理约束与代理模型的防火保护材料成本优化
articles.abstract: Passive Fire Protection (PFP) systems are essential for preserving the structural integrity of steel elements under thermal loads but represent a significant portion of the structural budget. Traditional design methodologies, which rely on the prescriptive selection of oversized components from existing product catalogs, often fail to minimize material usage and cost while meeting stringent fire resistance ratings. This study presents a novel physics-informed hybrid optimization framework to perform the inverse design of cost-optimal PFP materials. The proposed methodology integrates three computational components: (1) a numerical Finite Difference Method (FDM) solver governing heat transfer according to Eurocode 3 standards; (2) an CatBoost surrogate model, trained on a dataset of 533 commercial products, for non-linear cost estimation; and (3) a Genetic Algorithm (GA) to explore the high-dimensional design space. The framework identifies a global optimum characterized by a thickness of 78.2 mm and a density of 56.0 kg/m ³. Numerical verification under the standard ISO 834 fire regime confirms that this "digital phenotype" maintains steel temperatures below the critical 500°C threshold for a 180-minute duration (R180). At a predicted market cost of 23 EUR/m², the AI-optimized configuration achieves the required safety standards at a fraction of the cost of average commercial alternatives. These results validate the efficacy of coupling physics-based simulations with machine learning for generative design, demonstrating a paradigm shift from simple material selection to automated, cost-driven material discovery in structural fire safety.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种物理信息与代理模型辅助的混合优化框架，用于被动防火材料的逆向设计，以在满足钢结构耐火要求的同时降低材料用量和成本。框架结合符合 Eurocode 3 的有限差分传热求解器、基于 533 种商业产品训练的 CatBoost 非线性成本代理模型，以及用于搜索高维设计空间的遗传算法。优化得到的候选方案厚度约 78.2 mm、密度约 56.0 kg/m³，并在 ISO 834 标准火灾条件下通过数值验证，使钢温低于 500°C 临界阈值。

articles.title: Potential Metabolic Pathways Linking Alcohol Consumption to Osteoarthritis: A Mediation Analysis of Plasma Lipids
articles.title_zh: 连接饮酒与骨关节炎的潜在代谢通路：基于血浆脂质的中介分析
articles.abstract: Objective: To investigate the causal relationship between alcohol consumption frequency and generalized osteoarthritis (OA) risk using Mendelian randomization (MR), and to quantify the potential mediating role of plasma lipids. Methods: A two-sample MR and two-step mediation analysis were performed using large-scale genome-wide association studies (GWAS). Alcohol intake frequency was the primary exposure. Mediators included total cholesterol (TC), triglycerides (TG), high-density lipoprotein cholesterol (HDL-C), and low-density lipoprotein cholesterol (LDL-C). The inverse-variance weighted (IVW) method served as the primary framework, supplemented by multivariable MR (MVMR) to control for body mass index (BMI). Results: Genetically predicted higher alcohol intake frequency was significantly associated with an increased risk of generalized OA (OR = 1.27, 95% CI: 1.12–1.45, P < 0.001). Two-step mediation analysis identified a statistically significant, albeit modest, indirect effect through TC levels ( β = 0.0096, 95% CI: 0.0008–0.0184, P= 0.032), accounting for 4.03% of the total effect. Other lipid fractions (TG, HDL-C, LDL-C) and site-specific OA (knee/hip) yielded no significant causal mediation. Crucially, MVMR confirmed that the detrimental causal effect of alcohol on generalized OA remained highly stable and independent after adjusting for BMI (P < 0.001). Conclusion: Increased alcohol consumption frequency is a genetically-supported risk factor for generalized OA, independent of obesity-related mechanical loading. Although circulating TC acts as a statistically valid mediator, its minor mediation proportion suggests that the "alcohol–TC–OA" pathway represents only a small component of a more complex pathogenic network.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用大规模GWAS数据开展两样本孟德尔随机化和两步中介分析，评估饮酒频率与广泛性骨关节炎风险之间的因果关系，并考察血浆脂质的中介作用。结果显示，遗传预测的较高饮酒频率与广泛性骨关节炎风险升高显著相关；总胆固醇具有统计显著但幅度较小的中介效应，约解释总效应的4.03%。甘油三酯、HDL-C、LDL-C以及膝/髋等部位特异性骨关节炎未显示显著中介或关联证据。

articles.title: Ultrafast Electrical Charge Injection in Operating Perovskite Light-Emitting Diodes by Infrared Optical Control
articles.title_zh: 通过红外光学控制实现工作态钙钛矿发光二极管中的超快电荷注入
articles.abstract: Electrical injection of charges into semiconductors underlies the operation of LEDs, photodetectors, and transistors. The speed of electrically driven injection is constrained by resistor-capacitor (RC) time constants and interfacial charge-transfer barriers, limiting device operation to nanosecond timescales. Optical excitation, in contrast, can generate carriers on femtosecond timescales, but photons normally create neutral excitations or balanced electron–hole populations, resulting in device photophysics that is fundamentally different from electrically driven operation. Here we demonstrate ultrafast electrical charge injection in operating perovskite LED assisted by infrared optical pulses. During device operation, electrical bias builds up an interfacial space-charge reservoir. A femtosecond infrared pulse can then release this reservoir, injecting carriers into the emissive perovskite layer within ~100 fs, far faster than the conventional electrical response of the device. Operando electrical-pump–IR-push–visible-probe spectroscopy reveals the rapid appearance of carriers in the perovskite emissive layer after the infrared pulse. Time-resolved electroluminescence shows that this injected population enhances device operation, producing a transient increase in electroluminescence from the working LED. Selective charge-blocking device architectures identify the electron-transport-layer interface as the dominant source of the IR-injected carriers, demonstrating polarity-selective control of electrical injection. Our results establish optical control of electrically accumulated charges as a route to fast creation of unipolar carrier population and potentially bypass conventional electronic speed limits of semiconductor devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作展示了在工作态钙钛矿LED中利用飞秒红外脉冲辅助实现超快电学电荷注入。器件偏压先在界面形成空间电荷储库，随后红外脉冲释放该储库，使载流子在约100 fs内注入发光钙钛矿层，显著快于常规受RC时间常数和界面势垒限制的电响应。原位电泵浦–红外推动–可见探测光谱和时间分辨电致发光表明，红外脉冲后钙钛矿发光层中载流子迅速出现并参与发光动力学。

articles.title: SU(4) Heisenberg model on the hyperhoneycomb lattice
articles.title_zh: 超蜂窝晶格上的 SU(4) 海森堡模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study the ground state of the SU(4) Heisenberg model on the hyperhoneycomb lattice using three-dimensional projected entangled pair states. We show that it is possible to compute physical observables for the ground states using loop expansions, which converge quickly on tree-like lattices. Our extrapolations to the limit of infinite bond dimensions point toward gapless spin-liquid ground state.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究采用三维投影纠缠对态研究超蜂窝晶格上SU(4)海森堡模型的基态性质。作者指出，在类树状晶格上可通过收敛较快的环路展开计算基态物理可观测量。对无限键维极限的外推结果支持该体系具有无能隙自旋液体基态。
authors: I. V. Lukin, A. G. Sotnikov

articles.title: Vacancy-mediated nitrogen diffusion and aggregation via high-fluence electron beam irradiation in HPHT synthesized diamond crystal
articles.title_zh: 高通量电子束辐照下HPHT合成金刚石中空位介导的氮扩散与聚集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27723v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The negatively charged nitrogen vacancy (NV-) center in diamonds is promising point defect for highly sensitive quantum sensing. The formation of high-density NV- centers is essential for improving sensitivity. We performed room-temperature electron beam irradiation (EBI) and annealing on nitrogen-doped high-pressure high-temperature diamond crystals to convert substitutional nitrogen into NV centers. In the low-fluence region of EBI, neutral substitutional nitrogen (Ns0) concentration decreased and NV0 and NV- center concentration increased with increasing EBI fluence. The decrease in Ns0 concentration was comparable to the increase in total NV center concentration; thus, the conversion from Ns0 to NV0 and NV- centers is a dominant defect formation process. In a high-fluence region, NV0 and NV- center and Ns0 and Ns+ concentrations decreased with increasing EBI fluence, indicating the formation of unknown nitrogen-related defects such as the H3 center, which is a nitrogen and vacancy aggregation defect. Although H3 centers were observed at high EBI fluence, their forming annealing temperature of 1375 +- 25 degrees Celsius was lower than the typically reported temperatures over 1600 degrees Celsius. We attribute this low-temperature formation to vacancy-mediated nitrogen diffusion and aggregation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究室温电子束辐照及退火对含氮高压高温金刚石中NV中心形成的影响，目标是提高用于量子传感的负电荷NV中心密度。在低辐照通量下，中性替位氮浓度降低，同时NV0和NV-浓度升高，表明Ns0向NV中心转化是主要缺陷形成过程。在高通量区，NV中心及Ns0/Ns+浓度均随通量增加而下降，并观察到H3等氮-空位聚集缺陷，说明强辐照促进了更复杂的氮相关缺陷形成。
authors: Chikara Shinei, Yuta Masuyama, Jun Chen, Hiroshi. Abe, Masashi Miyakawa, Takashi Taniguchi, Takeshi Ohshima, Tokuyuki Teraji

articles.title: Collision and coalescence dynamics of bosonic quantum Hall droplets
articles.title_zh: 玻色量子霍尔液滴的碰撞与并合动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27768v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Recently bosonic quantum Hall droplets have been observed in rapidly rotating two-dimensional Bose-Einstein condensates (BECs), which exhibit robust dynamical stability. Inspired by this, we systematically investigate the collision and coalescence dynamics of these droplets within the Gross-Pitaevskii framework. For two-droplet collisions, we find two distinct collision outcomes, namely merging and separation, that are controlled by the initial relative velocity. The critical velocity exhibits a universal scaling law with the interaction and the particle number as v_c propto (gN)¹/⁴, which can be interpreted from a simplified analytical model, revealing the essential role of the collision time. It differs fundamentally from the mechanism governing the conventional Lee-Huang-Yang stabilized quantum droplets. Furthermore, while the collision can change the shape of the droplet significantly, the center of mass trajectory remains nearly unaffected, owing to the conservation of angular momentum. For overlapping stationary droplets, vortex arrays can emerge through Kelvin-Helmholtz instability driven by phase-induced shear flow. Although two droplets may merge into a larger one, extended states cannot be constructed from multiple overlapping droplets. Instead, the system dynamically reorganizes into new isolated droplets, revealing the localized property in the bulk region. Our results reveal the unique nonequilibrium dynamics of quantum Hall droplets and suggest new pathways for manipulating strongly correlated rotating quantum fluids.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在Gross-Pitaevskii框架下系统考察快速旋转二维玻色-爱因斯坦凝聚体中玻色量子霍尔液滴的碰撞和并合动力学。两液滴碰撞呈现并合与分离两类结果，由初始相对速度控制；临界速度满足随相互作用和粒子数的普适标度关系 vc∝(gN)¹/⁴，并可由简化解析模型从碰撞时间角度解释。碰撞可显著改变液滴形状，但质心轨迹因角动量守恒几乎不受影响；重叠静止液滴中还可由相位诱导剪切流触发Kelvin-Helmholtz不稳定性并形成涡旋阵列。
authors: Xinyi Liu, Zhendong Li, Yuwen Zhou, Siying Li, Haoran Xu, Zihe Liu, Rongzhen Jiao, Mingyuan Sun

articles.title: Single-Crystalline Al/Ge Heterostructure with an Atomically Sharp Commensurate Interface
articles.title_zh: 具有原子级尖锐共格界面的单晶 Al/Ge 异质结构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27854v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: A key challenge in developing Al/Ge heterostructures for quantum applications is Al-Ge interdiffusion. This process is facilitated by grain boundaries in polycrystalline films, which degrades interface quality and impairs device performance and reliability. Here, we present epitaxial growth of single-crystalline Al(111) on Ge(111) by molecular beam epitaxy, achieving an atomically flat and sharp interface. At the interface, a commensurate 7-Al-lattice/5-Ge-lattice epitaxial relationship is observed, which dramatically reduces the intrinsic lattice mismatch from 28.4% to about 0.1%. Interestingly, this well-ordered interface does not form below a critical thickness of 0.3 nm. Instead, Al initially nucleates as random clusters, which then transform into two-dimensional (2D) islands and, as Al deposition further increases, eventually develop into a continuous film. By optimizing the growth parameters, we have achieved an ultra-flat Al film with a surface root-mean-square roughness of about 0.16 nm and an ultra-thin continuous film with thickness of only 2 nm. These epitaxially grown Al-Ge heterostructures, with their atomically flat surfaces and sharp interfaces, provide a promising platform for studying topological quantum states.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作通过分子束外延在Ge(111)上生长单晶Al(111)，获得原子级平整且尖锐的Al/Ge界面，以缓解多晶薄膜晶界促进的Al-Ge互扩散问题。界面呈现7个Al晶格匹配5个Ge晶格的共格外延关系，使固有晶格失配由28.4%大幅降至约0.1%。研究还发现有序界面需超过约0.3 nm临界厚度才形成，Al初始为随机团簇，随后转变为二维岛并最终连成薄膜；优化后可获得约0.16 nm均方根粗糙度的超平Al膜和厚度仅2 nm的连续超薄膜。
authors: Jian-Huan Wang, Ding-Ming Huang, Han Gao, Yuan Yao, H. Q. Xu, Jian-Jun Zhang

articles.title: Quantum enhancement of information-mediated energy transfer
articles.title_zh: 信息介导能量转移的量子增强
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27868v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Thermodynamics of information identifies information flow as a thermodynamic resource, but whether quantum coherence and collective coupling can enhance it at low entropy-production cost remains unresolved. We address this question for interacting open quantum systems by deriving a thermodynamic uncertainty relation that bounds information flow by entropy production in nonequilibrium steady states. We construct a quantum engine in which N-fold degenerate ground and excited states are collectively coupled to heat baths. Collective jumps enhance heat currents and information flow linearly with N, while entropy production remains independent of N, realizing a high-power, low-dissipation autonomous quantum Maxwell's demon that leverages collectively enhanced information flow to pump heat against a temperature gradient. Beyond steady states, collective interactions amplify the unitary component of quantum information flow, yielding a quadratic enhancement of the free-energy charging power of quantum batteries. Our results reveal scalable advantages of quantum coherence and collective effects in quantum engines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对相互作用开放量子系统推导了非平衡稳态中由熵产生约束信息流的热力学不确定关系，探讨量子相干性和集体耦合能否以低耗散代价增强信息热力学资源。作者构造了具有N重简并基态和激发态、并与热浴集体耦合的量子热机，发现集体跃迁使热流和信息流随N线性增强，而熵产生不随N增加，从而实现高功率、低耗散的自主量子麦克斯韦妖。进一步地，非稳态中集体相互作用可放大量子信息流的幺正分量，使量子电池自由能充电功率获得二次增强。
authors: Shotaro Oki, Yuki Kadono, Kaito Tojo, Takahiro Sagawa, Ken Funo

articles.title: Hidden valley dynamics behind vanishing circular polarization in moiré excitons
articles.title_zh: 莫尔激子中圆偏振消失背后的隐藏谷动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27963v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Optically addressable valley degrees of freedom in transition-metal dichalcogenide heterostructures provide a powerful platform for valleytronic and quantum-optical functionalities. In moiré superlattices, interlayer excitons inherit valley-contrasting optical selection rules while acquiring long lifetimes, electric dipoles, and site-dependent optical responses. However, because conventional measurements typically probe time-integrated valley polarization, the dynamical origin of vanishing polarization has remained elusive. Here, we show that a nearly zero steady-state valley polarization in electrically tunable moiré excitons does not necessarily indicate fast valley relaxation. Helicity-resolved time-resolved photoluminescence reveals a temporal crossing between co- and cross-circularly polarized emission, indicating that helicity-opposite dynamical components coexist and compensate after time integration. A minimal two-channel model, representing A-like and B-like moiré emission channels with opposite optical selection rules and distinct effective decay/depolarization rates, reproduces the observed helicity crossing without invoking a single rapid valley relaxation process. Furthermore, two-dimensional gate-field maps show that the crossing time evolves systematically with electrostatic tuning, demonstrating that the hidden valley dynamics are electrically controllable. These results show that time-integrated circular polarization can give a false-negative indication of valley polarization in multichannel valley emitters.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作研究过渡金属二硫族化物莫尔异质结构中层间激子的谷偏振动力学，指出稳态圆偏振接近零并不必然意味着快速谷弛豫。螺旋度分辨时间分辨光致发光显示，同圆偏振与反圆偏振发射存在时间交叉，说明相反螺旋度的动态分量共存并在时间积分后相互抵消。一个包含A-like和B-like两类莫尔发射通道、且具有相反光学选择定则和不同有效衰减/退偏振速率的最小模型可复现实验现象，而无需引入单一快速谷退相干机制。
authors: Yuto Urano, Lata Chouhan, Nurul Fariha Ahmad, Kenji Watanabe, Takashi Taniguchi, Daichi Kozawa, Ryo Kitaura

articles.title: Determining Electron Beam Lateral Coherence in a Scanning Electron Microscope Using Electron Diffraction
articles.title_zh: 利用电子衍射测定扫描电子显微镜中电子束的横向相干性
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28056v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We develop and characterize scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) capabilities within a scanning electron microscope (SEM) to investigate the effective lateral coherence of the electron beam (e-beam) in the specimen plane. Using single-crystalline Au flakes and a sample composed of a monolayer of graphene, we obtain high-quality selected-area electron diffraction (SAED) maps and convergent-beam electron diffraction (CBED) patterns, validating the systems ability to probe crystallographic information at an acceleration voltage of 30 keV. Building on these capabilities, we implement a method, which is adapted from techniques traditionally used in transmission electron microscopy, to measure the degree of lateral coherence of the e-beam in the specimen plane of the SEM. By analyzing interference between electrons with two different wave vectors separated by 0.031 per angstrom, we extract a lower limit for the degree of lateral coherence over 5% of the e-beam diameter of approximately 60%. These coherence values are sufficient to enable quantum-coherent electron-light-matter interaction experiments in the SEM.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在扫描电子显微镜中开发并表征扫描透射电子显微能力，用于测量样品平面处电子束的有效横向相干性。通过单晶Au薄片和单层石墨烯样品，作者获得高质量选区电子衍射图和会聚束电子衍射图，验证了30 keV加速电压下提取晶体学信息的能力。在此基础上，研究借鉴透射电子显微中的相干性测量方法，分析波矢差为0.031 Å⁻¹的电子干涉，得到在约5%电子束直径范围内横向相干度下限约为60%，足以支持SEM中的量子相干电子-光-物质相互作用实验。
authors: Evelijn Akerboom, Fatemeh Kiani, Giulia Tagliabue, Wiebke Albrecht, Joanne Etheridge, F. Javier García de Abajo, Albert Polman

articles.title: Moiré Phonons and Emergent Exciton-Phonon Coupling in a Moiré Heterobilayer
articles.title_zh: 莫尔异质双层中的莫尔声子与涌现激子-声子耦合
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28185v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Moiré superlattices have emerged as a new platform for engineering electronic and optical properties in van der Waals heterostructures, enabling control over correlated and excitonic phenomena. Yet the impact of moiré superlattices on exciton-phonon coupling remains largely unexplored. Here we demonstrate emergent, layer-selective coupling between moiré phonons and moiré excitons in angle-aligned WS2/WSe2 heterobilayers. Using a broadband terahertz phonon transducer, we coherently launch moiré phonons that resonantly perturb the excitonic states. We show that the exciton-phonon coupling is intrinsically modified by the moiré superlattice in a layer-selective manner. A driven oscillator model captures the dynamics, revealing three moiré phonon resonances with distinct coupling to the moiré excitons. First principles calculations show that many moiré phonon modes can arise with distinct strongly hybridized in-plane and out-of-plane vibrations in the moiré unit cells. The calculations further identify the three experimentally observed moiré phonons and their emergent characteristic coupling to the moiré excitons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作在角度对准的WS2/WSe2异质双层中展示了莫尔声子与莫尔激子之间涌现的层选择性耦合。研究利用宽带太赫兹声子换能器相干激发莫尔声子，并观测其对激子态的共振扰动；驱动振子模型揭示了三个与莫尔激子耦合方式不同的莫尔声子共振。第一性原理计算表明，莫尔晶胞中可产生多种强烈杂化的面内/面外振动模式，并识别出实验观测到的三个莫尔声子及其特征性激子耦合。
authors: Can B. Uzundal, Woochang Kim, Zhiyuan Cui, Yuxuan Wei, Zheyu Lu, Qixin Feng, Francis L. Hong, Indrajit Maity, Takashi Taniguchi, Kenji Watanabe, Manish Jain, Mit H. Naik, Yoseob Yoon, Michael F. Crommie, Steven G. Louie, Feng Wang

articles.title: Range-controlled entanglement in Lindbladian skin states of monitored fermions
articles.title_zh: 受监测费米子 Lindblad 趋肤态中的距离可控纠缠
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.09306v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Reservoir engineering can stabilize states inaccessible to unitary dynamics. Directed particle-conserving dissipation creates Lindbladian skin states, where Pauli exclusion turns edge accumulation into a many-body density imbalance. In a monitored fermion chain with tunable hopping range, we identify, within a Gaussian trajectory approximation, two finite-size scaling regimes: short-range hopping is consistent with complete skin accumulation and area-law entanglement, whereas sufficiently long-range hopping produces a finite bulk tail and effective algebraic sub-volume-law entanglement. Dissipation and coherent hopping thus jointly control skin localization and quantum entanglement, highlighting their close interconnection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有可调跃迁范围的受监测费米子链中，定向守粒子数耗散诱导的Lindblad趋肤态及其纠缠性质。在高斯轨迹近似下，作者识别出两类有限尺寸标度行为：短程跃迁情形与完全边界趋肤积累和面积律纠缠相一致，而足够长程跃迁会产生有限体相尾部和有效代数型亚体积律纠缠。结果表明，耗散与相干跃迁共同调控趋肤局域化和量子纠缠，二者存在紧密关联。
authors: Gianluca Passarelli, Angelo Russomanno, Davide Rossini, Procolo Lucignano

articles.title: Large Fluctuations in Open Quantum Systems
articles.title_zh: 开放量子系统中的大涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11822v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We study statistics of atypical measurement outcomes in the steady states of driven open quantum systems. In equilibrium, the probability distribution over the phase space, as encoded in, e.g., the Wigner function, is analytic in the phase-space coordinates. We show that this property is generically lost in driven dissipative systems: their it large-deviation function develops lines and surfaces across which its derivatives are discontinuous. As an illustrative example, we consider a parametrically driven Kerr oscillator coupled linearly and/or nonlinearly to a dissipative bath. Rare fluctuations in the amplitude and phase of the induced oscillations are governed by semiclassical instanton trajectories of the corresponding Keldysh-Lindblad action. We demonstrate that a given fluctuation can be realized through multiple distinct instanton trajectories. The competition between these trajectories leads to abrupt switching of the dominant instanton and, consequently, to non-analytic features in the large-deviation function.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析驱动开放量子系统稳态中非典型测量结果的统计性质，重点关注相空间分布对应的大偏差函数。作者指出，与平衡情形中Wigner函数等相空间分布通常解析不同，驱动耗散系统的大偏差函数会普遍出现导数不连续的线或面。以参量驱动Kerr振子耦合线性和/或非线性耗散浴为例，稀有振幅与相位涨落由Keldysh-Lindblad作用量的半经典瞬子轨道控制；同一涨落可由多条不同瞬子轨道实现，其竞争导致主导瞬子突变并产生大偏差函数的非解析特征。
authors: V. Yu. Mylnikov, S. O. Potashin, A. Kamenev

articles.title: A General Pipeline for Digesting Scientific Literature into a Shared Scientific Knowledge Base
articles.title_zh: 将科学文献消化为共享科学知识库的通用流程
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27384v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The published scientific literature is a rich, continuously growing record of measurements, correlations, and observations that modern AI tools can now make accessible in new ways. The Materials Explorer Pipeline digests collections of scientific papers into a structured, queryable database, producing sample records with full provenance and confidence, making them interactively explorable, and surfacing hypothesis candidates for scientist review. Each extracted record is a self-contained, portable unit of knowledge, carrying the measurements, research details, and source citations needed to use and cite the data appropriately. The Pipeline is demonstrated on recent superconducting qubit materials literature of the Co-design Center for Quantum Advantage, a DOE National Quantum Information Science Research Center, producing a corpus of 233 samples across 10 material classes. The Pipeline architecture is domain-agnostic and designed to be readily portable to other scientific domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Materials Explorer Pipeline，用于将科学论文集合转化为结构化、可查询的数据库。流程可提取带有来源、置信度和完整溯源信息的样品记录，并支持交互式探索和候选假设筛选。作者以量子优势协同设计中心的超导量子比特材料文献为例，构建了覆盖10类材料、233个样品的语料库，并强调该架构具有跨领域迁移性。

articles.title: Soft QED as Open Quantum System: Infrared Cancellation and Soft-Shell Coarse Graining
articles.title_zh: 作为开放量子系统的软 QED：红外相消与软壳粗粒化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27498v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: I formulate unresolved soft-photon sector of QED as open quantum system. Resolved charged particles and hard photons form the system, unresolved soft photons form the environment, and basic object is the reduced density matrix. A resolved outcome f of multiple hard particles and photons has probability Pf(i) =sumₙ|łangle f,n|S|i,0ångle|²⁼łangle i|F_f|iångle, with Kraus operators Kₙ₌ {}ₘ̊ ₛₒfₜ łangle n|S|0 ångleₘ̊ ₛₒfₜ and effect F_f=sumₙKₙ^daggerΠ_fKₙ. The SK formulation places unresolved virtual and real terms in one doubled-contour expansion. At one loop they carry the same on-shell eikonal kernel with opposite signs. This elegantly organizes the QED probability: for the same observable, perturbative order, diagrams, and phase space, the OQS gives the same infrared-finite terms as the full-QED. The soft-photon evolution is a unitary coherent-state displacement driven by the scattering current. The equal-history identity of influence functional exactly normalizes this soft evolution; together with the soft-photon theorem it removes the IR divergent leading-soft factor from inclusive probability. I also derive explicit leading-soft QED realization of scale-parametrized Lindblad evolution on a fixed hard-branch space. Tracing an infinitesimal soft-photon shell produces diagonal jump operators whose entries are fixed by the corresponding eikonal emission amplitudes. The finite-shell map is a completely positive unital Schur channel and, in the sharp scale-invariant leading-soft regime, a dephasing semigroup of a completely-positive-divisible scale flow. The resulting logarithmic visibility slope and monotonic purity loss are off-diagonal predictions of the reduced-state description. The same controlled-displacement dilation gives the Sudakov probability, Poisson soft-photon multiplicities, and the bremsstrahlung number spectrum.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将 QED 中未分辨的软光子部门表述为开放量子系统，其中可分辨带电粒子和硬光子构成系统，未分辨软光子构成环境，核心对象为约化密度矩阵。作者用 Kraus 算符和 Schwinger-Keldysh 形式统一处理虚软光子与实软光子贡献，显示一圈阶下二者具有相同的壳上 eikonal 核但符号相反，从而组织出红外有限的概率。软光子演化被解释为由散射流驱动的相干态位移，其影响泛函的等历史恒等式与软光子定理共同消去包容概率中的红外发散领先软因子。

articles.title: Higher dimensional quantum Hall effect and the analog of Wᵢₙfty-algebra
articles.title_zh: 高维量子霍尔效应及 W∞ 代数的类比
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28219v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We show that Abelian and nonabelian gauge transformations are the analog of Wᵢₙfty transformations for higher dimensional quantum Hall effect. The commutator anomaly and the extended algebra of such transformations on the edge modes of a droplet are obtained by purely topological arguments, basically utilizing the two-cocycle in the descent procedure for anomalies and using the fact that there is anomaly cancellation between the bulk and boundary actions. The method relies on the fact that bulk actions are easily constructed in general using the Dolbeault index theorem. The resulting algebras are shown to agree with explicit edge mode calculations for cases where they are available. We also comment on the similarities and differences in the nature of these transformations between two and higher dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 作者指出，在高维量子霍尔效应中，阿贝尔与非阿贝尔规范变换可视为二维情形 W∞ 变换的对应物。文章基于拓扑论证，利用反常下降程序中的二余循环以及体-边界反常抵消，推导液滴边缘模上的对易子反常和扩展代数。体作用量通过 Dolbeault 指标定理构造，所得代数与已有显式边缘模计算一致，并讨论二维与高维情形中这些变换的异同。

articles.title: Diameter truncated operator evolution
articles.title_zh: 基于直径截断的算符演化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.28313v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We present a method for simulating operator dynamics in out-of-equilibrium quantum systems. Due to the rapid growth of complexity in these systems, this is typically speaking an intractable task. However, exceptional progress has been made in recent years to sidestep this barrier, with the introduction of a number of methods that make use of a truncation of the simulation to low-weight (the number of non-trivial terms in a Pauli string basis expansion) observables, which turns out to be a good approximation for many dynamical quantities of interest, e.g., two-point infinite-temperature correlation functions between local operators. In this work, we extend this idea to a leaner truncation protocol, truncating operators based on their diameter - that is, the size of the region on the lattice on which they are non-trivially supported. Using existing analysis for generic circuits we argue that this kind of truncation protocol is physically well-motivated, and show via extensive numerical simulations for a number of systems of interest (here, the kicked Ising model and the Heisenberg XXZ model) that it is effective, and allows us to efficiently and accurately extract local correlation functions and transport properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种模拟非平衡量子系统算符动力学的方法，将算符按其在晶格上非平庸支撑区域的直径进行截断，而非传统的低权重截断。作者结合通用量子线路的已有分析说明这种截断具有物理动机，并在踢 Ising 模型和 Heisenberg XXZ 模型等体系中进行数值验证。结果表明，直径截断可高效近似多种局域动力学量，尤其适用于无限温两点关联等问题。
authors: Tom Holden-Dye, Max Marvell, Joel Mills, Christoper J. Turner, Arijeet Pal

articles.title: Current-induced re-entrant superconductivity and extreme nonreciprocal superconducting diode effect in valley-polarized systems
articles.title_zh: 谷极化体系中的电流诱导重入超导与极端非互易超导二极管效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2501.00835v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The superconducting diode effect (SDE) refers to the nonreciprocity of superconducting critical currents. Generally, the SDE has a positive and a negative critical currents jc+- corresponding to two opposite directions with unequal amplitudes. It is demonstrated that an extreme nonreciprocity where two critical currents can become both positive (or negative) has been observed in twisted graphene systems. In this work, we theoretically propose a possible mechanism to realize an extreme nonreciprocal SDE. Based on a simple microscopic model, we demonstrate that depairing currents required to dissolve Cooper pairs can be remodulated under the interplay between valley polarizations and applied currents. Near the disappearance of the superconductivity, the remodulation is shown to induce extreme nonreciprocity and also the current-induced re-entrant superconductivity where the system has two different critical current intervals. Our study may provide new horizons for understanding the coexistence of superconductivity and spontaneous valley polarizations, and pave a way for designing SDE with 100% efficiency
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从理论上提出一种实现极端非互易超导二极管效应的机制，即两个方向的临界电流可同时为正或同时为负。基于简单微观模型，作者表明谷极化与外加电流的相互作用会重新调制破坏 Cooper 对所需的去配对电流。接近超导消失处，这种调制可诱导极端非互易性和电流诱导的重入超导，使体系出现两个不同的临界电流区间，为理解超导与自发谷极化共存及设计高效率超导二极管提供思路。

articles.title: Information-theoretic principle of emergent 1-form symmetries
articles.title_zh: 涌现一形式对称性的信息论原理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2502.17572v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Higher-form symmetries act on sub-dimensional spatial manifolds of a quantum system. They can emerge as an exact symmetry at low energies even when they are explicitly broken at the microscopic level, making them difficult to characterize. In this work, we propose that the emergence of 1-form symmetries is information-theoretic in nature, characterized by the preservation of information about a specific bare (microscopic) 1-form symmetry. As a consequence, the loss of the emergent 1-form symmetry is an information-theoretic transition which we argue to be revealed from the long-range entanglement in the ensemble of post-measurement states. We analytically determine the regimes in which a 1-form symmetry emerges in product states on one- and two-dimensional lattices. In analytically intractable regimes, we demonstrate how to efficiently detect 1-form symmetries with a global quantum error correction (QEC) decoder and numerically examine the information-theoretic transition of the 1-form symmetry, including systems with Z₂ topological order. As a practical application of our framework, we show that once the 1-form symmetry is detected to exist, a topological quantum phase transition characterized by the spontaneous breaking of the 1-form symmetry can be accurately determined by a disorder parameter. We further argue that our proposed theory for emergent 1-form symmetries offers new perspectives on particle condensation and suggests sharp information-theoretic phase boundaries between Higgs and confining regimes in the Z₂ lattice gauge theory.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出，低能涌现的一形式对称性可从信息论角度理解为关于特定微观一形式对称性的信息被保留下来，即使该对称性在微观哈密顿量中被显式破缺。作者认为涌现一形式对称性的丧失对应一种信息论相变，可通过测量后态系综中的长程纠缠来揭示。文章解析确定了一维和二维晶格乘积态中一形式对称性涌现的参数区域，并在难以解析的情形中利用全局量子纠错解码器高效探测该对称性，包括具有 Z₂ 拓扑序的体系。
authors: Yu-Jie Liu, Wen-Tao Xu, Frank Pollmann, Michael Knap

articles.title: Holographic Strange Metals for Philosophers and Physicists
articles.title_zh: 面向哲学家与物理学家的全息奇异金属
articles.abstract: arXiv:2507.23527v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper introduces the physics and philosophy of strange metals, which are characterized by unusual electrical and thermal properties that deviate from conventional metallic behaviour. The anomalous strange-metal behaviour discussed here appears in the normal state of a copper-oxide high-temperature superconductor, and it cannot be described using standard condensed-matter physics. Currently, it can only be described through a holographic dual, viz.~a four-dimensional black hole in anti-de Sitter spacetime. This paper first introduces the theory of, and specific experiments carried out on, strange metals. Then it discusses a number of philosophical questions that strange metals open up regarding the experimental evidence for holography and its realist interpretation. Strange metals invert the explanatory arrows, in that usual holographic arguments are seen as giving explanations of the bulk quantum-gravity theory from the boundary. By contrast, the aim here is, by using holography, to explain the experimentally discovered and anomalous properties of strange metals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍奇异金属的物理与哲学问题，重点关注铜氧化物高温超导体正常态中偏离常规金属理论的异常电输运和热输运行为。作者指出，这些性质目前可通过反德西特时空中的四维黑洞全息对偶来描述，而难以用标准凝聚态理论解释。文章进一步讨论奇异金属为全息理论的实验证据和实在论解释带来的哲学问题，强调这里是用体理论解释边界实验现象，从而反转了通常的全息解释方向。
authors: Enrico Cinti, Sebastian De Haro, Mark Golden, Umut Gürsoy, Henk T. C. Stoof

articles.title: Finite-Bath Open Quantum Systems: Exact Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 有限浴开放量子系统：精确动力学
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.07180v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: In this work, we introduce a method for deriving exact master equations from the dynamical map for finite open quantum systems coupled to (in)finite reservoirs, using the principle of minimal dissipation. The exact dynamics of the central spin model, which models a finite-bath open quantum system, is developed for two interaction types: Heisenberg and stochastic pure-dephasing interactions. The Heisenberg interaction yields a novel phase-covariant quantum channel in the strong-coupling regime, offering a new platform for studying a range of quantum information protocols. The stochastic pure-dephasing interaction provides the microscopic derivation of the paradigmatic non-Markovian random telegraph noise (RTN) channel, establishing its quantum foundation and offering insight into stochastic couplings. We derive the closed-form master equations for both models. As a demonstration, we explore the thermodynamic performance of these systems as quantum batteries. A direct relationship between quantum heat current and charging power is revealed, and RTN quantum batteries are shown to have advantages in charge storage.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种从动力学映射出发、基于最小耗散原则推导有限开放量子系统精确主方程的方法。作者研究中心自旋模型在 Heisenberg 相互作用和随机纯退相干相互作用下的精确动力学：前者在强耦合区给出新的相位协变量子信道，后者为非马尔可夫随机电报噪声信道提供微观推导。文章还将这些体系作为量子电池研究其热力学性能，揭示量子热流与充电功率之间的直接关系，并指出随机电报噪声量子电池在电荷存储方面具有优势。

articles.title: Floquet Recurrences in the Double Kicked Top
articles.title_zh: 双重踢顶中的 Floquet 复现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2511.13342v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study exact quantum recurrences in the double kicked top (DKT), a driven spin model that extends the quantum kicked top (QKT) by introducing an additional time-reversal symmetry-breaking kick. Reformulating its dynamics in terms of effective parameters kᵣ and k_θ, we analytically show exact periodicity of the Floquet operator for kᵣ = jπ/2 and kᵣ = jπ/4 with distinct periods for integer and half-odd integer j. These exact recurrences were found to be independent of k_θ. The long-time-averaged entanglement and fidelity rate function show dynamical quantum phase transition (DQPT) for kᵣ = jπ/2 at time-reversal symmetric cases k_θ = ± kᵣ. In the other time-reversal symmetric case k_θ = 0, the DQPT exists only for a half-odd integer j. Using level statistics, a smooth transition is observed from integrable to non-integrable nature as kᵣ is changed away from jπ/2. Our work demonstrates that regular and chaotic regimes can be controlled for any system size by tuning kᵣ and k_θ, making the DKT a useful platform for quantum control and information processing applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究双重踢顶这一受驱自旋模型中的精确量子复现，该模型在量子踢顶基础上加入额外的破坏时间反演对称性的踢。作者用有效参数 kᵣ 和 k_θ 重写动力学，并解析证明当 kᵣ=jπ/2 和 kᵣ=jπ/4 时 Floquet 算符具有精确周期性，且整数与半奇整数 j 的周期不同，同时这些复现与 k_θ 无关。长时平均纠缠和保真率函数显示，在特定时间反演对称情形下存在动力学量子相变；能级统计还表明偏离 kᵣ=jπ/2 时体系从可积平滑过渡到非可积，为通过参数调控规则与混沌动力学提供平台。
authors: Avadhut V. Purohit, Udaysinh T. Bhosale

articles.title: Heat, work, and fluctuations in a driven quantum resonator
articles.title_zh: 受驱量子谐振器中的热、功与涨落
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.11480v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: A central building block of a heat engine is the working fluid, which mediates the conversion of heat into work. In nanoscale heat engines, the working fluid can be a quantum system whose behavior and dynamics are non-classical. A particularly versatile realization is a quantum resonator, which allows for precise control and coupling to thermal reservoirs, making it an ideal platform for exploring quantum thermodynamic processes. Here, we investigate the thermodynamic properties of a driven quantum resonator whose temperature is controlled by modulating its natural frequency. We evaluate the work performed by the external drive and the resulting heat flow between the resonator and its environment, both within linear response and beyond. To further elucidate these processes, we determine the full distribution of photon exchanges between the resonator and its environment, characterized by its first few cumulants. Our results provide quantitative insights into the interplay between heat, work, and fluctuations, and may help in designing future heat engines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究一个自然频率受调制、因而温度可控的受驱量子谐振器的热力学性质。作者在线性响应及其之外计算外部驱动对谐振器所做的功，以及谐振器与环境之间的热流。为进一步刻画能量交换过程，文章求得谐振器与环境间光子交换的完整分布及其前几阶累积量，从而量化热、功和涨落的相互关系，并为纳米尺度量子热机设计提供参考。
authors: Riya Baruah, Pedro Portugal, Jun-Zhe Chen, Joachim Wabnig, Christian Flindt

articles.title: On the Meaning of Localization in Non-Local Quantum Field Theory
articles.title_zh: 非局域量子场论中局域化的含义
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this paper we explore and derive an uncertainty principle for an ultraviolet complete nonlocal quantum field theory where under our hypothesises of an induced equal time detector response kernel, we then prove that the observed localization width obeys an exact variance addition law. Then when we combine this with the ordinary Heisenberg inequality and we obtain a nonlocal uncertainty relation. The bound reduces to the usual local relation in the infrared or local limit when E_M → infty, while in the ultraviolet it implies a minimal localization length of order L_M. We go on to explain what this means for locality, microcausality, the interpretation of spacetime points, and the ultraviolet structure of quantum field theory. In this formulation we note and prove that spacetime will remain a Lorentz covariant continuum at the level of the manifold description but pointlike localization ceases to be a physically realizable observable notion below the nonlocality scale.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文在紫外完备的非局域量子场论框架下推导一种不确定性原理。作者在等时探测器响应核的假设下证明观测到的局域化宽度满足精确的方差相加律，并将其与通常的 Heisenberg 不等式结合得到非局域不确定关系。该界限在红外或局域极限中退化为标准关系，而在紫外区预言量级为非局域尺度 L_M 的最小局域化长度；文章据此讨论局域性、微因果性、时空点的解释以及量子场论的紫外结构。

articles.title: Quantum-Conditioned Curvatures in Spacetime Surrounding Kerr-Newmann Black Hole
articles.title_zh: Kerr-Newman 黑洞周围时空中的量子条件曲率
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This research examines the possibility whether the curvatures found in conventional General Relativity (GR) are the only existing ones, using both analytical and numerical techniques. To this end, we introduce a thorough investigation of Riemann curvatures in the spacetime surrounding a Kerr-Newmann black hole, which is distinguished by its specific electric charges and rotational dynamics. We apply a geometric quantization ansatz that centers on the quantization of the metric tensor, from which the complete set of field equations can be derived. The conformal transformation of the standard metric tensor upholds all the principles of GR while also extending its applicability to lower (quantum) scales. We recognize two types of Riemann curvatures. In addition to the positive curvatures present in classical GR formulations, we also find significant negative curvatures at lower (quantum) scales. This may indicate quantum sources of gravitation that classical GR does not seem equipped to explore.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文考察传统广义相对论中的曲率是否穷尽了 Kerr-Newman 黑洞周围时空可能存在的曲率结构。作者采用以度规张量量子化为核心的几何量子化设想，并通过对标准度规作共形变换，在保持广义相对论基本原则的同时将其推广到较低的量子尺度。解析与数值结果显示，除经典广义相对论中的正 Riemann 曲率外，在量子尺度还可能出现显著负曲率，作者将其解释为经典理论难以描述的量子引力源迹象。
authors: A. Tawfik (Islamic U. Madinah,Ahram Canadian U.,Egyptian Ctr. Theor. Phys., Cairo,WLCAPP, Cairo), Saleh O. Allehabi (Islamic U. Madinah), M. Ur Rehman (Islamic U. Madinah), A. A. Alshehri (Hafr El Batin U.,Egyptian Ctr. Theor. Phys., Cairo)

articles.title: Direct imaging of enantiomer-specific orientation dynamics in unidirectionally rotating chiral molecules
articles.title_zh: 单向旋转手性分子中对映体特异取向动力学的直接成像
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27458v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Selectively controlling the dynamics of molecular enantiomers underlies advances across chemistry, biology, and physics, yet direct imaging of enantiomer-specific motion has so far remained elusive. Here, we image ultrafast enantioselective orientation dynamics in isolated chiral molecules. Unidirectional coherent rotation induced by a femtosecond laser-pulse pair generates equal and opposite out-of-plane orientations of the two enantiomers. Applying this scheme to 2-methyloxirane, we follow the rotational wave packets by time-resolved Coulomb explosion imaging with two orthogonally arranged detectors. The measured angular distributions reveal that the unidirectional rotation is identical for both enantiomers, while the out-of-plane orientations are mirror images that persist through both early-time quasi-classical and quantum dynamics regimes, in quantitative agreement with simulations. We demonstrate that full angular distributions provide richer dynamical information, with some qualitatively different distributions yielding similar orientation factors upon integration. Our approach opens a route to real-time observation and control of chiral dynamics in the gas phase.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究实现了孤立手性分子中超快对映选择性取向动力学的直接成像。作者用飞秒激光脉冲对诱导单向相干转动，使两种对映体产生大小相等、方向相反的面外取向，并在2-甲基环氧乙烷中通过时间分辨库仑爆炸成像跟踪转动波包。实验角分布显示两种对映体的单向转动相同，而面外取向互为镜像，并在准经典早期动力学和量子动力学阶段持续存在，且与模拟定量一致。
authors: Kenta Mizuse, Ilia Tutunnikov, Long Xu, Yuhei Oyagi, Naoya Sakamoto, Ryo Kondo, Allan Huang, Roman V. Krems, Ilya Sh. Averbukh, Yasuhiro Ohshima

articles.title: Universal framework for the design of near-zero refractive index photonic crystals
articles.title_zh: 近零折射率光子晶体设计的通用框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27470v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Near-zero-index (NZI) media are of great interest for controlling light-matter interactions, but homogeneous NZI materials in the telecom band remain limited and often suffer from significant losses. Photonic crystals provide an attractive alternative due to their tunability and use of low-loss constituent materials. This work presents a predictive framework for designing epsilon-near-zero (ENZ), mu-near-zero (MNZ), and epsilon-and-mu-near-zero (EMNZ) photonic crystals. We demonstrate an equivalence between Dirac cones and EMNZ behavior, showing that a Dirac cone at the Gamma point is both necessary and sufficient to obtain an effective EMNZ response under normal incidence. This result implies that the presence of a Dirac cone fully determines the NZI response of a photonic crystal, independent of the material composition. The prediction is based on mode symmetry universality and effective medium theory. The approach enables switching between ENZ-MNZ and EMNZ regimes through geometric tuning of the unit cell. It is validated on triangular and rectangular lattices. Overall, this work provides a predictive design strategy for NZI photonic crystals, replacing trial-and-error optimization. It may also impact metamaterials in the telecom regime and applications in quantum communication.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了用于设计近零折射率光子晶体的预测框架，覆盖epsilon近零、mu近零以及epsilon与mu同时近零响应。作者证明Gamma点狄拉克锥与法向入射下的有效EMNZ行为等价，即狄拉克锥是获得EMNZ响应的必要且充分条件，且这一结论不依赖材料组成。该框架基于模式对称性的普适性和有效介质理论，可通过单胞几何调控在ENZ-MNZ与EMNZ状态之间切换，并在三角和矩形晶格中得到验证。

articles.title: Non-dipole effects in two-photon double ionization of the K-shell of a beryllium-like atomic ion
articles.title_zh: 铍样原子离子K壳层双光子双电离中的非偶极效应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the second order of the non-relativistic quantum perturbation theory and outside the framework of the dipole approximation for the operator of the radiation transition between continuum-spectrum states, the analytical structures and absolute values of the generalized cross-sections of the two-photon double ionization of the K-shell of beryllium-like ions of titanium (Ti18+), iron (Fe22+) and zinc (Zn26+) atoms were predicted. It has been established that taking into account non-dipole effects by several orders of magnitude (giant non-dipole effect) reduces the generalized cross-sections calculated within the framework of the dipole approximation. It has also been established that at high (12.5 - 28 keV) energies of the absorbed photons, the generalized cross-section of the two-photon double ionization of the K-shell is several orders of magnitude greater than the generalized cross-section of the single ionization. At the same time, as was to be expected, the transition from a neon-like ion to a beryllium-like ion is accompanied by a significant increase in the role of non-dipole effects.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在非相对论二阶量子微扰理论框架下，超越偶极近似，预测了铍样Ti18+、Fe22+和Zn26+离子K壳层双光子双电离广义截面的解析结构和绝对数值。结果表明，计入非偶极效应会使偶极近似得到的广义截面降低数个数量级，呈现巨大的非偶极修正。在12.5–28 keV高光子能区，K壳层双光子双电离广义截面仍可比单电离广义截面大数个数量级；从氖样离子转向铍样离子时，非偶极效应的重要性显著增强。
authors: Alexey N. Hopersky, Alexey M. Nadolinsky, Rustam V. Koneev, Julia N. Kolesnikova

articles.title: Quantitative interpretation of Brookfield DV3TLV measurements: shear rate conversion, correction factors, and applicability limits
articles.title_zh: Brookfield DV3TLV测量的定量解释：剪切速率换算、修正因子与适用范围
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27524v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The flow behavior and hydrodynamic characteristics of fluids in rotational viscometry systems are investigated using the Brookfield DV3TLV viscometer, with emphasis on measurement reliability and applicability limits of different measuring geometries. The results are compared and validated using the high-precision MCR 302 rheometer manufactured by the Austrian company Anton Paar. Both Newtonian (water and glycerol) and non-Newtonian fluids (guar-based gels), exhibiting fundamentally different viscosity-shear rate behavior, were included in the study. Based on the comparison of measurements obtained with the Brookfield DV3TLV viscometer and the MCR 302 rheometer, empirical coefficients were determined that relate the spindle rotational speed to the shear rate, taking into account the geometry of the measuring systems. Analysis of the Reynolds number range showed that laminar flow conditions were maintained for all measurement systems, which justifies the application of quasi-static models that neglect possible flow turbulence within them. Comparison with high-precision measurements performed on the MCR 302 rheometer showed that, with appropriate interpretation, the data obtained using the Brookfield instrument can be used to estimate the real viscosity of process fluids with an accuracy specific to each geometry and its operating conditions. The proposed methodology enables reliable characterization of flow properties in rotational systems and can be applied in engineering practice and laboratory analysis of complex fluids, especially at oil and food production facilities where high-end rheometers are unavailable or impractical to use. The study is formulated within the framework of experimental fluid mechanics and non-Newtonian flow characterization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察Brookfield DV3TLV旋转黏度计中不同测量几何的流动行为、流体动力学特征和可靠性，并以Anton Paar MCR 302高精度流变仪结果进行验证。作者测试了水、甘油等牛顿流体以及瓜尔胶凝胶等非牛顿流体，建立了转子转速与剪切速率之间的经验换算系数，并考虑测量系统几何影响。雷诺数分析表明各系统均保持层流，因此可使用忽略湍流的准静态模型；与高精度流变测量的比较用于界定该仪器在不同体系中的定量适用范围。
authors: A. E. Vasiliev, A. S. Besov, D. O. Andreev

articles.title: Quantum frequency comb with pump-selectable bin pairing and extraction-aware loading in a lithium niobate microresonator
articles.title_zh: 铌酸锂微谐振器中具有泵浦可选频-bin配对和抽取感知加载的量子频率梳
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27911v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Integrated quantum photonics requires bright, high-fidelity photon-pair sources capable of spectral multiplexing, correlation control, and circuit-compatible extraction. Cavity-enhanced spontaneous parametric down-conversion (SPDC) enhances pair generation, but triply resonant operation imposes stringent pump-signal-idler spectral-alignment constraints. Moreover, the trade-off between intrinsic generation and coincidence-to-accidental ratio (CAR) does not capture the usable output flux, which depends on photon extraction. Here, we demonstrate a single-pass-pumped, resonator-enhanced quantum frequency comb (QFC) source based on a periodically poled lithium niobate photonic-crystal Fabry-Pérot microresonator. The device yields intrinsic and loaded brightnesses of 69.9 and 1.88 MHz/μW, respectively, and a maximum CAR of 16,000. Frequency-resolved measurements reveal 461 cavity-defined bins spanning 1495-1570 nm, and loaded spectral brightness approaching 4.29×10{}⁹ pairs/(sḑotmWḑotnm). In particular, tuning the single-pass pump deterministically selects correlated frequency-bin pairings within the fixed QFC grid while preserving brightness and pairwise coincidence rates. We further separate intrinsic generation from output photon-pair flux, revealing the loaded-brightness-CAR relation. Together, pump-selectable bin pairing and extraction-aware loading point to tailored SPDC QFCs as chip-integrated nonclassical light resources for multiphoton-interference quantum simulation and programmable frequency-bin quantum information processing.

articles.title: Quantum Dynamic Time Warping for Multivariate Time Series Classification
articles.title_zh: 用于多变量时间序列分类的量子动态时间规整
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.27815v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) is a cornerstone for time series classification, but its reliance on Euclidean distances fails to capture latent cross-channel correlations in complex multivariate data. We propose a hybrid Quantum Dynamic Time Warping (qDTW) architecture, replacing the classical distance metric with the parameterized geometry of a quantum Hilbert space. Through structural ablation on benchmarks up to C=8 spatial dimensions, we establish fundamental topological rules for quantum sequence alignment. We introduce a Unified Pre-Embedding Adjoint Ansatz that decouples trainable entanglement from classical data, eliminating the severe phase-scrambling and information bottlenecks inherent to traditional measurements. We demonstrate this decoupled architecture allows untrained quantum kernels to act as highly expressive baselines, while parameterized training effectively untangles deeply overlapping hyper-dimensional data. Furthermore, we identify a strict spatial-temporal expressivity tradeoff: temporal depth (data re-uploading) is necessary for dimensionally restricted univariate circuits, but applying it to wide multi-qubit registers triggers chaotic frequency-spectrum explosions and representation collapse. By navigating these topological hazards, our multivariate quantum architecture outperforms classical baselines, setting a new standard for integrating parameterized quantum circuits with dynamic programming

articles.title: Polaron transformed canonically consistent quantum master equation
articles.title_zh: 极化子变换的正则一致量子主方程
articles.abstract: A central challenge in the theory of open quantum systems is the development of theoretical frameworks capable of accurately describing large, strongly interacting quantum many-body systems in the regime of strong system–bath interaction. In this work, we take a step toward this goal by formulating a polaron-transformed version of the canonically consistent quantum master equation (CCQME) [T. Becker et al. , Phys. Rev. Lett. 129 , 200403 (2022)]. The CCQME extends beyond standard weak-coupling approaches while retaining the same numerical complexity as conventional quantum master equations, thereby enabling the treatment of large quantum systems. The polaron transformation further enhances the accessible system–bath interaction strengths, allowing us to move from moderate to ultra-strong interaction regimes. We present a unified and transparent derivation of these two approaches and combine them to obtain the polaron-transformed CCQME. Applying our method to the paradigmatic spin–boson model, we find excellent agreement with numerically exact time-evolving matrix product operator simulations. Finally, we predict an initial-state-independent slowing down of thermalization in the strong-coupling regime of the spin-boson model.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出了极化子变换版本的正则一致量子主方程，用于处理强系统-浴耦合下的大规模开放量子多体系统。正则一致量子主方程在保持常规主方程数值复杂度的同时超越标准弱耦合近似，而极化子变换进一步将适用范围推进到超强相互作用区。作者在自旋-玻色子模型中验证该方法，与数值精确的时间演化矩阵乘积算符模拟符合良好，并预测强耦合下热化过程会出现与初态无关的减慢。

articles.title: fishROI: A specialized workflow for semi-automated muscle morphometry analysis in teleosts
articles.title_zh: fishROI：用于硬骨鱼半自动肌肉形态计量分析的专用工作流
articles.abstract: Background Quantitative histological analysis of skeletal muscle morphometry provides critical insights into muscle physiology but remains labor-intensive and technically demanding. While recent developments in machine learning-based image segmentation techniques have facilitated large-scale tissue analysis, existing tools that automate muscle morphometry analysis are largely tailored to mammalian models, with limited applicability to teleosts. Moreover, there is a lack of effective tools for visualizing spatial organization and morphometric variability of teleost muscle fibers, a feature that is important for understanding hyperplastic muscle growth dynamics in teleosts.Methods In this study, we benchmarked the performance of existing muscle morphometry analysis workflows and general-purpose cell segmentation algorithms in identifying individual muscle fibers in teleost muscles. We used these findings to inform the development of a new, teleost-optimized analysis tool.Results We show that cytoplasmic staining combined with machine learning-based cell segmentation offers a robust and accurate approach for automated muscle morphometry analysis in developing zebrafish. We also introduce fishROI – a FIJI2 plugin implemented in Jython, that streamlines both morphometric analysis and visualization. This tool accommodates shallow and deep learning–based segmentation techniques and incorporates novel quantification and visualization methods suited to teleost-specific muscle features, including mosaic hyperplasia dynamics. The plugin features an intuitive graphical user interface and is designed for flexibility, with minimal constraints regarding species, image quality, or staining protocol. Its modular architecture allows it to be used as a baseline for automated muscle morphometry analysis, while permitting integration with other tools and workflows to permit a diverse range of analytical needs.Conclusion This plugin will serve as a foundational platform for semi-automated muscle morphometry analysis in teleosts, enabling a combination of reliable image segmentation, quantification and visualization optimized for teleost muscles.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对硬骨鱼骨骼肌组织形态计量分析缺乏合适自动化工具的问题，评估现有肌肉分析流程和通用细胞分割算法在识别硬骨鱼肌纤维方面的表现。结果表明，细胞质染色结合基于机器学习的细胞分割，可在发育期斑马鱼中实现较稳健、准确的自动化肌肉形态分析。作者据此开发了面向硬骨鱼优化的fishROI工作流，并强调其可用于可视化肌纤维空间组织和形态变异，从而支持对硬骨鱼增生性肌肉生长动力学的研究。

articles.title: FusionAttNet Framework for Hierarchical Attention Driven Sentinel 1 and Sentinel 2 Fusion for Semi Arid Land Cover Classification in Far North Cameroon
articles.title_zh: FusionAttNet：面向喀麦隆极北半干旱土地覆盖分类的Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2层级注意力融合框架
articles.abstract: Accurate land cover mapping in semi-arid regions remains challenging due to spectral homogeneity of sparse vegetation, seasonal variability, and persistent cloud cover. In this study, we propose a FusionAttNet, a novel deep learning framework integrating Sentinel-1 SAR and Sentinel-2 optical data through modality-aware hierarchical attention for land cover classification case study of Far North Cameroon. Our approach employs parallel sensor-specific processing streams (generating cross-modal indices like NDVI/VV ratios) and a three-tiered attention mechanism (pixel-patch-landscape) to resolve spatial ambiguities in semi-arid landscapes. Enhanced by modality-aware augmentation and focal loss with label smoothing, FusionAttNet achieved 96.75% overall accuracy and 0.9680 F1-score on a multi-seasonal dataset over a 12-month temporal window spanning the year 2021, outperforming feature-stacking (85.1%) and early fusion (87.6%) baselines. Key innovations include: (1) landscape-level attention capturing phenological transitions in Sahelian ecotones, (2) cross-modal indices mitigating cloud-induced optical data gaps, and (3) SAR-optimized augmentation preserving backscatter textures. Results demonstrate a 14.7% reduction in misclassification of mixed bare soil/grassland interfaces compared to state-of-the-art methods, establishing a new paradigm for semi-arid land cover monitoring.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出FusionAttNet，将Sentinel-1 SAR与Sentinel-2光学数据通过模态感知的层级注意力机制融合，用于半干旱区土地覆盖分类。模型采用传感器专用并行分支、NDVI/VV等跨模态指数，以及像素—斑块—景观三级注意力，以缓解稀疏植被光谱相似、季节变化和云覆盖造成的分类困难。在2021年12个月多季节数据集上，FusionAttNet取得96.75%的总体精度和0.9680的F1分数，优于特征堆叠和早期融合基线。

articles.title: Flexible hydrogel fiber-coupled SERS sensor for remote in situ food inspection
articles.title_zh: 用于远程原位食品检测的柔性水凝胶光纤耦合 SERS 传感器
articles.abstract: Optical fiber-based surface-enhanced Raman scattering (SERS) sensors offer efficient signal transmission and stable Raman enhancement, showing great potential for food safety. However, the rigidity of conventional silica fibers limits direct in situ detection on curved food surfaces, making it challenging to integrate remote signal readout and conformal sampling into a single SERS sensor. This study presents a flexible hydrogel fiber-coupled optical fiber SERS sensor. A sodium alginate-based hydrogel fiber was formed at the optical fiber tip through in situ crosslinking with calcium ions, enabling conformal contact with irregular surfaces while maintaining efficient optical transmission. The porous hydrogel structure promoted dense loading of silver nanoparticles and analyte enrichment, thereby enhancing Raman signals. The fabricated 1 cm hydrogel fiber showed excellent detection performance, with an enhancement factor of 2.65 × 109 and a limit of detection of 8.63 × 10− 12 M. It also exhibited good reproducibility and stability, showing a relative standard deviation of 5.41% and retaining 88.27% signal intensity after 40 days. Using thiram as a model pesticide, remote in situ detection of pesticide residues on apple surfaces was achieved with a detection limit of 1.6×10− 3 mg/L. In addition, a one-dimensional convolutional neural network was further employed for the intelligent identification of thiram concentrations, achieving an accuracy of 98.04%. This work provides a new strategy for developing flexible, remotely readable, and conformal sampling SERS sensors, thereby improving the efficiency of food safety inspection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出一种柔性水凝胶光纤耦合 SERS 传感器，用海藻酸钠水凝胶在光纤端部原位钙离子交联成纤，使传感端可贴合弯曲和不规则食品表面，同时保持远程光信号传输。多孔水凝胶有利于银纳米颗粒高密度负载和分析物富集，1 cm 水凝胶纤维的增强因子达 2.65×10⁹，检出限为 8.63×10⁻¹² M。器件具有较好重复性和稳定性，相对标准偏差为 5.41%，40 天后仍保持 88.27% 信号强度，并以福美双农药作为模型验证了远程原位检测能力。

articles.title: Quantum-Accelerated Nonlinear Seismic Simulation for Megathrust-Prone Urban Environments: A Three-Order-of-Magnitude Speedup via HHL-Embedded Newton–Raphson Integration
articles.title_zh: 面向俯冲带大地震风险城市环境的量子加速非线性地震模拟：嵌入 HHL 的 Newton–Raphson 积分实现三数量级提速
articles.abstract: Background: Nonlinear Time-History Analysis (NLTHA) is the most rigorous procedure for evaluating seismic structural performance, yet its O(N³) computational complexity confines its use to single-building studies, precluding real-time city-scale risk assessment in regions of high seismic hazard. Objective: This study formulates a quantum-enhanced Newton–Raphson (QNR) integration framework that embeds the Harrow–Hassidim–Lloyd (HHL) quantum linear solver within the classical Hilber–Hughes–Taylor (HHT-α) time-stepping scheme, targeting a three-order-of-magnitude reduction in wall-clock computation time. Methods: The effective tangent stiffness matrix KT ∈ ℝN×N is decomposed into Pauli operator products and mapped to a quantum Hamiltonian Ĥ. At each Newton–Raphson iteration, the residual force vector is encoded as quantum state |b⟩; the HHL algorithm returns |x⟩ ∝ KT⁻¹|b⟩, reducing per-step complexity from O(N³) to O(s²κ² log N). Accuracy is measured by MSE against a full-precision classical reference. A 1,000-run Monte Carlo study on a 64-DOF nonlinear shear-building model provides statistical confidence bounds. Results: The QNR framework achieves mean speedup μ = 1,002.5× (95% CI: [980.2, 1,024.8]; t = 2,814.5; p < 0.0001) with MSE = 1.2×10⁻⁴. Free Body Diagrams formalise physical mappings. The comparison matrix documents exponential space-complexity reduction from O(N²) to O(log N). Conclusion: The framework transitions NLTHA from a single-building tool to a viable real-time city-scale seismic risk platform. Applied to Lima, Peru—a megalopolis on soft-soil basins within the Nazca–South American subduction system—it enables simultaneous nonlinear evaluation of thousands of structures, supporting NTE E.030 compliance and CENEPRED disaster-risk mandates
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出量子增强 Newton–Raphson 积分框架，将 HHL 量子线性求解器嵌入经典 HHT-α 时程积分，用于降低非线性时程分析在城市尺度地震风险评估中的计算成本。方法将有效切线刚度矩阵分解为 Pauli 算符并映射为量子哈密顿量，在每次迭代中求解残差方程，理论复杂度由 O(N³⁾ 降至 O(s²κ² log N)。在 64 自由度非线性剪切建筑模型的 1000 次 Monte Carlo 测试中，作者报告平均约 1000 倍的计算加速，并以相对于高精度经典解的均方误差评估精度。

articles.title: Probabilistic Liquefaction Hazard Assessment in Highly Stratified Alluvial Deposits Integrating Continuous In-Situ Profiling and Depth-Dependent Seismic Demand
articles.title_zh: 结合连续原位剖面与深度相关地震需求的强分层冲积沉积物概率液化危险性评价
articles.abstract: This study evaluates the liquefaction potential of Holocene deposits at two sites in Kolkata: Jessore Road (22° 36' 35.87" N, 88° 24' 14.55" E) and Lake-town (22° 36' 10.53" N, 88° 23' 52.89" E). Because the broader study area sits on the seismotectonic boundary between Seismic Zone III and Zone IV according to the active IS 1893 (Part 1): 2016 hazard map, the analysis considers peak ground accelerations (PGA) of 0.16g and 0.24g. These values correspond directly to the Maximum Considered Earthquake (MCE) design zone factors for both respective zones under an Mw 7.0 scenario. Field investigations included Standard Penetration Testing (SPT), Cone Penetration Testing (CPT), Flat Dilatometer Testing (DMT), and Seismic Dilatometer Testing (SDMT). Initial empirical estimates using a constant surface PGA and standard shear stress reduction factors (rd) suggested a relatively low hazard, with the Probability of Liquefaction (PL) generally below 15%. To better account for kinematic wave propagation and local stratigraphy, one-dimensional total-stress nonlinear ground response analyses (NGRA) were performed in DEEPSOIL v7.1.9. When the conventional rd parameters were replaced with NGRA-derived, depth-dependent horizontal accelerations (amax/g), the computed seismic demand increased significantly. This depth-dependent approach identified severe vulnerability in loose granular layers, raising the PL above 85% for the 0.24g scenario. Additionally, continuous profiling from CPT and DMT proved more effective than SPT for detecting thin liquefiable lenses and evaluating cyclic mobility in fine-grained cap soils. The findings demonstrate that relying on uniform PGA assumptions can be highly unconservative in stratified alluvial basins, highlighting the need for site-specific ground response analysis and continuous in-situ testing in regional hazard assessments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估加尔各答 Jessore Road 与 Lake-town 两处全新世沉积场地的液化潜势，考虑印度规范中 III 区和 IV 区对应的 0.16g 与 0.24g 峰值地表加速度。现场测试包括 SPT、CPT、DMT 和 SDMT；采用恒定地表 PGA 与常规剪应力折减系数的初步经验法显示液化概率通常低于 15%。为纳入波传播与局部地层效应，作者进一步在 DEEPSOIL 中进行一维总应力非线性场地反应分析，并用由该分析得到的深度相关需求替代传统 rd 参数，从而得到更符合强分层场地条件的概率液化评价。

articles.title: By-Layer Covalent Organic Structure as a Metal-Free PCET Catalyst for Efficient Oxygen Evolution in Alkaline and Neutral Media
articles.title_zh: 作为无金属 PCET 催化剂的双层共价有机结构用于碱性和中性介质中的高效析氧反应
articles.abstract: The delayed evolution of proton transfer (PT) as the sluggish component of proton-coupled electron transfer (PCET) represents a critical limitation in the design of biomimetic artificial leaves. Here, we report a simple metal-free PCET catalyst for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) operating in both neutral and alkaline media, realized through successive evolutionary stages of a bilayer covalent superstructure. Graphite/graphene oxide hosts a repetitive porphyrin-based covalent organic structure (COS) assembled via bidentate ethylenediamine (EDA) linkages, functioning as a PCET catalyst in both alkaline and neutral environments. The experimentally detected unusual Gerischer impedance signature demonstrates the overwhelming dominance of interfacial proton exchange over natural diffusion, revealing a distinct chemical electrochemical chemical reaction pathway in OER. The H/D isotope and proton inventory studies provide direct and compelling mechanistic insight. The results show a secondary isotope effect, confirming that O–H bond cleavage is not involved in the rate-determining step of the water oxidation reaction. For the first time, this study elucidates how a robust interfacial covalent organic structure (COS), acting as an in situ heterogeneous stimulus, actively reorganizes the hydrogen-bonding network of water. Reflective infrared spectroscopy unequivocally reveals the role of COS in disrupting and agitating interfacial hydrogen-bonded water clusters, liberating free water molecules and thereby promoting adsorption events during OER.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作报道一种无金属质子耦合电子转移（PCET）析氧催化剂：在石墨/氧化石墨烯上构筑由乙二胺连接的卟啉基双层共价有机超结构，可在碱性和中性介质中工作。异常的 Gerischer 阻抗特征表明界面质子交换相对于自然扩散占主导，指向独特的化学–电化学–化学反应路径。H/D 同位素和质子库存实验显示二级同位素效应，说明水氧化反应速控步骤并不涉及 O–H 键断裂，并强调稳健界面质子传递网络对 PCET 催化的重要性。

articles.title: Functionally graded auxetic sub-surfaces for misalignment-tolerant polymer plain bearings
articles.title_zh: 用于耐失准聚合物滑动轴承的功能梯度负泊松比亚表层结构
articles.abstract: Rigid polymer plain bearings (machined HDPE or UHMWPE) are widely used in slow, heavily loaded, dust-exposed pivots such as solar-tracker torque tubes, where their dominant failure is edge loading: when the shaft misaligns, a rigid bore cannot conform, the contact patch collapses onto one axial edge, and the local pressure spikes far above nominal, driving localized wear. We propose a single-piece bearing that keeps the sliding surface smooth but replaces the solid sub-surface with a functionally graded re-entrant (auxetic) lattice, engineered so the bore deforms elastically to follow a misaligned shaft. The concept is evaluated with a reproducible simulation pipeline: numerical homogenization of the lattice, a two-dimensional plane-stress contact model, pressure-dependent Archard wear, viscoelastic creep over a 25-year horizon, and NSGA-II multi-objective optimization with Sobol sensitivity analysis. An optimized graded design reduces the peak contact pressure at misalignment by ( to MPa) and raises retained contact area from to ; the solid baseline reaches wear-skin breakthrough within 250 oscillation cycles whereas the graded design does not. A matched-stiffness experiment isolates a peak-pressure benefit from negative-Poisson in-drawing, and global sensitivity shows that graded radial compliance, set by lattice density, is the dominant lever. A three-dimensional finite-element model, validated against the Lamé thick-cylinder solution, confirms the mechanism ( reduction) and shows the plane-stress model to be conservative. Graded compliance does most of the work, with the auxetic grading a secondary gain that matters when stiffness must be held against creep.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对 HDPE 或 UHMWPE 聚合物滑动轴承在轴失准时易发生边缘载荷和局部磨损的问题，提出一种滑动表面保持光滑、亚表层采用功能梯度内凹负泊松比晶格的单体轴承。作者建立了可复现的仿真流程，包括晶格均匀化、二维平面应力接触模型、压力相关 Archard 磨损、25 年黏弹性蠕变预测以及 NSGA-II 多目标优化和 Sobol 灵敏度分析。优化梯度设计可使孔表面弹性贴合失准轴，降低峰值接触压力、增加保留接触面积，并相较实体基准显著延缓磨损层贯穿。

articles.title: Defect-induced electrostatic anchoring for extreme-temperature power device encapsulation
articles.title_zh: 缺陷诱导静电锚定用于极端温度功率器件封装
articles.abstract: The transition to wide-bandgap semiconductors requires power electronics to operate reliably at extreme temperatures exceeding 250 °C. Silicone gels are essential for power-device packaging, yet they undergo accelerated dielectric degradation under such severe thermal conditions. Traditional chemical modification methods fail to withstand such extreme temperatures, inevitably compromising long-term reliability. Here, we report a modifier-free 0D/2D hybrid filler architecture within silicone gel constructed via a defect-induced electrostatic anchoring strategy. By exploiting oxygen vacancies on CeO2 nanoparticles to electrostatically capture electron-rich BN nanosheets, we establish a robust functional network devoid of thermally unstable chemicals. This hybrid architecture creates an extensive deep-trap network that immobilizes high-energy carriers, while the 2D BN nanosheets provide a tortuous physical barrier against electrical treeing. The resulting composite achieves a characteristic breakdown strength of 19.52 kV/mm at 250 °C, approximately three times that of pure gels, while preserving the ultra-low modulus necessary to protect fragile wire bonds. Ultimately, we demonstrate the first purely physical filler-gel interfacial engineering in silicone gel packaging. This defect-driven approach bypasses the thermal instability of conventional organic interfacial modifiers, ensuring robust insulation at extreme temperatures of 250 °C and offering a design strategy for soft encapsulants in extreme-environment power devices.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对宽禁带半导体功率器件在250 °C以上工作时硅凝胶封装材料介电退化的问题，提出无需有机改性剂的0D/2D杂化填料结构。利用CeO2纳米颗粒氧空位静电捕获富电子BN纳米片，构建深陷阱网络以束缚高能载流子，同时BN片层提供抑制电树枝的曲折屏障。复合硅凝胶在250 °C下特征击穿强度达19.52 kV/mm，约为纯凝胶的三倍，并保持保护引线键合所需的超低模量。

articles.title: Improvement in the bandgap and photoluminescence behavior by Holmium (Ho) and Iron (Fe) co-doping in LaNiO 3, synthesized using sol-gel route for novel sustainable energy applications
articles.title_zh: 溶胶-凝胶法制备Ho/Fe共掺杂LaNiO3及其带隙和光致发光行为改善
articles.abstract: The effect of incorporating holmium and iron into LaNiO3 (LNO) perovskites with compositions, LaNi0.95Fe0.05O3 (LFNO), and La0.95Ho0.05Ni0.95Fe0.05O3 (LHFNO), synthesized via the sol-gel method are examined. Structural and morphological properties are characterized by x-ray diffraction (XRD) and Field Emission Scanning Electron Microscopy (FESEM) show a progressive distorted rhombohedral phase formation for prepared samples with particle sizes ranging from 9 to 15 nm. Fourier Transform Infra-Red (FTIR) spectroscopy, UV-Vis DRS, Photoluminescence (PL) and XPS for its structural, morphological and spectroscopic modifications owing to doping. Structural studies confirm the formation of distorted rhombohedral phases with particle sizes ranging from 9 to 15 nm, increasing with doping and then co-doping. Surface morphology studies reveal agglomerated particles, while the elemental composition obtained from Energy dispersive x-ray spectroscopy (EDX). The elemental composition and the molecular bonding characteristics particularly metal-oxygen bonds of the octahedra are analyzed using EDX and FTIR spectroscopy. The optical band gap measured to be between 2.4eV and 3.3eV from UV-DRS measurements, decreasing with doping and further by co-doping. PL spectroscopy demonostrates the recombination kinetics of photogenerated electron-hole pairs significantly with dopants inclusion. Furthermore, XPS analysis clarifies the electronic energy levels and vacancies through valence states of La and Ni ions in both pure and doped samples. The results indicate an overlap between the La 3d and Ni 2p core level spectra due to spin-orbit coupling. Overall, Ho-Fe co-doping tailors the electronic and optical properties leading to an enhaced performance characteristics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了Fe掺杂和Ho/Fe共掺杂对LaNiO3钙钛矿结构、形貌和光学性质的影响，样品包括LaNi0.95Fe0.05O3和La0.95Ho0.05Ni0.95Fe0.05O3。XRD和FESEM表明样品形成畸变菱方相，粒径约9–15 nm，并随掺杂/共掺杂发生变化；EDX、FTIR、UV-Vis DRS、PL和XPS用于分析元素组成、金属-氧键及光谱性质。UV-DRS测得光学带隙约2.4–3.3 eV，表明掺杂可调控其光学响应，具有可持续能源相关应用潜力。

articles.title: Quantifying the Security-Performance Trade-off in Constrained IoT: A Multi-Vector MQTT Attack Framework with Hybrid Defense-in-Depth Evaluation
articles.title_zh: 受限物联网中的安全—性能权衡量化：多向量MQTT攻击框架与混合纵深防御评估
articles.abstract: The Message Queuing Telemetry Transport (MQTT) protocol is the de facto standard for machine-to-machine (M2M) communication in Internet of Things (IoT) deployments. However, existing security research treats protocol-level vulnerabilities and physical-layer attack vectors as isolated domains, leaving a critical and unexplored intersection: the chained, multi-vector threat in which a physical Human Interface Device (HID) intrusion serves as the initial foothold for a subsequent MQTT network compromise. This paper presents a reproducible experimental framework that designs, executes, and defends against exactly this attack chain using three low-cost hardware components: a Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040), ESP8266 NodeMCU, and Arduino UNO (ATmega328P) as a representative legacy device. Three mitigation strategies: Simple Authentication, Access Control Lists (ACLs), and Transport Layer Security v1.2 (TLS) are systematically evaluated. Results reveal that while TLS eliminates confidentiality threats, it imposes a 1,133% connection latency overhead on 32-bit devices and causes catastrophic memory exhaustion on 8-bit microcontrollers. ACLs achieve zero unauthorized injections with negligible latency impact. These findings motivate a novel Hybrid Defense-in-Depth Architecture, a Hierarchical CIA model, and a Delegated Trust Model with a Secure Edge Gateway providing empirical guidance for industrial IoT security architects and educators.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对MQTT在物联网机器通信中的安全问题，提出一个可复现实验框架，将物理HID入侵作为初始立足点，并进一步触发MQTT网络层攻击，从而研究链式多向量威胁。作者使用Raspberry Pi Pico、ESP8266 NodeMCU和Arduino UNO等低成本硬件，系统评估简单认证、访问控制列表和TLS 1.2三类防御。结果显示，TLS可消除机密性威胁，但在32位设备上引入显著连接延迟，并导致8位微控制器内存耗尽；ACL在低开销下阻止未授权注入，凸显受限设备中安全性与性能的强权衡。

articles.title: Secure and Intelligent IoT: A Dynamical-Systems View of Threat Modelling and Machine-Learning Defence
articles.title_zh: 安全且智能的物联网：威胁建模与机器学习防御的动力系统视角
articles.abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) couples billions of resource-constrained devices into networkswhose behaviour evolves continuously in time. Security incidents on such networks — wormand botnet propagation, traffic-anomaly bursts, energy-depletion attacks — are, at bottom,dynamical phenomena: they are generated by rates, flows, and feedback. This paper arguesthat differential equations and machine learning are not two competing toolboxes for IoTsecurity but two representations of one object: the time-evolution of a system state x(t). Adifferential equation ̇x = f(x,θ) encodes mechanism with few interpretable parameters; aneural network trained on telemetry approximates the same vector field f from data. Modernconstructs — Neural Ordinary Differential Equations, Physics-Informed Neural Networks,and sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics — make this equivalence operational. Wedevelop a unified state-space framework for “secure and intelligent” IoT in which (i) com-partmental differential equations model threat propagation and yield closed-form stabilityand reproduction-number results, (ii) machine learning identifies parameters, detects anoma-lies as residuals against the learned flow, and forecasts outbreaks, and (iii) optimal controlcloses the loop by scheduling patching and isolation. A normalised SEIRS malware modelis analysed and simulated as a running case study, giving a basic reproduction numberR0≈3.37 and an infection peak of roughly 29% of the fleet. We close with open problemsin identifiability, adversarial robustness, and edge deployment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文主张将物联网安全事件视为随时间演化的动力学现象，例如蠕虫和僵尸网络传播、流量异常爆发以及能量耗尽攻击。作者认为微分方程与机器学习并非相互竞争的工具，而是对系统状态演化向量场的两种表征：前者以少量可解释参数刻画机制，后者从遥测数据中近似该动力学。论文提出统一的状态空间框架，用隔室模型分析威胁传播和稳定性，并结合神经ODE、物理信息神经网络和稀疏动力学识别等方法进行参数识别与异常检测。

articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 26 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74798-z Quantum phase interference in molecular magnets could provide a route to topological control of spin dynamics but has remained inaccessible in lanthanide systems. Here, the authors report its observation in a 4f single-ion molecular magnet using magneto-spectroscopy, resolving tunnelling splittings and revealing topological quenching.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在 4f 镧系单离子分子磁体中观测到量子相位干涉，为通过拓扑效应调控自旋动力学提供实验依据。作者利用磁谱学分辨隧穿能级劈裂，并揭示了量子隧穿的拓扑淬灭现象。

articles.title: Ultra-fast light-shaping technology could be 'game-changer' for future imaging
articles.title_zh: 超快光场整形技术有望成为未来成像的“游戏规则改变者”
articles.abstract: Scientists have developed a new type of "virtual" metasurface—capable of controlling light in ways traditional lenses and optics can't—which they say is superior to the current approach, which relies on ultrathin engineered materials. The Nottingham Trent University team says the work will help fully optimize metasurface potential for a range of real-world applications and paves the way for a move from physical to virtual platforms in nanotechnology.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了一种“虚拟”超表面技术，可实现传统透镜和常规光学元件难以完成的光场控制。与依赖超薄人工结构材料的物理超表面相比，该方案强调从实体平台转向虚拟平台，可能推动纳米技术和成像应用中超表面能力的进一步优化。

articles.title: Seven exotic quantum phases predicted in ultracold magnetic atoms, including topological superconductivity
articles.title_zh: 超冷磁性原子中预测出七种奇异量子相，包括拓扑超导相
articles.abstract: Strongly interacting quantum particles are key to some of the most fascinating phenomena in modern physics—from magnetism and superconductivity to topological states.
