Conventional high-fidelity numerical models require a high resolution to obtain reliable results, resulting in huge computational expense. This restricts the applicability of these models for multi-query problems, such as uncertainty quantification and optimisation, which require running numerous scenarios. As a cheaper alternative to high-fidelity models, this work develops eight surrogate models for predicting the fluid flow in porous media. Four of these are reduced-order models (ROM) based on one neural network for compression and another for prediction. The other four are single neural networks with the property of grid-size invariance; a term which we use to refer to image-to-image models that are capable of inferring on computational domains that are larger than those used during training. In addition to the novel grid-size-invariant framework for surrogate models, we compare the predictive performance of UNet and UNet++ architectures, and demonstrate that UNet++ outperforms UNet for surrogate models. Furthermore, we show that the grid-size-invariant approach is a reliable way to reduce memory consumption during training, resulting in good correlation between predicted and ground-truth values and outperforming the ROMs analysed. The application analysed is particularly challenging because fluid-induced rock dissolution results in a non-static solid field and, consequently, it cannot be used to help in adjustments of the future prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向岩石—流体相互作用建模中偏微分方程高保真求解代价高的问题，开发用于预测多孔介质流动的八种替代模型，以服务不确定性量化和优化等多查询任务。其中四种为由压缩网络和预测网络组成的降阶模型，另外四种为具有“网格尺寸不变性”的单网络图像到图像模型，可在比训练域更大的计算域上推断。作者还比较了UNet与UNet++等架构的预测性能，重点评估替代模型在跨网格尺寸应用中的泛化能力。
authors: Nathalie C. Pinheiro, Donghu Guo, Hannah P. Menke, Aniket C. Joshi, Claire E. Heaney, Ahmed H. ElSheikh, Christopher C. Pain

articles.title: Formation of Suprathermal Electron Populations in the Expanding, Turbulent Solar Wind
articles.title_zh: 膨胀湍流太阳风中超热电子群体的形成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.01895v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Nonthermal features are ubiquitously observed in electron velocity distribution functions in the solar wind, yet their origin in the collisionless, turbulent, expanding solar-wind plasma remains unclear. We investigate how solar-wind expansion and Alfvénic turbulence jointly generate and regulate these features using the first fully kinetic particle-in-cell simulation of an expanding turbulent plasma under heliospheric conditions. In our setup, expansion-driven weakening of the magnetic field adiabatically cools the plasma perpendicularly to the mean field while leaving the parallel temperature largely unchanged, driving the system toward the firehose-instability threshold. Concurrently, strongly anisotropic turbulence leads to perpendicular heating and the development of nonthermal features. Subsequently, we find that suprathermal electron populations preferentially develop in the parallel direction, forming pronounced power-law tails even under weakly compressive, highly Alfvénic conditions, and persist despite anisotropy regulation by the firehose instability. The preferentially parallel energization suggests the involvement of parallel electric fields or resonant wave--particle interactions, rather than simple velocity-space redistribution. These results provide the first direct evidence of the emergence of nonthermal-electron features in a unified kinetic framework linking expansion, turbulence, and instabilities in the solar wind.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作利用首个在日球层条件下针对膨胀湍流等离子体的全动理学粒子模拟，研究太阳风电子速度分布函数中非热特征的形成机制。模拟显示，太阳风膨胀导致磁场减弱，使等离子体相对于平均磁场发生垂直绝热冷却，而平行温度基本保持，从而推动系统接近火蛇不稳定性阈值；同时，强各向异性阿尔芬湍流引发垂直加热并形成非热特征。随后，超热电子优先沿平行方向发展并形成明显幂律尾，即使在弱压缩、高阿尔芬性的条件下也能持续存在，表明平行方向的电子增能过程十分关键。
authors: Maximilien Péters de Bonhome, Fabio Bacchini, Luca Pezzini, Viviane Pierrard

articles.title: What Do Language Priors Contribute to Darcy-Flow Inversion? A Mechanistic Audit
articles.title_zh: 语言先验对Darcy流反演有何贡献？一项机制审计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24967v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In ill-posed inverse problems, the recovered solution depends as much on the prior as on the data, yet much of the engineering knowledge that could serve as that prior is recorded qualitatively rather than in formal mathematical form. Here we test whether sentence embeddings can act as an inference-time interface for injecting geological descriptions into a learned Darcy-flow inverse solver. Across six synthetic geological classes and an exploratory transfer to a benchmark reservoir model (SPE10), we vary only the conditioning representation and find that text conditioning reduces reconstruction error by 81 % relative to a no-text counterfactual. Most of this gain comes from a categorical, class-level constraint whose value concentrates where the hydraulic head leaves the conductivity field underdetermined, while within-class geometric detail is secondary and pattern-dependent. Compared with a discrete class label, sentence embeddings add little dense-observation accuracy but improve training stability and enable paraphrase-based sensitivity analysis and open-vocabulary inputs. These results show that language priors can serve as an engineering-informatics interface for injecting geological knowledge into learned inverse solvers, while clarifying when they help and what signal they actually carry.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究检验句子嵌入能否在推理阶段将地质文字描述注入学习型Darcy流反演求解器，以缓解病态反问题中先验难以形式化的问题。作者在六类合成地质结构及SPE10储层模型探索性迁移中，仅改变条件表示方式，发现文本条件相较无文本对照可将重建误差降低81%。进一步分析表明，主要增益来自类别级约束，尤其集中在水头数据不足以确定电导率场的区域；句子嵌入相较离散类别标签对密集观测精度提升有限，但改善训练稳定性，并支持改写敏感性分析和开放词汇输入。
authors: Taiga Saito, Yu Otake, Daijiro Mizutani, Sopheakpolin Mom

articles.title: Uncertainty-aware reinforcement learning for chemical language models
articles.title_zh: 面向化学语言模型的不确定性感知强化学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has become a powerful paradigm for de novo molecular design, enabling Chemical Language Models (CLMs) to navigate and explore the chemical space while optimizing specific desired properties. However, the existing RL frameworks treat all scoring functions as deterministic oracles, neglecting the inherent uncertainty attached to the predictions of the different molecular properties. This can lead to the exploration of highly-uncertain regions of the chemical space, focusing on the generation of highly scored molecules which are poorly supported by the training data. This can destabilize the optimization process, yielding predictions that are far from their true values. We propose and compare two complementary ways of incorporating predictive uncertainty into RL. In the first one, uncertainty is treated as an additional optimization objective and incorporated along with the rest of the scoring functions, allowing the policy to trade off exploitation against reliability. Secondly, uncertainty is used to modulate policy updates, reducing the influence of molecules whose properties lie far outside the scoring function confidence domain. Both approaches were evaluated across three different settings: (i) a controlled model system, in which the prediction error is modeled as a Gaussian distribution, with a variance proportional to the distance to the training data; and two real-world tasks, making use of (ii) ChemProp models and (iii) a Conformal Prediction wrapper applied to a Random forest classifier. We show that uncertainty-aware RL enables CLMs to explore chemical space more robustly by favoring lower-uncertainty regions. This leads to more reliable hit discovery without compromising molecular score, increasing the true hit rate by 0.25 (from 0.5 to 0.75), and nearly doubling the total number of true hits.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作针对从头分子设计中的化学语言模型强化学习框架，指出现有方法常将性质评分函数视为确定性预言机，忽略预测不确定性，可能导致策略偏向训练数据支持不足的高不确定化学空间区域。作者提出并比较两种将预测不确定性纳入强化学习的方式：一是把不确定性作为额外优化目标，与其他评分函数共同权衡利用与可靠性；二是用不确定性调制策略更新，降低性质预测远离评分函数适用范围的分子对学习的影响。该方法旨在提升分子生成优化过程的稳定性和可信度。

articles.title: A Zeroth-Order Deep Learning Method for Fully Nonlinear Parabolic Partial Differential Equations with Unknown Coefficients
articles.title_zh: 面向未知系数全非线性抛物型偏微分方程的零阶深度学习方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24999v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: High-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs) with unknown coefficients arise widely in scientific machine learning, including continuous-time reinforcement learning, yet solving them efficiently in a data-driven way remains challenging. Existing deep learning solvers often rely on repeated automatic differentiation to evaluate differential operators, which can cause instability and amplify derivative errors in high dimensions, while probabilistic methods based on stochastic representations require explicit knowledge of the data-generating dynamics and therefore do not apply to black-box environments. We introduce two types of simulators as data-generating mechanisms, and take a ``representing-then-learning" approach that learns the solutions and their derivatives under settings where the underlying PDE operators are accessible only through simulations and pointwise evaluations. Our representation of derivatives relies on the zeroth-order derivative (ZOD) estimators derived from perturbed Monte Carlo trajectories. This fully model-free approach generates targets for the gradient and Hessian networks using only function evaluations. We provide a statistical learning analysis of the proposed approach, including a bias--variance tradeoff for ZODs. Assuming a standard contraction property of the underlying operator, we establish a non-asymptotic error bound that decomposes the total error into discretization error, approximation error, statistical error, and ZOD bias. Crucially, we derive the sample complexity of the learned representations in (weighted) Sobolev space, characterizing the error up to second-order derivatives. Numerical experiments illustrate the competitive performance of the method in moderate and high dimensions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究高维、系数未知的全非线性抛物型 PDE 的数据驱动求解问题，目标场景包括连续时间强化学习等只能通过仿真或点值评估访问算子的黑箱环境。作者提出“先表示、再学习”的模型无关框架，利用扰动 Monte Carlo 轨迹构造零阶导数估计器，为解函数、梯度和 Hessian 网络生成训练目标，从而避免对自动微分和显式动力学模型的依赖。
authors: Yanwei Jia, Du Ouyang, Huyên Pham, Xun Yu Zhou

articles.title: A Framework for Directed Hypergraph Signal Processing via tensor t-SVD
articles.title_zh: 基于张量 t-SVD 的有向超图信号处理框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25112v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce Directed Hypergraph Signal Processing (DHGSP), a unified framework that extends graph signal processing to accommodate both higher-order (polyadic) and asymmetric (directional) relationships simultaneously. Using the tensor singular value decomposition (t-SVD) within the t-product algebra, we define a novel adjacency tensor for directed hypergraphs, a topologically faithful shift operator, and a lossless Directed Hypergraph Fourier Transform (t-DHGFT). Experiments on real traffic networks demonstrate that DHGSP outperforms matrix-based (graph and digraph) and undirected tensor-based (hypergraph) baselines in denoising tasks.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出有向超图信号处理（DHGSP）框架，用于同时刻画高阶多元关系和非对称方向关系。作者基于 t-product 代数中的张量奇异值分解定义有向超图邻接张量、拓扑一致的移位算子和无损有向超图傅里叶变换。真实交通网络实验表明，该方法在去噪任务上优于基于矩阵的图/有向图方法和无向超图张量基线。
authors: Carlos Mundo-Levano, Nicolás Bello, Daniel L. Lau, Gonzalo R. Arce

articles.title: Forget to Improve: On-Device LLM-Agent Continual Learning via Budget-Curated Memory
articles.title_zh: 为改进而遗忘：基于预算筛选记忆的端侧大语言模型智能体持续学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25115v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On-device language-model agents improve by accumulating experience in retrieved memory rather than by updating weights. This memory is hard-bounded and exposed: it consumes RAM and energy, reaches peers through a thin uplink, and becomes an attack surface because it is writable by what the agent reads. Existing systems each cover one part of this problem: agentic memories grow without a budget, on-device methods keep entries by success alone, and poisoning is studied mainly as an attack rather than as a memory-governance problem. We propose sys{}, a single net-value-per-byte score that governs an agent's experience-memory lifecycle. The main idea is to let the budget act as the curator: each entry is scored as value minus harm, per byte, so one ruler decides what to keep, share, and trust. sys{} makes three decisions: (1) KEEP evicts low-value bytes under the RAM and energy budget; (2) SHARE sends an insight only when its value exceeds its uplink cost; and (3) TRUST gates a peer entry by provenance. On language-model-agent task-drift benchmarks and a real heterogeneous Jetson testbed with two robot-arm nodes and a hub, sys{} reduces memory by 2.7× and uplink by 2.4×, drives injection success from 0.75 to zero, and raises accuracy on cases corrupted by poison or stale memory. Curating by net value reduces footprint, energy, uplink, and injection success together without reducing accuracy. In this setting, forgetting by net value improves the agent rather than weakening it.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文关注端侧 LLM 智能体通过检索式经验记忆而非权重更新实现持续学习时面临的内存、能耗、通信和投毒风险。作者提出以“每字节净价值”为核心的记忆治理机制，用统一评分决定经验条目的保留、共享与信任：低价值内容在资源预算下被淘汰，只有收益超过上行成本的信息才共享，来自其他节点的记忆需经过来源门控。该框架在任务漂移基准和异构 Jetson 机器人测试床上验证了其降低资源占用并提升稳健性的潜力。
authors: Beining Wu, Zihao Ding, Jun Huang, Yanxiao Zhao

articles.title: Silent Failures in Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Parameter Poisoning and the Limits of Loss-Based Validation
articles.title_zh: 物理信息神经网络中的静默失效：参数投毒与基于损失验证的局限
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25151v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) embed governing equations in their loss function, enabling mesh-free solutions to partial differential equations. Low training loss is treated as evidence that the learned solution is physically correct. This paper shows that assumption breaks down when encoded physics are incorrect. By perturbing PDE parameters before training, a setting we describe as physics parameter poisoning or parameter misspecification, we produce models that train to low loss but give incorrect answers; we treat the perturbation schedule as sensitivity analysis rather than only as a security threat, and none of our claims requires an adversary. Achieving low residual loss does not discriminate accurate from inaccurate solutions: poisoned models reach losses at or below the clean baseline yet differ by large margins, so driving the residual down is not evidence of physical accuracy. Across three PDE systems (Burgers equation, Navier-Stokes cavity, and convection-diffusion), poisoned models match or beat the clean-model training loss while their solutions differ by up to 71% in the fixed sweep and up to 128% under adversarial search; at Cavity Re=400 the poisoned loss falls below the clean baseline. We define a detection difficulty ratio R (solution error divided by training loss) to summarize how invisible the corruption is, though cross-PDE comparison is complicated by differences in loss scale. We test six candidate defenses, none of which reliably detects corruption across all regimes. We propose a post-hoc defense: sweeping the PDE residual loss across parameter values without retraining. The loss minimum recovers the true training parameter without external data, and generalizes across all three PDE systems. The effect holds across five network architectures (8.7K to 133K parameters), is bidirectional, and is confirmed across multiple random seeds.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，PINN 中低训练损失并不必然意味着物理解正确，尤其当损失函数中编码的 PDE 参数存在错误时。作者通过在训练前扰动 PDE 参数来研究“物理参数投毒”或参数设定错误，并将其视为敏感性分析而不仅是安全攻击。针对 Burgers 方程、Navier–Stokes 方腔流和对流-扩散方程的实验显示，错误参数模型可达到与干净模型相当甚至更低的残差损失，但解却出现显著偏差，说明仅依赖损失验证存在根本局限。

articles.title: EveLoad: Cognitive Workload Recognition from Event-Based Eye Movements
articles.title_zh: EveLoad：基于事件相机眼动的认知负荷识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25177v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Cognitive workload monitoring is important for adaptive rehabilitation and assistive interfaces, where task difficulty, pacing, and feedback should be adjusted according to the user's cognitive state to avoid overload and under-challenge. Emerging extended reality and robot-assisted rehabilitation environments provide controllable training tasks, but they require unobtrusive sensing methods that can capture rapid ocular dynamics during interaction. Existing eye-movement-based cognitive workload recognition methods mainly rely on frame-based eye trackers, which often suffer from limited temporal resolution and degraded robustness under rapid eye movements. In contrast, event cameras provide microsecond-level temporal resolution, high dynamic range and low latency, making them suitable for capturing fine-grained ocular dynamics. Many previous studies rely on free-viewing or similar paradigms, where gaze locations can vary across tasks. As a result, models may learn associations between gaze-location distributions and cognitive workload, rather than workload-related eye movement characteristics themselves. In this work, we introduce EveLoad, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first event-based eye-movement dataset with graded cognitive workload annotations, collected from 20 healthy participants under spatially constrained and task-driven conditions using a controlled N-back-guided fixation paradigm. Based on this dataset, we establish a benchmark for cognitive workload recognition with six workload levels and propose a learning framework that encodes spatiotemporal event representations. Experimental results show that our approach achieves an average subject-specific accuracy of 96.36% and 96.13% under mixed random split evaluation. These results suggest that event-based eye movements may provide a useful sensing pathway for future workload-aware rehabilitation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向自适应康复和辅助交互中的认知负荷监测，探索利用事件相机捕捉高速眼动动态。相比传统帧式眼动仪，事件相机具有微秒级时间分辨率、高动态范围和低延迟，更适合记录交互过程中的精细眼动变化。作者提出 EveLoad，旨在减少模型对注视位置分布的依赖，使其更关注与认知负荷相关的眼动动力学特征。
authors: Guorui Lu, Shaohua Guan, Zhen Xu, Qinyu Chen

articles.title: A Hybrid CNN-LSTM Intrusion Detection Framework for Cybersecurity in Smart Renewable Energy Grids
articles.title_zh: 面向智能可再生能源电网网络安全的混合 CNN-LSTM 入侵检测框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25200v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The accelerated digitalization of renewable energy smart grids through IoT sensors, AMI, and SCADA systems has significantly expanded the attack surface for sophisticated cyberattacks, FDI attacks that stealthily distort state estimation and DoS/DDoS attacks that flood communication channels. Current IDS, however, exhibit three inherent limitations: inadequate modeling of the temporal progression of multi-step attacks, degraded scalability under extremely skewed class distributions of standard benchmark datasets, and restricted generalization across heterogeneous network environments. In this study, we present a Hybrid CNN-LSTM IDS that jointly exploits CNN-based spatial feature extraction and LSTM-based temporal sequence modeling, enabling the detection of instantaneous volumetric anomalies and gradually evolving low and slow-attack campaigns in real time. The model was trained using a seven-step preprocessing workflow comprising missing-value imputation, min-max normalization, one-hot encoding, SMOTE class balancing, mutual-information feature selection, causal temporal sequence construction (T=10), and stratified partitioning. LSTM (96.1%), Random Forest (93.5%), SVM (91.2%) and KNN (89.7%); in NSL-KDD, it reaches 98.2% precision versus 96.4% (LSTM), 95.2% (CNN), 92.7% (Random Forest) and 90.8% (SVM), with margins of 2-9 percentage points in all measures. An ablation analysis identified SMOTE balancing as the most influential design choice (-3.7~pp F1 without it). The model achieves a real-time inference throughput of 27,800 flows/s on GPU and 0.082 ms/sample CPU latency in FP32,, with INT8 quantization providing an additional 3.1 x speedup at 0.3% accuracy loss, confirming deployment feasibility on resource-constrained IEDs with <128MB memory and establishing a deployable deep-learning framework for securing next-generation renewable energy smart grid infrastructure.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对物联网传感器、AMI 和 SCADA 推动的可再生能源智能电网数字化所带来的网络攻击面扩展，提出混合 CNN-LSTM 入侵检测系统。模型结合 CNN 的空间特征提取和 LSTM 的时间序列建模，用于同时识别瞬时大流量异常以及缓慢演化的多阶段攻击。训练流程包括缺失值填补、归一化、独热编码、SMOTE 类平衡、互信息特征选择、因果时间序列构造和分层划分，以提升在类别极不均衡与异构网络环境下的检测能力。

articles.title: TopoCast: A Topological Fidelity Framework for Evaluating Transformer-Based Time Series Forecasting
articles.title_zh: TopoCast：用于评估 Transformer 时间序列预测的拓扑保真度框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25439v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep learning-based models have achieved state-of-the-art performance in Time Series Forecasting (TSF), yet their evaluation remains dominated by pointwise error metrics such as Mean Squared Error (MSE), which quantify numerical accuracy but overlook structural properties of the forecast signal, including recurrent dynamics, oscillatory behavior, and phase alignment. As a result, forecasts exhibiting over-smoothing, phase shifts, or frequency distortions may achieve favorable error scores despite substantial structural degradation. To address this limitation, we propose TopoCast, a topology-driven framework for evaluating structural fidelity in TSF. TopoCast reconstructs phase-space representations of forecast and ground-truth sequences using Takens delay embedding and applies persistent homology to characterize their intrinsic dynamics. We derive four complementary topological fidelity measures from persistence diagrams and aggregate them into a Topological Fidelity Score (TFS). We further introduce dominant cycle overlap, a novel metric that maps persistent topological features to the temporal domain to assess whether dominant oscillatory patterns occur at the correct time points. Combined with TFS, this yields the Localized Topological Fidelity Score (LTFS), a phase-aware measure that captures temporal localization errors invisible to existing evaluation metrics. Experiments on five Transformer architectures across three real-world benchmark datasets demonstrate that models with similar forecasting errors can exhibit markedly different structural fidelity profiles, revealing failure modes overlooked by conventional evaluation and highlighting the value of topology-aware forecast assessment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，时间序列预测常用的 MSE 等点态误差指标难以反映预测信号的递归动力学、振荡行为和相位结构，可能低估过平滑、相移或频率失真的问题。作者提出 TopoCast，通过 Takens 延迟嵌入重构预测序列和真实序列的相空间，并利用持久同调刻画内在动力学。该框架从持久图导出四类拓扑保真度指标并汇总为拓扑保真分数，同时引入主导循环重叠指标评估主要振荡结构在时间域中的保持情况。

articles.title: Learning with a Single Rollout via Monte Carlo Pass@k Critic
articles.title_zh: 通过 Monte Carlo Pass@k 评论器实现单次轨迹学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25451v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating token-level advantages in reinforcement learning (RL) for language models remains challenging because scaling up episodic experience collection is expensive. The difficulty intensifies for baseline advantage estimation methods, where repeated sampling causes trajectories to diverge into substantially different reasoning prefixes. In this context, RL algorithms such as GRPO prove limited: an outcome reward is too sparse to be attributed to specific actions like intermediate steps, and comparisons across sampled traces are non-trivial because they are heterogeneous. To mitigate both the computational cost of repeated sampling and the difficulty of credit assignment, we study single-rollout proximal policy optimization (SR-PPO) featuring token-level credit assignment in RL for language models. Instead of estimating advantages by normalizing episodic returns within the candidate group, we train a calibrated token-level credit critic using Monte Carlo outcomes from one rollout per prompt. Specifically, we use the critic to predict the Pass@k success probability at the prompt prefix, which is derived from a Pass@1 attempt. This choice yields a more selective learning signal than Pass@1: it discounts easily solved prefixes while prioritizing hard ones whose success probability remains marginal. We show that as k increases, Pass@k converges to a reachability indicator, reflecting whether a prefix can lead to at least one successful continuation. In an explicit state graph, the limit (k i̊ghtarrow infty) can be computed in O(|V|+|E|) time, offering a promising surrogate for direct credit assignment without the need to sample contrastive traces. As an initial validation, SR-PPO exhibits stable learning dynamics, along with consistent gains in Pass@128 success rates on mathematical reasoning benchmarks such as HMMT26 and AIME24.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究语言模型强化学习中如何在仅采集单次 rollout 的条件下进行 token 级优势估计，以降低多次采样带来的计算成本和异质轨迹比较困难。作者提出单轨迹近端策略优化方法，不再依赖候选组内的 episodic return 归一化，而是训练校准的 token 级信用评论器。该评论器利用每个提示一次 rollout 的 Monte Carlo 结果预测给定前缀下的 Pass@k 成功概率，从而为中间推理步骤提供更细粒度的信用分配信号。
authors: Fengdi Che, Yang Liu, Lei Yu, Meng Cao, Tong Che, Rupam Mahmood, Dale Schuurmans

articles.title: Is Variational Monte Carlo Robust? Sharp Moment Thresholds and Heavy-tailed Stochastic Optimization
articles.title_zh: 变分 Monte Carlo 是否鲁棒？尖锐矩阈值与重尾随机优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26009v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Variational Monte Carlo (VMC) is a central algorithm in electronic structure theory and has gained renewed importance through modern neural-network ansätze such as FermiNet. At its core, VMC seeks ground states by minimizing the Rayleigh quotient by stochastic optimization. In this work, we show that the resulting stochastic optimization problem is intrinsically governed by the nodal geometry of the underlying wave function. More precisely, we establish that properties of the nodal set determine the integrability of the local energy and gradient estimators that drive VMC. For broad and practically relevant ansatz classes, including Slater-Jastrow wave functions with variable-exponent Slater-type orbitals, we prove that these estimators are generically heavy-tailed and fail to admit higher moments. At the same time, for general analytic ansätze, we prove weak moment bounds for the relevant estimators and identify precise low-moment regimes, showing how generic and degenerate nodal structures lead to different integrability thresholds. Building on this analysis, we introduce a new robust variant of VMC n̆icodex2013 coined PS-Clip-VMC n̆icodex2013 which is based on clipping both the local energy and the gradient random variable. We prove that PS-Clip-VMC converges both in expectation and with high probability in the weak moment regime of VMC. Preliminary experiments for training FermiNet on Atoms with up to 18 electrons suggest that PS-Clip-VMC is significantly more robust than standard methods.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文从理论上分析电子结构计算中变分 Monte Carlo 的随机优化稳定性，强调其由波函数节点几何内在支配。作者证明，节点集性质决定局部能量和梯度估计器的可积性；对包括带可变指数 Slater 型轨道的 Slater-Jastrow 波函数在内的广泛实用 ansatz，这些估计器通常呈重尾分布并缺乏高阶矩。基于对解析 ansatz 的低阶矩阈值分析，作者进一步提出一种名为 PS-Clip-VMC 的鲁棒 VMC 变体，以缓解重尾估计对优化的影响。

articles.title: Neglected Free Lunch from Post-training: Progress Advantage for LLM Agents
articles.title_zh: 后训练中被忽视的免费收益：面向大语言模型智能体的进展优势
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26080v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Process reward models enable fine-grained, step-level evaluation of LLMs, yet building them for agentic settings remains prohibitively difficult: long-horizon interactions, irreversible actions, and stochastic environment feedback make both human annotation and Monte Carlo estimation infeasible at scale. In this work, we show that reinforcement learning (RL) post-training already provides the ingredients for effective step-level scoring, eliminating the need for dedicated reward model training altogether. Concretely, we derive an implicit advantage under a general stochastic Markov decision process, which we term progress advantage -- log-probability ratio between the RL-trained policy and its reference policy exactly recovers the optimal advantage function. This formulation makes the resulting signal annotation-free, domain-agnostic, and available as a byproduct of the standard RL post-training pipeline. We validate the effectiveness of the progress advantage across three different applications: test-time scaling, uncertainty quantification, and failure attribution on five benchmarks and four model families. Across all settings, it consistently outperforms confidence-based baselines and, despite requiring no task-specific training, surpasses dedicated trained reward models. We complement these results with deeper analyses on characteristics of progress advantage, offering practical guidance for adoption in real-world agentic systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究无需额外训练过程奖励模型的 LLM 智能体步骤级评估方法。作者指出，强化学习后训练本身已隐含可用的步骤级信号，并在一般随机马尔可夫决策过程中推导出“进展优势”：RL 后策略与参考策略的对数概率比可恢复最优优势函数。该信号无需人工标注、与领域无关，可直接作为标准 RL 后训练流程的副产物，并在测试时扩展、不确定性量化和失败归因等任务中进行验证。
authors: Changdae Oh, Wendi Li, Seongheon Park, Samuel Yeh, Tanwi Mallick, Sharon Li

articles.title: Recursive QLSTM with Dynamic Variational Quantum Circuit Adaptation
articles.title_zh: 具有动态变分量子线路自适应的递归 QLSTM
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24932v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent advances in quantum computing and machine learning have motivated the development of quantum models for sequential data processing. In this paper, we propose a Recursive Quantum Long Short-Term Memory model, or Recursive QLSTM, which extends QLSTM through metacore-based recursive constructions. We numerically test the model under different input sequence lengths, metacore designs, and recursive rules, and identify the best-performing architecture among these variants. For this selected model, we further provide theoretical arguments explaining why its recursive structure improves temporal information propagation and enhances learning performance. Our results suggest that Recursive QLSTM offers a flexible and effective framework for quantum recurrent learning over input time series of various lengths.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出递归量子长短期记忆模型（Recursive QLSTM），通过基于 metacore 的递归构造扩展传统 QLSTM，以处理序列数据。作者在不同输入序列长度、metacore 设计和递归规则下进行数值测试，并筛选表现最佳的架构。理论分析表明，递归结构有助于改善时间信息传播并提升学习性能，显示其可作为适应不同长度时间序列的量子循环学习框架。
authors: Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Yifeng Peng, Jiun-Cheng Jiang, Chun-Hua Lin, Kuo-Chung Peng, Junghoon Justin Park, Huan-Hsin Tseng, Hsin-Yi Lin, Kuan-Cheng Chen, Chen-Yu Liu, Shinjae Yoo

articles.title: Self-Modulating Quantum Fast-Weight Programmers for Efficient Adaptive Sequential Learning
articles.title_zh: 用于高效自适应序列学习的自调制量子快速权重编程器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24933v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent advances in quantum machine learning have motivated efficient models for sequential data processing. In this paper, we propose Self-Modulating Quantum Fast Weight Programmers, or Self-Modulating QFWP, which extends Quantum Fast Weight Programmers by introducing adaptive modulation over both newly generated fast-weight updates and historical fast-weight memory. Numerical results show that the proposed mechanism improves convergence stability and prediction performance across varying model settings, including different numbers of qubits and input sequence lengths. We further provide theoretical arguments explaining how self-modulation balances new information injection with memory retention, thereby enhancing temporal information propagation. These results suggest that Self-Modulating QFWP is a compact and effective framework for quantum machine learning on time-series data.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出自调制量子快速权重编程器（Self-Modulating QFWP），在量子快速权重编程器基础上对新生成的快速权重更新和历史快速权重记忆同时引入自适应调制。数值实验显示，该机制在不同量子比特数和输入序列长度设置下改善了收敛稳定性和预测性能。作者进一步从理论上解释了自调制如何平衡新信息注入与记忆保持，从而增强时间信息传播能力。
authors: Samuel Yen-Chi Chen, Yifeng Peng, Kuo-Chung Peng, Jiun-Cheng Jiang, Chun-Hua Lin, Junghoon Justin Park, Huan-Hsin Tseng, Hsin-Yi Lin, Kuan-Cheng Chen, Chen-Yu Liu, Shinjae Yoo

articles.title: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI: From Foundations to Systems
articles.title_zh: 代理式人工智能漫游指南：从基础到系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.24937v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Hitchhiker's Guide to Agentic AI is a comprehensive practitioner's reference for building autonomous AI systems. The book covers the full stack from first principles to production deployment, organized around a central thesis: building great agentic systems requires understanding every layer of the pipeline, not just one. The book opens with the LLM substrate -- transformer architecture, GPU systems, training and fine-tuning (SFT,LoRA, MoE), model compression, and inference optimization -- treated as essential foundations rather than the primary focus. It then develops the alignment and reasoning layer: reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), PPO, DPO and its variants, GRPO, reward modeling, and RL for large reasoning models including chain-of-thought and test-time scaling. The second half is devoted to agentic AI proper. Topics include agentic training and trajectory-based RL, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG and Agentic RAG), memory systems (in-context, external, episodic, and semantic), agent harness design and context management, and a taxonomy of agent design patterns. Inter-agent coordination is covered in depth: the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agent skills and tool use, the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocol, and multi-agent architectures spanning centralized, decentralized, and hierarchical topologies. The book concludes with agent development frameworks, agentic UI design, evaluation methodology for agentic tasks, and production deployment. Each chapter pairs rigorous theoretical foundations with implementation guidance, code examples, and references to the primary literature.
articles.abstract_zh: 该 arXiv 著作型文稿面向实践者，系统梳理自主代理式 AI 系统的构建方法。内容从 LLM 底座出发，涵盖 Transformer、GPU 系统、训练与微调、模型压缩和推理优化，并进一步讨论 RLHF、PPO、DPO、奖励建模和大推理模型的测试时扩展。后半部分聚焦代理式 AI，包括轨迹强化学习、RAG 与 Agentic RAG、记忆系统、代理框架设计、上下文管理、代理设计模式及多代理协作。

articles.title: BiPACE: Bisimulation-Guided Policy Optimization with Action Counterfactual Estimation for LLM Agents
articles.title_zh: BiPACE：面向 LLM 代理的双模拟引导策略优化与动作反事实估计
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25556v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Stepwise group-based RL is an attractive way to train long-horizon LLM agents without a learned critic: it reuses multiple sampled rollouts to estimate local advantages. Its weakness is less visible but more fundamental: every group-relative estimator assumes that the steps it compares are equivalent for credit assignment. We show that current agentic variants violate this assumption through a state-action credit mismatch. The observation-hash partition is overly fine on the state side, creating singleton groups with zero step-level signal, while a single within-group mean is too coarse on the action side, mixing state-value estimation with action-specific credit. We introduce BiPACE (Bisimulation-Guided Policy Optimization with Action Counterfactual Estimation), a drop-in advantage estimator that fixes both sides without adding a critic, auxiliary loss, or extra rollouts. BiGPO clusters steps by cosine distance in the actor's own hidden-state geometry, an empirical policy-induced proxy for bisimulation that substantially lowers the singleton rate left by observation hashing. PACE then recenters returns within each behavioral cluster using action-conditioned peer baselines; its Q-style instance estimates a local Q(s,a)-V(s) nonparametrically. On ALFWorld/Qwen2.5-7B, BiPACE_Q raises overall validation success from GiGPO's 90.8 to 97.1±0.9 over three seeds, and crosses the 95% threshold on every seed, which GiGPO never does within the same budget. On Qwen2.5-1.5B it reaches 93.5±1.2 versus GiGPO's 86.7, and on WebShop and TextCraft it improves over GRPO and GiGPO at both model scales. The measured BiPACE-specific overhead is 11.3% of a single training-step wall time. Yet it changes the estimator's comparison unit from surface identity to approximate behavioral equivalence plus action-side counterfactuals. The code is available at https://github.com/TianxiangZhao/BiPACE.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究指出，长时程 LLM 代理训练中常用的逐步组相对强化学习存在状态—动作信用分配不匹配：观测哈希导致状态分组过细，而组内均值又混合了状态价值和动作特异信用。作者提出 BiPACE，一种无需评论家、辅助损失或额外 rollout 的即插即用优势估计器。其 BiGPO 组件利用 actor 隐状态几何中的余弦距离进行近似双模拟聚类，PACE 则在行为簇内对回报重新中心化，以改进局部信用估计。
authors: Hanyang Wang, Weijieying Ren, Yuxiang Zhang, Ding Cao, Zhizhao Zeng, Ke Zeng, Tianxiang Zhao

articles.title: Statistically Valid Hyperparameter Selection: From Tuning to Guarantees
articles.title_zh: 具有统计有效性的超参数选择：从调参到保证
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25601v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Hyperparameter selection is a critical step in the deployment of modern artificial intelligence systems, given the need to tune degrees of freedom such as inference-time parameters, implementation-level settings, and thresholds driving decision rules. Despite its practical importance, hyperparameter selection is typically performed using best-effort empirical methods such as grid search or Bayesian optimization, which provide no formal statistical guarantees on reliability or safety. This monograph presents a unified statistical framework for reliable hyperparameter selection, centered on the learn-then-test (LTT) paradigm, which formulates the problem as multiple hypothesis testing over a candidate set of hyperparameters. The framework enables the selection of hyperparameters that provably satisfy application-specific reliability requirements -- such as bounds on average risk, quantile risk, or information-theoretic constraints -- with explicit, finite-sample control of error probabilities. The supporting statistical machinery, namely p-values, e-values, and concentration inequalities, is developed from first principles in a dedicated appendix.
articles.abstract_zh: 该综述式专著提出一个可靠超参数选择的统一统计框架，针对推理参数、实现设置和决策阈值等现代 AI 系统部署中的关键自由度。核心是 learn-then-test 范式，将候选超参数集合上的选择问题表述为多重假设检验。该框架可在有限样本下对错误概率给出显式控制，并保证所选超参数满足平均风险、分位数风险或信息论约束等应用特定可靠性要求。

articles.title: A 3D-Printable Dataset for Fair Testing and Comparisons of Tactile Sensors
articles.title_zh: 用于触觉传感器公平测试与比较的可 3D 打印数据集
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25886v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Existing texture datasets for tactile sensing primarily consist of sensor readings from a specific sensor interacting with available surfaces/objects rather than describing the textures themselves, limiting fair comparison between tactile sensors and hindering reproducible research. In this work, we introduce a 3D-printable dataset of mathematically defined textures designed to be fabricated reliably across different printers and filament types. The dataset consists of six parametrically generated surface patterns derived from combinations of sine-wave and Fourier-based functions, giving controlled variation in spatial frequency, amplitude, and directional structure. We evaluate the reproducibility of these textures across three popular 3D printers and multiple filament types by measuring variance in images captured using an optical TacTip sensor under controlled contact conditions. Our results show that print quality, particularly peak sharpness and stringing, affects tactile variance, with higher-end printers producing significantly more consistent signatures. Classification experiments using neural networks and PCA-based models further demonstrate that high-quality prints support strong within-printer generalisation, while cross-printer generalisation remains challenging due to geometric inconsistencies. This work establishes the first openly available, physically reproducible 3D-printed texture benchmark, providing a foundation for fair comparison of tactile sensors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一个由数学定义纹理组成的可 3D 打印触觉数据集，以避免现有数据集过度依赖特定传感器与现成物体、难以公平比较的问题。数据集包含六类参数化表面图案，由正弦波和傅里叶函数组合生成，可控制空间频率、幅度和方向结构。作者在多种 3D 打印机和耗材上评估可重复性，发现打印质量，尤其峰形锐度和拉丝，会显著影响触觉信号一致性。
authors: Dexter R. Shepherd, Nicolas Herzig, Phil Husbands, Andrew Philippides, Chris Johnson, William Kimbell

articles.title: Weave of Formal Thought
articles.title_zh: 形式化思维之织：面向代码生成的语法约束与结构学习框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25987v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) attain remarkable surface fluency on code, yet they neither formally guarantee the syntactic validity of their output nor leverage the hierarchical structure defining the target language. While existing constrained-decoding frameworks address the former, they operate under rigid assumptions that preclude critical lexical mechanisms -- including context-sensitive lexing, maximal-munch tokenization, and keyword extraction -- and only approximate vocabulary masking, sacrificing completeness. For the latter, code LLMs typically inject grammatical structure via predetermined policies rather than learning which structural information to expose. In this work, we introduce Weave of Formal Thought (WoFT), a paradigm uniting rigorous syntactic validation with learned structural representations. First, we present a formal engine and constrained decoder that is sound and complete with respect to the full Tree-sitter specification. By augmenting generalized LR (GLR) parsing with a speculative-lexing construction that maintains concurrent lexer-state hypotheses synchronized with a GLR graph-structured stack, our decoder admits every subword token extending to a valid program prefix and rejects all others. Second, we present a latent-variable fine-tuning method training the language model to interleave non-terminal grammar symbols directly into generation. Utilizing the reweighted wake-sleep (RWS) algorithm to optimize the importance-weighted evidence lower bound (IW-ELBO) of the surface text, the model learns to selectively retain formal derivations as an adaptive structural scratchpad. For Python, fine-tuning StarCoder2-3B with our RWS objective reduces per-token cross-entropy by 14.3% relative to a text-only SFT baseline, demonstrating that discretionary latent syntax recovers critical structural information that flat autoregressive training discards.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出 Weave of Formal Thought，用于结合严格语法验证和可学习的结构化表示，以改进大语言模型代码生成。作者指出现有约束解码方法难以完整处理上下文敏感词法、最长匹配分词和关键字抽取等机制，且常以固定策略注入语法结构。WoFT 通过扩展广义 LR 解析并引入推测性词法分析，在 Tree-sitter 规范下实现声称完备且可靠的约束解码，并探索让模型学习应暴露哪些层级结构信息。

articles.title: Beyond Shapley: Efficient Computation of Asymmetric Shapley Values
articles.title_zh: 超越 Shapley：非对称 Shapley 值的高效计算
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25103v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We address the problem of explainability in machine learning models through feature attribution methods. In particular, we consider a variant of Shapley values known as Asymmetric Shapley Values (ASV), which enables the incorporation of causal knowledge into model-agnostic explanations through the use of a causal graph. We show that in certain contexts in which the computation of SHAP is #P-hard, the exact computation of ASV can be done in polynomial time. To extend this algorithmic result, we introduce a notion of equivalence classes over the topological orderings of the underlying causal graph, which is useful to reduce the time to compute ASV. In particular, we present a polynomial-time algorithm (in the number of equivalence classes) to compute it whenever the causal graph is a rooted directed tree. Finally, we develop an algorithm for approximating ASV in arbitrary causal DAGs which relies on a procedure to sample topological orderings uniformly at random. To implement this sampling mechanism we leverage known algorithms as well as simpler alternatives. Our experimental results demonstrate the practical viability of the proposed approach in realistic causal structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究机器学习可解释性中的特征归因问题，重点关注可通过因果图引入因果知识的非对称 Shapley 值（ASV）。作者证明，在某些 SHAP 计算为 #P-hard 的情形下，ASV 可被精确地多项式时间计算；并提出基于因果图拓扑序的等价类方法以降低计算成本。对于根有向树形式的因果图，文中给出关于等价类数目的多项式时间算法，并进一步提出适用于任意因果 DAG 的基于均匀随机采样拓扑序的近似算法。
authors: Ezequiel Companeetz, Santiago Cifuentes, Sergio Abriola

articles.title: Rate-Aware Quantum-Inspired Trajectory Learning for Interference-Limited Multi-UAV Networks
articles.title_zh: 面向干扰受限多无人机网络的速率感知量子启发轨迹学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.25480v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) can provide on-demand, high-capacity connectivity in disaster and normal situation. However, it faces a challenge of curse of dimensionality in trajectory optimization, where interference-limited environments and vast search spaces make real-time coordination computationally expensive. To overcome this challenge, we propose the Rate-Aware Quantum-Annealed Graph Condensation (RA-QAGC) scheme, which combines rate-aware graph abstraction with decentralized reinforcement learning to enable scalable, interference-aware UAV coordination. By identifying high throughput locations and guiding UAV trajectory adaptation toward throughput-optimal regions, RA-QAGC effectively balances network capacity by maintaining quality-of-service (QoS) requirements. Simulation results demonstrate the proposal outperformed over existing schemes by achieving 59.4 Mbps total throughput and 23.9 Mbps priority-user throughput, representing gains of approximately 15% and 34%, respectively, over the baseline schemes.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对干扰受限多无人机网络中的轨迹优化维数灾难和实时协调成本问题，提出速率感知量子退火图凝聚（RA-QAGC）方案。该方法结合速率感知图抽象与去中心化强化学习，通过识别高吞吐位置并引导无人机向吞吐最优区域调整轨迹，在满足 QoS 的同时提升网络容量。仿真显示，该方案总吞吐量达到 59.4 Mbps、优先用户吞吐量达到 23.9 Mbps，相比基线分别提升约 15% 和 34%。
authors: Khaoula Khaled, Muhammad Afaq, Ali Arshad Nasir, Zeeshan Kaleem

articles.title: A welding penetration prediction model for laser welding process based on self-supervised learning using physics-informed neural networks
articles.title_zh: 基于物理信息神经网络自监督学习的激光焊接熔透预测模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26059v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The laser welding full-penetration is of critical importance, as it constitutes one of the fundamental factors in achieving defect-free welded joints. Accurate prediction of the penetration state is therefore essential for ensuring weld quality. To this end, this paper introduces SimPhysNet, a novel algorithm that achieves high classification accuracy in laser welding penetration prediction using only a limited number of labelled images. This approach effectively overcomes the limitations of supervised learning classification algorithms, which are hindered in industrial applications by their dependence on extensive, high-quality labelled data. The core of SimPhysNet is a unique self-supervised learning paradigm that embeds physical priors into a contrastive learning framework. By incorporating a physics-informed neural network (PINN), the model is guided to extract physically meaningful features of the molten pool and keyhole from a large set of unlabelled data, while three image augmentation tasks further enhance its generalization capabilities. Subsequently, a few-shot learning strategy, based on prototypical networks, enables robust classification by constructing class representations from a minimal set of labelled images. Experimental results demonstrate that SimPhysNet achieves a classification accuracy of 96.06% using only 200 labelled images (approximately 5% of the total labelled dataset), which is comparable to the performance of conventional supervised learning algorithms that utilize the entire labelled dataset. This work presents a new, efficient, and highly accurate method, providing the way for the intelligent automation of laser welding.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 SimPhysNet，用于在少量标注图像条件下实现激光焊接熔透状态的高精度分类，以缓解工业场景中监督学习对大规模高质量标注数据的依赖。其核心是在对比学习框架中嵌入物理先验，并借助物理信息神经网络引导模型从未标注数据中提取熔池与小孔的物理相关特征，同时通过图像增强任务提升泛化能力。随后结合基于原型网络的小样本学习策略，实现对不同熔透状态的鲁棒识别。
authors: Sen Li, Xiaoying Liu, Xiaojian Xu, Chendong Shao, Yaqi Wang, Ling Lan, Xinhua Tang, Haichao Cui

articles.title: Coincidence of the metal-insulator transition and epsilon near zero condition in amorphous FeCuB films
articles.title_zh: 非晶 FeCuB 薄膜中金属-绝缘体转变与近零介电常数条件的重合
articles.abstract: A study of the magnetic, electronic transport, and dielectric properties of a series of sputter grown amorphous FeCuB samples with varying metal/boron content was performed to explore the relationship between the room temperature values of the dielectric function e(ω) and distance to the disorder-driven metal-insulator transition (MIT). The results demonstrate that e(ω) ~ 0 at metal concentrations similar to those near the MIT so that the ENZ condition is satisfied near the MIT on the metallic side.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察了一系列溅射制备、金属/硼含量不同的非晶 FeCuB 样品的磁性、电子输运和介电性质，以探索室温介电函数与无序驱动金属-绝缘体转变（MIT）距离之间的关系。结果表明，在接近 MIT 的金属侧、且金属浓度与转变附近相当时，介电函数 ε(ω) 接近零。该发现说明 FeCuB 非晶薄膜的 ENZ 条件可与无序诱导 MIT 在成分空间中相邻或重合。

articles.title: A large positive motional anharmonicity in the electron-on-helium qubit: consequences for gates, readout, and the coherence frontier
articles.title_zh: 电子-液氦量子比特中的大正运动非谐性：对门操作、读出与相干性前沿的影响
articles.abstract: Electrons floating on superfluid helium are a long-proposed qubit host whose pristine, defect-free substrate promises long coherence, and strong coupling between a single electron's motion and a microwave resonator was recently demonstrated. Whether such a qubit is well-conditioned for gates and readout, however, depends on its motional level structure, which has not been reported. Here we determine it by solving the demonstrated device's own finite-element (FEM) potential with the experimenters' electrostatic pipeline, and predict that the barrier-confined dot is box-like and so has a emphlarge, positive anharmonicity---αₑ/2π=+945~MHz at the operating point and exceeding +400~MHz across the entire measured 4--8~GHz tuning band, an order of magnitude beyond a transmon and of the opposite sign. We propose this as a falsifiable prediction---a positive αₑ following an empirical αₑproptoømegaₑ⁻¹.⁸ trend, testable by two-tone spectroscopy---and trace its consequences with leakage- and decoherence-aware master-equation simulations. The predicted level structure has two concrete consequences at the coherent (leakage) ceiling: it renders |1ångle!→!|2ångle leakage negligible (single-qubit gate infidelity 1.3×10⁻⁴, 90× below the small-anharmonicity case) and admits strong-dispersive readout over a broad detuning window (2ḩi/κapprox21 near the operating point). Anchoring every other parameter to the measured device, we assemble a universal gate set (single-qubit rotations, a bus-mediated sqrtiSWAP, a |11ångle!łeftrightarrow!|20ångle controlled-Z, and a magic T gate, all at coherent ceilings) and frequency-multiplexed readout. With these ingredients control and measurement are not the limitation; coherence is. With the measured T₂approx2.6~ns the gates are not yet usable, and we cast the requirement as a two-knob target (T₁gtrsim7~μs emphand T₂gtrsim4~μs) that the device's own measured negative-offset and dynamical-decoupling levers can plausibly reach. This is a simulation-based characterization and requirements analysis---not a demonstration, and built on established gate constructions---whose durable contributions are a single falsifiable prediction (the positive anharmonicity and its frequency dependence, measurable by two-tone spectroscopy) and a quantitative, device-specific coherence target, offered as input to the experimental program that alone can confirm or refute them.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文通过求解已演示器件的有限元静电势，预测液氦表面电子量子点具有近似盒状的势阱结构，并表现出很大的正运动非谐性：工作点处 αₑ/2π 约为 +945 MHz，在 4–8 GHz 调谐带内均超过 +400 MHz。作者提出该正非谐性及其近似随频率按 αₑ∝ωₑ⁻¹·⁸ 变化的趋势可由双音谱实验检验。基于含泄漏与退相干的主方程模拟，研究进一步讨论了该能级结构对单量子比特泄漏、门操作和读出的影响。

articles.title: Integrated Geophysical and Reactive Transport Assessment of Fracture-Controlled Rare Earth Mineral Recovery in Pegmatitic Subsurface Systems
articles.title_zh: 伟晶岩地下系统中裂隙控制稀土矿物回收的综合地球物理与反应输运评估
articles.abstract: The increasing global demand for rare earth elements (REEs) for clean energy technologies, advanced electronics, and sustainable industrial applications has intensified the need for efficient and environmentally responsible subsurface mineral recovery strategies. This study presents an integrated hydrogeophysical and reactive transport modelling framework for evaluating fracture-controlled rare earth element recovery within pegmatitic subsurface systems. The approach combines electrical resistivity tomography (ERT), seismic refraction analysis, petrophysical parameter estimation, mineralogical characterization, and coupled reactive transport simulations to investigate the influence of structural heterogeneity on fluid migration and mineral dissolution behaviour. Integrated geophysical interpretation identified pronounced subsurface variability characterized by low-resistivity conductive fracture corridors (< 200 Ωm) spatially associated with reduced seismic velocities (3.0–4.5 km/s), elevated porosity, and enhanced permeability. Petrophysical transforms derived from Archie’s Law, the Wyllie time-average equation, and the Kozeny–Carman relationship revealed permeability distributions ranging approximately from 120 to 480 mD within structurally altered pegmatitic zones, indicating favourable conditions for fracture-assisted reactive fluid transport and mineral dissolution. SEM, SEM-EDS, XRD, and BET analyses confirmed the occurrence of REE-bearing mineral phases including monazite, bastnäsite, xenotime, and zircon within quartz–feldspar-rich pegmatitic matrices. Microstructural observations further revealed interconnected fracture networks
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出综合水文地球物理与反应输运建模框架，用于评估伟晶岩地下系统中由裂隙控制的稀土元素回收过程。方法结合电阻率层析成像、地震折射、岩石物理参数估算、矿物学表征和耦合反应输运模拟，以分析结构非均质性对流体迁移和矿物溶解行为的影响。结果识别出低电阻率导电裂隙通道与较低地震波速、高孔隙度和高渗透率区域的空间关联，表明裂隙结构是控制浸出流动与稀土释放的重要因素。

articles.title: Two-Stage Neural Residual Decoding for FastSurface-Code Quantum Error Correction
articles.title_zh: 用于快速表面码量子纠错的两阶段神经残差解码
articles.abstract: One of the critical requirements for fault-tolerant quantum computation is fast and reliable decoding,Minimum-weight perfect matching (MWPM) is a reliable surface-code decoder,but it will face long decoding time when decoding instances grow. Neural-network decoders was used to solve this problem, but large models often require costly retraining when the code distance or noise model changes.In this work, we propose a two-stage decoder that combines pretrained graph neural network (GNN) residual pre-decoding with global MWPM cleanup.The GNN receives a detector graph generated by the established decoding backend and assigns confidence scores to local correction candidates.Two staggered layers of parallel local windows process confidence corrections.The residual syndrome is passed to the NVIDIA-accelerated MWPM backend.On matched batches of 32,768 samples, the complete method reduced the logical failure rate by 6.25% to 18.01% relative to Pure MWPM for code distances d=3,5,7 and 9 at physical error rates p = 0.007 to 0.013. At d=3,it decoded 3.48x – 4.38x faster over p=0.003 to 0.021. We also trained separate GNN residual pre-decoders for four circuit-level noise models over 160 code-distance/error-rate configurations and obtained 2.25x to 5.41x speedups in every case.The logical-failure benefit depended on the noise model,but the pace is all improving. Our work can accelerate surface-code decoding pace and extend to others noise models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种两阶段表面码解码器，将预训练图神经网络（GNN）残差预解码与全局最小权完美匹配（MWPM）清理结合，以提升容错量子计算中的解码速度和可靠性。GNN 基于探测器图为局部校正候选分配置信度，两个交错并行局部窗口执行置信校正，剩余综合征再交由 NVIDIA 加速的 MWPM 后端处理。在批量 32768 个样本上，该方法在 d=3、5、7、9 和物理错误率 0.007–0.013 下相对纯 MWPM 将逻辑失败率降低 6.25%–18.01%，并在 d=3 时实现约 3.48–4.38 倍加速。

articles.title: Fifteen Years of Meteorological Observations at the Aragats High-Altitude Station, Armenia
articles.title_zh: 亚美尼亚 Aragats 高海拔站十五年气象观测
articles.abstract: Mountain environments are highly sensitive to environmental variability, yet long-term high-altitude observations remain scarce in the South Caucasus. We analyze fifteen years (2012–2025) of one-minute meteorological observations from the Aragats High-Altitude Research Station (3200 m a.s.l.), Armenia, focusing on air temperature, solar radiation, and cloud-base distance, and their relationships to atmospheric-electric and high-energy atmospheric phenomena. The annual mean air temperature shows a statistically significant positive trend, whereas daytime solar radiation shows a significant negative trend. Bootstrap resampling, outlier-sensitivity tests, and comparisons of two independent DAVIS weather stations confirm the robustness of these trends and the stability of the observational system. The results show that warming at Aragats cannot be explained solely by variations in measured solar radiation and emphasize the importance of multivariate interactions among meteorological, atmospheric-electric, and high-energy atmospheric processes. Analysis of cloud-base distance during periods of enhanced atmospheric electric fields shows that Thunderstorm Ground Enhancements (TGEs) occur preferentially when strong electric fields coincide with low cloud bases. Aragats provides a unique observational framework in which climate variability, atmospheric electricity, lightning activity, geomagnetic conditions, and particle fluxes can be studied simultaneously.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析了亚美尼亚 Aragats 高海拔研究站（海拔 3200 m）2012–2025 年一分钟分辨率气象观测数据，重点关注气温、太阳辐射、云底距离及其与大气电和高能大气现象的关系。结果显示，年平均气温存在显著上升趋势，而日间太阳辐射呈显著下降趋势；自助重采样、异常值敏感性检验和两套独立 DAVIS 气象站对比均支持这些趋势的稳健性。研究指出，Aragats 的增暖不能仅由测得的太阳辐射变化解释，并强调气象、大气电和高能大气过程之间的多变量耦合。

articles.title: In doped NiCo-LDH as bifunctional electrocatalysts for overall water splitting
articles.title_zh: 铟掺杂 NiCo 层状双氢氧化物作为全水分解双功能电催化剂
articles.abstract: The development of efficient, stable, and cost-effective bifunctional electrocatalysts for overall water splitting is crucial for green hydrogen production. Herein, we report a series of indium-doped nickel-cobalt layered double hydroxide (In-NiCo LDH) catalysts synthesized directly on nickel foam via a one-step electrodeposition method. By varying the In doping concentration, we identified the optimal In/(Ni + Co) molar ratio of 1.0% that delivers exceptional bifunctional activity. The optimized In1.0-NiCo LDH electrode exhibits low overpotentials of 215 mV for the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and 180 mV for the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER) at 100 mA cm− 2, with small Tafel slopes of 71.53 mV dec− 1 (OER) and 47.69 mV dec− 1 (HER). Structural characterization reveals that In3+ ions are incorporated as interstitial defects into the LDH lattice, causing lattice expansion and distorted electronic structure. This unique doping mode creates new active sites that serve as electron-donating sites for HER and electron-withdrawing sites for OER. Furthermore, the In1.0-NiCo LDH demonstrates remarkable long-term stability, maintaining stable operation for 100 hours in both OER and HER tests. When assembled as a two-electrode electrolyzer, it requires only 1.73 V to achieve 100 mA cm− 2 for overall water splitting. This work presents a facile electrodeposition strategy for fabricating high-performance In-doped NiCo-LDH bifunctional catalysts and elucidates the structure-activity relationship governed by atomic doping engineering.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文报道了通过一步电沉积在泡沫镍上直接制备的铟掺杂 NiCo 层状双氢氧化物（In-NiCo LDH）电催化剂，并优化了 In 掺杂浓度。In/(Ni+Co) 摩尔比为 1.0% 的样品表现出优异的双功能活性，在 100 mA cm⁻² 下 OER 和 HER 过电位分别为 215 mV 和 180 mV，Tafel 斜率分别为 71.53 和 47.69 mV dec⁻¹。结构表征表明 In³⁺ 以间隙缺陷形式进入 LDH 晶格，引起晶格膨胀和电子结构畸变，从而为 HER 和 OER 分别提供给电子和吸电子活性位点，并实现 100 小时稳定运行。

articles.title: A Proportionate Validation Framework for AI-Assisted Data Extraction in Evidence Synthesis: A Methodological Evaluation using Elicit Within a Scoping Review in Health.
articles.title_zh: 证据综合中 AI 辅助数据提取的比例化验证框架：在健康领域范围综述中使用 Elicit 的方法学评估
articles.abstract: Background Artificial intelligence (AI) tools have the potential to improve the efficiency of systematic and scoping reviews, particularly in data extraction. However, uncertainty remains regarding the reliability of AI-assisted extraction and how such tools can be integrated into evidence synthesis workflows without compromising methodological rigour. This study aimed to develop and evaluate a proportionate validation framework for AI-assisted data extraction within a health scoping review.Methods We previously conducted and published a traditional manual scoping review of wearable vital sign monitoring in hospitalised adults. In this study, we repeated the data extraction component using Elicit to assess the agreement, completeness, and consistency. Data extraction was performed using a structured prompting approach with dual human verification. A total of 53 full-text studies and 19 predefined data extraction fields were included. Agreement between AI-assisted and human extraction was assessed using Gwet’s agreement coefficient (AC2). Monte Carlo simulation was used to evaluate the performance of proportionate validation strategies under partial review scenarios.Results Overall agreement between AI-assisted and human data extraction was high, with a global AC2 of 0.960 (95% CI 0.951–0.972). Agreement varied across data fields but remained consistently strong. Simulation analyses demonstrated that partial validation approaches could achieve comparable reliability to full dual manual extraction under certain sampling conditions. Based on these findings, we propose a framework for the ethical use of AI-assisted data extraction using Elicit, incorporating structured human oversight to ensure accuracy and accountability.Conclusions AI-assisted data extraction, when implemented within a structured human-in-the-loop framework, can achieve high levels of reliability in evidence synthesis. A proportionate validation approach may offer a scalable alternative to full dual manual extraction.Systematic review registration Not applicable.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究旨在建立并评估一种比例化验证框架，用于在健康领域范围综述中安全整合 AI 辅助数据提取，同时保持方法学严谨性。作者以既往关于住院成人可穿戴生命体征监测的人工范围综述为基础，使用 Elicit 重新执行 53 篇全文研究、19 个预定义字段的数据提取，并采用结构化提示和双人工核验。研究使用 Gwet 一致性系数评估 AI 与人工提取的一致性，并通过蒙特卡罗模拟考察部分人工复核场景下比例化验证策略的表现。

articles.title: Magnetic Flux Density as a Driver of Chromospheric and Coronal Emissions During the Rise of Solar Cycle 25
articles.title_zh: 太阳第 25 周上升阶段磁通密度对色球和日冕辐射的驱动作用
articles.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between magnetic flux density (MFD) and key solar proxies (f10.7 cm radio flux, Mg II index, and Ca II K-line) during the ascending phase of Solar Cycle 25. Strong linear (((r = 0.94))--((0.96)))and monotonic (((h̊o = 0.85))) correlations indicate that solar magnetic fields are the primary drivers of chromosphericand coronal emissions. The temporal hierarchy revealed by correlogram analysis shows that MFD leads the chromospheric indices by 33 days, whileit has no lag with f10.7 cm, which is significant for space weather prediction. Wavelet analysis further identifies synchronized variability on 16--32 day timescales associated with solar rotation, reflecting coherent periodic behavior across different layersof the solar atmosphere.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究分析太阳第 25 周上升阶段磁通密度（MFD）与 f10.7 cm 射电流量、Mg II 指数和 Ca II K 线等太阳活动代理指标之间的关系。强线性相关（r=0.94–0.96）和强单调相关（ρ=0.85）表明太阳磁场是色球和日冕辐射变化的主要驱动因素。相关图分析显示 MFD 领先色球指标约 33 天、与 f10.7 cm 基本无滞后；小波分析还识别出与太阳自转相关的 16–32 天同步变率。

articles.title: Spin modulations in the Rashba-Hubbard chain -- a tensor network study
articles.title_zh: Rashba-Hubbard链中的自旋调制：张量网络研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26014v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Uniform spin-orbit coupling in an open single-band Hubbard chain is an exactly removable (SU(2)) gauge field at the Hamiltonian level, but not at the level of laboratory-frame spin correlations. We study this separation using density matrix renormalization group calculations for the repulsive one-dimensional Rashba-Hubbard chain. For open boundary conditions, a site-dependent spin rotation maps the model with hopping (t) and Rashba spin-orbit strength (łambda) onto the ordinary Hubbard chain with renormalized hopping (t_łambda=sqrtt²⁺łambda²). Consequently, charge and energy diagnostics are affected only through the bandwidth renormalization, which is quadratic in weak (łambda/t). Spin correlations, however, respond already at linear order because the same transformation rotates the local spin basis by the wave vector (kₘ̊ ₛₒ=2arctan(łambda/t)). We use DMRG to verify this observable consequence across the filling diagram of finite open chains. The filling structure follows the gauge-equivalent Hubbard model, whereas the spin structure factor shows the predicted spin-orbit sidebands. A dominant Hubbard-chain magnetic wave vector (k₀) is transformed into components at (k₀± kₘ̊ ₛₒ), folded into the open-chain Brillouin zone. At half filling, where (k₀₌π), the two sidebands fold onto a single, in-plane, spin spiral wave with (k=π-kₘ̊ ₛₒ<π). Away from half filling, the incommensurate Hubbard spin response splits into two distinct spin-orbit-shifted components, producing a real-space beating pattern. Our results provide a filling-resolved tensor-network benchmark for the exactly removable limit of one-dimensional spin-orbit coupling, and establish a controlled reference point for ladders, multiorbital chains, rings, proximitized wires, and higher-dimensional Hubbard systems where spin-orbit coupling can no longer be gauged away.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文用密度矩阵重整化群研究具有排斥相互作用的一维开边界Rashba-Hubbard链。作者指出，均匀自旋—轨道耦合在哈密顿量层面可通过位置依赖的SU(2)规范变换消去，并等价为跃迁幅重整化的普通Hubbard链，因此电荷与能量性质主要体现带宽变化。相反，实验室坐标系中的自旋关联会因局域自旋基旋转而在线性阶出现响应，并在自旋结构因子中表现为自旋—轨道边带。
authors: Jozef Genzor, Roman Krčmár, Andrej Gendiar, Chia-Min Chung, Denis Kochan

articles.title: Paleomagnetic signatures of core-mantle interactions inferred from top-heavy thermochemical geodynamo simulations
articles.title_zh: 由顶重热化学地球发电机模拟推断的核幔相互作用古地磁特征
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.26042v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The time-averaged geomagnetic field provides crucial insights into deep Earth dynamics and thermal core-mantle interactions. Paleomagnetic observations and numerical dynamo simulations are equivocal regarding the longitudinal structure of the time-averaged field, though the latter have often considered a generic buoyancy source, which may obscure distinct signatures of thermal and chemical buoyancy that arise near the equator and poles, respectively. In this study, we present a new suite of top-heavy geodynamo simulations, varying the relative strengths of thermal and chemical driving and comparing the resultant magnetic signatures to observational field models spanning centuries to tens of thousands of years. None of the spatially-averaged measures of field morphology and variability we tested could robustly distinguish between different levels of chemical driving or the presence of heterogeneous outer boundary heat flux. On the other hand, observational constraints requiring longitudinal variations in time-averaged inclination anomaly are readily matched by simulations with heterogeneous outer boundary thermal forcing, in contrast to those with homogeneous mantle heat flux. Longitudinal field structures are reduced, but not erased, by elevated chemical driving, which also promotes the formation and deepening of polar minima in the radial magnetic field. Our simulations indicate that both the strong heat flux heterogeneity and chemical driving in Earth's core are likely to result in small but persistent departures from the geocentric axial dipole approximation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过一组顶重热化学地球发电机数值模拟，考察热驱动和化学驱动相对强度以及外边界热通量非均一性对时间平均地磁场的影响。作者将模拟磁场特征与覆盖数百年至数万年尺度的观测场模型进行比较。结果显示，若干空间平均的场形态和变率指标难以稳健区分不同化学驱动强度或边界热通量异质性；而时间平均倾角异常的经向变化更容易由具有非均一外边界热强迫的模拟再现。
authors: Souvik Naskar, Jonathan E. Mound, Christopher J. Davies, Hannah F. Rogers, Stephen J. Mason, Andrew T. Clarke

articles.title: Knowledge-Constrained Neural Completion of Islamic Geometric Patterns with Symmetry Guarantees
articles.title_zh: 具有对称性保证的知识约束神经补全伊斯兰几何图案
articles.abstract: Islamic geometric patterns are governed by exact rotational symmetry and precise constructional rules. We treat these rules as formal geometric domain knowledge and embed them into a neural graph-completion framework through an orbit-structured candidate lattice. A pattern that merely looks plausible may still be structurally invalid if this knowledge is violated. The method predicts edges and bounded curve refinements over a candidate lattice organised into rotational orbits, and enforces symmetry either through an orbit-tied architecture or through inference-time orbit projection. The orbit-tied variant guarantees exact N-fold symmetry, anchor preservation, and bounded refinement for any input and any orbit-level selection policy, and these invariants are verified numerically. The present implementation addresses rotational symmetry, and all quantitative experiments use procedurally generated pattern graphs inspired by Islamic geometric design. These experiments show that exact validity introduces no measurable loss in completion fidelity on clean inputs. When control geometry is missing, clean-trained unstructured decoding loses fidelity and accumulates symmetry violations. Training with corrupted inputs recovers most of this fidelity, but does not restore exact validity, whereas symmetry-structured inference preserves zero orbit violations throughout. These results show that data augmentation and symmetry structure address complementary failure modes, since augmentation improves fidelity while symmetry structure guarantees validity. A procedural template baseline further shows that high overlap can be achieved through edge over-completion, confirming that fidelity alone is insufficient for this domain. The framework generates scalable vector Islamic geometric ornament across multiple symmetry orders and motif families, providing a knowledge-constrained and guarantee-backed approach to structurally reliable neural completion in a domain where validity depends on exact geometric knowledge.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将伊斯兰几何图案中的精确旋转对称性和构造规则形式化为几何领域知识，并嵌入神经图补全框架。方法在按旋转轨道组织的候选格点上预测边和有界曲线细化，并通过轨道绑定结构或推理阶段投影来强制满足对称性。轨道绑定方案可保证任意输入下的精确N重对称、锚点保持和有界细化；在程序生成的图案图实验中，精确有效性在干净输入上未造成可测的补全精度损失。

articles.title: An Intelligent Well Log Based Lithology Identification Method Integrating Unsupervised Clustering and BiLSTM-CRF
articles.title_zh: 融合无监督聚类与BiLSTM-CRF的智能测井岩性识别方法
articles.abstract: Accurate lithology identification from well logs is essential for reservoir characterization, stratigraphic interpretation, and hydrocarbon exploration. However, lithology prediction in heterogeneous reservoirs remains challenging because well log responses are nonlinear, lithological classes are strongly imbalanced, and logging curves are often incomplete. To address these issues, this study proposes an intelligent lithology identification method that integrates Gaussian mixture model based unsupervised clustering with a bidirectional long short-term memory conditional random field network. First, well log curves are standardized, reconstructed, and screened to reduce dimensional inconsistency and improve data continuity. Second, GMM is used to model the statistical distribution of multi-parameter logging responses and generate geologically constrained pseudo-labels. Finally, BiLSTM extracts bidirectional sequential features along the depth domain, while CRF imposes global constraints on adjacent lithological transitions. The proposed workflow is evaluated using classification metrics, error analysis, and multi-well prediction experiments from the Viking Graben well log dataset. Results show that the proposed GMM-BiLSTM-CRF model achieves an overall accuracy of 93.18% and a single-well average accuracy of 90.1%, while maintaining stable performance under incomplete logging-curve conditions. The method provides a data-driven and geologically consistent solution for automatic lithology identification and can support reservoir evaluation and geological interpretation in complex subsurface settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向非均质储层中测井响应非线性、岩性类别不平衡和曲线缺失等问题，提出一种融合高斯混合模型无监督聚类与BiLSTM-CRF的岩性识别流程。方法首先对测井曲线进行标准化、重构和筛选，再用GMM生成带地质约束的伪标签。随后BiLSTM提取沿深度方向的双向序列特征，CRF对相邻岩性转移施加全局约束，并在Viking Graben测井数据集上通过多井预测和误差分析进行评估。

articles.title: Robotic Arm-Assisted Droplet-Based Additive Manufacturing via Acoustic Levitation: Process Implementation and Experimental Optimization
articles.title_zh: 声悬浮辅助的机器人臂液滴增材制造：工艺实现与实验优化
articles.abstract: This paper presents the concept, implementation and process optimization of a robotic arm-assisted additive manufacturing system using acoustic levitation for droplet-based deposition of photocurable resin. By integrating acoustic levitation and robotic manipulation, the tank-free material deposition approach has the potential to overcome the limitations inherent in conventional 3D printing - such as fixed build directions, planar layers and the reliance on resin tanks. The focus of this study is on experimental characterization and process optimization. Necessary aspects of implementing the additive manufacturing system were investigated, including the ultraviolet (UV) light profile characterization, resin curing characterization and contact angle measurement. A Taguchi experiment- based process optimization further revealed the optimal combination of process parameters for surface quality on continuously deposited droplets. Implementation of the system was demonstrated using a commercial photocurable resin. This work paves the way for the development of a multi-material contactless and tankless additive manufacturing platform that supports multi-directional deposition.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出并实现了一种结合声悬浮与机器人操作的液滴式光固化树脂增材制造系统，用于无料槽、非接触材料沉积。作者对紫外光场、树脂固化行为和接触角等关键工艺环节进行了实验表征，并通过田口实验优化连续液滴沉积的表面质量。结果展示了商用光固化树脂的系统可行性，为多材料、无接触、无料槽和多方向沉积平台奠定基础。

articles.title: The Srx1-Prx/Trx System Is Involved in Ammonia-Induced Oxidative Injury in the Grass Carp Liver Cell Line L8824
articles.title_zh: Srx1-Prx/Trx系统参与氨诱导的草鱼肝细胞系L8824氧化损伤
articles.abstract: Ammonia exposure is an important stressor that impairs cellular homeostasis, yet the redox-regulatory mechanisms underlying ammonia-induced injury remain unclear. In this study, L8824, a grass carp liver cell line, was used to establish an in vitro ammonia stress model and to assess the involvement of the Srx1-Prx/Trx system in the response to NH₄Cl. Cells were treated with different NH₄Cl concentrations for 24 and 48 h, and cellular injury, oxidative stress, redox status, and transcriptional responses were evaluated. NH₄Cl induced time- and concentration-dependent cytotoxicity, including morphological deterioration, increased lactate dehydrogenase (LDH) release, and reduced cell viability. Accordingly, 20 mM NH₄Cl for 24 h was selected for subsequent mechanistic analyses. Under this condition, intracellular reactive oxygen species (ROS), malondialdehyde (MDA), superoxide dismutase (SOD) activity, and oxidized glutathione (GSSG) were increased, whereas glutathione (GSH) content was decreased, indicating oxidative stress and disruption of glutathione redox homeostasis. Quantitative PCR showed that ammonia stress significantly upregulated key Srx1-Prx/Trx system genes, including SRX1, TRX, PRX1, PRX2, PRX3, PRX4, and PRX5, and altered antioxidant enzyme- and apoptosis-related genes. Integrated correlation analysis revealed positive associations between the Srx1-Prx/Trx response module and oxidative stress/redox imbalance, cell injury, and apoptosis-related transcriptional responses. These findings indicate that NH₄Cl induces cellular injury and redox disturbance in L8824 cells, and that the Srx1-Prx/Trx system may represent a key antioxidant regulatory axis and a potential target for improving ammonia-stress tolerance in aquaculture fish.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以草鱼肝细胞系L8824建立体外氨胁迫模型，考察Srx1-Prx/Trx氧化还原调控系统在NH₄Cl诱导损伤中的作用。NH₄Cl处理导致细胞形态恶化、LDH释放增加和细胞活力下降，并在20 mM、24 h条件下引发ROS、MDA、SOD活性和GSSG升高以及GSH降低。qPCR结果显示氨胁迫显著上调Srx1-Prx/Trx系统关键基因，提示该系统参与氨毒性下的氧化应激响应。

articles.title: Global phylogeography of H10Nx avian influenza reveals regional persistence and an intensifying poultry-associated spillover interface
articles.title_zh: H10Nx禽流感的全球系统地理学揭示区域持续传播及增强的家禽相关溢出界面
articles.abstract: Influenza A viruses are maintained primarily in wild aquatic birds, but H10Nx viruses have repeatedly crossed host barriers into poultry, mammals, and humans. Despite increasing reports of reassortment, host expansion, and sporadic human infection, the global circulation history of H10Nx remains poorly resolved. Here, we assembled 1,045 non-redundant global H10Nx virus sequences collected from 1949 to 2023 and analyzed a clock-filtered dataset of 824 HA sequences using time-scaled phylogenetics, Bayesian phylogeography, source-sink inference, trunk persistence analysis, and site-level evolutionary screening. We found that H10Nx evolution is dominated by regionally structured persistence within major transmission pools, especially Atlantic America, East Asia, and Europe, rather than by frequent sustained intercontinental mixing. Anas-associated lineages contributed disproportionately to the long-term evolutionary backbone, whereas host-transition analyses supported a stepwise diffusion pattern from ducks to chickens and then sporadically to mammals. Within China, phylogeographic reconstruction revealed a sequential shift from an early Hong Kong-Hubei-Jiangxi focus to a Jiangxi-centered dissemination network and, more recently, to the eastern coastal provinces, especially Jiangsu, Shanghai, and Zhejiang. Parallel evolution analysis identified recurrent substitutions at HA residue 130 as a candidate adaptive signal associated with recent host expansion. Overall, H10Nx follows a structured metapopulation model in which duck-associated maintenance, poultry amplification, and episodic long-distance lineage seeding jointly shape global diversification. These findings provide a clearer evolutionary framework for interpreting the continued emergence of H10Nx viruses at the duck-chicken-human interface.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究整合1949—2023年全球1045条非冗余H10Nx病毒序列，并对824条经分子钟过滤的HA序列开展时间尺度系统发育、贝叶斯系统地理和来源-汇分析。结果表明，H10Nx演化主要由大西洋美洲、东亚和欧洲等区域传播池内的长期持续维持驱动，而非频繁的持续性洲际混合。宿主转移分析支持病毒由鸭类逐步扩散至鸡并偶发溢出至哺乳动物，中国内部传播中心也呈现阶段性空间转移。

articles.title: Development of Advanced Materials for High Temperature stable Drilling Fluids to Unlock Deep Geothermal Energy
articles.title_zh: 用于开发深层地热能的高温稳定钻井液先进材料
articles.abstract: The drilling of deep geothermal wells requires water-based drilling fluids that retain rheological function under prolonged exposure to high temperatures and pressures. Conventional bentonite-based fluids rely on electrostatic edge–face interactions between smectite platelets to generate yield stress and shear-thinning behaviour; however, these interactions weaken at elevated temperature, leading to loss of suspension capacity in polymer-free systems. In this study, we investigate the use of layered double hydroxides (LDHs) and related inorganic colloidal particles to stabilise polymer-free bentonite drilling fluids through particle-mediated network formation. A simple water-dispersed base fluid comprising sodium bentonite and Laponite RD was modified with colloidal particles of hydrotalcite, magnesium hydroxide, aluminium hydroxide, and magnesium oxide. The clays and colloidal particles were characterised using scanning electron microscopy, particle size analysis, zeta potential measurements, and elemental analysis. Rheological properties were evaluated before and after 16 h thermal aging at temperatures up to 300°C, with post-aging rheology measured at 25°C. Hydrotalcite platelets (≈ 200 nm) at concentrations of 0.4–1.0 wt% enabled retention of strongly shear-thinning rheology and yield stress after thermal aging at 300°C, while magnesium hydroxide platelets (≈ 300 nm) provided stability after aging at 240°C. In contrast, magnesium oxide and aluminium hydroxide did not confer comparable high-temperature stability. The enhanced performance of hydrotalcite is attributed to the formation of a hybrid LDH–clay platelet network in which load-bearing stress is redistributed from thermally fragile smectite edge interactions to thermally robust platelet–platelet interactions.
