More encouragingly, the additive combination of FEC and LiBTCB enables a high specific energy battery system of LiNi0.8Co0.1Mn0.1O2/SiOx-Graphite with unprecedented high capacity retention of 80.9% after 600 cycles at 50 °C. It is also disclosed that this additive combination contributes to construct robust interphases on both electrodes. This research underscores the great importance of low-carbon and computation-efficient machine learning assisted additives molecular design in tailoring electrolytes and interphases for next generation LIBs with high specific energy density.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对含SiOx负极和高镍正极高比能锂离子电池在高温循环中受LiPF6-碳酸酯电解液热不稳定限制的问题，解析了FEC辅助电解液的耦合降解路径。作者指出，Lewis酸PF5和微量水是高温下推动FEC水解与开环聚合的主要因素，相关反应会产生腐蚀性HF和阻碍锂离子传输的聚合物。研究进一步采用资源高效、物理启发的高通量机器学习筛选流程，在大规模分子库中快速识别出排名靠前的富氰添加剂LiBTCB，用于缓解高温降解。

articles.title: The Empty Ring Rule: A Universal Aromaticity Code for Engineering Magnetic Nanographenes
articles.title_zh: 空环规则：用于工程化磁性纳米石墨烯的通用芳香性编码
articles.abstract: Aromaticity and antiaromaticity underpin the emergence of magnetic open shell states in nanographenes, yet their perceived ambiguity has limited their use as reliable design principles for magnetic carbon materials. Recent atomically precise syntheses of Stone–Wales (SW)–modified armchair graphene nanoribbons (AGNRs) highlight the need for simple, predictive rules that connect local aromaticity to structural stability and magnetic response. We introduce the Empty Ring Rule (ERR), a general aromaticity based design framework derived from the aromaticity pattern (AP) of the parent AGNR. APs identify aromatic (“full”) and non aromatic (“empty”) rings, the latter serving as optimal sites for SW insertion. ERR is robust to the choice of aromaticity descriptor and is uniquely determined by the ribbon width Z through the relation Z = 3n or 3n ± 1, enabling descriptor independent predictions. ERR not only accounts for the behavior of recently synthesized SW AGNRs but also predicts a lower energy 4×2 SW isomer with an identical excitation spectrum yet a clearly differentiated Raman response. Moreover, ERR reveals that Z=4 AGNRs and their SW modified analogues possessing Clar type aromaticity patterns, due to a synergy of ERR and Clar’s rules, are inherently more stable, aromatic, and planar, as well as energetically “more economical” to synthesize than Z=3 or Z=2 systems, the latter showing strong odd–even variations in their magnetic, electronic, and structural properties. This framework provides a computationally efficient, conceptually transparent route for designing magnetic nanographenes with atomic precision.
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作提出“空环规则”（ERR），将母体扶手椅型石墨烯纳米带的芳香性图样与Stone–Wales缺陷插入位置、结构稳定性和磁响应联系起来。作者认为非芳香性的“空环”是SW插入的优选位点，且该规则对芳香性描述符具有稳健性，并可由纳米带宽度类别进行预测。该框架解释了近期合成的SW改性AGNR行为，并预测了能量更低、光谱相近但拉曼响应可区分的异构体。

articles.title: Properties of Heavy Cosmic Nuclei Phosphorus, Chlorine, Argon, Potassium, and Calcium: Results from the Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer
articles.title_zh: 重宇宙线核磷、氯、氩、钾和钙的性质：阿尔法磁谱仪结果
articles.abstract: Author(s): A. Aceituno et al. (AMS Collaboration) We report the unique properties of cosmic phosphorus (P), chlorine (Cl), argon (Ar), potassium (K), and calcium (Ca) fluxes in the GV to TV rigidity range collected by the Alpha Magnetic Spectrometer (AMS) on the International Space Station. With a total of one million events collected over 13.5 yea… [Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 241002] Published Wed Jun 17, 2026

articles.title: Predicting the hydrogen bond strength from water reorientation dynamics at short timescales
articles.title_zh: 由短时间尺度水分子取向动力学预测氢键强度
articles.abstract: Path-integral molecular dynamics simulations and electronic structure-based energy decomposition analysis (EDA) are employed to connect hydrogen bond (H-bond) strength, its asymmetry, and the total delocalization energy at the water/air interface to experimentally measurable observables, such as the reorientation dynamics and the sum-frequency generation (SFG) spectrum. Using SFG spectra for distinct layers at the water/air interface, we validate the accuracy of our simulations and report a red-shift from the interface to the bulk and a strongly bonded water peak at around 3250 cm −1 in the layer closest to the bulk. The reorientation dynamics of water molecules slow down from the interface to the bulk, which correlates with the SFG results. From our EDA based on absolutely localized molecular orbitals, we observe a strong decline in total delocalization energy from bulk to the interface, as well as a decline in the strength of the strongest donor and acceptor interactions. The asymmetry between the two strongest interactions similarly rises toward the interface, while the importance of interactions from the outer solvation shells is greatly diminished and is lower than previously reported. Finally, we find that the strength of the strongest H-bond donor/acceptor is best correlated with the local minimum of the autocorrelation function resembling the L2 band librational motions. Following that, we propose a simple yet quantitative relationship between H-bond strength and the short-time reorientation dynamics at the water/air interface, which could potentially be extended to predict H-bond strength in other hydrophobic systems from experimentally obtainable observables.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究结合路径积分分子动力学模拟和基于电子结构的能量分解分析，建立水/空气界面氢键强度、不对称性和离域能与可实验观测量之间的联系。研究利用不同界面层的和频产生光谱验证模拟，并发现从界面到体相存在红移以及靠近体相层中约3250 cm−1的强氢键水峰。水分子取向动力学从界面到体相逐渐变慢，且总离域能和最强供受体相互作用强度从体相到界面明显下降，氢键不对称性则向界面增强。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Two-dimensional IR–Raman spectroscopy of vibrational polaritons: Role of dipole surfaces
articles.title_zh: 振动极化激元的二维红外–拉曼光谱：偶极面作用
articles.abstract: Nonlinear spectroscopy provides a unique perspective to understand time-resolved molecular dynamics under vibrational strong coupling (VSC). Herein, equilibrium–nonequilibrium cavity molecular dynamics simulations are performed to compute the two-dimensional (2D) infrared–infrared–Raman (IIR) spectroscopy of liquid water under VSC. In conventional computational chemistry practices, accurate molecular spectra are often constructed by using an advanced molecular dipole or polarizability model to post-process molecular dynamics trajectories evolved under a computationally efficient potential. By contrast, this work highlights the necessity of employing a consistent dipole surface model in both cavity molecular dynamics (CavMD) simulations and spectroscopic post-processing. While utilizing inconsistent dipole models only mildly influences the linear polariton spectrum, it severely distorts 2D spectra in wide frequency regions. With a consistent dipole–induced-dipole model, compared to the outside-cavity molecular 2D-IIR spectrum, the cavity 2D-IIR spectrum splits the OH stretch band to a pair of polariton branches only along the IR (not Raman) axis, while fading molecular signals at other frequency regions. This work provides the foundation for employing direct CavMD simulations to construct 2D spectra of realistic molecules under VSC.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过平衡–非平衡腔分子动力学模拟，计算了振动强耦合下液态水的二维红外–红外–拉曼光谱。作者指出，在腔分子动力学模拟和光谱后处理中必须采用一致的偶极面模型；不一致的偶极模型对线性极化激元谱影响较小，却会在宽频范围内严重扭曲二维光谱。使用一致的偶极–诱导偶极模型时，腔内二维光谱显示OH伸缩带沿红外轴分裂为一对极化激元分支，而分子信号发生明显变化。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: On the single-Hessian Gaussian wavepacket dynamics
articles.title_zh: 关于单Hessian高斯波包动力学
articles.abstract: Single-Hessian Gaussian wavepacket dynamics (GWD) significantly reduces the computational burden of Heller’s local harmonic GWD while maintaining comparable accuracy in approximating vibronic spectra. Here, we provide a new, symplectic derivation of the equations of motion of single-Hessian GWD and show that, unlike the local harmonic version, this method conserves the non-canonical symplectic structure on the manifold of Gaussian wavepackets and—for bounded dynamics in smooth potentials—avoids the drift of energy. Our numerical results suggest that, despite being much more efficient than the local harmonic variant, the single-Hessian GWD exhibits the same O(ℏ) asymptotic error in averages of observables. To further accelerate numerical simulations, we implement high-order time-stepping geometric integrators that are time-reversible and conserve the norm and symplectic structure exactly, regardless of the time step. In addition, we present explicit expressions for the exact evolution of the width of a single-Hessian Gaussian wavepacket in a general potential, as well as for the exact evolution of the whole wavepacket in a global harmonic potential. Using on-the-fly ab initio Gaussian wavepacket dynamics on the first excited-state surface of ammonia, we numerically confirm the conservation of geometric properties by these integrators and demonstrate that high-order integrators can enhance both accuracy and computational efficiency. We also compute the photoelectron spectrum of the difluorocarbene anion and the absorption spectrum of methylamine and find that, in comparison with experiment, single-Hessian GWD outperforms global harmonic models and matches the accuracy of local harmonic GWD. Finally, we identify which spectral features are sensitive to the choice of reference Hessian.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究对单Hessian高斯波包动力学方程给出了新的辛几何推导，说明其在保持较高效率的同时可近似振电子光谱。与局域谐近似方法不同，该方法在高斯波包流形上保持非正则辛结构，并在光滑势中的有界动力学下避免能量漂移。作者还实现了高阶几何时间积分器，并给出波包宽度及全局谐势中波包精确演化的表达式，以进一步加速数值模拟。
articles.journal: The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

articles.title: Urban Ecological Corridors: Connecting Forest Fragments Associated with Protected Springs in the Southern Amazon
articles.title_zh: 城市生态廊道：连接南亚马孙受保护泉源相关森林斑块
articles.abstract: Rapid urban expansion and native vegetation fragmentation have significantly reduced ecological connectivity in tropical landscapes, compromising ecosystem functioning and biodiversity persistence. This study aimed to identify potential ecological corridors connecting forest fragments associated with protected springs within the urban perimeter of Alta Floresta, located in the Southern Brazilian Amazon. The analysis integrated land use and land cover data, landscape ecology metrics, and resistance surfaces derived from environmental variables relevant to arboreal fauna movement. Landscape resistance was modeled using the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP), incorporating variables such as land use, forest fragments, Permanent Preservation Areas (APPs), and slope. Connectivity was assessed using Least-Cost Path (LCP) modeling. The results revealed potential connectivity routes among multiple forest fragments associated with protected springs. Larger fragments linked to Saracura II (15.04 ha) and Buritis (14.51 ha) springs were identified as key structural nodes within the urban ecological network. The most favorable corridors are concentrated in the central and southeastern portions of the urban area, where resistance values are lower and vegetation continuity is higher. These findings demonstrate that urban landscapes in the Southern Amazon still retain structural elements capable of sustaining ecological connectivity when forest fragments and riparian vegetation are integrated into urban planning. The proposed approach provides relevant spatial support for biodiversity conservation strategies and green infrastructure planning in expanding Amazonian cities.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对巴西亚马孙南部阿尔塔弗洛雷斯塔城市范围内快速扩张与植被破碎化导致的生态连通性下降问题，识别连接受保护泉源相关森林斑块的潜在生态廊道。研究整合土地利用/覆盖、景观生态指标以及基于土地利用、森林斑块、永久保护区和坡度等变量构建的阻力面，并采用层次分析法和最小累积阻力路径模型评估连通性。结果显示，多处泉源相关森林斑块之间存在潜在连接路径，其中Saracura II和Buritis泉源附近较大斑块是城市生态网络的重要结构节点，有利廊道主要集中在城市中部和东南部区域。

articles.title: Origin of enhanced muon-spin relaxation rate in superconducting Sr2RuO4
articles.title_zh: 超导体Sr2RuO4中增强μ子自旋弛豫率的起源
articles.abstract: Broken time-reversal symmetry (BTRS) in superconductors is widely regarded as evidence for a multicomponent order parameter, yet the microscopic origin of the associated spontaneous magnetic fields remains unresolved. Sr2RuO4 is a central example, where BTRS has been reported by several probes but its relation to superconductivity remains controversial. Here we use zero-field muon spin relaxation (μSR) to investigate how spontaneous magnetic fields evolve with pair-breaking disorder and crystal inhomogeneity in Sr2RuO4. We combine measurements on Sr2−yLayRuO4 single crystals at ambient pressure with measurements on stoichiometric Sr2RuO4 under hydrostatic pressure, and compare these results with literature data spanning samples with different levels of inhomogeneity and Ru inclusions. We find that the superconductivity-induced enhancement of the exponential muon-spin relaxation rate, ∆Λ, associated with spontaneous magnetic fields decreases monotonically with La substitution and hydrostatic pressure, following approximately ∆Λ ∝ Tc2 when the effective density of field-generating inhomogeneities remains nearly unchanged. In contrast, ∆Λ is enhanced in samples containing stronger structural inhomogeneities, including nonmagnetic random disorder and Ru inclusions. These results support a picture in which spontaneous magnetic fields in Sr2RuO4 are generated by nonmagnetic inhomogeneities within a BTRS superconducting state, with the strength controlled by the superconducting order parameter. More broadly, our findings provide an experimental framework for interpreting local magnetic signatures in multicomponent superconductors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用零场μ子自旋弛豫实验考察Sr2RuO4中自发磁场如何随破坏配对的无序和晶体不均匀性变化，以澄清其时间反演对称性破缺信号与超导性的关系。作者比较了La替代单晶、静水压力下化学计量比样品以及文献中不同不均匀性和Ru夹杂水平样品的数据。结果表明，在场产生不均匀性有效密度近似不变时，超导诱导的指数弛豫率增强随La替代和压力单调减小，并近似服从与Tc平方相关的趋势；而更强结构不均匀性样品中该信号会增强。

articles.title: Optimization of Karonda (Carissa carandas L.) Bread Spread Formulation Using Box–Behnken Response Surface Methodology and Its Nutritional Evaluation
articles.title_zh: 利用Box–Behnken响应面法优化卡龙达果面包涂抹酱配方及其营养评价
articles.abstract: Karonda is an underutilized indigenous berry fruit possessing high nutritional value, a distinctive sour taste, and adaptability to semi-arid regions. However, its short shelf life and lack of consumer awareness have limited its utilization and commercial importance. The present study aimed to develop and optimize a karonda-based bread-spread using Response Surface Methodology and a Box–Behnken Design. Three independent variables, namely aonla pulp (50–70 g), sugar (45–55 g), and citric acid (0.5–1.0 g), were optimized through 15 experimental runs generated using Design Expert® software version 13. Physicochemical, nutritional, and color parameters including total soluble solids (TSS), total sugars, reducing sugars, titratable acidity, ascorbic acid, flavonoids, antioxidant activity, β-carotene, total phenolic content (TPC), soluble protein, viscosity, and colour values (L*, a*, b*) were evaluated. Second-order regression models adequately fitted all responses. The optimized formulation consisted of 56.613 g aonla pulp, 54.607 g sugar, and 0.815 g citric acid, with an overall desirability score of 1.000. The optimized bread-spread exhibited maximum values of 66.10% TSS, 52.68% total sugars, 12.89% reducing sugars, 1.44% titratable acidity, 25.80 mg/100 g ascorbic acid, 10.40% flavonoids, 30.18% antioxidant activity, 4921.84 IU/100 g β-carotene, 107.37 mg GAE/100 g TPC, 0.991% soluble protein, and 1204.34 P.a viscosity. The colour values recorded were L* 12.75, a* 16.25, and b* 13.55. Experimental values showed close agreement with predicted values, confirming the suitability of the optimization model. The study demonstrated the potential of karonda fruit for the development of a nutritious and value-added bread-spread product.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以营养价值高但利用不足、货架期短的本土浆果卡龙达为原料，采用响应面法和Box–Behnken设计开发并优化面包涂抹酱配方。研究以余甘子果浆、糖和柠檬酸为自变量，评估总可溶性固形物、糖类、酸度、抗坏血酸、黄酮、抗氧化活性、β-胡萝卜素、总酚、蛋白、黏度和色泽等指标。二阶回归模型能较好拟合各响应，优化配方为约56.613 g果浆、54.607 g糖和0.815 g柠檬酸，综合期望值达到1.000，并表现出较高的可溶性固形物和营养功能成分水平。

articles.title: Moore–Gibson–Thompson Modeling of Mechanical and Magnetic Field Effects in Thermo-Microstretch Media with Variable Thermal Conductivity
articles.title_zh: 变热导率热微伸缩介质中机械与磁场效应的Moore–Gibson–Thompson建模
articles.abstract: The study aims to understand and predict how mechanical forces and magnetic fields affect heat transfer, deformation, and microstructural behavior in thermo-micro-stretch materials with temperature-dependent thermal conductivity using the advanced Moore–Gibson–Thompson thermoelastic framework. A generalized magneto-thermo-micro-stretch model is formulated within the framework of the Moore–Gibson–Thompson theory to account for finite thermal-wave propagation. The governing equations of motion, microstretch deformation, heat conduction, and electromagnetic interactions are derived for a thermo-microstretch medium with variable thermal conductivity. The resulting system of coupled partial differential equations is transformed using analytical techniques such as the normal mode method. Parametric analyses are carried out to investigate the influence of magnetic field intensity, mechanical loading, and thermal conductivity variation, on the thermoelastic response of the medium. Graphical representations are used to compare the effects of different physical parameters and to illustrate wave propagation characteristics. The magnetic field alters the distributions of displacement, stress, temperature, and microstretch parameters, generally enhancing the coupling between thermal and mechanical responses. Variable thermal conductivity substantially influences heat propagation and temperature distribution, leading to noticeable changes in the associated stress and deformation fields. The integration of these features into a unified analytical model represents an extension of existing thermo-elastic studies and provides new insights into the behavior of micro-structured materials subjected to coupled thermo-mechanical and electromagnetic influences.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究在Moore–Gibson–Thompson热弹性理论框架下，建立含温度相关热导率的磁-热-微伸缩介质模型，以描述有限速度热波传播。作者推导了运动方程、微伸缩变形、热传导和电磁相互作用的耦合偏微分方程，并采用正规模等解析方法进行变换求解。参数分析显示，磁场强度、机械载荷和热导率变化会显著影响位移、应力、温度及微结构响应分布，并改变介质中的波传播特征。

articles.title: High degree of quantum entanglement detected for first time in centimeter-sized crystal of strange metal
articles.title_zh: 首次在厘米级奇异金属晶体中探测到高程度量子纠缠
articles.abstract: Many quantum effects can be observed only when a small number of particles is studied—individual atoms, molecules or photons, for example, carefully shielded from the rest of the world. But what about macroscopic objects, consisting of an unimaginably large number of particles? Can they, too, display effects that provide a direct glimpse into the quantum world?
articles.abstract_zh: 这篇物理新闻报道围绕宏观尺度物体是否能展现可直接揭示量子世界的效应展开，重点介绍在厘米级奇异金属晶体中探测到高程度量子纠缠的进展。原摘要仅提供背景性引入，未给出实验体系、测量方法或定量结果等细节，需查阅原文了解具体发现和意义。
