articles.title: PHINN: Persistent Homology Inspired Neural Network for Rare-Event Time Series Generation
articles.title_zh: PHINN：受持久同调启发的稀有事件时间序列生成神经网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Rare events in time series are critical to model but hard to learn due to data scarcity. Current generative models struggle with extreme values. We observe that rare events leave distinct topological fingerprints - transitions in Betti numbers from point-cloud embeddings - that are more stable and discriminative than statistical moments. We introduce PHINN, a flow-matching framework using dynamic Betti curves as conditioning signals and a persistence landscape loss for homology consistency. It scales to multivariate data, includes a natural-language interface to set Betti targets, supports cross-domain meta-learning and few-shot generation, and provides certified adversarial robustness. On financial, epidemiological, and multi-modal benchmarks, PHINN outperforms statistical and diffusion baselines in topological fidelity (beta-RMSE down 41-63%, transition accuracy up 84%) and matches jump-diffusion models in tail coverage while exceeding them in shape fidelity. All results have 95% confidence intervals.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对时间序列中稀有事件数据稀缺、极端值难以学习的问题，提出 PHINN 生成框架。方法将点云嵌入产生的动态 Betti 曲线作为条件信号，并加入持久性景观损失以保持同调一致性。实验覆盖金融、流行病学和多模态基准，结果显示 PHINN 在拓扑保真度、状态转变识别和尾部分布覆盖方面优于统计与扩散基线。
authors: Emre Yusuf, Ren Takahashi, Jayabrata Bhaduri

articles.title: Scalar-pathway fidelity improves physical accuracy in short-range equivariant interatomic potentials
articles.title_zh: 标量通路保真度提升短程等变原子间势的物理精度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15892v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate interatomic potentials enable molecular dynamics of materials, molecules, and interfaces beyond density-functional-theory length and time scales. Equivariant neural network potentials have improved the representation of local geometry. However, their deployable energy surfaces ultimately manifest through invariant scalar channels, whose aggregation and spectral resolution remain comparatively underexamined. Here we use Physics-Aware Neighborhood (PAN) pooling and Physics-Guided Spectral (PGS) mixers as controlled scalar-pathway probes: lightweight, symmetry-preserving modifications that act only on (ell=0) channels while leaving the equivariant tensor backbone unchanged. Using MACE as a high-body-order mechanistic scaffold, PAN adds coordination-sensitive amplitude modulation, whereas PGS augments edge and readout scalar features with radial and tapered spectral bases. Across metallic Ag, covalent Si, a short-range ionic LiF/Li--F subset, and MD17/rMD17 molecules, this scalar-pathway correction reduces MACE force errors by 22--27% and energy errors by 19--22%; on systems with stress labels, stress errors decrease by 27--28%, at approximately 5% additional inference-FLOPs cost. Directionally consistent gains in Allegro and NequIP further indicate that the correction is portable across distinct short-range equivariant backbones, although effect sizes remain architecture-dependent. These results identify scalar-pathway fidelity as a practical design dimension for short-range equivariant interatomic potentials.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注等变神经网络原子间势中最终决定能量面的不变标量通道，提出以物理感知邻域池化和物理引导谱混合器作为轻量、保对称的标量通路修正。作者以 MACE 为高体阶骨架，在不改变等变张量主干的情况下增强配位敏感幅度调制和径向谱特征表达。多个金属、共价、离子及分子体系上的结果显示，该修正可降低力、能量和应力预测误差。
authors: Jia Bi, Alin Marin Elena, Samuel Pinilla

articles.title: Mojo: A Promising Tool for Scalable Financial AI Efficiency
articles.title_zh: Mojo：提升可扩展金融人工智能效率的有前景工具
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16059v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: For thirty years, quantitative finance has paid a costly two-language tax: models researched in Python are rewritten in C++ for production, often introducing numerical discrepancies. GPU-accelerated deep learning exacerbates this problem, as nondeterministic floating-point reductions can produce drift in long backtests, challenging regulatory reproducibility and auditability expectations. This article surveys Mojo, Modular's 2026 Python-like systems language, as a structural response for capital markets engineering. While closing the Python-to-C++ performance gap, Mojo uniquely combines native interoperability with the low-level systems control required to construct bit-exact deterministic kernels. Its MLIR compilation infrastructure further allows a single codebase to target scalar, SIMD, multicore, and GPU execution, reducing the translation bottleneck between research and production. We benchmark four core financial AI workloads: Monte Carlo option pricing, LLM sentiment inference, multi-asset backtesting, and portfolio Value at Risk. On Apple Silicon, Mojo demonstrates 20x to 180x speedups over pure Python on directly measured kernels; larger-scale GPU workload results are projections calibrated from published benchmarks. Alongside transparent performance data, we introduce mojo-deterministic, an open-source library of reproducible reduction kernels, and provide a candid assessment of the problems Mojo does and does not yet solve.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文章评述 Mojo 作为一种类 Python 系统语言在资本市场工程中的潜力，旨在缓解量化金融长期存在的 Python 研究代码到 C++ 生产代码重写成本。作者强调 Mojo 兼具 Python 互操作性、底层系统控制和 MLIR 编译基础设施，可支持确定性内核并统一面向标量、SIMD、多核和 GPU 的执行。文中在蒙特卡罗期权定价、大语言模型情绪推断、多资产回测和投资组合风险价值等金融 AI 负载上给出性能基准，显示其相较纯 Python 具有显著加速潜力。

articles.title: Stop the Sampler! Classifier-Based Adaptive Stopping for Sampling Kernels
articles.title_zh: 停止采样器！基于分类器的采样核自适应停止方法
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16073v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sampling from complex, unnormalized probability densities is a fundamental challenge in Bayesian inference and probabilistic modeling. While Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) methods provide asymptotic guarantees, they often suffer from slow mixing and high computational costs due to fixed or manually tuned trajectory lengths. In this work, we propose a novel framework that treats trajectory termination as a learnable component of the sampling dynamics. By framing MCMC within the theory of non-acyclic generative flow networks (GFlowNets), we train state-dependent neural classifiers to decide when a trajectory has reached a high-density region and should terminate. We theoretically establish the connection between optimal classifiers and the target density via detailed balance conditions and introduce a multilevel training scheme to facilitate exploration in complex geometries. Experimental results across various benchmark densities demonstrate that our approach significantly reduces average trajectory lengths while improving mode coverage and mixing compared to standard MCMC baselines.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对复杂未归一化概率密度采样中 MCMC 轨迹长度固定或需手工调参导致的慢混合与高计算成本问题，提出将轨迹终止视为可学习的采样动态组件。作者在非无环生成流网络框架下训练状态依赖神经分类器，用于判断轨迹是否已到达高密度区域并应停止。理论上，文章通过细致平衡条件建立了最优分类器与目标密度之间的联系，并提出多层训练方案以增强复杂几何中的探索能力。实验显示，该方法在多种基准密度上可缩短平均轨迹长度，同时改善模态覆盖与混合效果。
authors: Kirill Korolev, Nikita Morozov, Stepan Pavlenko, Esmeralda S. Whitammer, Sergey Samsonov

articles.title: Phys-JEPA: Physics-Informed Latent World Models for Multivariate Time-Series Forecasting
articles.title_zh: Phys-JEPA：用于多变量时间序列预测的物理信息潜在世界模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16076v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multivariate forecasting in physical systems requires models that predict coupled temporal variables while preserving meaningful state evolution. Deep forecasters can fit temporal correlations, and physics-informed models can regularize predictions with scientific constraints, but these directions are often connected only at the decoded-output level. As a result, the hidden predictive state that generates future trajectories may remain statistically useful but physically unstructured. We introduce Phys-JEPA, a physics-informed joint-embedding predictive architecture for multivariate time-series forecasting. Phys-JEPA learns a latent world model in which predictive states are decomposed into physical and residual components, and physical consistency is imposed directly on latent states and latent transitions rather than only on decoded forecasts. This formulation uses known physical variables to organize the representation space while retaining residual capacity for unresolved dynamics. On Jena Climate 2009--2016, Phys-JEPA reduces aggregate MSE from 0.12482 to 0.12273 and temperature MSE from 0.01892 to 0.01831 at H=24. On Traffic, full Phys-JEPA improves aggregate MSE over the supervised baseline across all tested horizons, reducing H=192 MSE from 0.800784 to 0.773873. On Electricity, the best variant depends on horizon: static latent consistency is strongest at H=24 and H=48, while full Phys-JEPA gives the best aggregate and target-variable MSE at H=192. These initial results suggest that moving physics-informed learning from output space to latent predictive state space is a promising direction for interpretable temporal world models.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Phys-JEPA，一种面向物理系统多变量时间序列预测的物理信息联合嵌入预测架构。模型将潜在预测状态分解为物理成分与残差成分，并直接在潜在状态及其转移上施加物理一致性，而不仅限于解码输出层面的约束。通过已知物理变量组织表示空间，同时保留对未解析动力学的残差建模能力。实验在 Jena Climate 等数据集上显示，该方法可降低总体均方误差和温度预测误差。
authors: Weizhi Nie, Weichao Liu, Honglin Guo, Yuting Su

articles.title: A comparative and critical study of EEGNet for fNIRS-driven cognitive load classification
articles.title_zh: 面向 fNIRS 驱动认知负荷分类的 EEGNet 比较性与批判性研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16160v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurately classifying cognitive load from functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS) signals remains a significant challenge due to temporal variability, inter-subject differences, and sensitivity to preprocessing choices. This study provides a comprehensive evaluation of EEGNet for fNIRS-based cognitive load classification by systematically examining the effects of temporal segmentation strategies (overlapping vs. non-overlapping), window lengths (10s, 20s, 30s), feature extraction methods (Analysis of Variance (ANOVA), Principal Component Analysis (PCA), Fast Independent Component Analysis (FastICA)), learning rate configurations (fixed and adaptive), and evaluation protocols (random split vs. subject-independent (SI)). Results from random-split experiments show that overlapping segmentation, combined with smaller fixed learning rates (0.01-0.001), yields the highest accuracies, due to temporal redundancy and dense sampling of hemodynamic transitions. However, SI evaluation reveals a substantial drop in accuracy, demonstrating limited generalization to unseen participants. Under SI evaluation, non-overlapping segmentation outperformed overlapping windows, with the best accuracy of 56.11% achieved using PCA features with a 20-second window and a 0.1 learning rate. These findings indicate that eliminating temporal redundancy helps the model learn more robust and generalizable representations of cognitive load across individuals. Although adaptive learning rate strategy improved training stability, it did not surpass the performance of optimally selected fixed learning rates. The study highlights the critical role of segmentation strategy and learning rate selection in improving model generalization and identifies methodological considerations essential for developing reliable, real-time, and SI cognitive load classification systems using fNIRS.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究系统评估 EEGNet 在基于功能近红外光谱信号的认知负荷分类任务中的表现，考察时间分段方式、窗口长度、特征提取方法、学习率设置和评估协议等因素。随机划分实验表明，重叠分段结合较小固定学习率通常获得最高准确率，这主要受益于时间冗余和更密集的血流动力学过渡采样。然而，在被试独立评估下准确率显著下降，说明模型对未见参与者的泛化能力有限。结果强调了在 fNIRS 认知负荷分类中采用严格跨被试验证和谨慎预处理策略的重要性。
authors: Mehshan Ahmed Khan, Houshyar Asadi, Li Zhang, Mohammad reza Chalak Qazani, Ghazal Bargshady, Stefanos gkikas, Christian arzate, Sam Oladazimi, Zoran Najdovsk, Lei Wei, Chee Peng Lim

articles.title: BRICKS-WM: Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models
articles.title_zh: BRICKS-WM：通过接口组合动力学构建可复用的结构化世界模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16489v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Model-based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in continuous control by leveraging latent world models. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on monolithic latent dynamics, entangling environment dynamics into a coupled process. This coupling severely limits reusability: altering the agent necessitates retraining the entire world from scratch, even if the environment remains constant. To address this, we introduce BRICKS-WM (Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models), a framework for the modular assembly of structured world models. Driven by the insight that the physical world is composed of independent entities, we posit that global dynamics can be modeled as a composition of distinct dynamical modules interacting via latent interfaces. As a minimal instantiation, we factorize the latent state space into an actuated Agent module and an external Background module, bridged by a learned latent interface. Unlike prior object-centric methods that prioritize visual segmentation, BRICKS-WM enforces a functional separation in transition dynamics, ensuring that background dynamics remains agnostic to the agent's dynamics. Empirically, BRICKS-WM achieves control performance comparable to strong monolithic baselines when trained from scratch, and enables the reuse of frozen background dynamics across agents.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对基于模型的强化学习中潜在世界模型常采用整体式动力学、导致环境与智能体动态耦合并限制复用的问题，提出 BRICKS-WM 框架。其核心思想是将全局动力学建模为多个独立动力模块通过潜在接口交互的组合过程。作为最小实例，作者将潜在状态空间分解为受动作驱动的智能体模块和外部背景模块，并通过学习到的潜在接口连接二者。该方法强调转移动力学上的功能分离，而非仅进行视觉对象分割，从而有助于在智能体变化时复用环境相关模型组件。
authors: Shaowei Zhang, Jiahan Cao, Xunlan Zhou, Shenghua Wan, De-Chuan Zhan

articles.title: RepNet: Tackling spectral bias in deep neural networks via parameter reparameterization
articles.title_zh: RepNet：通过参数重参数化缓解深度神经网络的谱偏置
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16575v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in scientific computing, yet they often suffer from spectral bias in capturing oscillatory and multiscale behaviors. In this study, we investigate this limitation by examining the failure of shallow ReLU neural networks in fitting high-frequency functions. This observation identifies two important factors in resolving rapid oscillations: the initial slope scale and the distribution of partition points induced by the networks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose RepNet, a reparameterized DNN model for ReLU and tanh networks designed for high-frequency and multiscale problems. The key idea is to reparameterize the weights and biases in the first hidden layer, which enables effective control of the initial slope scale and provides an appropriate distribution of the initial partition points. Furthermore, treating the reparameterized weights and biases as trainable parameters allows the DNN to achieve adaptive frequency scaling during training. In addition, we derive quantitative estimates for the output and slope magnitudes of the reparameterized DNN to guide the initialization of the proposed method. Numerical experiments, including multiscale one- and four-dimensional function approximation, forward and inverse PDE problems in combination with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), and operator learning, demonstrate that RepNet improves the predicted accuracy of vanilla DNNs in capturing highly oscillatory features with slightly additional computational cost. These results indicate that RepNet provides an effective and flexible approach for overcoming spectral bias and applying DNNs to multiscale problems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注深度神经网络在科学计算中拟合振荡和多尺度行为时存在的谱偏置问题，并通过分析浅层 ReLU 网络拟合高频函数的失败机制，指出初始斜率尺度和网络诱导分割点分布是解析快速振荡的关键因素。作者提出 RepNet，对 ReLU 和 tanh 网络第一隐藏层的权重与偏置进行重参数化，以控制初始斜率尺度并形成更合适的初始分割点分布。重参数化参数在训练中可继续学习，从而实现自适应频率缩放。文中还给出了输出与斜率幅值的定量估计，用于指导模型初始化。
authors: Yong Wang, Tao Zhou, Xuhui Meng

articles.title: Beyond the Smile: A Hybrid Convolutional VAE for Crypto Volatility Surfaces
articles.title_zh: 超越波动率微笑：用于加密货币波动率曲面的混合卷积变分自编码器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16961v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We present a convolutional variational autoencoder for cryptocurrency implied-volatility surfaces, together with a deployable predictor that combines it with a quadratic smile re-fit through a deterministic per-tenor routing rule. Trained on 6,034 fully-filled hourly Binance Options surfaces of BTC and ETH spanning May-October 2023 and parameterised on a common 6 × 7 tenor-delta grid, the model attains a hidden-cell surface-completion RMSE in the 0.94-1.56 vol-point range across both markets and mask rates 10-50%. The hybrid predictor attains 0.83 vol points at 50% masking against 7.00 for the smile re-fit alone, an eightfold reduction obtained at no additional inference cost. Under structurally-correlated hole patterns that emulate the withdrawal of an entire tenor of strikes, the smile re-fit incurs 9.6-13.1 vol points of error while the learned model remains at 1.5-1.9, isolating a regime in which the generative model is the only viable predictor. Joint training on BTC and ETH improves the in-distribution model on both markets by 9-27% relative to the better-performing single-symbol counterpart, indicating a substantially shared vol-surface manifold across the two largest cryptocurrencies over the observation window. The hybrid is calendar- and butterfly-arbitrage-free at the listed strikes, a property that the parametric smile re-fit alone fails at high mask rates. The per-snapshot reconstruction error of the trained model flags the late-October ETF-anticipation rally and the August 17, 2023 flash crash as elevated-error periods without supervision. All training and evaluation infrastructure is released to support reproducible follow-on work.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于加密货币隐含波动率曲面的卷积变分自编码器，并结合按期限确定性路由的二次波动率微笑重新拟合，形成可部署预测器。模型在 2023 年 5 月至 10 月 BTC 和 ETH 的 6034 个完整小时级 Binance 期权波动率曲面上训练，并使用统一的期限—Delta 网格参数化。实验显示，在曲面补全和高遮蔽率条件下，混合方法显著优于单独的微笑重新拟合，且无需额外推理成本。在模拟整段期限缺失的结构相关空洞模式下，学习模型保持较低误差，表明生成式模型在该场景中具有关键实用价值。
authors: Sadanand Singh, Allam Reddy, Manan Chopra

articles.title: Analytic Torsion and Spectral Gap Capture Persistent-Laplacian Performance
articles.title_zh: 解析挠率与谱隙刻画持久拉普拉斯算子的性能
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16990v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While persistent Laplacians (PL) offer a richer geometric representation of data than persistent homology, utilizing their full eigenspectrum for learning tasks is often hampered by high dimensionality and the ``varying length'' problem across different filtration scales. We propose a compact spectral representation that distills the persistent Laplacian into three mathematically grounded invariants: Betti numbers, the spectral gap, and analytic torsion. Across benchmark datasets including MNIST, QM-3D, and SKEMPI WT, we demonstrate that this reduced feature space captures the essential predictive signal of the full spectrum, and in some cases outperforms it, while significantly reducing computational overhead and preventing the noise introduced by higher-frequency eigenvalues. Our results suggest that these invariants provide a principled, fixed-length interface between spectral geometry and topological learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对持久拉普拉斯算子完整特征谱在学习任务中维度高且随滤波尺度长度变化的问题，提出一种紧凑的谱表示。该表示将持久拉普拉斯信息压缩为三个具有数学基础的不变量：Betti 数、谱隙和解析挠率。作者在 MNIST、QM-3D 和 SKEMPI WT 等基准数据集上验证，这一低维特征空间能够捕获完整谱中的主要预测信号，部分情况下甚至优于完整谱。结果表明，这些不变量可作为谱几何与拓扑学习之间原则性且固定长度的接口，并降低计算开销与高频特征噪声。

articles.title: Dynestyx: A Probabilistic Programming Library for Dynamical Systems
articles.title_zh: Dynestyx：面向动力系统的概率编程库
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: State-space models (SSMs) are the standard formalism for Bayesian treatment of dynamical systems, with natural applications in statistics, signal processing, and machine learning. Despite their importance in both theory and application, dynamical systems have proven difficult to incorporate in modern probabilistic programming languages (PPLs), making state-of-the-art methods less accessible to practitioners and introducing friction in following the "Bayesian workflow." We introduce dynestyx, a probabilistic programming library with first-class support for SSMs, including state-of-the-art methods in the estimation of both states and parameters. Through a single, unified interface, users may specify arbitrary priors for discrete-time or continuous-time dynamical systems, perform inference over mixed-effect data, and make state and parameter estimates with principled uncertainty quantification.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍 dynestyx，一个为状态空间模型和动力系统提供一等支持的概率编程库。状态空间模型是动力系统贝叶斯处理的标准形式，广泛用于统计、信号处理和机器学习，但在现代概率编程语言中通常较难自然表达和推断。dynestyx 通过统一接口支持离散时间与连续时间动力系统的任意先验设定、混合效应数据推断，以及状态和参数估计。该库旨在让先进的状态与参数估计方法更易被实践者使用，并提供原则性的 uncertainty quantification。
authors: Daniel Waxman, Dmitry Batenkov, John Feser, Andy Zane, Eli Bingham, Youssef Marzouk, Matthew E. Levine

articles.title: Learning Topological Representations for Molecular Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 面向分子动力学的拓扑表示学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14737v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Molecular dynamics (MD) simulations generate trajectories in a high-dimensional configuration space whose analysis critically depends on molecular descriptors, typically handcrafted observables or learned kinetic embeddings. Designing descriptors that are both expressive and broadly applicable, however, remains challenging. We study persistent homology (PH) as a general-purpose representation for MD and introduce the masked Flood complex, a protein-tailored modification of a recently introduced simplicial complex construction that emphasizes inter-residue structure at low computational cost. Vectorized persistence diagrams then provide information-rich, geometry-aware summaries of protein conformations, which we evaluate on protein class prediction, frame-level observable regression, and Markov state model (MSM) estimation from learned low-dimensional coordinates in a single shared representation space. Results on the mdCATH dataset show that PH-based descriptors are competitive across tasks, with masked Flood PH yielding the most consistent overall performance. Further, when using topologically-informed MSMs as a drop-in replacement within the recent MarS-FM framework for generative modeling of protein conformations, we obtain consistently better ensemble statistics than MSMs based on physical observables. Finally, we explore the transferability of the generative model to qualitatively different, fast folding, proteins.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨持久同调作为分子动力学模拟轨迹的通用表示方法，并提出 masked Flood 复形，这是一种面向蛋白质的改进构造，可在较低计算成本下突出残基间结构。作者将向量化的持久图用于生成包含几何信息的蛋白质构象摘要，并在蛋白质类别预测、帧级可观测量回归以及基于低维坐标的马尔可夫状态模型估计中进行评估。mdCATH 数据集结果表明，基于持久同调的描述符在多项任务中具有竞争力，其中 masked Flood PH 表现最为稳定。该工作说明拓扑信息可作为分子动力学分析中表达性较强且适用面较广的表示。
authors: Dominik Geng, Florian Graf, Martin Uray, Roland Kwitt

articles.title: A Koopman-PINN Framework for Epidemic Models: Parameter Inference and Forecasting
articles.title_zh: 用于流行病模型的 Koopman-PINN 框架：参数推断与预测
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15201v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We propose a Koopman-enhanced physics-informed neural network (K--PINN) framework for parameter inference and forecasting in nonlinear epidemic models. This method combines Koopman operator theory and physics-informed learning. It maps epidemic states into a latent observable space where the dynamics evolve approximately linearly while satisfying the governing epidemic equations through automatic differentiation. This integration improves interpretability, parameter identifiability, and long-term predictive stability. We apply the proposed framework to a normalized SEIRSD epidemic model and evaluate it using synthetic monkeypox (Mpox) data and real-world datasets from Germany, Morocco, and Sweden for the SARS-CoV-2 virus. Synthetic trajectories are generated using a structure-preserving, nonstandard finite difference scheme to ensure reliable training data. Numerical results demonstrate that K--PINN achieves more accurate parameter estimation, trajectory reconstruction, and long-term forecasting than classical PINNs and Koopman-EDMD approaches. These results suggest that K--PINN is an effective machine learning framework for epidemic modeling that can be extended to more complex systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 Koopman 增强的物理信息神经网络 K-PINN，用于非线性流行病模型的参数推断与预测。该方法结合 Koopman 算子理论和物理信息学习，将流行病状态映射到潜在可观测空间，使其动力学近似线性，同时通过自动微分满足控制方程。作者将该框架应用于归一化 SEIRSD 模型，并在合成 Mpox 数据以及德国、摩洛哥和瑞典的新冠真实数据上评估。数值结果表明，K-PINN 在参数估计、轨迹重构和长期预测方面优于经典 PINN 与 Koopman-EDMD 方法。
authors: Achraf Zinihi, Matthias Ehrhardt, Moulay Rchid Sidi Ammi

articles.title: Score-Based Martingale Posteriors for Deep Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 深度神经网络的基于得分的鞅后验
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15725v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: In this paper we investigate the efficacy of the score-based martingale posteriors (SMP) (Cui & Walker, 2025; Fong et al., 2023) in the context of modern and large-scale machine learning problems and its potential for meaningful uncertainty quantification. SMPs work with a stochastic gradient ascent-type recursion on the parameter space of stochastic models and construct a martingale on the parameter space. Under simple mathematical assumptions, the recursion can be built so that the parameters form a martingale sequence which possesses a limiting, in time, random variable, the latter of which can be simulated very quickly, in contrast to Monte Carlo-based methods such as Markov chain Monte Carlo. In this expository paper we explore the SMP for inferring the parameters of deep neural networks (DNNs) and, where feasible, compare our results to the state-of-the-art Monte Carlo methods aimed at inferring conventional Bayesian posteriors.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究基于得分的鞅后验方法在现代大规模机器学习，尤其是深度神经网络参数推断中的有效性及其不确定性量化潜力。SMP 通过类似随机梯度上升的递推在参数空间中构造鞅序列，并在较简单的数学假设下收敛到可快速模拟的极限随机变量。相较于 MCMC 等传统蒙特卡洛方法，该方法有望以更低计算成本进行近似后验推断。文章以说明性方式探索 SMP 在深度神经网络中的应用，并在可行情况下与面向传统贝叶斯后验的先进蒙特卡洛方法进行比较。
authors: Abylay Zhumekenov, Ajay Jasra, Mohamed Maama, Raul Tempone

articles.title: Optimal Transport for Machine Learners
articles.title_zh: 面向机器学习者的最优传输
articles.abstract: arXiv:2505.06589v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Modern machine learning repeatedly manipulates probability measures: empirical datasets, generated samples, latent distributions, class-conditional laws, particle systems, weights of wide networks and attention patterns. Optimal transport is useful in this setting because it compares such objects by asking how mass should move. It therefore combines a statistically meaningful notion of discrepancy with a geometry of interpolation, dual certificates and variational dynamics. This makes OT a common language for losses, generative modeling, domain adaptation, robust learning, barycenters, gradient flows and mean-field descriptions of learning algorithms. This book presents the main OT techniques with these machine-learning uses in mind. It starts from finite assignment and the Monge map viewpoint, passes to Kantorovich couplings and dual potentials, and then explains the algorithmic ideas that make transport usable: linear programming, semi-discrete cells, Sinkhorn scaling and low-dimensional projections. The same objects are then reused as a geometry of measures, giving Wasserstein distances, barycenters, gradient flows, dynamic formulations and Gaussian/Bures formulas. The final chapters emphasize the variants most relevant to modern ML: divergences and adversarial losses, entropic and unbalanced relaxations, robust or spectral ground geometries, Gromov and quantum extensions, and transport-based views of generative models, mean-field networks and attention dynamics. The goal is to keep the mathematics explicit while exposing the computational and geometric intuitions needed to turn OT into a working toolbox for machine learners.
articles.abstract_zh: 该书面向机器学习应用系统介绍最优传输方法，强调其在比较概率测度、构造插值几何、提供对偶证书和描述变分动力学方面的作用。内容从有限分配与 Monge 映射视角出发，过渡到 Kantorovich 耦合和对偶势，并进一步讲解线性规划、半离散单元、Sinkhorn 缩放和低维投影等可计算技术。书中还将这些工具用于 Wasserstein 距离、重心、梯度流、生成建模、领域自适应、鲁棒学习和学习算法的平均场描述。整体上，该著作为机器学习研究者提供了最优传输理论、算法与应用之间的统一入口。

articles.title: Conditional Score-Based Modeling of Effective Langevin Dynamics
articles.title_zh: 有效朗之万动力学的条件得分建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.23952v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Stochastic reduced-order models are widely used to represent the effective dynamics of complex systems, but estimating their drift and diffusion coefficients from data remains challenging. Standard approaches often rely on short-time trajectory increments, state-space partitioning, or repeated simulation of candidate models, which become unreliable or computationally expensive for high-dimensional systems, coarse temporal sampling, or unevenly sampled data. We introduce a data-driven calibration method based on a novel relationship between the coefficients of a stochastic reduced model and the conditional score of the finite-time transition density, defined as the gradient of the logarithm of the transition density with respect to the initial state. The resulting identity expresses derivatives of lagged correlation functions as stationary expectations over observed lagged pairs involving this conditional score and the unknown model coefficients. This formulation allows the drift and diffusion structure to be constrained directly from finite-lag statistics, without differentiating trajectories, partitioning state space, or repeatedly integrating candidate reduced models during calibration, yielding a least-squares fitting problem over stationary lagged pairs. We validate the approach on three systems of increasing complexity: an analytically tractable Cox--Ingersoll--Ross diffusion, a two-dimensional nonequilibrium diffusion with affine multiplicative noise, and a periodic soft-spin stochastic Landau--Lifshitz chain. Across these tests, the inferred models preserve the invariant statistics while reproducing finite-lag dynamical correlations. The framework provides a scalable route for learning stochastic reduced-order models from data that reproduce prescribed statistical and dynamical properties.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种数据驱动的随机降阶模型校准方法，用于从观测数据估计有效朗之万动力学中的漂移与扩散系数。作者建立了模型系数与有限时间转移密度条件得分之间的新关系，将滞后相关函数的导数表示为包含条件得分和未知系数的平稳期望。该方法可直接利用有限滞后统计量约束模型结构，避免轨迹微分、状态空间划分和反复模拟候选模型，尤其适合高维、粗采样或非均匀采样数据场景。

articles.title: Random Gradient-Free Optimization in Infinite Dimensional Spaces
articles.title_zh: 无限维空间中的随机无梯度优化
articles.abstract: arXiv:2512.20566v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We propose a new gradient-free method for infinite-dimensional optimization in Hilbert spaces that requires only the computation of directional derivatives. Though functional optimization is often solved through finite-dimensional gradient descent over a parametrization, such as neural networks, we instead propose to leverage the functional nature of the optimization problem to enable provable guarantees. However, infinite-dimensional gradients are often hard to compute in practice, rendering naïve functional gradient descent intractable. To overcome this limitation, our framework leverages only directional derivatives and a pre-basis for the Hilbert space, i.e., a linearly independent set whose span is dense. This resolves the tractability issue, as pre-bases are much more accessible than full orthonormal bases or reproducing kernels -- which may not even exist -- and individual directional derivatives can be computed using automatic differentiation. We showcase the use of our method to solve partial differential equations à la physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), where it effectively enables provable convergence.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于希尔伯特空间无限维优化的新型无梯度方法，仅需计算方向导数。与将函数优化转化为有限维参数化梯度下降不同，该方法利用问题的函数空间结构，并借助稠密张成的预基来避免显式计算无限维梯度。作者指出预基通常比完整正交基或再生核更易获得，方向导数也可通过自动微分计算，并展示其在类似物理信息神经网络的偏微分方程求解中的应用与可证明收敛性。
authors: Caio Peixoto, Daniel Csillag, Bernardo F. P. da Costa, Yuri F. Saporito

articles.title: Forced Deferral: Manipulating Routing Decisions in Multimodal LLM Cascades
articles.title_zh: 强制延迟：操纵多模态大语言模型级联系统中的路由决策
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.15308v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning abilities, serving a large model for every query is computationally expensive. MLLM cascades mitigate this cost by first querying a weak but cheaper model and deferring to a strong model when the weak model's output is unconfident. However, since the weak model's confidence directly controls compute allocation, these systems expose a new attack surface: an adversary can manipulate confidence so that their queries are consistently deferred to the strong model. Motivated by this vulnerability, we introduce the Forced Deferral Attack (FDA), an adversarial image attack that lowers the weak model's confidence and causes cascades to route queries to the strong model. FDA learns a universal border trigger by optimizing a temperature-flattened objective. This objective pushes the weak model's token distribution on triggered inputs toward less concentrated targets constructed from its clean responses. Across datasets, model families, and deferral metrics, FDA consistently increases strong-model routing while outperforming image-perturbation and prompt-injection baselines. These results show that MLLM cascades are vulnerable to attacks that manipulate compute allocation, forcing unintended strong-model usage without directly targeting answer correctness.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究关注多模态大语言模型级联系统中的新型攻击面：弱模型的置信度决定是否将查询转交给更强但更昂贵的模型。作者提出强制延迟攻击，通过对图像加入通用边框触发器并优化温度平坦化目标，降低弱模型置信度，使请求更频繁地被路由至强模型。实验显示，该攻击在不同数据集、模型家族和延迟指标上均能显著增加强模型调用，并优于常见图像扰动和提示注入基线。
authors: Zhongye Liu, Yaopei Zeng, Yurui Chang, Lu Lin

articles.title: MR-GVNO: A Geometry-Aware Variational Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Mindlin-Reissner Plates on Irregular Domains
articles.title_zh: MR-GVNO：用于不规则区域Mindlin-Reissner板的几何感知变分物理信息神经算子
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.16624v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Plate and shell structures are widely used in engineering, making rapid response prediction under varying geometries, materials, and loads highly desirable. However, conventional finite element methods require repeated modeling and solution, resulting in high computational costs. This study proposes a geometry-aware variational neural operator for Mindlin-Reissner plate problems, termed MR-GVNO. The method uses boundary point clouds to represent irregular geometries and employs separate encoders for spatially varying material fields, pressure loads, and scalar physical parameters. A cross-attention mechanism integrates these inputs with query point information to predict transverse deflections and rotations at arbitrary locations. MR-GVNO is trained without labeled solution data using a variational physics-informed loss derived from the discretized total potential energy. It directly processes irregular point clouds and allows different physical fields to be discretized independently, avoiding interpolation onto a common grid. Numerical experiments on single-hole, double-hole, and L-shaped plates demonstrate accurate response prediction under homogeneous and heterogeneous materials and uniform and random loads. The model also achieves millisecond-level full-field inference and favorable cross-geometry generalization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出MR-GVNO，一种面向Mindlin-Reissner板问题的几何感知变分神经算子，用于快速预测不同几何、材料和载荷条件下的板结构响应。方法以边界点云表示不规则几何，并分别编码空间变化材料场、压力载荷和标量物理参数，再通过交叉注意力融合查询点信息以预测任意位置的挠度和转角。模型无需标注解数据，而是基于离散总势能构造的变分物理信息损失训练，并可直接处理不规则点云和不同离散方式的物理场。
authors: Siqi Wang, Daobo Sun, Yizheng Wang, Yilong Zhang, Yabin Jin, Xiaoying Zhuang, Timon Rabczuk

articles.title: PH-KAN: Port-Hamiltonian Kolmogorov-Arnold Network
articles.title_zh: PH-KAN：端口哈密顿Kolmogorov-Arnold网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14708v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Data-driven machine learning approaches have become increasingly attractive for nonlinear system identification, but standard models often fail to preserve the underlying physical structure and remain difficult to interpret, especially when no analytical model is available. In this context, port-Hamiltonian (pH) models provide a natural physics-informed representation. However, when these models are parameterized with standard multilayer perceptrons (MLPs), the learned constitutive components often remain poorly interpretable. In this paper, we propose a structure-preserving identification framework for nonlinear port-Hamiltonian systems based on Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs). The proposed PH-KAN model parameterizes the interconnection matrix, dissipation matrix, Hamiltonian, and input mapping using dedicated KAN blocks, while enforcing the port-Hamiltonian constraints by construction. This yields constitutive representations in which the nonlinear functions defining the identified pH components can be explicitly inspected, leading to a more interpretable model than with standard MLP-based parameterizations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络的非线性端口哈密顿系统结构保持辨识框架PH-KAN。模型使用专门的KAN模块参数化互连矩阵、耗散矩阵、哈密顿量和输入映射，并在构造上强制满足端口哈密顿约束。相比标准多层感知机参数化，该方法使所识别物理组成中的非线性函数更易显式检查，从而提升模型可解释性。
authors: Achraf El Messaoudi (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Karim Cherifi (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Yann Le Gorrec (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST), Yongxin Wu (UMLP, ENSMM, FEMTO-ST)

articles.title: X-Tokenizer: A Multimodal Action Tokenizer for Vision-Language-Action Pretraining
articles.title_zh: X-Tokenizer：用于视觉-语言-动作预训练的多模态动作分词器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14752v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Modern Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models must bridge pretrained vision-language reasoning and precise continuous robot control. Existing action tokenizers discretize actions primarily for reconstruction, producing codes that preserve motion geometry but provide only weak semantic supervision to the backbone. We therefore formulate action tokenization not as mere compression, but as semantic interface learning between multimodal reasoning and executable control. To this end, we introduce X-Tokenizer, a lightweight encoder-Semantic Residual Quantization (SRQ)-decoder architecture that provides a shared action interface across diverse robotic arm embodiments. Its key component, SRQ, imposes an asymmetric structure on residual vector quantization: the first level is trained with Masked Action Modeling (MAM) to form a discrete action language that captures coarse motion intent, while deeper levels remain reconstruction-oriented residuals that preserve fine-grained details. To further align action tokens with multimodal semantics, X-Tokenizer is pretrained with contrastive alignment to the representation space of a pretrained foundation model and with next-frame vision-language feature prediction. Pretrained on 2.4M trajectories (2.0B action frames), a single frozen X-Tokenizer plugs into a mixed discrete-continuous VLA as a representation-shaping supervision signal. X-Tokenizer achieves top real-world aggregate and strong RoboTwin 2.0 simulation results. Outperforming FAST in multimodal grounding (+13.5%) and long-horizon tasks (+8.25), it shows that action tokenizers serve as semantic interfaces for VLA pretraining beyond mere action compression.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出X-Tokenizer，将动作分词从单纯压缩重构重新定义为连接多模态推理与可执行机器人控制的语义接口学习。其轻量级编码器-SRQ-解码器结构通过语义残差量化形成跨多种机械臂形态共享的动作表示，其中第一层利用掩码动作建模学习粗粒度动作意图，后续层保留细粒度重构信息。模型还通过与预训练基础模型表征空间的对比对齐，使动作令牌更好地承载多模态语义。
authors: Xirui Kang, Yanpei Shi, Lucy Liang, Roy Gan, Dongxiu Liu, Pushi Zhang, Danpeng Chen, Xiaoyi Qin, Yinan Zheng, Jinliang Zheng, Hao Wang, Xianyuan Zhan, Hang Su

articles.title: Quantum Machine Learning for Industrial Applications
articles.title_zh: 面向工业应用的量子机器学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.14822v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Recent advances in Machine Learning have transformed numerous industrial sectors, yet classical paradigms face fundamental limitations: rapidly growing data volumes, rising computational costs, significant energy consumption, and the physical scaling limits of conventional hardware architectures. Quantum computing has emerged as a promising computational paradigm to address these challenges, giving rise to the field of Quantum Machine Learning (QML). In this thesis, the theoretical foundations of QML are investigated, with a focus on near-term and future practical applications. Three central challenges are addressed: the trainability of variational quantum circuits, their expressivity, and their resistance to efficient classical simulation. The trainability of Hamming-weight preserving variational quantum circuits is first studied, and theoretical guarantees are established that resolve an open conjecture on the absence of barren plateaus for this circuit family. Subspace-preserving QML algorithms are then introduced, including photonic circuits and quantum convolutional neural networks, and are designed to mimic classical ML subroutines while offering polynomial quantum advantage. Finally, variational quantum circuits are analyzed as quantum Fourier models, and a framework is derived to jointly characterize expressivity and trainability, from which conditions are obtained under which quantum models provably separate from their classical counterparts. These contributions are intended to advance the theoretical roadmap for harnessing near-term and future quantum technologies in real-world applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文探讨量子机器学习的理论基础及其在近期和未来工业应用中的潜力，背景是经典机器学习面临数据规模、计算成本、能耗和硬件扩展限制等挑战。研究重点包括变分量子线路的可训练性、表达能力以及抵抗高效经典模拟的能力。作者分析了保持汉明重量的变分量子线路，并给出关于该线路族不存在贫瘠高原现象的理论保证，同时提出保持子空间的量子机器学习算法，包括光子线路和量子卷积神经网络等。

articles.title: The causal vacuum is an orientation ferromagnet: photons as Goldstone magnons and matter as topological defects
articles.title_zh: 因果真空是取向铁磁体：作为Goldstone磁振子的光子与作为拓扑缺陷的物质
articles.abstract: The companion paper [Paper I] derives spacetime geometry, Newtonian gravitation, and the operator content of a tested modified-gravity theory from a discrete causal network—the Theory of Expanding Informational Causality (TEIC). Here we determine the structure of that network’s vacuum and the nature of its excitations and defects. We establish that the order parameter of the vacuum is not its density but its internal orientation: a Metropolis study of the orientation field on causal (Hasse) links shows a continuous second-order transition into a long-range-ordered phase (⟨⃗n⟩ ̸= 0, with C(r) → m2), so the vacuum is an orientation ferromagnet. Its Goldstone mode is the photon: propagated with the Sorkin–Benincasa–Dowker causal wave operator, the orientation perturbation δ⃗n disperses as ω = ck (measured c = 0.98, deviation 4.5%, massless to m2 < 0, diffusive model rejected at ∆χ2/N ≈ 11) with two transverse polarisations. The deepMOND interpolation function fitted phenomenologically in Paper I is shown to be the longitudinal Goldstone susceptibility of this vacuum, χ∥ ∼h-1/2 (the Brezin–Wallace coexistence anomaly), giving the law ν ∼ (g/a0)-1/2 a microscopic origin. Stable matter requires more than the bare ferromagnet: the hedgehog defect of ⃗n is only metastable (no Derrick minimum), so we add the minimal structure selected by a measured elimination chain—an SU(2) gauge sector with the Skyrme operator (which itself emerges from Poisson coarse-graining, λSk = a/√120, only its dominance imported). The result is a stable B = 1 Skyrmion with mass MSk ≈ 146 that gravitates; collectivecoordinate quantisation yields spin- 1 2 (2π → -ψ at 5 × 10-16), and the Finkelstein–Rubinstein identification [exchange] = [2π] = 1 ∈ π1 = Z2 is measured on the lattice. Skyrmion–antiSkyrmion collisions annihilate to magnon radiation, with E = mc2 (lattice c, MSk) forbidding sub-relativistic creation. Finally, the massive vector mA, frozen and then oscillating by misalignment, is cold (w = -0.04, ρ ∝a-3): a genuine cold-dark-matter component of the same vacuum. A mandatory derived/assumed table and the honest negatives (the S8 tension is unsolved in every sector) are given.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本作为TEIC理论的配套研究，试图刻画离散因果网络真空的结构及其激发和缺陷。作者提出真空的序参量并非密度而是内部取向，并通过因果链路上的Metropolis模拟声称系统发生连续二阶相变，进入长程有序的取向铁磁相。文中进一步将取向扰动的Goldstone模解释为光子，并把深MOND插值函数与纵向Goldstone易感性联系起来，同时将稳定物质解释为拓扑缺陷；这些主张属于高度理论化的预印本结果，需结合原文审慎评估。

articles.title: The causal network: emergent spacetime, Newtonian gravitation, and the inevitable operator structure of a tested modified-gravity theory
articles.title_zh: 因果网络：涌现时空、牛顿引力与经检验修正引力理论的必然算符结构
articles.abstract: We develop the Theory of Expanding Informational Causality (TEIC), a discrete causal network in which events are local centres of causal expansion placed by Poisson sprinkling, as a physical theory of spacetime and gravitation, and we establish its content under a mechanically enforced anti-circularity protocol in which no relativistic formula is allowed in any data-generating module. In the geometric sector the theory reproduces special relativity (Lorentz dilation to correlation 0.9998; a regular lattice fails at 17% directional variation versus 0.8%), spacetime dimension by counting (d = 2.006, 4.004), Schwarzschild dilation by non-circular counting (0.21%), and curvature as the 23.5σ divergence of two proper-time estimators (the Ricci scalar); this sector coincides with causal set theory. Beyond it we derive results causal set theory does not contain. A free Monte Carlo over the causal density �eld yields the Newtonian potential (θ ∝ 1/r, 0.62%). A one-line minimal action coarse-grains to the complete operator content X, p1 - X/X0, A·∂θ, F 2, A2 of a scalar�vector�tensor modi�ed-gravity e�ective theory �tted to 167 galaxies; the operators the network forbids coincide exactly with the classes excluded by GW170817 and Fermi-LAT. A dimensional scan selects d = 3 as the unique dimension with long-range gravity, stable orbits, and stable topological matter; an elimination chain selects SU(2) as the minimal gauge group able to carry that matter. Four pure numbers (15/8π2, 3/320π2, πρH2/ ln 2, ≈ 520) are computed with no free parameters. The vacuum of the network is an orientation ferromagnet whose Goldstone mode is the photon (ω = ck); this is developed in a companion paper. We state the theory's riskiest prediction prominently: the baryonic Tully�Fisher relation evolves as ? log vflat = 14 log[H(z)/H0], and the �rst measurement in the correct low-acceleration regime (MUSE-DARK III, 2026) �nds the critical acceleration growing with redshift, consistent at 0.5�0.9σ while null evolution is disfavoured at ∼ 19σ; the pre-registered kill criterion remains armed at z ≥ 2. The absolute values of G, ?, and a0 are external; their dimensionless combinations are calculable.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本发展了“扩展信息因果性理论”（TEIC），将泊松撒点形成的离散因果网络作为时空和引力的物理理论，并强调数据生成过程中不使用相对论公式以避免循环论证。作者声称该理论在几何部分可再现狭义相对论效应、时空维数、Schwarzschild膨胀和曲率估计，并与因果集理论相一致。进一步地，文中宣称通过因果密度场的蒙特卡洛分析得到牛顿势，并从极小作用量粗粒化出与修正引力有效理论相关的一组算符结构；这些结论应以预印本性质谨慎看待。

articles.title: Smart Detection of Elephant Intrusions Using LoRaWAN Enabled IoT Sensors
articles.title_zh: 基于LoRaWAN物联网传感器的智能大象入侵检测
articles.abstract: Despite recent progress in mitigating human elephant conflict across Sri Lanka, it continues to pose severe threats to human lives, security and elephant conservation, not only in Sri Lanka but also in other parts of Asia and Africa. Limited coverage, unreliable sensors, on-site maintenance, and lack of a communications infrastructure in remote areas are all limitations of current available mitigation technology (e.g., fences, manual guarding, single sensor alarms). In this paper, a smart intrusion detection system is designed for elephants which integrates both seismic and passive infrared sensors, locally processes the data, uses a machine learning algorithm to classify the event, communicates via LoRaWAN, sends the alerts to the cloud and includes a non-lethal deterrent counter measure. The proposed system has four coordinated layers: multi sensor field nodes, a hybrid LoRaWAN communication backbone to connect to the WiFi and LTE networks as a failover option, a machine learning engine to discriminate between elephants and non-elephants, and last but not least, a dashboard and notification layer for farmers and wildlife officers. The architecture has been developed with these features – low power, self-healing communication, offline buffering, delivery of warning in real time. The paper also implies the design on the backdrop of the latest literature from the open sources for human elephant conflict, seismic elephant detection and LoRaWAN for wildlife monitoring. In a recent geophone interface study done in Sri Lanka, up to 155.6 m distance was achieved for seismic detection and an accuracy of 99.5% was achieved which provides strong support to the sensing basis of this project. The system being proposed further builds on that as a full farm platform for deployment in the rural environment.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文面向斯里兰卡及其他地区的人象冲突问题，设计一种用于大象入侵检测的智能物联网系统。系统结合地震传感器和被动红外传感器，在本地处理数据并利用机器学习区分大象与非大象事件，同时通过LoRaWAN、WiFi和LTE故障转移链路发送云端告警。整体架构包括多传感器野外节点、混合通信骨干、机器学习判别引擎以及面向农民和野生动物管理人员的仪表盘与通知层，并包含非致命驱离措施。

articles.title: Multimodal Evaluation of Cognitive Load During Prosthetic Device Use in Activities of Daily Living
articles.title_zh: 日常活动中使用假肢装置时认知负荷的多模态评估
articles.abstract: Purpose:The cognitive burden associated with upper-limb prosthesis use remains a barrier to functional adoption, yet existing evaluations often rely on single-modality measures. This study investigates a multimodal framework for assessing cognitive load during activities of daily living.Methods:Twelve participants without limb difference performed standardized tasks using their natural hand and a tendon-driven prosthesis in a within-subject design. Cognitive workload was assessed using task performance metrics, subjective ratings from the NASA Task Load Index (NASA-TLX), eye-tracking measures including gaze behavior and pupillary dynamics, and prefrontal cortical activation measured with functional near-infrared spectroscopy (fNIRS).Results:Prosthesis use was associated with increased cognitive demand across modalities, although modality-specific responses differed by task. Subjective workload ratings and prefrontal cortical activation consistently indicated greater workload during prosthesis use, with neural activation becoming more widespread as task complexity increased. In contrast, pupillary activity differentiated conditions during the simpler block transfer and checker transfer tasks but not during the more visually dynamic carton transfer and pour task. Performance measures alone did not fully capture these differences, highlighting complementary information provided by physiological and visual attention measures.Conclusion:A multimodal framework provides a more comprehensive assessment of cognitive load than any single measure alone, offering valuable insights into how cognitive demand manifests across behavioral, perceptual, and biological domains . This approach enables improved evaluation of prosthetic systems and may inform the design of devices that reduce user burden and enhance functional performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估上肢假肢使用在日常活动中带来的认知负荷，并提出结合多种测量手段的评估框架。12名无肢体差异参与者在被试内设计中分别使用自然手和腱驱动假肢完成标准化任务，测量任务表现、NASA-TLX主观负荷、眼动指标和功能近红外光谱记录的前额叶激活。结果显示，假肢使用总体增加认知需求，但不同模态对任务复杂度的敏感性不同；主观评分和前额叶激活较稳定地反映负荷增加，而瞳孔活动在较简单任务中更能区分条件。

articles.title: The structure a causal network cannot avoid: measured selection of operators, dimension, gauge group, and stabiliser
articles.title_zh: 因果网络无法避免的结构：算符、维度、规范群与稳定子的测量选择
articles.abstract: A discrete causal network with Poisson sprinkling—the Theory of Expanding Informational Causality (TEIC)—analysed under a mechanically enforced anti-circularity protocol, turns out to have almost no structural freedom. We report a chain of six selections, each decided by measurement or exact theorem rather than by choice: (i) the discretisation itself—a regular lattice breaks Lorentz isotropy at 17% against 0.8% for Poisson, the microscopic counterpart of the Fermi-LAT exclusion of linear vacuum dispersion; (ii) the effective operator content—the network forbids, for internal causal and combinatorial reasons, precisely the two operator classes that observation has executed (Horndeski G4X/G5 by GW170817; a preferred frame by Fermi-LAT), while the five operators it forces are all minimally coupled and survive cT = c structurally; (iii) the spatial dimension—d = 3 is the unique dimension in which the measured network potential (p = -(d - 2), no ansatz) supports both bound orbits and escape, a Derrick window exists, and the topological charge is protected by a measured divergent barrier; (iv) the gauge group—a measured elimination chain (scalar → discrete subgroups → U(1) → SU(2)) leaves SU(2) as the unique minimal group supporting conserved point-like matter, every U(1) class function being exactly blind to the vortex core; and (v) the stabiliser—the Skyrme operator emerges from Poisson coarse-graining (measured ratio 5/9 to 0.06%), while a cubic lattice is exactly blind to it; and (vi) the vacuum and its photon—the network vacuum is an orientation ferromagnet (⟨⃗n⟩ ̸= 0, a measured second-order transition), and its Goldstone mode, smeared to relativistic locality by the causal wave operator, is the photon (ω = ck measured, two transverse polarisations), so light is a mode of the forced vacuum, not an added field. The same selections are tied by parameter-free pure numbers on one substrate, including Gnetρ2rc3λ2 Sk = 3/320π2. The negatives are part of the result: the dominance of the stabiliser does not emerge, and dimension does not emerge dynamically from the growth rule tested. The framework retains one pre-registered kill criterion, currently armed.
articles.abstract_zh: 该预印本继续分析基于泊松撒点的TEIC离散因果网络，主张在反循环论证协议下该网络几乎没有结构自由度。作者报告一系列由测量或定理决定的“选择”，包括泊松离散化相对于规则晶格更好保持洛伦兹各向同性、有效算符内容与观测排除项的对应、三维空间的特殊性，以及规范群的逐步筛选。文章试图将维度、算符、规范群和稳定结构统一归因于因果网络的内在约束；鉴于其为预印本且主张较强，具体论证和证据需查阅原文评估。

articles.title: Assessment of Groundwater Storage Variability and Recharge Dynamics in Nigeria's Major Aquifer Systems: An Integrated GRACE/GRACE-FO, GLDAS, and Borehole-Constrained Hydrogeological Evidence Approach
articles.title_zh: 尼日利亚主要含水层系统地下水储量变异与补给动态评估：整合 GRACE/GRACE-FO、GLDAS 与钻孔约束水文地质证据的方法
articles.abstract: Groundwater resources underpin more than 70% of Nigeria's freshwater supply, yet national groundwater monitoring remains constrained by fewer than 43 active observation boreholes distributed across approximately 923,768 km². This observational deficit has increased reliance on satellite-derived hydrological products, despite persistent uncertainty regarding the extent to which basin-scale terrestrial water storage anomalies reflect actual groundwater conditions. Addressing this challenge, this study presents an integrated assessment of terrestrial water storage, groundwater storage, and recharge dynamics across Nigeria's six principal aquifer systems—the Chad Basin, Sokoto Basin, Middle Niger Basin, Benue Trough, Southwestern Basement Complex, and Niger Delta using GRACE/GRACE-FO satellite gravimetry, GLDAS-2.1 land-surface model simulations, hydroclimatic observations, and archival borehole records. The analysis incorporated 254 monthly GRACE/GRACE-FO terrestrial water storage observations from the JPL RL06.3 Mascon CRI product (April 2002–February 2024), 276 monthly GLDAS-2.1 Catchment Land Surface Model groundwater storage estimates (January 2002–December 2024), CHIRPS precipitation data, and more than 90 borehole lithological and groundwater-level records spanning 1963–2017. Long-term trends were evaluated using the Mann–Kendall non-parametric trend test, Sen's slope estimation, Theil–Sen confidence intervals, and autoregressive effective sample size correction to account for serial dependence. A consistent and previously under-recognized pattern emerged across all six aquifer systems: statistically significant increases in GRACE-derived terrestrial water storage (+ 4.0 to + 22.2 mm yr⁻¹; p < 0.0001) occurred concurrently with statistically significant declines in GLDAS-derived groundwater storage (− 1.4 to − 2.5 mm yr⁻¹; p < 0.0001). Cross-dataset agreement was weak (Pearson r = − 0.34 to + 0.09; RMSE = 70–186 mm; NSE = − 30.5 to − 4.4), indicating that positive terrestrial water storage anomalies do not translate directly into groundwater replenishment. Instead, the results suggest a systematic storage-partitioning effect whereby increases in soil moisture, surface-water storage, wetlands, and other near-surface hydrological reservoirs contribute disproportionately to the positive mass anomalies detected by GRACE, while groundwater storage exhibits persistent long-term decline. Independent hydrogeological evidence supports this interpretation. Borehole water-level records from the Chad Basin reveal substantial declines between 1960 and 2012 (Dalori: −49 m; Sabsawa: −19 m; Gajibo: −12 m), consistent with the direction of GLDAS groundwater storage trends. Model-derived seasonal storage-amplitude recharge proxies (a GLDAS-based analogue of the classical Water Table Fluctuation method) ranged from 1.9 mm yr⁻¹ in the Chad Basin and Southwestern Basement Complex to 6.7 mm yr⁻¹ in the Niger Delta, highlighting pronounced spatial variability in recharge potential. These proxy estimates are not a substitute for well-based WTF recharge determinations but are constrained by modelled seasonal groundwater storage and formation-specific specific yield. These findings demonstrate that positive terrestrial water storage trends should not be interpreted as evidence of aquifer recovery in the absence of independent groundwater assessment. More broadly, the study provides evidence that terrestrial water storage and groundwater storage may become systematically decoupled in heavily exploited and hydroclimatically variable aquifer systems. This has important implications for the interpretation of satellite gravimetry products, groundwater monitoring strategies, and water-security assessments throughout data-scarce regions of Sub-Saharan Africa, where reliance on GRACE-derived indicators is increasingly common.
articles.abstract_zh: 尼日利亚超过70%的淡水供应依赖地下水，但全国监测井数量极少，导致对卫星水文产品的依赖增加。本研究整合 GRACE/GRACE-FO 卫星重力、GLDAS-2.1 陆面模型、水文气候观测和历史钻孔记录，评估尼日利亚六大主要含水层系统的陆地水储量、地下水储量及补给动态。研究旨在检验流域尺度陆地水储量异常在多大程度上反映真实地下水状况，并为地下水监测不足地区提供综合评估框架。

articles.title: Heme-Containing Enzymes Generate Hydrogen Peroxide from Molecular Hydrogen: Implications for Redox Signaling in Human Cells
articles.title_zh: 含血红素酶可由分子氢生成过氧化氢：对人类细胞氧化还原信号的启示
articles.abstract: Molecular hydrogen (H2) has long been regarded as metabolically inert gas in mammalian organism, lacking any known enzymatic catalysts for its activation. Nevertheless, numerous studies have reported that H2 modulates cellular redox signaling, a paradox not explained by the popular hypothesis of its radical scavenging effect. Here, we demonstrate that H2 promotes hydrogen peroxide (H2O2) formation in human and mouse cells through enzymatic oxygen reduction. The H2-driven H2O2 synthesis was localized to microsomal fractions and reproduced by purified heme-proteins including horseradish peroxidase, cytochrome P450, catalase, and even hemoglobin, implicating off target H2 oxidation as the novel source of H2O2 in the organisms. Despite increased H2O2 generation, H2 treatment was not cytotoxic and did not deplete antioxidant capacity, but upregulated redox-sensitive signaling markers Nuclear factor κB activity and Heme oxygenase-1 expression. Therefore, H2 can act as an electron donor for heme-proteins in aerobic organisms driving significant H2O2 synthesis, thereby serving as a redox-signaling mediator with numerous potential implications.
articles.abstract_zh: 分子氢长期被认为在哺乳动物中代谢惰性，但其调节细胞氧化还原信号的现象难以用自由基清除假说解释。本研究表明，氢气可通过酶促氧还原在人和小鼠细胞中促进过氧化氢生成，该过程定位于微粒体组分，并可由多种纯化血红素蛋白复现。尽管过氧化氢生成增加，氢气处理并未表现出细胞毒性或耗竭抗氧化能力，而是上调 NF-κB 活性和血红素加氧酶-1 表达，提示氢气可作为血红素蛋白的电子供体参与氧化还原信号调控。

articles.title: Performance Analysis of a Blended Wing Body Aircraft Utilizing Hybrid-Electric Distributed Propulsion and Boundary Layer Ingestion
articles.title_zh: 采用混合电推进分布式推进与边界层吸入的翼身融合飞机性能分析
articles.abstract: This research investigates a novel aircraft propulsion architecture integrating hybrid-electric power systems with Blended-Wing Body (BWB) airframes and Boundary-Layer Ingesting (BLI) distributed ducted fans to achieve substantial improvements in fuel efficiency and emissions reduction for commercial aviation. With traditional tube-and-wing configurations approaching their aerodynamic and thermodynamic efficiency limits, the study addresses critical inefficiencies in conventional aircraft, particularly wake and boundary-layer drag over the fuselage and aft-body, where externally mounted engines bypass low-energy airflow and leave significant propulsion efficiency unutilized. The proposed configuration employs a compact gas turbine generator coupled with lithium-ion battery systems to power multiple distributed electric ducted fans strategically positioned on the BWB’s aft body to ingest the low-momentum boundary layer. This approach synergistically combines the aerodynamic benefits of the BWB platform—including higher lift-to-drag ratios, reduced wetted area, and enhanced internal volume for energy storage—with the propulsive efficiency gains from BLI, which can reduce fuel burn by 5–10% by recovering wake losses. The methodology integrates computational fluid dynamics simulations, thermodynamic cycle analysis, electric propulsion system modelling, and mission-level performance assessments to evaluate the integrated system. Key technical innovations include optimized fan placement for boundary-layer ingestion effectiveness, electrical distribution network design to minimize resistive losses, and hybrid power management strategies balancing gas turbine and battery operation across flight phases. Unlike previous studies that examine these technologies in isolation, this work provides a comprehensive systems-level analysis incorporating aerodynamic-propulsion coupling, mass estimation, and crucially, redundancy and failure tolerance analysis for multi-fan configurations. Parametric studies explore the design space across variables including fan count (4–12), fan diameter (0.8–1.5 m), pressure ratio (1.2–1.4), and battery specific energy (200–350 Wh/kg) to identify optimal configurations. The analysis demonstrates that integrated BWB-BLI-hybrid-electric architectures represent one of the most promising pathways for sustainable aviation while maintaining near-term technological feasibility. Results are validated against NASA STARC-ABL and MIT D8 benchmarks, with performance metrics including mission fuel burn reduction, take-off gross weight, propulsive efficiency improvements, and system-level power saving coefficients. This study addresses critical research gaps in distributed BLI systems, hybrid-electric BWB integration, and operational robustness under fan-out scenarios, providing a rigorous foundation for future development of advanced commercial aircraft configurations that balance environmental performance with practical implementation constraints.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究探讨将混合电推进系统、翼身融合机体和边界层吸入式分布式涵道风扇相结合的新型飞机推进构型，以提升商用航空燃油效率并降低排放。传统筒翼布局已接近气动和热力效率极限，尤其在机身和后体边界层及尾迹阻力方面仍存在未充分利用的推进效率。所提方案利用燃气涡轮发电机与锂离子电池驱动布置于翼身融合后体的多个电涵道风扇，以吸入低动量边界层气流，并结合翼身融合平台的高升阻比、较小湿表面积和更大内部储能空间。

articles.title: Oxidation-dependent mechanical response of graphene oxide: taming the spread with ab-initio Machine Learning simulations
articles.title_zh: 氧化依赖的氧化石墨烯力学响应：利用从头算机器学习模拟约束预测离散性
articles.abstract: The mechanical response of graphene oxide (GO) is controlled by oxidation level and functional group composition, yet a clear atomic level picture remains ambiguous due to limitations of classical reactive force fields. Here, we develop a machine learning interatomic potential by fine-tuning a MACE foundation model on DFT data. We employ this potential to systematically investigate GO tensile behavior across oxidation levels of 10–40 % and hydroxyl-to-epoxy (OH/O) ratios of 0–3. Our potential accurately reproduces the expected decrease in Young's modulus and ultimate tensile strength with increasing oxidation, correcting the overestimation and dispersion characteristic of ReaxFF predictions. In the elastic and plastic regimes, oxidation level dominates the mechanical response, while the functional group identity remains secondary. In the fracture regime, however, chemical composition becomes significant, controlling ductile/brittle behavior. In highly oxidized, hydroxyl-rich systems, stress relaxation via dehydration, not captured by reactive force fields, critically influences fracture behavior.
articles.abstract_zh: 氧化石墨烯的力学性能受氧化程度和官能团组成控制，但传统反应力场难以提供清晰可靠的原子尺度图像。本研究通过在 DFT 数据上微调 MACE 基础模型，构建机器学习原子间势，并系统考察10%至40%氧化水平及不同羟基/环氧基比例下的拉伸行为。结果表明，该势能准确再现杨氏模量和极限拉伸强度随氧化增强而降低的趋势，修正了 ReaxFF 的高估和离散性；氧化水平主导弹性与塑性响应，而断裂阶段的化学组成会显著影响韧脆行为，尤其高氧化羟基富集体系中的脱水应力松弛。

articles.title: Active learning and explicit electrostatics enable accurate modeling of electrolytes
articles.title_zh: 主动学习与显式静电作用实现电解质的准确建模
articles.abstract: arXiv:2510.03479v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) offer near-ab initio accuracy with the efficiency of classical force fields, making them attractive for modeling electrolytes. Collecting a diverse training set is essential for their accuracy and reliability, and explicit treatment of strong electrostatic interactions may be necessary. In this work, we demonstrated that D-optimality-based active learning can automatically generate diverse training sets for moment tensor potentials (MTPs), enabling reliable molecular dynamics simulations of pure ethylene carbonate (EC), ethyl methyl carbonate (EMC), their mixtures, and LiPF₆ solutions. The resulting MTPs exhibit excellent transferability across various EC/EMC compositions, producing ionic conductivities within 11% mean deviations from experiments. In addition, we assessed the impact of explicitly incorporating electrostatics by augmenting MTP with charge redistribution schemes using either fixed or environment-dependent charges. Our results show that the augmented MTP achieves the same or higher accuracy than standard model with fewer parameters, while environment-dependent charges further improve accuracy and the stability of simulations.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习原子间势可在接近从头算精度的同时保持经典力场效率，但电解质建模需要多样训练集并可能需要显式处理强静电相互作用。本研究表明，基于 D-最优性的主动学习可自动生成矩张量势训练集，用于纯 EC、EMC、其混合物以及 LiPF₆ 溶液的可靠分子动力学模拟。所得模型在不同 EC/EMC 组成间具有良好可迁移性，预测离子电导率与实验平均偏差较小；加入固定或环境依赖电荷重分布的显式静电增强模型可用更少参数达到相当或更高精度。
authors: Olga Chalykh, Mikhail Polovinkin, Dmitry Korogod, Nikita Rybin, Alexander Shapeev

articles.title: Sustainable Materials Discovery in the Era of Artificial Intelligence
articles.title_zh: 人工智能时代的可持续材料发现
articles.abstract: arXiv:2601.21527v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) has transformed materials discovery, enabling rapid exploration of chemical space through generative models and surrogate screening. Yet current generative AI models for materials discovery, which now drive exploration of vast chemical and structural spaces, optimize candidates exclusively for structural stability and functional properties, with no integration of environmental assessment at any stage of the design loop. Prospective and ex-ante life cycle assessment methods exist and have been applied to emerging technologies, but they operate as standalone downstream analyses, not as active constraints within generative or active-learning pipelines. The result is that environmental feedback, even when produced, arrives after design decisions have been made rather than informing them. The disconnect between atomic-scale design and lifecycle assessment (LCA) reflects fundamental challenges: (i) data scarcity across heterogeneous sources, (ii) scale gaps from atoms to industrial systems, (iii) uncertainty in synthesis pathways, and (iv) the absence of frameworks that co-optimize performance with environmental impact. In this Perspective, we propose integrating upstream ML-assisted materials discovery with downstream LCA into the ML-LCA framework, comprising five components: information extraction for building materials-environment knowledge bases, harmonized databases linking properties to sustainability metrics, multi-scale models bridging atomic properties to lifecycle impacts, ensemble prediction of manufacturing pathways with uncertainty quantification, and uncertainty-aware optimization enabling simultaneous performance-sustainability navigation. Case studies spanning polymers, glass, photoresists, and cement demonstrate both necessity and feasibility while identifying material-specific integration challenges.
articles.abstract_zh: 人工智能已通过生成模型和代理筛选显著加速材料发现，但当前材料生成式 AI 通常只优化结构稳定性和功能性能，缺乏对环境影响的内嵌评估。尽管前瞻性和事前生命周期评价已用于新兴技术，它们多作为下游独立分析，未能在生成或主动学习设计循环中形成约束。本文讨论原子尺度设计与生命周期评价之间的脱节，指出数据稀缺、尺度跨度、合成路径不确定性以及性能与环境指标协同优化框架缺失是主要挑战。
authors: Sajid Mannan, Rupert J. Myers, Rohit Batra, Rocio Mercado, Lothar Wondraczek, N. M. Anoop Krishnan

articles.title: A geometric basis for materials families in inorganic solids
articles.title_zh: 无机固体材料家族的几何基础
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.00254v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The thermodynamic stability of inorganic solids spans a vast compositional space, yet materials scientists have long organized their intuition around a manageable number of materials families. Here we show that this organization has a precise geometric basis. The formation-energy convex hull of all inorganic compounds from the Materials Project, spanning 92-dimensional elemental composition space, is captured to near DFT accuracy by a polyhedron with only seven facets. Each facet corresponds to a family of materials sharing similar chemical potentials. This low-dimensional structure is not merely an economical description of energies: without retraining or structural input, the same framework reproduces trends in DFT-calculated defect energies and elemental spatial correlations in high-entropy nanoparticles. These results reveal that a small number of material families, corresponding to geometric features of composition-energy space, govern bulk stability, defect energetics, and elemental mixing, and provide a unified, interpretable framework for rapid screening across diverse materials systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 材料科学中常以有限数量的材料家族组织对无机固体稳定性的理解，本研究指出这种分类具有明确的几何基础。作者发现，Materials Project 中无机化合物形成能凸包在92维元素组成空间中可由仅含七个面的多面体以接近 DFT 精度描述，每个面对应具有相似化学势的一类材料。该低维结构不仅能刻画能量，还能在不重新训练或引入结构信息的情况下再现缺陷能趋势和高熵纳米粒子中的元素空间相关性，为跨材料体系快速筛选提供统一且可解释的框架。
authors: Justin Tahmassebpur, Sarvesh Chaudhari, Cristóbal Méndez, Rushil Choudhary, Sudipta Kundu, Raymond E. Schaak, Héctor Abruña, Peter Frazier, Tomás Arias

articles.title: The Entropic Barrier around the Conical Intersection Seam
articles.title_zh: 圆锥交叉缝周围的熵势垒
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.02115v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Conical intersections (CIs) are seen as the main mediators of nonadiabatic transitions; yet, mixed quantum-classical (MQC) simulations that treat nuclei as classical point particles rarely, if ever, sample geometries with exactly degenerate electronic energies. Here we show that this behavior arises from a fundamental statistical-mechanical constraint on classical nuclear motion. Using a linear vibronic coupling model, we derive the free energy along the adiabatic energy gap and demonstrate analytically that as the gap approaches zero, the free energy diverges around the CI seam. Molecular dynamics simulations of the methaniminium cation on the S₁ surface confirm this prediction: trajectories can approach regions with small adiabatic gaps, but never reach the CI seam, even if the CI corresponds to a region of lowest potential energy. These results clarify why MQC methods successfully capture nonadiabatic behavior without sampling exact degeneracies and agree with recent findings that classical trajectories can sense the presence of CIs without visiting them.
articles.abstract_zh: 圆锥交叉通常被视为非绝热跃迁的主要媒介，但混合量子-经典模拟中经典核轨迹很少采样到电子能量完全简并的几何构型。本研究利用线性振动耦合模型推导了沿绝热能隙的自由能，并解析证明当能隙趋近于零时，圆锥交叉缝附近自由能发散。对甲亚胺阳离子 S₁ 面的分子动力学模拟验证了这一预测：轨迹可接近小能隙区域但不会到达交叉缝，即使该区域具有最低势能。这解释了混合量子-经典方法为何无需采样精确简并也能捕捉非绝热行为。
authors: Johannes C. B. Dietschreit, Sebastian Mai, Leticia González

articles.title: Tuning Terahertz Optomechanics of MoS2 Bilayers with Homogeneous In-plane Strain
articles.title_zh: 利用均匀面内应变调控 MoS₂ 双层的太赫兹光机械性质
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.03996v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Homogeneous in-plane biaxial tensile strain strengthens the out-of-plane van der Waals (vdW) interaction in MoS bilayers (BLs) and can be used to fine-tune their terahertz (THz) oscillations. Using ultralow-frequency Raman spectroscopy on hexagonal (2H) and rhombohedral (2R) stacked BLs, we observe a hardening of the interlayer breathing modes originating from a strain-induced Poisson contraction of the vdW separation between the layers characterized by an effective out-of-plane Poisson's ratio of νₑff approx 0.19--0.24. Strikingly, this geometric contraction drives the system into a highly repulsive regime of the intermolecular potential, corresponding to a Grüneisen parameter of γ approx 14--20. This value surpasses even the `giant' one reported for phosphorene, establishing these van der Waals BLs as highly tunable nonlinear mechanical platforms that can be addressed at the THz regime without external pressure knobs.
articles.abstract_zh: 均匀面内双轴拉伸应变可增强 MoS₂ 双层的层间范德华相互作用，并用于精细调控其太赫兹振荡。研究通过超低频拉曼光谱考察六方与菱方堆垛双层，观察到层间呼吸模硬化，其来源于应变诱导的泊松收缩使层间范德华间距减小。该几何收缩将体系推入强排斥的分子间势能区间，并产生很大的 Grüneisen 参数，表明这类范德华双层可作为无需外压调控的高度可调非线性太赫兹机械平台。
authors: S. Patel, Jose D. Mella, S. Puri, Salvador Barraza-Lopez, H. Nakamura

articles.title: Quantum spin models of commensurate p-wave magnets
articles.title_zh: 相称 p 波磁体的量子自旋模型
articles.abstract: arXiv:2602.23986v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The p-wave magnet has emerged as a new type of magnetism exhibiting odd-parity, time-reversal-symmetric spin splitting in momentum space, and has attracted considerable interest as a promising platform for spintronic applications. However, the theoretical understanding of the fundamental mechanism responsible for stabilizing this phase remains limited. In this work, we identify a microscopic interacting model that realizes the p-wave magnet as its ground state. We first introduce a Hubbard model and derive the corresponding low-energy spin Hamiltonian. At the classical level, we find that the p-wave magnet is stabilized but remains energetically degenerate with competing noncoplanar states. Quantum fluctuations lift this degeneracy, selecting the p-wave magnet as the unique ground state. The resulting electronic structure exhibits finite spin accumulation via the Edelstein effect, highlighting the potential of p-wave magnetism for spintronic applications. We further discuss the relevance of our theory to quasi-two-dimensional honeycomb magnets such as Ni₂Mo₃O₈. Our findings establish the possibility of spontaneous p-wave magnetism.
articles.abstract_zh: p 波磁体是一类新型磁性态，在动量空间中表现出奇宇称、时间反演对称的自旋劈裂，因其自旋电子学潜力而受到关注。本研究提出一个可将 p 波磁体实现为基态的微观相互作用模型，先构建 Hubbard 模型并推导相应低能自旋哈密顿量。经典层面上 p 波磁态虽可稳定但与竞争性非共面态简并，而量子涨落会解除简并并选择 p 波磁体作为唯一基态；所得电子结构还表现出 Edelstein 效应诱导的有限自旋积累。作者进一步讨论了该理论与 Ni₂Mo₃O₈ 等准二维蜂窝磁体的相关性。

articles.title: AMELI: Angular Matrix Elements of Lanthanide Ions
articles.title_zh: AMELI：镧系离子角矩阵元数据库与计算框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.21947v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Matrix elements of spherical tensor operators are fundamental to analyzing lanthanide spectra in both amorphous and crystalline host materials. This work presents a comprehensive framework for calculating angular matrix elements using a Slater determinant basis and their subsequent transformation to the traditional LS-coupling scheme using the classification introduced by Racah. While computationally demanding, this direct product-state approach is more universally applicable than conventional methods and remains well within modern desktop computing capabilities. We provide a concise set of general rules to calculate angular matrix elements for virtually any spherical tensor operator within an f^N configuration. Because these matrices are mathematical constants independent of the host environment, they need only be calculated once. A comprehensive set of calculated matrix elements for unit and angular momentum operators, alongside perturbation Hamiltonians, is made available in the open-access repository AMELI. By utilizing exact arithmetic, AMELI eliminates the numerical artifacts and rounding errors inherent to conventional floating-point representations. This takes full advantage of the selection rules and symmetry properties of each operator, resulting in a very compact data format due to the high sparsity of the matrices and the small number of unique non-zero elements. While the evaluation of final physical observables requires subsequent numerical diagonalization, this foundational repository is intended to replace legacy tables currently used for semi-empirical calculations. Extensive quantitative comparisons to classic tables from Judd and Carnall are presented, and application examples are demonstrated using the open-source Python reference implementation YALIP.
articles.abstract_zh: 球张量算符矩阵元是分析非晶和晶体宿主材料中镧系离子光谱的基础。本研究提出一种基于 Slater 行列式基计算角矩阵元并转换到传统 LS 耦合方案的综合框架，虽计算量较大，但在现代台式计算机上可行且适用范围广。作者给出适用于 f^N 组态中几乎任意球张量算符的通用计算规则，并在开放资源 AMELI 中提供单位算符、角动量算符及微扰哈密顿量等矩阵元；通过精确算术避免了传统浮点计算中的数值伪影和舍入误差。

articles.title: Dynamical magnetic breakdown and quantum oscillations from hot spot scattering
articles.title_zh: 热点散射导致的动力学磁击穿与量子振荡
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.23605v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Quantum oscillations (QO) are a well-established probe of Fermi-surface (FS) geometry and in the presence of long-range density wave order can display new QO frequencies from reconstructed FS pockets. We show that such reconstructed frequencies can arise even in the absence of long-range density order. Considering electrons coupled to a fluctuating bosonic mode that scatters quasiparticles between sharp hot spots on the FS, we develop a semiclassical theory in which the interaction generates time-dependent tunneling processes analogous to magnetic breakdown. This dynamical magnetic breakdown produces new semiclassical orbits corresponding to reconstructed FS areas despite the absence of static order. Because tunneling probabilities depend on the thermal population of bosonic excitations, the resulting oscillation amplitudes exhibit characteristic deviations from standard Lifshitz-Kosevich behavior. Our results provide a mechanism to probe bosonic fluctuations in quantum critical metals and provide a framework for dynamical magnetic breakdown.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究讨论在没有长程密度波有序的情况下，费米面重构相关的量子振荡频率如何仍可出现。作者考虑电子与涨落玻色模耦合，并在费米面热点之间散射准粒子，建立了类似磁击穿的半经典时间依赖隧穿理论。由于隧穿概率依赖玻色激发的热占据，所得振荡振幅偏离标准 Lifshitz-Kosevich 行为，为探测量子临界金属中的玻色涨落提供了机制。

articles.title: Strongly Correlated Superconductivity in Twisted Bilayer Graphene: a Gutzwiller Study
articles.title_zh: 扭转双层石墨烯中的强关联超导：Gutzwiller 方法研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2604.04631v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study strongly correlated superconductivity in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene (MATBG) using a variational Gutzwiller wavefunction ketΨ_G = prodb̌R hatPb̌R ketΦ₀, where the Gutzwiller projector hatPb̌R is allowed to break charge U(1) symmetry to accommodate superconducting (SC) order. The ground state energy is evaluated via the Gutzwiller Approximation applied to an 8-band model consisting of correlated f-orbitals and uncorrelated c-orbitals, with interactions including onsite Coulomb repulsion U, phonon-mediated anti-Hund's coupling hatHJ_A, and intra-orbital Hund's coupling hatHJ_H.
