We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach on the reward-tuning of energy-based models within various settings.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究梯度不可解函数的优化问题，这类问题常见于机器学习和统计中的边际似然最大化及生成模型微调等场景。作者提出使用序贯蒙特卡洛采样器替代昂贵的内部采样循环，以近似随机梯度相关计算并降低计算成本。论文给出了所定义基本递推过程的收敛结果，并在能量模型的奖励调优任务中验证了该方法的有效性。
authors: James Cuin, Davide Carbone, Yanbo Tang, O. Deniz Akyildiz

articles.title: The Theory of Mind Utility: Formal Specification of a Mentalizing Mechanism
articles.title_zh: 心智理论效用：一种心理化机制的形式化规范
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12721v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Inferring others' beliefs requires more than reading surface signals; it requires tracking who told them what, in what order, and how credibly. The Theory of Mind Utility (ToM-U) formalizes this epistemic state inference problem at the computational level of analysis, specifying what mentalizing computes and why without commitment to algorithmic or neural implementation. ToM-U achieves this by constructing Local Epistemic World Models (LEWMs) -- directed typed graphs that represent agents, state nodes, and the epistemic relationships among them -- and evaluating discrete candidate LEWMs against observed behavior until one achieves sufficient confidence. Five formal definitions specify the LEWM structure, agent node properties including ordered information access history, a bounded proliferation mechanism for recursive mentalizing, three inference procedures, and a residue function that captures the structured trace left by failed mentalizing attempts. ToM-U differs from Bayesian Theory of Mind and adjacent formal accounts, which presuppose rather than derive belief states, and from simulation theory and theory-theory, which lack a formal apparatus for epistemic state inference. The architecture generates directional, falsifiable predictions about mentalizing failure that follow from structural properties of the model rather than auxiliary assumptions, and positions ToM-U as a domain-agnostic mechanism upstream of goal inference and other downstream social cognitive processes.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出“心智理论效用”（ToM-U），从计算层面对推断他人信念的问题进行形式化，强调信念推断需要追踪信息来源、顺序与可信度，而不只是读取表面信号。该框架构建局部认知世界模型，即由主体、状态节点及其认知关系组成的有向类型图，并通过评估离散候选模型来解释观察到的行为。论文给出多项形式定义，涵盖模型结构、主体信息访问历史、递归心理化的有界扩展、推理过程以及失败推理残留函数，并将其与贝叶斯心智理论及相关理论区分开来。

articles.title: HarnessBridge: Learnable Bidirectional Controller for LLM Agent Harness
articles.title_zh: HarnessBridge：用于大语言模型智能体运行框架的可学习双向控制器
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12882v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as agents for long-horizon tasks, yet their performance is shaped not only by model capability and environment design, but also by the harness that mediates agent--environment interaction. Existing harnesses are largely manually engineered, making them difficult to scale as trajectories grow longer and interactions become more complex. In this work, we ask whether harness can be generated by a learnable plug-in module that can be trained in an end-to-end fashion. We introduce HarnessBridge, a lightweight learnable harness controller that parameterizes the agent--environment interface as a bidirectional projection. HarnessBridge learns two bidirectional projections: observation projection, which distills raw trajectories into compact, decision-relevant states, and action projection, which converts proposed actions into executable transitions or trajectory-grounded rejections. We train HarnessBridge on a harness supervision dataset via unified instruction tuning. On Terminal-Bench~2.0 and SWE-bench Verified, HarnessBridge matches or surpasses strong specialized harnesses while substantially reducing token usage and trajectory length, and generalizes from smaller generators to larger commercial models.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文关注大语言模型智能体在长程任务中的运行框架问题，指出现有框架多依赖人工设计，难以适应更长轨迹和更复杂交互。作者提出HarnessBridge，一种轻量级可学习的运行框架控制器，将智能体—环境接口参数化为双向投影：观测投影将原始轨迹压缩为决策相关状态，动作投影将候选动作转化为可执行转移或基于轨迹的拒绝。该模块通过统一指令微调在框架监督数据上训练，并在Terminal-Bench 2.0和SWE-bench Verified上达到或超过强专用框架，同时降低人工工程化需求。
authors: Xiaoxuan Wang, Haixin Wang, Alexander Taylor, Jason Cong, Yizhou Sun, Wei Wang

articles.title: Physics-Guided Spatiotemporal Learning for Coastal Wave Peak Period Estimation from Video
articles.title_zh: 用于从视频估计近岸波浪峰值周期的物理引导时空学习
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13302v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Wave parameters in the nearshore are crucial for coastal engineering, shoreline protection, marine hazard assessment, and coastal management for climate resilience. Traditional monitoring systems like buoys and radar platforms offer accurate monitoring but can have high installation and maintenance expenses and limited spatial coverage. Passive ocean monitoring using video has been achieved by leveraging deep learning, however, many methods are not physically interpretable, feasible, and validated for oceanography. In thiswork, a Physics-Guided Deep Spatiotemporal Learning Framework for direct estimation of nearshore wave peak periods from passive coastal video stream is proposed. The framework combines automated temporal-variance based region-of-interest detection, multi-stage Sim-to-Real transfer learning, and physics-informed regularization to enhance the predictive accuracy and physical consistency. A variety of spatiotemporal architectures were assessed, such as transformer-based and recurrent-convolutional ones, alongside synthetic pretraining,silver-label adaptation, and expert fine-tuning. The results show that transformer-based architectures outperformed in terms of the accuracy of the instantaneous prediction, while lightweight recurrent-convolutional architectures achieved higher temporal stability and operational oceanographic skill. Ablation studies also demonstrated the benefits of physics-guided regularization in terms of trend-following consistency, and physically implausible predictions. Explainability auditing also helped to focus attention in hydrodynamically active surf-zone regions and showed good agreement with the physically derived wave propagation behavior. In general, the proposed framework shows the promise of physics-guided video-based deep learning systems for long-term coastal wave monitoring that are cost-efficient and operationally feasible.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种物理引导的深度时空学习框架，用于从被动海岸视频流直接估计近岸波浪峰值周期。该框架结合基于时间方差的自动感兴趣区域检测、多阶段Sim-to-Real迁移学习和物理信息正则化，以提升预测精度与物理一致性。作者评估了包括Transformer和循环卷积模型在内的多种时空架构，并结合合成预训练、银标签适配和专家微调，旨在为成本较低、可解释且适用于海洋观测的视频监测提供方案。
authors: Abubakar Hamisu Kamagata, Dharm Singh Jat, Attlee Munyaradzi Gamundani, Abhishek Srivastava, Paramasivam Saravanakumar

articles.title: Optimizing Appliance Scheduling for Solar Energy Management Using Metaheuristic Algorithms
articles.title_zh: 使用元启发式算法优化太阳能管理中的家电调度
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13407v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Renewable energy is essential for meeting future energy demands; however, solar energy generation, which occurs only during daylight hours often does not align with household consumption patterns. Appliances such as cookers, washing machines, and dryers are typically operated according to user preferred schedules rather than solar energy availability, creating a scheduling optimization problem. The objective is to determine optimal appliance start times to maximize renewable energy utilization while minimizing user inconvenience and adhering to system constraints. This paper presents a metaheuristic approach using Iterated Local Search (ILS) and Simulated Annealing (SA) to optimize appliance start times, while considering appliance operating durations, power consumption, inverter limit, battery state of charge constraints, and solar generation forecasts. Unlike most existing work, the scheduling is extended beyond a single day to accommodate unfinished tasks from previous days (spillover), ensuring operational continuity and enabling sequential operation across multiple days. Experimental results show that the sequential multi-day scheduling framework effectively manages system constraints while ensuring user convenience under exclusive solar generation. These findings also open opportunities for future research on multi-objective trade-offs between investment in equipment of various sizes, return on that investment, and user satisfaction.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文研究家庭太阳能发电与用电需求在时间上不匹配导致的家电启动时间优化问题，目标是在满足用户便利性和系统约束的同时最大化可再生能源利用。作者采用迭代局部搜索和模拟退火方法，综合考虑家电运行时长、功率消耗、逆变器限制、电池荷电状态约束和太阳能发电预测。与多数单日调度研究不同，论文将调度扩展到多日序列场景，以处理前一日未完成任务的延续，从而提高运行连续性。
authors: Hiba Ahmed, Alexander E. I. Brownlee, Jason Adair, Simon T. Powers

articles.title: Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning from Delayed Marketplace Feedback for Objective-Weight Adaptation in Three-Sided Dispatch
articles.title_zh: 三方派单中基于延迟市场反馈的多智能体强化学习目标权重自适应
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13604v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Dispatch in three-sided marketplaces provides a natural setting for reinforcement learning from world feedback: decisions are evaluated by delayed operational outcomes such as delivery speed, courier utilization, and merchant congestion. We present a deployed reinforcement learning system at DoorDash that adapts dispatch objective weights in a large-scale food-delivery marketplace using delayed signals. Rather than replacing the combinatorial assignment optimizer, a store-level policy learned from logged marketplace data selects a discrete multiplier that shifts the dispatch optimizer's tradeoff between delivery quality and batching efficiency. This interface enables offline policy learning under noisy, delayed, and coupled feedback while preserving production feasibility constraints and operational safeguards. We train a shared value function using centralized offline data and decentralized store-level execution, with Double Q-learning targets and a conservative regularizer to reduce out-of-distribution value overestimation. In a production switchback experiment, the offline-trained policy increases batching and reduces courier-side time costs without degrading customer-facing delivery quality. Results illustrate how world feedback from a live economic and logistics system can be used to safely adapt decision policies online.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文介绍DoorDash在大规模外卖配送市场中部署的强化学习系统，用于根据延迟运营反馈自适应调整派单目标权重。该方法不替换组合分配优化器，而是在门店层面学习策略，选择离散乘子来调整配送质量与合单效率之间的权衡。系统使用集中式离线数据训练共享价值函数，并以去中心化门店执行，结合Double Q-learning目标和保守正则化以缓解分布外价值高估；生产实验表明该策略能够提高合单并减少骑手侧相关成本或压力。
authors: Haochen Wu, Yi Hou, Shiguang Xie

articles.title: Representing Time Series as Structured Programs for LLM Reasoning
articles.title_zh: 将时间序列表示为结构化程序以支持大语言模型推理
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12481v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong reasoning and instruction-following capabilities, making them potentially powerful tools for time-series analysis. However, time series lie outside their native textual modality, raising a fundamental question: how should time series be represented so that LLMs can reason about them effectively? Existing work typically serializes raw numerical sequences or fine-tunes pre-trained LLMs on time-series data. These approaches place the burden of extracting temporal structure directly on the LLM, creating a modality mismatch that often degrades performance on long sequences and introduces substantial computational overhead. In this work, we introduce Time-Series-to-Structured-Program representation (T2SP), a deterministic, training-free method that represents a time series as a structured symbolic program. T2SP decomposes time series into trends, periods, and salient events, expressing them in a program-friendly format aligned with the textual and code-like modalities on which LLMs are natively trained. By shifting temporal-structure extraction from the model to the representation itself, T2SP enables off-the-shelf LLMs to leverage their existing reasoning capabilities for time-series understanding. We evaluate T2SP on three reasoning tasks -- editing, captioning, and question answering -- where it consistently improves performance, reduces reasoning time, and lowers failure rates compared with raw-string representations. Our results demonstrate that T2SP provides an effective interface between time series and LLMs.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出Time-Series-to-Structured-Program（T2SP），一种无需训练的确定性表示方法，将时间序列转换为结构化符号程序，以便大语言模型进行推理。与直接序列化数值或对大模型进行时间序列微调不同，T2SP先将时间序列分解为趋势、周期和显著事件，并以更接近文本和代码模态的格式表达。该方法将时间结构提取从模型内部转移到表示层，有助于缓解模态不匹配、长序列性能下降和计算开销问题。
authors: Jaeho Kim, Changhun Oh, Seokhyun Lee, Irina Rish, Changhee Lee

articles.title: SymQNet: Amortized Acquisition for Low-Latency Adaptive Hamiltonian Learning
articles.title_zh: SymQNet：用于低延迟自适应哈密顿量学习的摊销式采集策略
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12808v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Adaptive Hamiltonian learning is central to calibrating and characterizing quantum devices. In an adaptive controller, choosing the next experiment is itself a computation. Bayesian design rules are recomputed after every posterior update, and that step can take seconds. Across hundreds of shots, those seconds become a significant wall-clock cost for adaptivity. We introduce SymQNet, an amortized reinforcement-learning approach for low-latency adaptive Hamiltonian learning. SymQNet learns a posterior-conditioned acquisition policy offline, then uses a fast policy forward pass online while retaining Bayesian posterior feedback. On transverse-field Ising benchmarks, SymQNet substantially reduces acquisition latency relative to bounded Fisher-information search and bounded two-step Bayesian active learning by disagreement (BALD). At five qubits, it reduces acquisition-only decision latency by 47.1× and 72.6× relative to these online baselines; at twelve qubits, full simulated steps take 1.02 s for SymQNet versus 13.27 s for bounded two-step BALD. Overall, we show that learned acquisition can make adaptive Hamiltonian learning practical for repeated low-latency workloads.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出SymQNet，一种基于摊销强化学习的低延迟自适应哈密顿量学习方法。该方法离线学习以后验为条件的采集策略，在线阶段通过快速策略前向传播选择实验，同时保留贝叶斯后验反馈。横场伊辛模型基准结果显示，SymQNet相较于有界Fisher信息搜索和有界两步BALD显著降低采集决策延迟，在多量子比特设置中展现出使自适应哈密顿量学习更实用的潜力。
authors: Yash Vardhan Tomar, Dheeraj Peddireddy, Vaneet Aggarwal

articles.title: Bounding Boxes as Goals: Language-Conditioned Grasping via Neuro-Symbolic Planning
articles.title_zh: 以边界框作为目标：通过神经符号规划实现语言条件抓取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12910v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: For robotics to be effectively integrated into household or industrial environments, machines must adapt to natural-language prompts in real time. Although Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have enabled zero-shot generalization in robot task and motion planning (TAMP), current state-of-the-art approaches often remain computationally "heavyweight" or require extensive training on thousands of demonstrations. We present GRASP (Grounded Reasoning and Symbolic Planning), a framework designed as a step toward open-vocabulary tabletop manipulation. Our approach leverages a pretrained VLM to translate natural-language queries into neuro-symbolic goal states, grounded in the physical world via a bounding-box detection pipeline. Unlike methods that rely on fixed color lists or hard-coded coordinates, GRASP enables robots to interpret abstract spatial concepts such as "top shelf" and execute tasks without additional fine-tuning. We achieve 73.3% overall success across 90 real-robot trials at three difficulty levels, requiring no task-specific training.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出GRASP框架，面向开放词汇桌面操作任务，将自然语言指令转化为神经符号目标状态，并通过边界框检测将目标落地到物理世界。该方法利用预训练视觉语言模型理解查询，不依赖固定颜色列表、硬编码坐标或任务特定微调，能够处理“顶层架子”等抽象空间概念。真实机器人实验在三个难度等级的90次试验中取得73.3%的总体成功率，显示了其在自然语言条件抓取中的可行性。
authors: Allison Andreyev, Landon Eum, Nestor Tiglao, Romel Gomez

articles.title: An LLM System for Autonomous Variational Quantum Circuit Design
articles.title_zh: 用于自主变分量子线路设计的大语言模型系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.13380v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The design of high performing quantum circuits remains largely dependent on human expertise. We introduce an autonomous agentic framework that employs large language models (LLMs) to conduct iterative quantum circuit designs under explicit design constraints. Our system integrates seven components: Exploration, Generation, Discussion, Validation, Storage, Evaluation, and Review. These components form a closed-loop workflow that combines web-based knowledge acquisition, literature-grounded critique, executable code generation, and experimental feedback. We evaluate the framework on two tasks: quantum feature map construction for quantum machine learning and ansatz generation for variational quantum eigensolver applications in quantum chemistry. In image classification benchmarks, the best generated feature map outperforms representative quantum feature maps and, when scaled to larger qubit counts, surpasses the classical radial basis function kernel. In molecular ground state estimation across seven molecules, the generated ansatz attains competitive accuracy with widely used chemically inspired and hardware-efficient constructions while satisfying the imposed scaling constraints. These results establish LLM driven agentic system as a viable paradigm for automated quantum circuit design and illustrate how AI systems can participate in iterative scientific optimization workflows across scientific domains.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种基于大语言模型的自主智能体框架，用于在明确设计约束下迭代设计高性能量子线路。系统包含探索、生成、讨论、验证、存储、评估和复审等模块，形成结合网络知识获取、文献依据批判、可执行代码生成与实验反馈的闭环流程。作者在量子机器学习特征映射和量子化学变分量子本征求解器ansatz生成任务上进行评估，结果显示生成的线路在若干基准中具有竞争力甚至优于代表性方法。
authors: Kenya Sakka, Wataru Mizukami, Kosuke Mitarai

articles.title: A CubeSat-Based Laser Power Transmission Framework for Sustained Lunar Surface Operations
articles.title_zh: 面向持续月表作业的基于立方星的激光电力传输框架
articles.abstract: The lunar night — approximately 354 hours of complete solar darkness with surface temperatures reaching − 173°C — was formally ranked as the single highest-priority unsolved technology challenge in civil space exploration by NASA's Space Technology Mission Directorate in 2024. This paper proposes and rigorously evaluates the Orbital Solar Relay Network (OSRN): a constellation of CubeSat-class spacecraft in 100 km polar low lunar orbit equipped with deployable photovoltaic arrays and diode-pumped solid-state lasers (DPSSL, λ = 1064 nm) that transmit harvested solar energy to photovoltaic laser power converter (PVLPC) arrays on the lunar surface throughout the lunar night. Corrected beam optics analysis — using the Gaussian beam propagation model — confirms that laser WPT is uniquely suited to the LLO-to-surface geometry. A 10 cm transmitter aperture at 1064 nm produces a beam waist of 67.7 cm at 100 km range and 135.5 cm at 200 km, yielding beam collection efficiencies of 99.6% and 75.0% respectively onto a 2×2 m PVLPC receiver. This stands in contrast to microwave transmission at 2.45 GHz (λ = 12.24 cm), which produces a half-angle beam divergence of 28.5° from a 0.3 m aperture — yielding a spot radius of 54 km at 100 km range and rendering microwave WPT from CubeSat-scale apertures physically infeasible at LLO ranges without apertures exceeding 800 m. The critical enabling constraint for the laser architecture is fine beam pointing: the beam divergence half-angle of 6.77 µrad requires a pointing accuracy of σ ≤ 1–2 µrad, achievable with a fast steering mirror (FSM) and beacon-tracking system consistent with LLCD-heritage technology (TRL 7). The end-to-end link budget yields 40.2 W delivered DC per 6U satellite (80.5 W for 12U) at 200 km range with σ = 1 µrad pointing, for an end-to-end efficiency of 5.9%. An 18-satellite Walker Star constellation with simultaneous transmission from all satellites delivers approximately 1.45 kW to a fixed 2×2 m surface PVLPC array — sufficient for early robotic and thermal management operations. Orbital coverage analysis confirms greater than 97% power availability at the lunar south pole for this constellation. These results are quantitatively bounded: the architecture as described delivers 100 W (3 × 6U sats), 500 W (6 × 12U sats), and 1.45 kW (18 × 12U sats). Scaling beyond this range requires additional satellites or receiver aperture expansion, both of which are characterized in the sensitivity analysis. The primary technology development requirement is a space-qualified CubeSat-scale DPSSL with FSM pointing, currently at TRL 3–4.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出轨道太阳能中继网络，用低月球极轨道上的立方星级航天器收集太阳能，并通过1064 nm二极管泵浦固体激光向月表光伏激光功率转换阵列供能，以应对漫长月夜带来的能源挑战。作者基于高斯光束传播模型分析激光无线电力传输的光束扩展和接收效率，认为该方案适合低月轨道到月表的几何条件。研究还将激光传输与微波传输进行对比，强调激光方案在束散控制和接收效率方面的潜在优势。

articles.title: HVIA: A Hybrid Variational Ising Architecture for Quantum Language Modeling
articles.title_zh: HVIA：用于量子语言建模的混合变分伊辛架构
articles.abstract: Language modeling in natural language processing has predominantly relied on large-scale classical neural architectures, yet constructing expressive and resource-efficient models compatible with Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) devices remains a fundamental open challenge. In this work, two Ising-inspired variational quantum-classical architectures are proposed to enhance representational capacity by leveraging spin-coupling mechanisms and Ising-type Hamiltonian evolution within hybrid classical-quantum layers. Specifically, a quantum Ising Ansatz circuit parameterized by an Ising Hamiltonian is constructed, and a quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) is incorporated to reduce the number of trainable circuit parameters while enabling learnable quantum evolution of hidden states. To achieve stable and efficient hybrid training under NISQ constraints, a joint optimization strategy is introduced that combines the Adam optimizer with quantum simultaneous perturbation stochastic approximation (SPSA), yielding convergence acceleration of up to 64% relative to parameter-shift rule and Adam-only baselines. Empirical evaluations on the WikiText-2 benchmark demonstrate that the proposed architectures effectively capture long-range semantic dependencies, achieving a competitive perplexity of PPL = 39.8 (lower values indicate stronger language modeling performance). This result surpasses existing quantum language models, including Quixer, Quantum LSTM, and Quantum GRU, and approaches the performance of the classical NanoGPT baseline (PPL = 40.5). Collectively, these findings establish the viability of Ising-based hybrid quantum-classical networks as a promising direction for practical quantum natural language processing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出两种受伊辛模型启发的变分量子—经典语言建模架构，旨在增强NISQ设备条件下的表达能力和资源效率。方法通过伊辛哈密顿量参数化量子ansatz线路，并结合量子近似优化算法减少可训练参数，同时实现隐藏状态的可学习量子演化。作者还提出结合Adam与量子SPSA的联合优化策略，在WikiText-2等实验中展示了训练稳定性和收敛效率方面的改进潜力。

articles.title: QoS-Aware Distributed Work Stealing for Opportunistic Computing over IoT Device Clusters
articles.title_zh: 面向物联网设备集群机会计算的QoS感知分布式工作窃取机制
articles.abstract: Previous work has shown that groups of underutilized IoT devices can be organized into temporary clusters to execute decomposable services collaboratively, using spare CPU, memory, battery, and network capacity without compromising their primary functions. However, earlier orchestration-based approaches rely on an initial allocation of work proportional to each device's estimated capacity. Such static or semi-static allocation becomes inefficient when task costs are irregular, nodes are heterogeneous, background load varies, or devices join and leave during execution. This paper proposes a QoS-aware distributed work-stealing model for opportunistic IoT clusters. The proposed approach replaces centralized work assignment with local double-ended queues, capacity-aware victim selection, lease-based task ownership, bounded stealing, and QoS-preserving admission control. We formalize the system model, define residual capacity and utility-aware stealing decisions, provide the core distributed algorithm, and analyze termination, safety, bounded interference, and expected makespan under standard work-stealing assumptions extended with communication and heterogeneity costs. We evaluate the proposed approach against four baselines---proportional static decomposition, multi-round proportional decomposition, centralized dynamic rescheduling, and random stealing---across heterogeneous IoT cluster sizes ranging from 4 to 64 devices, three task-cost distributions (uniform, log-normal, Pareto), and three failure regimes (none, transient, permanent). The results demonstrate that QoS-aware distributed work stealing matches the makespan of an idealised centralised scheduler without placing it on the critical path, scales without performance degradation up to 64 devices, where uncoordinated random stealing breaks down completely; achieves the highest and most consistent cluster utilisation; and recovers from failures with the most predictable cost, even under an aggressive stress regime where approximately 90% of devices fail during a typical run. These results confirm that distributed work stealing preserves the central goal of the previous framework---exploiting otherwise unused IoT capacity to improve edge service execution within acceptable QoS ranges---while improving load balance, resilience, and scalability for irregular workloads.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对机会式物联网集群中静态或半静态任务分配在任务成本不规则、节点异构和负载变化时效率不足的问题，提出QoS感知的分布式工作窃取模型。该方法使用本地双端队列、容量感知的被窃取节点选择、基于租约的任务所有权、有界窃取以及保持QoS的准入控制来替代集中式分配。作者形式化系统模型与残余容量、效用感知窃取决策，并分析终止性、安全性、有界干扰和预期完工时间，为动态物联网协同计算提供调度框架。

articles.title: Geo-Data-Driven HD Map Generation Workflow with Integrated Reference-Free Constraint-Based Verification
articles.title_zh: 集成无参考约束验证的地理数据驱动高精地图生成流程
articles.abstract: High-definition (HD) maps are core artifacts for automated driving systems, but their generation commonly relies on sensor-intensive mobile mapping campaigns, while quality assessment often depends on high-precision reference data. These dependencies make HD map engineering costly and difficult to apply in settings where specialised measurement data or independently measured reference maps are unavailable. This paper presents an engineering-oriented geo-data-driven workflow for HD map generation with integrated representation-level verification. The workflow uses openly available geo-engineering datasets as the primary input source and transforms them into lane-level HD map representations of existing road environments through explicit intermediate representations and processing stages. To assess the generated representations without external reference maps, the workflow integrates executable constraint-based verification into the engineering process. Selected constraints are derived from specifications relevant to automated driving and road-design guidelines. They are evaluated directly on the generated lanelet-based representation to detect geometric, topological, and elevation-related inconsistencies. The workflow is evaluated using real-world shapefile-based road-network data from four cities in Lower Saxony, Germany, and controlled defect-injection scenarios. The real-world evaluation shows that the generated map representations satisfy the selected constraints in the evaluated scenarios, while the defect-injection study demonstrates complete detection of the considered defect types without observed false positives. The results indicate that geo-data-driven HD map generation with integrated executable verification can provide a modular and inspectable complement to sensor-intensive mapping workflows under reduced sensing and reference-data availability.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种面向工程应用的高精地图生成流程，使用开放地理工程数据作为主要输入，将现有道路环境转换为车道级高精地图表示。为避免依赖外部高精度参考地图，流程集成了可执行的基于约束的表示层验证。相关约束来源于自动驾驶规范和道路设计指南，并直接作用于生成的lanelet表示，用于检测几何、拓扑和高程相关问题，从而降低高精地图工程对专用测量数据的依赖。

articles.title: Fullerene-hosted nickel clusters as electrocatalysts for efficient overall water splitting: activity and mechanism study
articles.title_zh: 富勒烯负载镍团簇作为高效全水分解电催化剂：活性与机理研究
articles.abstract: The design of highly efficient catalysts for water splitting (WS) is a pivotal approach to the search for sustainable energy conversion technologies. WS consists of two fundamental half-reactions, including the oxygen evolution reaction (OER) and the hydrogen evolution reaction (HER), each necessitating electrocatalysts that exhibit both superior activity and long-term stability. Building upon a recent discovery of nickel clusters anchored at NiN3 centers and their demonstrated efficacy in the CO2 reduction reaction (CO2RR) (Angew. Chem. Int. Ed. 2025, 64, e202424552), we report, for the first time, a density functional theory (DFT) investigation of the OER and HER pathways on NiN3 sites as well as Ni6-NiN3 clusters incorporated within a C60 fullerene framework (NiN3@C60 and Ni6/NiN3@C60). The primary aim of this study is to elucidate the electrocatalytic performance of NiN3@C60 and Ni6/NiN3@C60 systems toward OER and HER. Among the investigated substrates, Ni6/NiN3@C60 demonstrates the best thermodynamic performance for hydrogen adsorption (ΔGH=-0.10 eV), highlighting its enhanced catalytic suitability for the HER relative to the NiN3@C60 counterpart. Computational results further demonstrate that Ni6/NiN3@C60 exhibits superior catalytic activity in OER, achieving a reduced overpotential (ƞOER = 0.68 V) compared to NiN3@C60.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用密度泛函理论首次系统考察了C60富勒烯框架中NiN3位点及Ni6/NiN3团簇对析氧反应和析氢反应的电催化性能。结果表明，Ni6/NiN3@C60在氢吸附自由能方面表现更优，显示出相较NiN3@C60更适合析氢反应的热力学特征。该工作旨在阐明富勒烯限域镍活性中心在全水分解中的反应路径和催化机制，为设计稳定高效水分解催化剂提供理论依据。

articles.title: Probing Jupiter-bound ultralight dark matter with space quantum sensors
articles.title_zh: 利用空间量子传感器探测木星束缚超轻暗物质
articles.abstract: Dark matter remains one of the central open problems in fundamental physics, yet most direct searches target the local Galactic dark matter field near Earth. We propose a complementary strategy: using space-based quantum sensors to search for ultralight dark matter gravitationally bound to Jupiter. Jupiter’s large mass and deep gravitational potential make the Jovian system a distinctive environment in which ultralight fields may form spatially structured overdensities with coherence properties different from those accessible in terrestrial searches. We develop a framework for probing scalar ultralight dark matter through its couplings to photons and electrons, which induce coherent oscillations in the magnetic field of a reference permanent magnet. As a benchmark, we consider a superconducting quantum interference device magnetometer integrated with a shielded permanent-magnet configuration on a future Jovian mission. We model the allowed Jupiter-bound overdensity, derive the resulting magnetic-field signal, and present sensitivity projections near Jupiter and its moons. Our results show that Jovian quantum sensors could probe scalar ultralight dark matter parameter space beyond comparable terrestrial experiments, particularly over 1 Hz– 100 kHz, corresponding to masses of approximately 10−14–10−8 eV. This work identifies planetary systems as precision laboratories for searches for weakly coupled light fields.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出利用空间量子传感器搜索受木星引力束缚的超轻暗物质，作为地球附近银河暗物质直接探测的补充策略。作者构建了标量超轻暗物质通过与光子和电子耦合诱导参考永磁体磁场相干振荡的探测框架，并以未来木星任务中的超导量子干涉仪磁强计为基准方案。研究模拟了木星束缚暗物质过密度及其磁场信号，并给出木星及其卫星附近的灵敏度预测，显示该方案有望探索传统地面实验难以覆盖的参数空间。

articles.title: Reconfigurable Multistate MRAM Synapses with Vortex STNO based Neurons for Scalable In-Memory Convolutional Neural Networks
articles.title_zh: 面向可扩展存内卷积神经网络的可重构多态MRAM突触与涡旋STNO神经元
articles.abstract: Magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ)-based magnetic random-access memory (MRAM) is a promising platform for neuromorphic and in-memory computing owing to its non-volatility, high endurance, fast switching dynamics and CMOS compatibility. However, conventional spin-transfer torque and spin-orbit torque MRAM implementations for neural networks often suffer from high critical switching currents, large latency, thermal instability and significant read-write overheads. Here, we demonstrate a unified multistate MRAM-spin-torque nano-oscillator (STNO) architecture that integrates synapses and neurons on a single chip for convolutional neural network (CNN) applications. The system employs 1×8 multistate MRAM arrays as programmable synapses coupled with a vortex-based STNO neuron, enabling both individual and collective programming through field-line-driven write channels. Multiple configurable resistance states are achieved by tuning internal and external magnetic fields together with bias currents, allowing quantized positive and negative synaptic weights for configurable kernel and pooling operations. The proposed architecture is evaluated through simulation on MNIST, SVHN, CIFAR-10, Google Speech Commands (GSC) and RadioML datasets, achieving accuracy of 99.76%, 87.93%, 78.14%, 87.96% and 56.46% respectively. Based on fabricated device dimensions, the complete architecture occupies ~6171.2 µm² with an average energy consumption of 200.08 pJ per training and inference cycle for MNIST, highlighting its potential for scalable low-power neuromorphic computing.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种统一的多态MRAM—自旋转矩纳米振荡器架构，将可编程突触和涡旋型STNO神经元集成于单芯片，用于卷积神经网络和存内计算。系统利用1×8多态MRAM阵列实现突触权重，并通过调控内外磁场和偏置电流获得多个可配置电阻态，从而支持量化正负权重、卷积核和池化操作。作者通过多种图像识别数据集仿真评估该架构，展示其在非易失性、可重构性和神经形态计算扩展性方面的潜力。

articles.title: Trace elements distribution and Potential ecological risk assessment of surface sediments from, Muthupet mangroves province, Tamil Nadu India
articles.title_zh: 印度泰米尔纳德邦穆图佩特红树林区表层沉积物中微量元素分布及潜在生态风险评估
articles.abstract: This study evaluates the sedimentological characteristics and geochemical composition of surface sediments from the Muthupet mangrove ecosystem along the southeast coast of Tamil Nadu, India. A total of 25 surface sediment samples were collected from the study area and analyzed for textural properties, trace element distribution, potential ecological risk, and statistical relationships. The results show that the sediments are predominantly fine-grained, with mud forming the major fraction. The dominance of clayey silt in the Muthupet region indicates a low-energy depositional environment influenced by dense mangrove vegetation and tidal processes. The complex root network, including pneumatophores, appears to enhance the trapping of suspended particles and the accumulation of fine sediments. Spatial variation in sediment texture reflects differences in local hydrodynamic conditions and sediment supply. The sediments generally contain low to moderate levels of calcium carbonate, suggesting limited marine biogenic input and possible post-depositional dissolution and reprecipitation under reducing conditions. Organic matter and organic carbon contents were moderate to high, particularly in fine-grained sediments. Trace element concentrations determined by atomic absorption spectrophotometry followed the order Fe > Mn > Pb > Zn > Cr > Ni > Co > Cu > Cd. The elevated concentrations of Fe and Mn likely reflect geogenic sources and riverine inputs. Sediment quality guidelines, contamination factor, geoaccumulation index, enrichment factor, sediment pollution index, and pollution load index indicated that the sediments ranged from uncontaminated to moderately contaminate. Potential ecological risk assessment suggested low to moderate risk levels in the study area. Statistical analysis further indicated that both natural processes and human activities influence trace metal distribution in the mangrove sediments. The findings highlight the need for continued monitoring of trace metals in the Muthupet mangrove 60 ecosystem to support long-term ecological protection and management.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究评估了印度泰米尔纳德邦东南海岸穆图佩特红树林生态系统表层沉积物的沉积学特征、地球化学组成与潜在生态风险。研究采集25个表层沉积物样品，分析粒度组成、微量元素分布及其统计关系。结果表明，沉积物以细粒泥质组分为主，黏土质粉砂占优势，反映出受红树林植被和潮汐过程影响的低能沉积环境；有机质和有机碳含量总体为中等至较高水平。

articles.title: From public weather narratives to solar-market risk decisions using constrained language-model features
articles.title_zh: 利用受约束语言模型特征将公共天气叙事转化为太阳能市场风险决策
articles.abstract: Weather risk in high-solar power systems affects generation, prices, and imbalance exposure. Public forecasting pipelines use numerical weather prediction and operator forecasts, but forecast-discussion judgment remains difficult to structure. We evaluate a constrained language-model extraction design that converts NWS Area Forecast Discussions into bounded weatherrisk features. The CAISO–SP15 public-data test bed combines system solar generation, day-ahead and real-time prices, HRRR forecasts, and NWS discussions. Photovoltaic and price forecasts are propagated through residual-bootstrap scenarios into a CVaR-regularized settlement-proxy quantity rule. In 2024–2025 full-HRRR neural forecasts, an irradiance-focused LLM cloud-rule feature reduced mean all-hour PV RMSE to 1167.35 MW from 1186.03 MW with no text and 1221.09 MW with keyword rules. For real-time prices, LLM-rule weather scores reduced mean RMSE to 17.94 USD/MWh from 18.47 USD/MWh with deterministic rule-text scores. Under a common no-text anchor and validation-selected anchor blend, the LLM scenario path increased proxy value by 12.28 million USD, reduced CVaR95 loss by 6.51 thousand USD per hour, and reduced imbalance by 248.2 GWh. These results support public weather narratives as an auditable residual-information layer for solar forecasting and risk-sensitive market-proxy decisions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一种受约束的大语言模型信息抽取方法，将美国国家气象局区域预报讨论文本转化为有界天气风险特征，并用于高太阳能占比电力系统的发电、价格与不平衡风险决策。作者在CAISO–SP15公开数据集上结合太阳能发电、日前和实时电价、HRRR预报及天气讨论文本进行验证。结果显示，相比无文本或关键词规则方法，LLM提取的云量和天气风险特征可改善光伏与实时电价预测，并在CVaR约束的结算代理决策中提高代理价值、降低尾部损失和不平衡风险。

articles.title: Topological Polarization of the Tensegrity Cytoskeleton Amplifies Localized Mechanotransduction under Ultrasound Stimulation
articles.title_zh: 张拉整体细胞骨架的拓扑极化放大超声刺激下的局域机械转导
articles.abstract: Low-intensity ultrasound has emerged as a promising noninvasive modality for neuromodulation and tissue regeneration by activating mechanosensitive ion channels such as Piezo1. While macroscopic acoustic radiation force (ARF) is widely recognized as the fundamental mechanical driver, often inducing dynamic fluid shear stresses within the cellular microenvironment, how these macroscale stimuli translate into the substantial localized membrane tension (∼ 1 to 5 mN/m) strictly required for channel gating remains an active area of investigation. Here, we present a high resolution 3D acoustic structure interaction (ASI) tensegrity model to decode the spatiotemporal dynamics of cellular mechanotransduction and bridge this macroscopic to microscopic force gap. We computationally demonstrate a novel biomechanical mechanism termed “Topological Polarization”. By incorporating physiological geometric asymmetry, specifically a 4 μm nuclear eccentricity, we reveal that the tensegrity cytoskeleton acts as an active mechanical router that significantly amplifies microscopic membrane strains. Parametric analysis indicates that this topological asymmetry induces a localized tension amplification factor between 2.3 and 2.8, surpassing the Piezo1 activation threshold (> 1.4 mN/m). Furthermore, this mechanism elucidates why standard low-frequency (∼1 MHz) ultrasound necessitates pulsed duty cycles to prevent localized tension hotspots from exceeding the cell lysis limit (11 mN/m). Guided by these fundamental topological insights, we computationally predict a continuous-wave (CW) “Golden Window” at higher frequencies (> 3.3 MHz) and ∼10 kPa incident pressure. Within this optimized regime, the tensegrity network sustains safe, widespread Piezo1 gating while inherently suppressing lytic stress concentrations. This topology-driven framework offers a candidate mechanism for the force-gap paradox in acoustic mechanotransduction and establishes a robust biophysical parameter space for the rational design of next-generation ultrasound therapies.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对低强度超声如何将宏观声辐射力转化为足以门控Piezo1等机械敏感离子通道的局域膜张力这一问题，建立了高分辨率三维声-结构相互作用张拉整体模型。作者提出“拓扑极化”机制，指出包含生理性几何不对称的细胞骨架可作为机械路由器，显著放大局部膜应变。参数分析显示，细胞核偏心等拓扑不对称因素会诱导局域张力放大，从而为超声机械转导的宏观—微观力学耦合提供解释。

articles.title: Leakage-Aware Wide Fan-In Domino Logic Architecture Using Controlled Keeper and Stacked Footer for Low-Power High-Speed CMOS with Tag Comparator Design
articles.title_zh: 面向低功耗高速CMOS标签比较器的泄漏感知宽扇入多米诺逻辑架构：受控保持器与堆叠脚管设计
articles.abstract: Wide fan-in domino logic circuits are widely used in high-speed applications such as tag comparators; however, their performance is degraded by contention, leakage and dynamic node instability in scaled CMOS technologies. A new wide fan-in domino logic circuit is presented to improve power efficiency, reduce contention and increase robustness. The proposed design employs a conditionally controlled keeper with a stacked footer network to regulate PDN, thereby suppressing leakage, reducing contention and minimizing unnecessary switching at the dynamic node. This results in lowering effective capacitance and improving evaluation speed. Simulation results in 90 nm CMOS technology for 8-64 input OR gates demonstrate up to 20% reduction in power consumption, 19% improvement in PDP and up to 1.8× improvement in noise immunity, along with 1.86× improvement in FOM and reduced variability under Monte Carlo analysis. A tag comparator implemented using the proposed circuit achieves up to 29% reduction in power consumption and 23% reduction in delay, while maintaining robust operation across PVT variations.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出一种新的宽扇入多米诺逻辑电路，以解决缩放CMOS技术中高扇入门面临的争用、泄漏和动态节点不稳定问题。设计采用条件控制保持器和堆叠脚管网络来调节下拉网络，从而抑制泄漏、降低争用并减少动态节点不必要的开关活动。90 nm CMOS仿真表明，该方法在8至64输入OR门和标签比较器中可降低功耗、改善功耗延迟积、提高噪声容限，并在PVT变化下保持较强鲁棒性。

articles.title: DL-HIDS-IoT: A Lightweight Deep Learning-Enhanced Hybrid Intrusion Detection System for IoT and Wireless Sensor Networks
articles.title_zh: DL-HIDS-IoT：面向物联网与无线传感器网络的轻量级深度学习增强混合入侵检测系统
articles.abstract: The rapid expansion of Internet of Things (IoT) devices and Wireless Sensor Networks (WSN) has opened up a vast and largely unprotected attack surface. Traditional intrusion detection systems (IDS) simply were not built with these environments in mind — the computational demands, memory requirements, and power consumption make them impractical for the microcontroller-class hardware that most IoT devices run on. In this paper, we introduce DL-HIDS-IoT, a hybrid intrusion detection framework that brings together Snort-based signature detection and a compressed Convolutional Neural Network — Bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (CNN-BiLSTM) anomaly engine, jointly designed from the ground up to operate within the tight resource budgets of IoT and WSN nodes. This work builds on the hybrid IDS foundation laid by Garg and Maheshwari (2016a–d), who demonstrated in a series of four papers that signature and anomaly detection are genuinely complementary rather than competing approaches. DL-HIDS-IoT takes that architectural insight and advances it with modern deep learning, model compression, and federated training. We evaluated the system on three widely used benchmarks: NSL-KDD, UNSW-NB15, and N-BaIoT. The results are encouraging: 98.6% overall detection accuracy, a false-positive rate of 1.2%, and an F1-score of 0.984, with a model footprint of just 1.3 MB and an average inference latency of 18 ms — placing DL-HIDS-IoT squarely within the range of what microcontroller-class IoT hardware can realistically support. To protect privacy, the system uses a federated training protocol that keeps raw traffic data local, sharing only compressed gradient updates across the network.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出DL-HIDS-IoT，一种面向资源受限物联网设备和无线传感器网络的轻量级混合入侵检测框架。系统结合基于Snort的特征签名检测与压缩的CNN-BiLSTM异常检测引擎，并引入模型压缩和联邦训练以适配微控制器级硬件的计算、内存和能耗限制。作者在NSL-KDD、UNSW-NB15等常用基准数据集上评估该系统，旨在证明签名检测与异常检测在低资源安全场景中的互补性。

articles.title: Chirality routing non-polaritonic vacuum correlations in Landau polaritons
articles.title_zh: 朗道极化激元中手性路由的非极化激元真空关联
articles.abstract: Ultrastrong coupling between matter and cavity vacuum fields can turn the electromagnetic vacuum into a structured quantum environment, thereby opening passive routes for modifying and manipulating material properties. Recent work has identified light--matter entanglement as an important ingredient in these property changes, which raises the question of where the relevant vacuum correlations actually reside. Landau polaritons provide chiral ultrastrong coupling systems in which one circular cavity polarization forms the bright polariton branches. Here, using a quantum information approach, we show that an exact chiral charge in a multimode Hopfield model routes the dominant anomalous correlations, squeezing, and cavity–matter entanglement into the opposite polarization. We find that, using parameters extracted from a multimode Landau polariton system, this hidden sector correlates the cyclotron resonance with finite momentum magnetoplasmons through Gaussian discord, while pairwise matter–matter entanglement remains absent. We further predict a polarization anisotropy of dressed vacuum electric field fluctuations as a signature of this chiral routing. These results identify chirality as a symmetry principle for organizing ultrastrong coupling vacua and show that quantum information tools provide a powerful framework for revealing the salient properties of Landau polaritons.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察超强光-物质耦合如何将电磁真空塑造成结构化量子环境，并关注相关真空关联在朗道极化激元体系中的分布。作者基于多模Hopfield模型和量子信息方法表明，精确的手性荷会将主要的反常关联、压缩效应和腔-物质纠缠路由到与明亮极化激元相反的圆偏振通道。研究还预测了缀饰真空电场涨落的偏振各向异性，可作为这种手性路由的实验信号。

articles.title: Intrinsic response of electronic structure and Li-ion migration in layered LiCoO₂ to low-field magnetic perturbation
articles.title_zh: 层状LiCoO₂电子结构与锂离子迁移对低场磁扰动的本征响应
articles.abstract: Publication date: 25 July 2026 Source: Computational Materials Science, Volume 272 Author(s): Guanqiang Ruan, Jie Tang, Xiaoming Li, Yuhang Zhu, Honggang Yang, Kuo Yang, Xiangdong Kong
articles.abstract_zh: 该条目提供的信息主要为题名、期刊来源和作者元数据，未给出详细摘要。根据题名判断，该工作围绕层状LiCoO₂在低场磁扰动下的电子结构变化和锂离子迁移行为展开，可能采用计算材料学方法分析其本征响应机制。具体模型、参数与结论需查阅原文。

articles.title: Room-Temperature Intrinsic Nonlinear Planar Hall Effect in TaIrTe₄
articles.title_zh: TaIrTe₄中的室温本征非线性平面霍尔效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): Chang Jiang, Fan Yang, Yu Zhao, Jinshan Yang, Peng Yu, Huiying Liu, Yuda Zhang, Zehao Jia, Xiangyu Cao, Li Tian, Jingyi Yan, Zheng Liu, Zhongkai Liu, Xian-Lei Sheng, Cong Xiao, Shengyuan A. Yang, Shaoming Dong, and Faxian Xiu A room-temperature intrinsic nonlinear planar Hall effect in the nonmagnetic topological semimetal TaIrTe 4 reveals how an in-plane magnetic field generates a Berry-connection-polarizability dipole through an orbital mechanism. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 136, 236302] Published Fri Jun 12, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究报道了非磁性拓扑半金属TaIrTe₄中的室温本征非线性平面霍尔效应。摘要指出，面内磁场可通过轨道机制产生Berry联络极化率偶极，从而导致该非线性输运响应。该发现为理解拓扑材料中由几何量和轨道效应驱动的室温非线性霍尔现象提供了实验依据。

articles.title: Hund's coupling governed orbital-selective superconductivity in Ba₁−ₓKₓFe₂As₂
articles.title_zh: Ba₁−ₓKₓFe₂As₂ 中由洪特耦合支配的轨道选择性超导
articles.abstract: Author(s): Elena Corbae, Rong Zhang, Cong Li, Kunihiro Kihou, Chul-Ho Lee, Makoto Hashimoto, Thomas Devereaux, Oscar Tjernberg, Egor Babaev, Dung-Hai Lee, Vadim Grinenko, Donghui Lu, and Zhi-Xun Shen While the influence of electronic correlations on superconductivity is a defining question, identifying how these correlations manifest in the superconducting state remains difficult. Furthermore, in multiorbital systems, correlations driven by Hund’s coupling can differentiate the behavior of individual orbitals, and how such orbital selectivity governs superconducting pairing has remained largely unexplored experimentally. Here, the authors use angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy to experimentally determine the superconducting gap of a representative iron-based superconductor as the Hund’s coupling influence increases. They find increased correlation diminishes the superconducting gap in an orbital-selective way, suggesting that Hund’s coupling plays a central role in shaping pairing in multiorbital superconductors. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 224517] Published Fri Jun 12, 2026

They show that these systems realize a unifying landscape of Majorana metals with topological Fermi surfaces, nodal lines, and Weyl points, and show how symmetry and flavor mixing control their splitting, stability, and topological transitions. This provides an organizing framework for gapless fractionalized quantum spin liquid phases in three dimensions. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 235120] Published Fri Jun 12, 2026

articles.title: Pair density modulation from nematic superconductivity in systems with intra-unit-cell symmetry breaking

articles.abstract: Nature Communications, Published online: 12 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-74221-7 The authors present a theoretical mechanism for the recently-observed pair density modulation in exfoliated flakes of the iron-based superconductor FeTe0.55Se0.45. The mechanism is based on the appearance of a nematic mixed s± + d superconducting phase in a system with broken glide mirror symmetry.

articles.title: Elastica++: A high-performance, multiphysics framework for large interacting assemblies of Cosserat rods
articles.title_zh: Elastica++：面向大规模相互作用 Cosserat 杆集合的高性能多物理场框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2605.13766v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Soft, slender structures are ubiquitous in natural and engineered systems, with broad application potential from biomimetic materials to soft robotics. However, there is a notable lack of computational tools that simultaneously preserve high-fidelity continuum rod mechanics, scale to large interacting ensembles, and remain flexible across diverse biophysical settings. Here we introduce Elastica++, an open-source, high-performance implementation of the Cosserat-rod model for large-scale simulations of slender-body dynamics. Elastica++ combines performance-oriented kernels with shared-memory parallelism to sustain teraflop-scale throughput despite complex discretization domains and physical interactions. The framework further interoperates with external numerical solvers, supporting efficient multiphysics workflows. We demonstrate robustness and breadth through case studies spanning passive nest-like metamaterials, collective active-matter dynamics, cilia carpets, soft magnetic microrobots, and schooling swimmers. Elastica++ thus provides a missing foundation for high-throughput studies of emergent behavior in interacting assemblies of elastic slender structures.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文介绍了 Elastica++，一个开源高性能 Cosserat 杆模型实现，用于大规模细长体动力学模拟。该框架结合面向性能的计算内核与共享内存并行，可在复杂离散结构和多种物理相互作用下实现高吞吐模拟，并能与外部数值求解器协同工作。作者通过巢状超材料、集体主动物质、纤毛毯、软磁微机器人和群游泳体等案例展示了其稳健性与适用范围。
authors: Tejaswin Parthasarathy, Seung Hyun Kim, Songyuan Cui, Mattia Gazzola

articles.title: Development of Physically Constrained Machine Learning Surrogates for Rapid Settlement Prediction in Complex Tropical Peats
articles.title_zh: 面向复杂热带泥炭快速沉降预测的物理约束机器学习替代模型开发
articles.abstract: Tropical peat deposits in Malaysia, comprising fibric, hemic, and sapric materials, are extremely compressible as the water content often > 200% and reported up to 2200%, initial void ratio typically 5 up to 30, and low shear strength of from 5 to 25 kPa, creating major risks for road embankments through excessive consolidation settlement and instability. This study aimed to quantify when classical one-dimensional (1D) consolidation theory remains valid and when two-dimensional (2D) stress redistribution demands advanced modelling, and to develop physically constrained machine-learning surrogates Artificial Neural Network (ANN) versus Support Vector Regression (SVR) for rapid settlement prediction. Settlement behavior was first examined through a parametric sensitivity framework comparing a theoretical 1D analytical baseline with 2D finite element analysis using the Soft Soil Model, revealing close alignment for decomposed peats under standard loading but divergence up to 21% for highly fibrous peats at maximum void ratios, indicating thresholds where lateral yielding and multidirectional stress transfer dominate. A synthetic database was then generated by varying governing embankment–peat variables across realistic Malaysian ranges, producing 24,000 scenarios; physical feasibility was enforced via a settlement-to-depth constraint (ST/Dp < 1.0), removing around 3,000 non-physical cases with including extreme case of cc = 3.15 with eo = 15 at shallow depths and yielding 21,000 high-fidelity samples. An MLP ANN (9 inputs; 128–64 hidden neurons; tanh; Adam; L2 = 0.0001; early stopping) and an RBF-kernel SVR (GridSearchCV, 5-fold CV, standardized inputs) were trained, validated and tested (70/15/15) and evaluated using R², RMSE, and MAE. Both achieved R² > 0.999. As per prediction, SVR provided superior global accuracy on testing (R² = 0.999872, RMSE = 8.033 mm, MAE = 6.025 mm) versus ANN (R² = 0.999655, RMSE = 13.190 mm, MAE = 9.646 mm). Correlation and trend verification confirmed settlement is primarily governed by peat depth (r = 0.55) and compression index (r = 0.53), with controlled inverse sensitivity to eo and weaker but physically consistent effects of groundwater level and embankment loading. Overall, SVR is recommended for high-precision prediction within the trained domain, while ANN showed stronger physical fidelity in isolated parametric interpretations, underscoring that geotechnical ML surrogates should be judged by both statistical performance and mechanistic consistency.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对马来西亚高含水率、高孔隙比和低抗剪强度的热带泥炭，评估传统一维固结理论的适用范围以及何时需要考虑二维应力重分布。作者将一维解析基准与采用软土模型的二维有限元分析进行对比，发现分解程度较高的泥炭在常规荷载下吻合较好，而高纤维泥炭在极端孔隙比条件下偏差明显，表明侧向屈服和多向应力传递不可忽略。研究进一步构建合成数据库，并开发物理约束的 ANN 与 SVR 替代模型，用于快速预测路堤沉降。

articles.title: Development of a Path Loss Model for Mobile Communication Signal Propagation over Water Bodies
articles.title_zh: 水体上方移动通信信号传播路径损耗模型的建立
articles.abstract: Existing wireless propagation models are optimized for terrestrial and urban environments. Still, their accuracy declines over water bodies due to unique channel characteristics such as high reflectivity, surface conductivity, and evaporation ducting. This creates uncertainty for network planners and optimizers deploying coastal, maritime, and inland water communication systems. This work conducted a measurement campaign to derive a path loss model for over water bodies’ channel environment at 1800 MHz signal propagation carrier frequency. The derived models are for the environment of over fresh water bodies and ocean environment, this is because water salinity, which is different for fresh and salt water affect signal propagation. The path loss exponent for over fresh water is 2, with the addition of model saturating signal power of -19.43dBm which yield the mean error with reference to the measured signal power value of 0.0067dB and for over salt water, the path loss exponent is 2.88, with the addition of model saturating signal power of -10.52dBm which yield the mean error with reference to the measured signal power value of 0.00143dB. While for free space and two ray models on over fresh water yield the mean errors of -19.43dB and -45.3dB respectively and for on over ocean water yield the mean errors of -13dB and -48.62dB respectively.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对水体环境中无线传播模型精度不足的问题，在 1800 MHz 载频下开展测量并建立水上路径损耗模型。由于淡水与海水盐度不同会影响信号传播，作者分别给出了淡水和盐水环境模型，其中淡水路径损耗指数为 2，盐水为 2.88，并引入饱和信号功率项以提高与实测数据的一致性。该工作可为海岸、海上及内陆水域通信网络规划与优化提供参考。

articles.title: The Investigation of Morphological and Thermal Properties of SAN/PMMA/MWCNT Nanocomposites
articles.title_zh: SAN/PMMA/MWCNT 纳米复合材料形貌与热性能研究
articles.abstract: This study investigated the effects of multi-walled carbon nanotubes (MWCNTs) on the phase morphology and thermal behavior of poly(styrene-co-acrylonitrile) (SAN)/poly (methyl methacrylate) (PMMA) blend systems, with particular emphasis on the localization behavior of MWCNTs within the phases and at the phase interface. Nanocomposite films with varying SAN/PMMA ratios and MWCNT loadings were prepared via solvent casting and characterized using SEM, FTIR, XRD, DSC, and TGA analyses within a multiscale framework. SEM observations revealed that MWCNTs were preferentially localized at the SAN/PMMA phase interface, where they suppressed phase coalescence and refined the characteristic phase morphology. Although wetting coefficient calculations predicted thermodynamic preference toward the PMMA phase, the experimental findings indicated that solvent evaporation-induced viscosity increase kinetically restricted nanotube migration, leading to interfacial trapping. FTIR analyses showed no evidence of new covalent bond formation, while slight reductions in PMMA carbonyl band intensity suggested steric shielding and reduced functional-group accessibility. XRD results confirmed that the nanocomposites retained their dominant amorphous structure despite MWCNT incorporation. DSC analyses demonstrated a single glass transition temperature (Tg) for all compositions, indicating that the segmental homogeneity and miscibility character of the system were preserved. Thermogravimetric analyses revealed that increasing MWCNT content systematically improved thermal stability, shifted degradation temperatures to higher values, and increased char formation. This behavior was attributed to the discontinuous interfacial MWCNT network, which generated a barrier/labyrinth effect limiting volatile diffusion during degradation. Overall, the results demonstrate that interfacial localized MWCNTs act not only as reinforcing nanofillers but also as morphological regulators governing phase stability and thermal degradation behavior in SAN/PMMA nanocomposite systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察多壁碳纳米管对 SAN/PMMA 共混体系相形貌和热行为的影响，重点关注其在各相及相界面的定位行为。实验表明，MWCNTs 优先滞留在 SAN/PMMA 相界面，抑制相并合并细化相结构；尽管理论润湿系数预测其热力学上偏向 PMMA 相，但溶剂蒸发导致的黏度上升会动力学限制纳米管迁移。FTIR 未显示新的共价键形成，XRD、DSC 和 TGA 等表征用于进一步揭示纳米复合体系的结构与热性质变化。

articles.title: Electric-Field-Induced Ferromagnetic-to-Altermagnetic Transition in a Two-Dimensional Fractional-Quantum Ferroelectric Multiferroic
articles.title_zh: 二维分数量子铁电多铁材料中电场诱导的铁磁—交替磁相变
articles.abstract: Electric-field control of magnetic phase transitions offers a promising route toward energy-efficient and high-density spintronic devices, yet its reliable realization in multiferroic materials remains highly challenging. In this work, we address this challenge by integrating fractional-quantum ferroelectricity (FQFE) with p-electron ferromagnetism, thereby enabling electric-field-driven switching between ferromagnetic (FM) and altermagnetic (AM) states. First-principles calculations identify monolayer ScO2 as a two-dimensional multiferroic platform that realizes this coupling mechanism. In this material, a second-order Jahn–Teller (SOJT) distortion gives rise to mixed ferroic order comprising orthogonal FQFE–antiferroelectric (AFE) and ferroelastic (FA) orders. These ferroic distortions provide electrically addressable structural degrees of freedom that are coupled to spin-polarized O-2p-derived magnetism. Remarkably, an in-plane electric field as low as 0.075 V/Å applied along the FQFE direction drives an FM-to-AM phase transition, switching the system between conventional FM and d-wave AM spin-splitting states. Moreover, AFE switching allows reversible sign reversal of the AM spin splitting with an energy barrier of 38.9 meV/f.u., while 120°AFE/FA switching reorients the momentum-space spin texture with an even lower barrier of 25.3 meV/f.u. These findings establish FQFE-assisted low-field magnetic transition and reveal an SOJT-enabled ferroic mechanism for energy-efficient spin-texture control in two-dimensional multiferroics.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出将分数量子铁电性与 p 电子铁磁性结合，以实现电场驱动的铁磁态与交替磁态切换。第一性原理计算表明，单层 ScO2 可作为二维多铁平台，其中二阶 Jahn–Teller 畸变产生包含正交分数量子铁电—反铁电序和铁弹序的混合铁性结构，并与 O-2p 自旋极化磁性耦合。研究发现，沿分数量子铁电方向施加较低面内电场即可驱动铁磁到 d 波交替磁自旋劈裂态的相变，反铁电翻转还可实现交替磁自旋劈裂符号的可逆反转。

articles.title: NISQ-Compatible Variational Quantum Solver for Lyapunov Equations
articles.title_zh: 面向 NISQ 设备的 Lyapunov 方程变分量子求解器
articles.abstract: noindent This paper applies the Variational Quantum Linear Solver (VQLS) to the continuous-time Lyapunov equation A^T X + X A = -Q. Using the Kronecker product formulation, the matrix equation is transformed into the linear system H z = b, where H = Iₙ øtimes A^T + A^T øtimes Iₙ and z = vec(X). VQLS approximates the solution via parameterized quantum circuits optimized in a hybrid quantum-classical loop. Numerical experiments on four control system benchmarks with Kronecker dimensions up to 25 × 25 demonstrate residual norms as low as 10⁻⁹, with logarithmic qubit scaling (2-5 qubits) and shallow circuit depths (6-14 layers) suitable for near-term quantum devices. Compared to the HHL algorithm, VQLS offers reduced circuit complexity and qubit overhead, making it practical for noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. This paper demonstrates the potential of variational quantum algorithms for solving Lyapunov equations in control and dynamical systems applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文将变分量子线性求解器（VQLS）用于连续时间 Lyapunov 方程 A^T X + X A = -Q 的求解，并通过 Kronecker 积将矩阵方程转化为线性系统 Hz=b。作者采用参数化量子线路与经典优化相结合的混合框架近似求解，在多个控制系统基准问题上获得较低残差。结果表明，该方法具有对数级量子比特需求和较浅线路深度，相比 HHL 算法更适合近期含噪中等规模量子设备。

articles.title: Sol–Gel-Derived Zn-Substituted Akermanite for Bioactive Chitosan Composite Coatings: Correlating Composition, Corrosion Protection, and Apatite-Forming Ability on AZ31 Magnesium Alloy
articles.title_zh: 溶胶–凝胶法制备锌取代钙镁黄长石用于生物活性壳聚糖复合涂层：AZ31 镁合金上组成、腐蚀防护与磷灰石形成能力的关联
articles.abstract: Zn-substituted akermanite powders (Ca₂ZnₓMg₁₋ₓSi₂O₇, x = 0–0.5) were synthesized via a sol–gel route and employed as functional ceramic fillers in chitosan-based composite coatings deposited on AZ31 magnesium alloy by electrophoretic deposition (EPD). The study aimed to establish correlations between Zn substitution, coating characteristics, corrosion resistance, and bioactivity. Sol–gel processing enabled homogeneous incorporation of Zn²⁺ into the akermanite lattice, resulting in phase-pure crystalline powders with modified microstructural features. Stable ceramic–polymer suspensions were obtained through electrosteric stabilization arising from interactions between protonated chitosan chains and hydroxylated particle surfaces, facilitating the formation of uniform composite coatings. The influence of Zn content on coating morphology, electrochemical behavior, and apatite-forming ability was investigated using structural, morphological, and electrochemical characterization techniques. Electrochemical measurements demonstrated that Zn substitution significantly improved the protective performance of the coatings, with the Ak0.2Zn/chitosan coating exhibiting the highest impedance modulus and lowest corrosion current density after immersion in simulated body fluid (SBF). The enhanced corrosion resistance was attributed to the formation of a dense and homogeneous coating structure that effectively restricted electrolyte penetration and mitigated localized corrosion. Furthermore, Zn incorporation promoted the nucleation and growth of a uniform cauliflower-like calcium phosphate layer, yielding a Ca/P ratio close to that of stoichiometric hydroxyapatite. In contrast, undoped akermanite coatings showed inferior barrier properties and less uniform biomineralization. The results demonstrate that controlled Zn substitution in sol–gel-derived akermanite provides an effective strategy for simultaneously enhancing corrosion protection and bioactivity of chitosan-based coatings on magnesium alloys. The Ak0.2Zn/chitosan coating exhibited the most favorable balance between structural stability, electrochemical performance, and apatite-forming ability, highlighting its potential for biodegradable orthopedic implant applications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究通过溶胶–凝胶法合成 Zn 取代钙镁黄长石粉体，并将其作为功能陶瓷填料用于 AZ31 镁合金表面的壳聚糖复合涂层。研究考察了 Zn 掺杂对粉体结构、涂层形貌、电化学腐蚀行为及体外磷灰石形成能力的影响。结果显示，适量 Zn 取代有助于提高涂层的防护性能和生物活性，其中 Ak0.2Zn/壳聚糖涂层表现出较优的阻抗与综合性能。

articles.title: Wireless Battery Management System with Data- Driven Modelling
articles.title_zh: 基于数据驱动建模的无线电池管理系统
articles.abstract: The objective of this research is to develop and analyze through experimentation a wireless battery management system (WBMS) prototype capable of tracking multiple Li-Ion battery cells (3.7 V, 2600 mAh). The sample loss ratio (SLR), latency, switching delay, and monitoring duty cycle of two wireless communication methods, Bluetooth Classic HC-05 and ZigBee XBee Series 2, have been examined under conditions where the battery pack is monitored on a per-minute basis for two hours. Three runs per communication protocol have been performed to increase accuracy of outcomes. A wireless network with star topology has been utilized, employing Arduino Uno as the target and control node, which included ACS712 sensors for current measurement and resistive voltage dividers for voltage measurement. It has been found that ZigBee outperforms Bluetooth Classic HC-05 in terms of lower SLR (1.2% versus 43.9%), shorter latency (128 ms versus 287 ms), and higher monitoring duty cycle (100% versus 30.8%), respectively. Linear regression analysis (R² = 0.9987) has been used to correlate SLR values with Coulomb counting state-of-charge (SOC) estimation error rates, producing a design formula. Implementation of the exponentially weighted moving average (EMA) prediction technique has been shown to reduce SOC estimation errors by an average of 47.9%. Significance testing between samples was carried out using the 95% confidence interval and two-sample t-test (p < 0.001). The best condition for determining a dual sampling frequency was found to be fi mod fv = 0, with fi ≥ fv.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发并实验评估了一种用于多节锂离子电池监测的无线电池管理系统原型，比较了 Bluetooth Classic HC-05 与 ZigBee XBee Series 2 两种无线通信方案。实验考察了样本丢失率、延迟、切换延迟和监测占空比等指标，并在星型网络结构下使用 Arduino 与电压、电流传感模块采集数据。结果表明，ZigBee 在样本丢失率、延迟和监测连续性方面明显优于蓝牙方案；研究还利用线性回归建立了样本丢失率与库仑计量 SOC 估计误差之间的关联。

articles.title: Microwave-Assisted Synthesis of Co-Doped Chromium Oxide Nanocomposites: Structural, Optical and DC Conductivity Studies
articles.title_zh: 微波辅助合成钴掺杂氧化铬纳米复合材料及其结构、光学和直流电导研究
articles.abstract: A novel and efficient microwave-assisted synthesis route has been employed to fabricate cobalt (Co) doped chromium oxide (Cr₂O₃) nanocomposites with varying Co concentrations of 1%, 3%, and 5%, designated as CCO1, CCO3, and CCO5, respectively. The progressive incorporation of Co into the Cr₂O₃ lattice induced a red shift in the absorption edge, as evidenced by UV-Vis and photoluminescence (PL)spectroscopy, indicating a modulation of the intrinsic bandgap. Structural integration of Co within the Cr₂O₃ matrix was confirmed through X-ray diffraction (XRD) and energy dispersive X-ray (EDAX) spectroscopy. Detailed morphological and crystallographic analyses were obtained using scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and high-resolution transmission electron microscopy (HRTEM). Furthermore, Fourier transform infrared (FTIR) and Raman spectral analyses revealed characteristic peak shifts, reflecting alterations in the local chemical environment due to cobalt substitution. In addition, DC conductivity measurements were performed to probe the charge transport behaviour of the nanocomposites. The synthesised Co-doped Cr₂O₃ nanocomposites exhibit enhanced structural integrity, tunable optical properties, and a well-defined morphology, underscoring their potential applications in advanced energy storage systems and lithium-ion batteries.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文采用微波辅助方法制备了不同 Co 掺杂浓度的 Cr₂O₃ 纳米复合材料，并系统研究其结构、形貌、光学和电输运性质。XRD、EDAX、SEM、HRTEM、FTIR 与 Raman 等表征证实 Co 成功进入 Cr₂O₃ 晶格并改变局部化学环境。紫外–可见与光致发光结果显示吸收边红移和带隙调控，直流电导测试进一步揭示了掺杂对载流子传输行为的影响。

articles.title: Highly dispersed Cobalt Catalyst in SBA-15 (Co@NC-SBA-15): A Promising Approach for Efficient, Mild and Selective C-H Bonds Oxidation Using Household Bleach
articles.title_zh: SBA-15 中高度分散的钴催化剂（Co@NC-SBA-15）：利用家用漂白剂高效、温和、选择性氧化 C–H 键的有前景方法
articles.abstract: Herein, a novel cobalt-based catalyst supported in mesoporous silica SBA-15 (Co@NC-SBA-15) was developed as a highly active non-precious metal catalyst. Comprehensive characterization via FT-IR, XRD, XPS, BET, TEM, FE-SEM, EDX, EDX mapping, TGA, ICP-OES and DRS confirmed the structural integrity, with high dispersion of the cobalt active sites and thermal stability of the catalyst. The aforementioned catalyst with the narrow particle size distribution (1.5-4 nm) exhibited excellent efficiency and selectivity in the oxidation of benzylic & allylic C-H bonds. This transformation proceeded without any organic solvent at room temperature, employing household bleach (aqueous solution of NaOCl) as an inexpensive, non-toxic and readily available oxidant. Desired carbonyl products were obtained from the oxidation reactions of various benzylic and allylic C-H bonds under the mild conditions. The catalyst retained its activity over six successive cycles, showing negligible cobalt leaching and structural degradation. This study highlights the potential of Co@NC-SBA-15 as a sustainable, low-cost alternative to noble metal catalysts for the oxidation of benzylic & allylic C-H bonds, offering significant advantages in terms of green chemistry metrics, operational simplicity and catalytic performance.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究开发了一种负载于介孔二氧化硅 SBA-15 的非贵金属钴催化剂 Co@NC-SBA-15，并通过多种表征确认其活性位点高度分散、结构稳定且具有热稳定性。该催化剂可在室温、无有机溶剂条件下，使用廉价易得的家用漂白剂作为氧化剂，实现苄位和烯丙位 C–H 键的选择性氧化。催化剂在多次循环中仍保持活性，钴流失和结构退化较小，显示出替代贵金属催化剂的可持续应用潜力。

articles.title: An Integrated Analytical Framework Linking Green-Blue Infrastructure Spatial Patterns to UTCI-derived Thermal Stress
articles.title_zh: 连接绿蓝基础设施空间格局与基于 UTCI 的热应激的综合分析框架
articles.abstract: Urban heat stress poses an increasingly critical challenge in the context of climate change and rapid urbanization, prompting the adoption of Green-Blue Infrastructure (GBI) as a key mitigation strategy. Despite its recognized potential, previous studies have reported inconsistent findings regarding the relationship between GBI spatial configuration and urban thermal environments, primarily due to methodological variations and urban structural diversity. To address these limitations, this study proposes a quantitative analytical framework grounded in the Universal Thermal Climate Index (UTCI), which captures human-perceived thermal stress more effectively than traditional land surface temperature (LST)-based approaches. Employing data from the Seoul metropolitan area, the study identified 1,800 meters as the optimal spatial scale for capturing GBI-thermal relationships. Through correlation and multicollinearity analyses, seven landscape metrics were selected to characterize GBI morphology, including vegetation condition, spatial composition, configuration, and connectivity. These metrics included NDVIₘₑₐₙ (vegetation vitality), C_G_PLAND (proportional dominance of green infrastructure), C_G_SHAPE_AM and C_GB_SHAPE_AM (area-weighted shape complexity of green and green–blue patches), C_G_SPLIT and L_GB_PD (fragmentation intensity at class and landscape levels), and L_GB_COHESION (spatial connectivity and continuity of GBI). Subsequent application of a Random Forest Regression model revealed that C_G_PLAND, L_GB_COHESION, and NDVIₘₑₐₙ exert the greatest influence on UTCI variation. These findings suggest that the cooling capacity of urban GBI is determined not only by its extent but also by vegetation quality and spatial connectivity. The proposed framework enables consistent time-series analysis and provides a transferable approach for evaluating and optimizing climate-responsive GBI strategies across different urban contexts.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究针对城市热应激问题，提出了一个基于通用热气候指数（UTCI）的定量分析框架，用于评估绿蓝基础设施空间格局与人体感知热压力之间的关系。以首尔都市区为案例，研究确定了 1800 米为空间尺度上的较优分析窗口，并筛选出表征植被状况、空间组成、格局和连通性的景观指标。该框架旨在克服仅依赖地表温度方法的局限，为城市绿蓝基础设施规划和热风险缓解提供更具人体热舒适导向的依据。

articles.title: First-principles evidences of optical damage resistance enhancement in Bi-doped lithium niobate via Mg/Zn co-doping
articles.title_zh: 第一性原理证据表明 Mg/Zn 共掺杂可增强 Bi 掺杂铌酸锂的抗光损伤能力
articles.abstract: Lithium niobate (LN), as an artificial dielectric crystal, holds significant importance due to its outstanding photorefractive and nonlinear properties. However, undesirable local changes in the refractive index of the crystal due to intense light, called optical damage, is the main obstacle for nonlinear optical applications of this system. Using large supercells containing over 500 atoms to address realistic doping concentrations, we employ density functional calculations to investigate the effects of double doping with bismuth and a divalent atom (magnesium and zinc) on electronic structure and optical damage resistance of LN. To shed light on the role of concentration threshold on the behavior of LN, the calculations are conducted at two distinct divalent concentrations: one that is below the threshold and another above it. It is argued that in both cases, the divalent impurity enhances absorption coefficient of the system in the desired working frequencies. The findings indicate that beyond the threshold, the doped crystal exhibits an increased optical conductivity, which is attributed to the migration of Bi and excess divalent impurity from Li to the Nb sites, resulting in an enhanced optical damage resistance. We argue that these substitutions narrow the effective band gap, displace bismuth energy levels toward the conduction band, and introduce two shallow Zn-d states above the valence band, thereby increasing the absorption coefficient of the post-threshold samples at selected green and blue laser frequencies. Furthermore, reduction of lithium vacancies beyond the threshold improves optical conductivity and consequently enhances resistance to the optical damage.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用包含 500 多个原子的大超胞密度泛函计算，考察 Bi 与 Mg 或 Zn 共掺杂对铌酸锂电子结构和抗光损伤性能的影响。作者比较了二价掺杂浓度低于和高于阈值两种情形，分析杂质占位迁移、吸收系数和光电导变化。结果表明，超过阈值时 Bi 及过量二价杂质从 Li 位向 Nb 位迁移可能增强光电导，从而影响并改善材料的抗光损伤行为。

articles.title: A statistical study of the developments of the inner magnetospheric ion on geomagnetic disturbance and solar activity using 7-year Arase observations
articles.title_zh: 基于 7 年 Arase 观测的内磁层离子随地磁扰动和太阳活动演化的统计研究
articles.abstract: Using recent in-situ Arase satellite observations during Solar Cycle 25, between March 2017 and December 2023, we perform a comprehensive statistical study of the inner magnetospheric ion (H+, He+, and O+) distributions as a function of geomagnetic conditions and solar activity. The analysis employed the intercalibration method to combine two ion datasets (LEPi and MEPi) onboard the Arase satellite, covering an energy range of 0.03–187 keV/q. In this study, we found distinct ion populations on energy: (1) plasmaspheric population (E < 30 eV) at L < 5; (2) suprathermal population at energies of several tens of eV to several keV at L > 5 for H+ and L < 5 for He+ and O+; (3) ring current population (E = 1 keV – several tens of keV) with the ion nose structures; and (4) high-energy ring current particles (E > 30 keV) with symmetric MLT distributions. Ion fluxes and partial number densities exhibited significant enhancements with increasing Kp levels and solar activity. The O+ fraction increased dramatically during periods of elevated Kp and enhanced solar activity, becoming comparable to the H+ contribution within the plasmasphere. From our observations, we suggest that ion behavior in the inner magnetosphere is strongly influenced by geomagnetic disturbance levels and solar activity. This ion behavior can provide the favorable conditions for understanding the major driver of various magnetospheric plasma waves.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究利用 2017 年 3 月至 2023 年 12 月 Arase 卫星在位观测数据，统计分析内磁层 H+、He+ 和 O+ 离子分布随地磁活动和太阳活动的变化。研究通过交叉定标整合 LEPi 与 MEPi 离子数据，覆盖 0.03–187 keV/q 能量范围，并识别出等离子体层、超热离子、环电流及高能环电流等不同离子群。结果显示，随着 Kp 指数和太阳活动增强，离子通量与部分数密度明显上升，O+ 比例在扰动期间显著增加，反映出内磁层离子组成与动力学对空间天气条件高度敏感。

articles.title: Sign-Engineered Interactions Enable Dynamic Frustration and Topology in a Passive Elastic Lattice
articles.title_zh: 符号可工程化相互作用在被动弹性晶格中实现动态阻挫与拓扑
articles.abstract: The sign and strength of interactions between coupled elements dictate collective behavior across diverse physical systems. While active modulation can engineer these interactions, passive systems typically rely on fixed structures that require a change in lattice connectivity or global symmetry to reverse interaction signs. Here we demonstrate that local anisotropy enables continuous Hamiltonian sign engineering in central-force elastic lattices. Rotating the internal anisotropic confinement projects interactions onto local degrees of freedom, decomposing the dynamics into spectrally separated 1D Hamiltonians. This allows the effective couplings to be tuned from positive to negative via rotation alone, without altering the underlying force law or lattice connectivity. Implemented in a zigzag magnetoelastic lattice, this mechanism enables the simultaneous emergence of frequency-selective frustration and topological band inversion. Our results establish local anisotropy as a general tool for Hamiltonian engineering, providing a classical analogue to phonon-mediated interaction design in quantum many-body platforms.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究展示了如何在中心力弹性晶格中利用局域各向异性连续调控有效哈密顿量相互作用的符号，而无需改变晶格连接方式或基本力学定律。通过旋转内部各向异性约束，系统动力学可投影到局域自由度并分解为谱分离的一维哈密顿量，从而实现耦合由正到负的调节。在锯齿形磁弹性晶格中的实现表明，该机制可同时产生频率选择性阻挫和拓扑能带反转，为经典平台中的哈密顿量工程提供了通用方法。

articles.title: A new kind of entanglement helps quantum sensors tune out noise
articles.title_zh: 一种新型纠缠帮助量子传感器抑制噪声
articles.abstract: In a quest to build the most accurate quantum sensors in the world, scientists are constantly improving their performance, making them more precise, more stable and more reliable. But eventually, physical constraints will prevent further improvements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该新闻报道围绕量子传感器精度、稳定性和可靠性的提升展开，重点介绍一种新型纠缠在降低或规避噪声影响方面的潜在作用。由于原文摘要较短，未给出具体实验体系、性能指标或结论细节。相关技术可能服务于突破量子传感在物理约束下的性能瓶颈，详情需查阅原文。

articles.title: Diffusion model links foam physics to voting shifts and market behavior
articles.title_zh: 扩散模型将泡沫物理与投票变化和市场行为联系起来
articles.abstract: A drop of dye added to a glass of water undergoes ordinary diffusion. However, when placed on the surface of a foam, the dye spreads differently—diffusion becomes anomalous. An example of this is the pattern on the froth of a cup of cappuccino. Interestingly, recent research suggests that diffusion equations in a heterogeneous environment can also describe social phenomena, such as election results or the behavior of stock market traders. The study is published in the Chaos: An Interdisciplinary Journal of Nonlinear Science.
articles.abstract_zh: 该报道介绍了异常扩散模型如何从泡沫表面染料扩散等物理现象延伸到复杂社会系统的描述。研究指出，在非均匀环境中的扩散方程可能用于刻画选举结果变化或股票市场交易者行为等社会现象。该工作发表在《Chaos: An Interdisciplinary Journal of Nonlinear Science》，强调了非线性科学模型在跨学科问题中的应用潜力。

articles.title: Composable free-space continuous-variable quantum key distribution using discrete modulation
articles.title_zh: 采用离散调制的可组合自由空间连续变量量子密钥分发
articles.abstract: Science Advances, Volume 12, Issue 24, June 2026.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文题目表明其研究自由空间连续变量量子密钥分发，并采用离散调制方案以实现可组合安全性。给定摘要仅包含期刊卷期信息，未提供具体方法、实验设置或性能结果。该工作可能涉及自由空间量子通信中的安全证明与系统实现问题，详细结论需查阅原文。
authors: Kevin Jaksch, Thomas Dirmeier, Yannick Weiser, Stefan Richter, Ömer Bayraktar, Bastian Hacker, Conrad Rößler, Imran Khan, Stefan Petscharning, Thomas Grafenauer, Michael Hentschel, Bernhard Ömer, Christoph Pacher, Florian Kanitschar, Twesh Upadhyaya, Jie Lin, Norbert Lütkenhaus, Gerd Leuchs, Christoph Marquardt
articles.journal: AAAS: Science Advances: Table of Contents

articles.title: Charting the emergent low-dimensional manifold of quantum materials
articles.title_zh: 量子材料涌现低维流形的绘制
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12520v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The periodic table of elements transformed chemistry by revealing simple organizing principles underlying atomic behavior. Despite decades of effort, no analogous framework has emerged for crystalline materials -- their microscopic complexity and vast configurational space have defied reduction to fundamental organizing principles.
