articles.title: PCA-Enhanced Adaptive NVAR Framework for High-Resolution Sea Surface Temperature Forecasting in the East Sea
articles.title_zh: 用于东海高分辨率海表温度预测的 PCA 增强自适应 NVAR 框架
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12141v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate forecasting of sea surface temperature (SST) in regional seas such as the East Sea is crucial for monitoring marine ecosystems, assessing climate risks, managing fisheries, and conducting naval operations. Traditional numerical ocean models provide reliable predictions but are computationally expensive and often unsuitable for real-time forecasting. Many deep learning methods also struggle with high-dimensional spatiotemporal ocean data and experience error accumulation over longer forecasting periods. This study builds on our previously proposed Adaptive Next-Generation Reservoir Computing (Adaptive NVAR) framework, initially introduced and tested on synthetic dynamical systems, and extends it to ocean forecasting. We present a reduced-order forecasting framework that combines Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) with Adaptive NVAR to predict SST dynamics in the East Sea. SST fields are compressed into a low-dimensional representation using SVD, which extracts dominant modes of ocean variability. Adaptive NVAR models the temporal evolution of these latent states, and the predicted states are reconstructed into SST forecasts. We evaluate the framework using regional ocean datasets and compare it with the standard NG-RC/NVAR. Results show that Adaptive NVAR consistently achieves lower forecasting errors across multiple prediction horizons. In addition, SVD reduces computational complexity, resulting in a fast and scalable framework suitable for real-time ocean forecasting.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究将此前用于合成动力系统的自适应下一代储备计算框架扩展到东海海表温度预测。方法利用奇异值分解将高维海表温度场压缩为低维潜在状态，提取主要海洋变率模态，再由自适应 NVAR 预测这些潜在状态的时间演化，并重构为海表温度预报。该框架旨在降低传统数值海洋模型和部分深度学习方法在实时高维时空预测中的计算负担与误差累积问题。
authors: Sherkhon Azimov, Susana López-Moreno, Eric Dolores-Cuenca, JinYong Choi, Sangil Kim

articles.title: The Standard Interpretable Model: A general theory of interpretable machine learning to deductively design interpretable methods using Lagrangian mechanics
articles.title_zh: 标准可解释模型：一种利用拉格朗日力学演绎设计可解释方法的可解释机器学习通用理论
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12289v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: As Artificial Intelligence models grow in complexity, interpretability has become an indispensable tool for understanding, debugging, and controlling their computations. However, interpretability lacks general theories to deductively design interpretable methods. This gap between theories and methods results in a fragmented literature and inconsistent evaluation protocols. To fill this gap, we introduce the Standard Interpretable Model (SIM), a general theory grounded in Lagrangian mechanics that enables the deductive design of interpretable methods. Specifically, the SIM summarises, in a set of premises, what interpretability is for a target user. From these premises, the SIM systematically derives interpretability symmetries and corresponding constraints, which shape the landscape of a Lagrangian whose minima correspond to optimal interpretable models. To reach the minima, one can either update the parameter values of an opaque model to make it more interpretable or compile constraints into an interpretable architecture. We empirically show that the SIM identifies and solves limitations of existing methods (including traditional, concept-based, and mechanistic interpretability), highlights underexplored research directions, and informs the design of core programming interfaces. Beyond being a research method, the deductive nature of the SIM offers pedagogical grounding for interpretability curricula and may shift the scientific community's perspective of a discipline that has long been fragmented.
articles.abstract_zh: 本文提出标准可解释模型（SIM），试图为可解释机器学习提供一种基于拉格朗日力学的通用理论框架。SIM 将目标用户对可解释性的需求表述为一组前提，并由此前提系统推导可解释性对称性及相应约束，使最优可解释模型对应于某个拉格朗日量的极小值。该框架既可通过更新不透明模型参数提升可解释性，也可将约束编译进可解释架构，并用于分析和改进现有解释方法的局限。
authors: Pietro Barbiero, Giovanni De Felice, Mateo Espinosa Zarlenga, Francesco Giannini, Filippo Bonchi, Mateja Jamnik, Giuseppe Marra, Ruggero Noris

articles.title: Compatibility-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models
articles.title_zh: 面向大语言模型的兼容性感知动态微调
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11206v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is the predominant paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs), yet it suffers from optimization instability and limited generalization. Recent work attributes this issue to pathological gradient scaling and proposes Dynamic Fine-Tuning (DFT) to correct it at the token level. However, DFT assumes all demonstrations are equally suitable learning targets, an assumption violated by the strong heterogeneity of large-scale instruction data, where demonstration-policy mismatch induces high-variance updates at the sample level. We introduce Compatibility-Aware Dynamic Fine-Tuning (CADFT), a principled extension of DFT that controls sample-level optimization variance. CADFT derives a dynamic, policy-dependent compatibility signal from model likelihoods to modulate supervised updates, suppressing high-variance gradients from incompatible demonstrations. We further propose a delayed, low-frequency compatibility-guided rewriting strategy to transform persistently incompatible demonstrations into learnable targets. We show that CADFT can be interpreted as a variance-controlled estimator that generalizes token-level stabilization in DFT to the sample level. Extensive experiments demonstrate improved stability, generalization, and cold-start reinforcement learning initialization, while remaining fully supervised and independent of explicit reward modeling.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对监督微调在大语言模型对齐中的优化不稳定和泛化受限问题，提出兼容性感知动态微调（CADFT）。方法在动态微调的基础上，引入由模型似然导出的、依赖当前策略的样本级兼容性信号，以抑制不兼容示范带来的高方差梯度更新。作者还提出低频延迟的兼容性引导重写策略，将持续不兼容的示范转化为更可学习的目标，并从方差控制估计器角度解释该方法。
authors: Yucheng Zhou, Junwei Sheng, Qianning Wang, Jianbing Shen

articles.title: Learning Object Manipulation from Scratch via Contrastive Interaction
articles.title_zh: 通过对比式交互从零学习物体操作
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11525v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Contrastive Reinforcement Learning (CRL) has seen recent success in a wide variety of goal-conditioned robotics tasks by learning structured representations of the dynamics. However, despite its success in locomotion and simpler control domains, CRL often struggles in interaction-rich manipulation. We argue that a key source of this difficulty is object-centric interaction, such as contact or grasping, that induces distinct changes in the underlying dynamic modes. In this work, we formulate manipulation dynamics as a piecewise-smooth Markov process and show that interaction-induced mode changes create piecewise nonlinear reachability structures that are difficult for standard CRL energy functions to represent and plan over. Based on this analysis, we introduce Interaction-weighted Resampling (IWR). IWR performs interaction-aware resampling around phases before, during, and after interactions, encouraging the learned representation to preserve the mode boundaries that determine future reachability to capture multi-modal and piecewise nonlinear reachability. Across interaction-centric environments, including 2D dynamic control, robotic manipulation, and robot air hockey, IWR improves both sample efficiency and overall performance over prior CRL methods, with 19.8% average improvement in simulation. Finally, using a sim-to-real pipeline with policies trained by IWR, we demonstrate the first real-world goal-conditioned robot air hockey agent capable of hitting goals, improving success from 25% to 60%. Project Page: IWR-arxiv.github.io.
articles.abstract_zh: 对比强化学习在目标条件机器人任务中已有成功，但在接触、抓取等交互密集的操作任务中常遇到困难。该文将操作动力学表述为分段光滑马尔可夫过程，指出交互诱导的模式切换会产生分段非线性的可达性结构，标准对比强化学习难以充分表示。作者提出交互加权重采样方法，在交互前、中、后阶段进行感知交互的重采样，以保持模式边界并提升对多模态可达性的建模能力。
authors: Tongle Shen, Caleb Chuck, Fan Feng, Biwei Huang

articles.title: Family-Aware Residual Architecture for Predicting Quantum Circuit Simulation Performance
articles.title_zh: 用于预测量子电路仿真性能的家族感知残差架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11620v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Approximate tensor-network simulators enable classical simulation of quantum circuits beyond the reach of exact methods, but selecting optimal approximation parameters -- such as bond dimension thresholds -- remains a costly trial-and-error process. We present a family-aware neural architecture that predicts both the minimum approximation threshold required to achieve target fidelity and the expected wall-clock runtime for quantum circuit simulation, given only the circuit's OpenQASM description and execution context. Our key insight is that quantum circuits from different algorithmic families (e.g., QFT, Grover, VQE) exhibit fundamentally distinct simulation cost profiles due to their differing entanglement structures. We employ family-conditioned residual corrections -- additive, family-specific adjustments atop a shared backbone, drawing on established conditional computation techniques -- enabling the model to capture both universal circuit properties and algorithmic nuances. The architecture incorporates a pretrained family classifier (97.5% accuracy) and domain-informed algorithm fingerprint features derived from gate-composition heuristics. Evaluated on circuits spanning 7--130 qubits across 10 algorithm families, our system achieves 79.5% exact threshold accuracy (91.2% within one rung) and R² = 0.82 runtime correlation, with inference completing in approximately 50 ms -- replacing trial-and-error simulation runs that may take minutes to hours. Ablation studies confirm that family-aware modeling provides the single largest performance improvement (+3.2 percentage points), validating the hypothesis that algorithm family is a first-class feature for simulation cost prediction.
articles.abstract_zh: 近似张量网络仿真器可扩展经典量子电路仿真能力，但近似阈值等参数选择通常依赖昂贵的试错。该文提出一种家族感知神经网络架构，仅根据电路的 OpenQASM 描述和执行上下文，预测达到目标保真度所需的最小近似阈值及预期运行时间。核心思想是不同量子算法家族具有不同纠缠结构和仿真成本曲线，因此通过家族条件残差修正同时捕捉通用电路特征与算法特异性。
authors: Honjar Xing, Yehong Jiang, Xianbang Wang, Zehua Wang, Zhicheng Jiang

articles.title: Higher-Order Token Interactions via Quantum Attention
articles.title_zh: 通过量子注意力实现高阶词元交互
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11673v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Standard dot-product self-attention computes, in a single layer, only pairwise (order-2) interactions between tokens; representing a generic order-k interaction is known to require either super-quadratic resources in one layer or composition across depth. We introduce Quantum Higher-Order Attention (QHA), a shallow, hardware-realizable quantum attention head that, via data re-uploading and an all-to-all non-Clifford entangler, synthesizes order-k token interactions inside the circuit and exposes them through a local single-qubit read-out. We prove (i) an expressivity separation: any single standard self-attention layer with embedding dimension m, H heads and p-bit precision satisfying mHp=o(N/łogłog N) cannot represent the order-k correlation family that one QHA head represents with circuit depth O(łog k) (O(k) two-qubit gates); and (ii) a trainability guarantee for its local-design instantiation: with a local read-out and O(łog n) depth the gradient variance is Ømega(1/poly(n)) (no barren plateau), which we confirm empirically -- while being explicit that the more expressive all-to-all instantiation we benchmark is trained empirically and shows exponentially decaying gradients. Empirically, at a 6.5× smaller parameter budget, QHA generalizes hidden-subset parity of every order kłe6 from disjoint inputs, whereas the larger classical attention head collapses past order~2; consistent with theory, the size of the advantage tracks the target's Fourier degree - largest for parity and shrinking when low-order structure is present. As an application, QHA serves as a compact high-order interaction detector across three domains - genetic epistasis, learning-parity-with-noise, and graph triangle detection - reaching the noise ceiling at the smallest parameter budget where field-standard linear methods fail.
articles.abstract_zh: 标准点积自注意力在单层中主要计算词元间的二阶交互，而表示一般高阶交互通常需要超二次资源或更深网络。该文提出量子高阶注意力头，通过数据重上传和全连接非 Clifford 纠缠器在量子线路中合成高阶词元交互，并经局域单量子比特读出输出。作者给出表达能力分离结果，表明一个量子注意力头可用较浅线路表示标准单层自注意力难以表示的高阶相关族，并讨论了局域设计下避免贫瘠高原的可训练性保证。
authors: Jian Xu, Chao Li, Delu Zeng, John Paisley, Qibin Zhao

articles.title: Sparsified Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks for Interpretable Quantum State Tomography
articles.title_zh: 用于可解释量子态层析的稀疏化 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11814v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine-learning approaches to quantum state tomography can achieve high reconstruction fidelity, but the physical structure used by the trained model often remains implicit. Here we ask whether a sparsified Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) can be used not only as a regressor, but also as an inspectable reconstruction rule whose internal organization can be checked against known Pauli structure. We study a controlled three-qubit GHZ-family benchmark in which all 63 non-identity Pauli expectation values are used to reconstruct three GHZ-subspace variables: the population imbalance z, the real off-diagonal component c, and the imaginary off-diagonal component s. Under finite-shot sampling and depolarizing noise, external ablation identifies the extended 12-channel GHZ-relevant Pauli set from the 63 measurements, with exact top-12 recovery across the tested shot counts and depolarizing-noise strengths. These support patterns remain stable across multi-seed random-initialization and noise-level analyses, and collapse under random-label controls. The dominant pruned input-hidden-output pathways organize Z-type population observables and X/Y off-diagonal observables in a pattern consistent with the analytic GHZ Pauli grouping, and sparse formula recovery recovers the canonical signed Pauli relations. The contribution of the KAN is therefore pathway-level structural interpretability within a neural reconstruction model, rather than superior sparse regression. Together with negative controls, these probes provide a consistency chain for auditing learned reconstruction rules against known physical structure.
articles.abstract_zh: 机器学习量子态层析可获得较高重构保真度，但训练模型利用的物理结构往往不透明。该文研究稀疏化 Kolmogorov-Arnold 网络是否不仅能作为回归器，还能作为可检查的重构规则，并在三量子比特 GHZ 族基准上验证其内部结构与 Pauli 观测结构的一致性。结果显示，在有限采样和退相干噪声下，外部消融能够稳定识别 GHZ 相关的 Pauli 通道，剪枝后的主导路径也呈现与物理可解释变量相对应的组织结构。
authors: Xinge Wu, Huaxin Wang, Jiajun Liu, Ruiqing He, Jiandong Shang, Hengliang Guo, Qiang Chen

articles.title: Quantum Occam Learning: Sample-Supported Expressibility for Circuit-Based Quantum Learning
articles.title_zh: 量子奥卡姆学习：面向基于电路的量子学习的样本支撑表达能力
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12211v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: A central principle in quantum machine learning is that an ansatz should be expressive enough to represent the quantum data of interest. Yet, the expressibility is statistically meaningful only insofar as it can be learned from finitely many copies of an unknown quantum state. In this work, we develop an information-theoretic Occam theory for quantum data generated by finite-size quantum circuits. For the class Sₙ,G of n-qubit pure states preparable with at most G two-qubit gates, a metric-entropy argument gives the realizable sample law widetildeΘ(G/ϵ²⁾ in the circuit-limited regime. For an arbitrary source hath̊o, we introduce the best G-gate approximation error d_G(hath̊o) and the approximate circuit complexity C_η(hath̊o). We prove an agnostic quantum Occam theorem: with M copies, one can learn up to the best G-gate approximation error plus a statistical penalty widetildeO(sqrtG/M). We then remove the need to know G in advance through an adaptive model-selection theorem whose oracle inequality selects the circuit complexity justified by the data. Matching lower bounds yield a sample-supported expressibility law: at trace-distance accuracy ϵ, M samples can support only Gₘ̊ ₛᵤₚₚₒᵣₜₑd simeq Mϵ² gates, up to logarithmic factors and tomography saturation at 2ⁿ. Thus, the circuit complexity becomes an adaptive statistical resource rather than a static promise. Our framework turns bounded circuit complexity into a model-selection principle for quantum machine learning.
articles.abstract_zh: 量子机器学习通常要求 ansatz 足够表达目标量子数据，但这种表达能力只有在有限份未知量子态样本可学习时才具有统计意义。该文为有限规模量子电路生成的数据建立信息论式奥卡姆理论，分析至多含 G 个双量子比特门的 n 量子比特纯态类的样本规律。作者进一步提出不可知情形下的量子奥卡姆定理和自适应模型选择结果，说明可在最佳 G 门近似误差与统计惩罚之间取得数据支持的复杂度选择。
authors: Jeongho Bang, Kyoungho Cho, Jeongwoo Jae

articles.title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
articles.title_zh: 学习如何提示你的 VLA：基本无害的视觉—语言—动作模型引导
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12299v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a natural language interface to robot control, but the mapping from language to behavior is often brittle and unintuitive: semantically similar instructions can induce drastically different behaviors, while some capabilities may not be elicitable through prompting alone. As a result, both human instructions and zero-shot language models can fail to reliably steer VLAs toward successful task execution. In this work, we propose a framework that interactively searches for language sequences that improve closed-loop VLA task performance, distills these sequences into a test-time language feedback policy (LFP), and learns an improvement head that predicts when language steering will improve performance. We conformalize this improvement head to prevent harmful steering interventions, where the LFP decreases task performance relative to the original instruction on out-of-distribution scenarios. Crucially, our approach operates on arbitrary frozen pre-trained VLAs, requiring neither access to the original training distribution nor fine-tuning of the underlying model. On seen environments, our conformalized LFP improves base VLA performance by 24.7% in simulation and 65.0% in hardware. On visual and semantic perturbations, our conformalized LFP has strong harmlessness guarantees, and produces recovery behaviors not observed with open-loop prompting.
articles.abstract_zh: 视觉—语言—动作模型为机器人控制提供自然语言接口，但语言到行为的映射可能脆弱且不直观，语义相近的指令可能导致截然不同的行为。该文提出一种框架，交互式搜索可提升闭环任务表现的语言序列，并将其蒸馏为测试时语言反馈策略，同时学习一个预测语言引导是否会改进表现的改进头。通过保形化该改进头，方法旨在避免在分布外场景中产生有害引导，且无需访问原始训练分布或微调冻结的预训练 VLA。
authors: Hyun Joe Jeong, Gokul Swamy, Andrea Bajcsy

articles.title: Adjoint Method versus Physics-Informed Neural Networks in PDE-Constrained Inverse Problems
articles.title_zh: PDE 约束反问题中的伴随方法与物理信息神经网络比较
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12337v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Inverse problems governed by partial differential equations (PDEs) are central to computational mechanics and are commonly solved by adjoint-based optimization, while physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a flexible alternative. Their relative performance remains difficult to assess because the two approaches are often compared under different formulations, parameterizations, optimizers, and regularization choices. We present a fair comparison of adjoint optimization and PINNs for PDE-constrained inverse problems. From a common abstract formulation, we instantiate both methods on identical domains, governing equations, observation models, and regularization terms, while matching the optimizer, unknown parameterization, and arithmetic precision wherever applicable. The benchmarks include unsteady Burgers, noisy Darcy permeability inversion, three-dimensional Allen--Cahn reaction identification, and unsteady Navier--Stokes viscosity identification. The results show that the representation of the unknown largely determines the preferred method: grid-based fields favor the discrete adjoint, whereas neural representations are native to PINNs and relevant for closure and constitutive modeling. For time-dependent problems, adjoint inversion can be dominated by trajectory storage and differentiation, while PINNs provide satisfactory reconstructions at lower cost. A PINN-warm-started adjoint strategy then recovers adjoint-level accuracy at substantially reduced cost.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文针对偏微分方程约束反问题，对传统伴随优化方法与物理信息神经网络（PINNs）进行公平比较。作者在相同的区域、控制方程、观测模型、正则化项、优化器、未知量参数化和数值精度条件下，构建了包括 Burgers 方程、Darcy 渗透率反演、三维 Allen–Cahn 反应识别和 Navier–Stokes 黏度识别在内的基准测试。结果表明，未知量的表示方式很大程度上决定了更适合的方法：网格化场更有利于离散伴随方法，而神经表示则更适合 PINN 类方法。
authors: Zhen Zhang, Alessandro Alla, George Em Karniadakis

articles.title: Impact of Connectivity on Laplacian Representations in Reinforcement Learning
articles.title_zh: 连通性对强化学习中拉普拉斯表示的影响
articles.abstract: arXiv:2603.08558v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Learning compact state representations in Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) has proven crucial for addressing the curse of dimensionality in large-scale reinforcement learning (RL) problems. Existing principled approaches leverage structural priors on the MDP by constructing state representations as linear combinations of the state-graph Laplacian eigenvectors. When the transition graph is unknown or the state space is prohibitively large, the graph spectral features can be estimated directly via sample trajectories. In this work, we prove an upper bound on the approximation error of linear value function approximation under the learned spectral features. We show how this error scales with the algebraic connectivity of the state-graph, grounding the approximation quality in the topological structure of the MDP. We further bound the error introduced by the eigenvector estimation itself, leading to an end-to-end error decomposition across the representation learning pipeline. Additionally, our expression of the Laplacian operator for the RL setting, although equivalent to existing ones, prevents some common misunderstandings, of which we show some examples from the literature. Our results hold for general (non-uniform) policies without any assumptions on the symmetry of the induced transition kernel. We validate our theoretical findings with numerical simulations on gridworld environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究马尔可夫决策过程中的紧凑状态表示学习，重点关注基于状态图拉普拉斯特征向量的谱表示方法。作者证明了在线性价值函数近似中，利用学习到的谱特征所产生的近似误差上界，并说明该误差如何随状态图的代数连通度变化。论文还进一步界定了特征向量估计误差，给出了从表示学习到价值近似的端到端误差分解。
authors: Tommaso Giorgi, Pierriccardo Olivieri, Keyue Jiang, Laura Toni, Matteo Papini

articles.title: A Five-Plane Reference Architecture for Runtime Governance of Production AI Agents
articles.title_zh: 面向生产环境 AI 智能体运行时治理的五平面参考架构
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12320v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Enterprise security was built to govern data boundaries: the protected surface was data at rest and in transit, and the controls -- access control, data-loss prevention, perimeter inspection -- governed crossings of that boundary. Production AI agents dissolve this assumption. An agent reads context, calls tools, invokes connectors, and modifies systems of record on an enterprise's behalf, so risk moves inside the workflow, into sequences of individually-permitted actions that may transform a business process no one authorized. Existing policy engines do not extend to this regime: they evaluate request-time decisions against atomic principals, where agentic systems require stateful evaluation against composite principals whose authority attenuates through delegation chains. We present a reference architecture for the runtime governance of production agents, built from four composable primitives: a five-plane decomposition (a reasoning plane that adjudicates intent, and four enforcement planes -- network, identity, endpoint, data -- that realize the decision), stop-anywhere mediation, composite principals with capability attenuation, and audit as a structured evidence substrate. We define a taxonomy of six interruption primitives that generalize allow and deny, state and argue for four correctness invariants, and demonstrate the foreclosure of seven production-agent threats across five concrete workflows. A reference implementation of the policy-engine core supplies measured evidence: attenuation correctness and evidence reconstructability hold on every trial, adjudication runs in single-digit microseconds, and the audit substrate's tamper-evidence behaves exactly as designed. We are explicit about scope: the architecture governs delegated action, not model behavior, and a full-system evaluation against a live agent benchmark is the invited next step.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文指出，传统企业安全主要围绕数据边界设计，而生产级 AI 智能体会在工作流内部读取上下文、调用工具并修改业务系统，使风险转移到一系列单独被允许但整体可能未获授权的操作中。作者提出一种运行时治理参考架构，包含推理平面以及网络、身份、端点和数据四个执行平面，并引入可在任意点中止的中介机制、复合主体和能力衰减等原语。该架构旨在支持对具有委托链和组合权限的智能体系统进行有状态治理。

articles.title: Artificial Intelligence in Ship Finance: Applications, Opportunities, and a Case Study in AI-Augmented Loan Origination
articles.title_zh: 人工智能在船舶融资中的应用、机遇及 AI 增强贷款发起案例研究
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11238v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Ship finance is a data-intensive and document-heavy segment of asset-based lending, requiring the integration of financial, technical, contractual, and regulatory information from heterogeneous and largely unstructured sources. Increasing environmental regulation and ESG reporting requirements are adding further complexity to underwriting and loan-origination processes. Recent advances in artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs), create new opportunities for processing and analysing such information. This paper reviews potential applications of AI in ship finance, with a particular focus on LLM-based systems for document comprehension, information extraction, and workflow automation. We present ShipFinance.ai, a modular agentic architecture to support loan application workflows in ship finance. The proposed system combines an LLM-based extraction module, financial analysis components, external maritime data services, and a controlled document-generation module with a chatbot interface to support the preparation of standardized financing applications. The paper discusses the key challenges for using such models in production. We argue that AI-assisted systems can support maritime finance professionals in managing increasingly complex information and reporting requirements.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文讨论人工智能，尤其是大语言模型，在船舶融资这一数据密集、文档繁重的资产融资领域中的应用潜力。作者重点分析了 LLM 在文档理解、信息抽取和流程自动化方面的作用，并提出 ShipFinance.ai 这一模块化智能体架构，用于支持船舶融资贷款申请流程。该系统结合信息抽取、财务分析、外部海事数据服务、受控文档生成和聊天界面，以辅助标准化融资申请的准备。

articles.title: LLMs+Graphs: Toward Graph-Native, Synergistic AI Systems
articles.title_zh: LLM+图：迈向图原生的协同式人工智能系统
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11560v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have advanced rapidly, but their limitations in structured and multi-hop reasoning underscore the need for graph-native, synergistic artificial intelligence (AI) systems. Graph-structured data underpins critical applications across social, biological, financial, transportation, web, and knowledge domains, making it essential to understand how LLMs can leverage graph computation for grounded, context-rich inference. Three complementary synergies are emerging: LLMs augmented with graph computation for retrieval and reasoning; bidirectional integration between LLMs and knowledge graphs (KGs), where LLMs support KG construction and curation while KGs enforce semantic constraints and factual consistency; and AI agents strengthened by graph algorithms for planning, decision making, and multi-step reasoning. In parallel, LLMs introduce new capabilities for graph data management and graph machine learning (ML) through natural language interfaces and hybrid LLM-graph neural network (GNN) pipelines. This tutorial synthesizes the algorithms, systems, and design principles driving these converging directions, offering data science and data mining researchers a unified perspective on integrating LLMs, graph data management, graph mining, graph ML, and agentic computation into next-generation graph-native AI systems.
articles.abstract_zh: 该教程性论文综述了大语言模型与图计算相结合的发展方向，强调图结构数据对社交、生物、金融、交通、网络和知识等关键领域的重要性。文章归纳了三类协同路径：用图计算增强 LLM 的检索与推理，LLM 与知识图谱之间的双向集成，以及利用图算法增强 AI 智能体的规划和多步推理。同时，论文还讨论了 LLM 如何通过自然语言接口和 LLM-GNN 混合管线推动图数据管理与图机器学习。
authors: Arijit Khan, Longxu Sun, Xin Huang

articles.title: LUCID: Learning Embodiment-Agnostic Intent Models from Unstructured Human Videos for Scalable Dexterous Robot Skill Acquisition
articles.title_zh: LUCID：从非结构化人类视频中学习具身无关意图模型以实现可扩展灵巧机器人技能获取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11628v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The most widely-adopted robot learning pipelines today learn skills from robot demonstrations or structured human data, which are expensive to collect and tied to specific embodiments. In contrast, unstructured human videos provide a scalable alternative. They contain diverse manipulation demonstrations across objects, scenes, and strategies, but are not directly connected to robot action. We propose LUCID, a two-stage framework that learns task intent from unstructured human videos drawn from internet-scale datasets and learns robot control in massively-parallel simulation. The intent model predicts short-horizon intent (what should happen next in the scene) from the current observation in closed loop. An embodiment-specific sensorimotor policy converts this intent into robot actions. The intent interface is shared across controllers, so the same intent model can be applied to different embodiments, from our primary dexterous hand to a parallel-jaw gripper. We evaluate LUCID on five real-world manipulation tasks: stirring, wiping, and binning supervised by only internet video, with zero-shot transfer to novel scenes and object instances; and push-T and cable routing supervised by 1 hr each of self-collected smartphone video. Project page: https://lucid-robot.github.io/.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 LUCID，一个从互联网规模非结构化人类视频中学习任务意图、并在大规模并行仿真中学习机器人控制的两阶段框架。意图模型根据当前观测闭环预测短时场景变化目标，再由特定具身的感知运动策略将该意图转换为机器人动作。由于意图接口可在不同控制器间共享，同一意图模型可迁移到灵巧手和平行夹爪等不同机器人形态，并在搅拌、擦拭、投放等真实操作任务中进行评估。
authors: Harsh Gupta, Guanya Shi, Wenzhen Yuan

articles.title: Blind Dexterous Grasping via Real2Sim2Real Tactile Policy Learning
articles.title_zh: 通过 Real2Sim2Real 触觉策略学习实现盲式灵巧抓取
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11767v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Blind grasping with a dexterous hand is a crucial manipulation capability. Nevertheless, learning such tactile-only policies for real robots remains challenging due to the tactile sim-to-real gap and the limited expressiveness of sparse tactile signals. To bridge this gap, we propose a framework for tactile-only blind grasping that is deployable on a physical multi-fingered robotic hand. Our approach combines three key components. First, we introduce a Real2Sim tactile calibration pipeline that constructs a contact-calibrated digital-twin simulator capable of reproducing real tactile signals. Second, we improve the expressiveness of sparse tactile observations using a layout-aware tactile encoder, which incorporates sensor-geometry priors through self-supervised pretraining. Third, to improve generalization to unseen objects, we train object-specific reinforcement-learning experts in the calibrated simulator and aggregate their successful grasp trajectories into a tactile-conditioned Diffusion Policy. We evaluate our method on a physical LEAP Hand equipped with distributed tactile sensing across 10 seen and 10 unseen objects. The deployed policy achieves a 27% real-world grasp success rate across all 20 objects, without real-world grasping demonstrations or visual input. Simulation ablations show that layout-aware tactile pretraining improves grasping performance, while sensing-level evaluations confirm that Real2Sim calibration increases the consistency of tactile contact events between simulation and hardware. Together, these results suggest that contact-event calibration, geometry-aware tactile representation learning, and diffusion-based policy aggregation provide an effective path toward tactile-only blind grasping on real dexterous robotic hands. Project page:Dex-Blind-Grasp.github.io.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文研究仅依赖触觉的多指灵巧手盲抓取问题，针对触觉仿真到现实差距和稀疏触觉信号表达能力不足提出解决框架。方法包括 Real2Sim 触觉校准以构建接触校准数字孪生仿真器，利用布局感知触觉编码器增强稀疏触觉观测，并在校准仿真中训练对象专家后汇聚成功轨迹形成触觉条件扩散策略。作者在配备分布式触觉传感的真实 LEAP Hand 上，对已见和未见物体进行了评估。
authors: Shengcheng Luo, Xiyan Huang, Zhe Xu, Wanlin Li, Ziyuan Jiao, Chenxi Xiao

articles.title: TextHOI-3D: Text-to-3D Hand-Object Interaction via Discrete Multi-View Generation and Joint Mesh Optimization
articles.title_zh: TextHOI-3D：基于离散多视图生成与联合网格优化的文本到三维手物交互生成
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11805v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Text-conditioned 3D generation has progressed rapidly for images and isolated objects, but producing a hand-object mesh remains challenging: the output must preserve language semantics, cross-view consistency, object geometry, articulated hand shape, and physically plausible contact. We present TextHOI-3D, a staged framework that uses generated multi-view observations as an explicit interface between text-conditioned visual generation and geometry-aware hand-object recovery. TextHOI-3D learns a compact VQ token space for fixed-camera hand-object observations, predicts multi-view visual tokens from text with a CLIP-conditioned visual autoregressive model, and recovers a unified hand-object mesh through prior initialization, multi-view joint optimization, and anti-penetration refinement. The design separates semantic generation from geometric recovery while keeping both stages connected by a discrete multi-view representation. On HO3D-derived evaluations, the multi-view setting reduces object CD from 17.26 mm to 4.92 mm and penetration volume from 5.3721 cm³ to 0.2193 cm³ compared with a single-view counterpart, while improving hand errors and surface F-scores. These results support multi-view visual tokens as an effective intermediate representation for text-driven 3D hand-object mesh creation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出 TextHOI-3D，用于从文本生成三维手—物交互网格，目标是在保持语言语义、跨视图一致性、物体几何、手部关节形态和物理接触合理性的同时完成生成。方法先学习固定相机手物观测的紧凑 VQ 令牌空间，再用 CLIP 条件视觉自回归模型从文本预测多视图视觉令牌，最后通过先验初始化、多视图联合优化和防穿透细化恢复统一手物网格。实验显示，多视图设计相较单视图显著降低物体重建误差和穿透体积，并改善手部估计质量。

articles.title: Grammar-Constrained Decoding Can Jailbreak LLMs into Generating Malicious Code
articles.title_zh: 语法约束解码可能越狱大语言模型并诱导其生成恶意代码
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.11817v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used for code generation, raising concerns that they may be misused to produce malicious code. Meanwhile, Grammar-Constrained Decoding (GCD) has been widely adopted to improve the reliability of LLM-generated code by enforcing syntactic validity. In this paper, we reveal a counterintuitive risk: this reliability-oriented technique can itself become an attack surface. We uncover a new jailbreak attack, termed CodeSpear, that exploits GCD to induce LLMs into generating malicious code. Our experiments show that simply applying a benign code grammar constraint can effectively jailbreak LLMs. To address this vulnerability, we propose CodeShield, a safety alignment approach that robustly preserves safe behavior even under attacker-controlled grammar constraints. CodeShield aligns the model in the code modality by teaching it to generate honeypot code under GCD. Such code is semantically harmless, so it does not implement the malicious request, and structurally diverse, so it is difficult to suppress through grammar tightening. At the same time, CodeShield still preserves natural-language refusals when natural language is available. Experiments on 10 popular LLMs across 4 benchmarks show that CodeSpear outperforms representative jailbreak baselines and increases the attack success rate by more than 30 percentage points on average. CodeShield also restores safety under CodeSpear while preserving benign utility. Our findings reveal a fundamental risk of GCD and call for greater attention to its potential security implications.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文揭示了语法约束解码这一提升代码生成可靠性的技术可能成为新的攻击面。作者提出 CodeSpear 越狱攻击，证明即使是看似良性的代码语法约束，也可能诱导大语言模型生成恶意代码。为缓解该风险，论文提出 CodeShield 安全对齐方法，使模型在语法约束下生成语义无害且结构多样的“蜜罐代码”，从而保持安全行为并降低攻击者通过收紧语法绕过防护的可能性。
authors: Yitong Zhang, Shiteng Lu, Jia Li

articles.title: Non-frontal face recognition using GANs and memristor-based classifiers
articles.title_zh: 基于生成对抗网络与忆阻器分类器的非正面人脸识别
articles.abstract: arXiv:2606.12074v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Face recognition systems have advanced significantly through deep learning techniques, delivering high performance and robustness in complex scenarios. However, these approaches incur substantial computational overhead, limiting their in situ applicability in resource-constrained platforms such as drones, where they can address challenges including non-frontal facial imagery. Memristor-based neuromorphic systems have emerged as a compelling approach for edge AI applications, combining biologically inspired processing with efficient and scalable computation. In this work, we propose a facial recognition framework that addresses non-frontal pose variations by integrating lightweight generative adversarial network (GAN)-based pose frontalisation with memristor-based neuromorphic recognition. The experimental results on two datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of combining adversarial learning with memristive technology, achieving up to 96% identification accuracy. The proposed approach alleviates the computational bottlenecks of conventional AI and offers a scalable, efficient solution for face recognition in dynamic real-world environments.
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种面向资源受限边缘平台的非正面人脸识别框架，将轻量级 GAN 姿态正面化与基于忆阻器的神经形态识别相结合。该方法旨在缓解传统深度学习人脸识别计算开销大、难以在无人机等现场设备部署的问题。实验在两个数据集上验证了该框架的有效性，最高识别准确率达到 96%，显示出在动态真实场景中实现高效可扩展识别的潜力。
authors: Semih Vazgecen, Cristian Sestito, Spyros Stathopoulos, Themis Prodromakis

articles.title: Intense Magnetic-Cloud Geomagnetic Storms and Their Relation to Solar and Interplanetary Activity During Solar Cycle 24
articles.title_zh: 太阳第 24 周期间强磁云地磁暴及其与太阳和行星际活动的关系
articles.abstract: Geomagnetic storms (GMs) associated with magnetic clouds (MCs) during the declining phase of solar cycle 24 are investigated with respect to their solar and interplanetary origins. The analysis considers coronal mass ejections (CMEs), X-ray solar flares (SFs), and variations in solar wind plasma parameters, including interplanetary magnetic field strength (IMF B), its southward component (IMF Bz), solar wind proton density (SWPD), and solar wind plasma temperature (SWPT). Most MC-related storms are found to be associated with hard X-ray flares and with halo or partial halo CMEs, consistent with past studies showing high geomagnetic-storm association rates for such CMEs (Verma et al., 2009; Pandey et al., 2022; Kumar et al., 2024; Parihar et al., 2024). A strong positive correlation (r = 0.584) is obtained between GM intensity and peak IMF B, and a still larger correlation (r = 0.644) between GM intensity and the peak southward IMF Bz, in line with broader results that storm strength is primarily controlled by IMF magnitude and southward orientation (Pandey et al., 2022; Kumar et al., 2024; Ochani et al., 2023; Parihar et al., 2024). Positive but weaker correlations are found between GM intensity and peak disturbances in SWPD (r = 0.235) and SWPT (r = 0.149), similar to earlier reports of modest storm–plasma parameter correlations (Verma et al., 2009; Kumar et al., 2024; Verma et al., 2009; Parihar et al., 2024). These findings indicate that MC-related geomagnetic storms during this period are mainly driven by CMEs linked to hard X-ray solar flares, with strong and sustained IMF B and southward IMF Bz playing the dominant role and solar wind density and temperature providing secondary modulation.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察太阳第 24 周下降阶段与磁云相关的地磁暴，并分析其太阳源和行星际来源。论文关注日冕物质抛射、X 射线太阳耀斑以及行星际磁场强度、南向分量、太阳风质子密度和等离子体温度等参数的变化。结果表明，多数磁云相关地磁暴与硬 X 射线耀斑以及全晕或部分晕 CME 有关，且地磁暴强度与峰值 IMF B 和南向 IMF Bz 呈较强正相关。

articles.title: Decomposition-informed deep learning for wind-power forecasting: A CEEMDAN→VMD hybrid with feature extraction and per-component deeplearners
articles.title_zh: 面向风电功率预测的分解信息深度学习：结合特征提取与分量级深度学习器的 CEEMDAN→VMD 混合模型
articles.abstract: Accurate wind power forecasting remains a critical challenge for grid stability and renewable energy integration, particularly in emerging power systems with limited flexibility. This study proposes a hybrid decomposition–learning framework that combines the Complete Ensemble Empirical Mode Decomposition with Adaptive Noise (CEEMDAN) and Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) with a deep gated recurrent network (B6-CEEMDAN-VMD). The dual decomposition enables the extraction of multi-scale temporal features, while the GRU–attention backbone captures nonlinear dependencies and temporal dynamics across horizons. The proposed model was evaluated on data from seven wind farms using 1-hour, 4-hour, and 24-hour forecast horizons and benchmarked against persistence, linear regression, ARIMA, gradient boosting (GBM), and standalone deep models. Results demonstrate that B6 outperforms all baselines, reducing mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean squared error (RMSE) by 25--35% compared to GBM and by more than 40% compared to persistence forecasts. The model also exhibits strong spatial robustness, maintaining low forecasting errors across geographically diverse sites. Operationally, these accuracy gains translate into a 26--30% reduction in spinning reserve requirements for a 100 MW grid, contributing to more efficient dispatch, reduced curtailment, and lower backup fuel costs. Overall, the CEEMDAN–VMD–Deep hybridization provides a scalable, physics-consistent, and data-efficient solution for improving short-term and day-ahead wind forecasting in emerging renewable energy systems
articles.abstract_zh: 该文提出一种用于风电功率预测的混合分解—学习框架 B6-CEEMDAN-VMD，将自适应噪声完备集合经验模态分解与变分模态分解相结合，并采用带注意力机制的 GRU 网络建模非线性时序依赖。模型在七个风电场数据上针对 1 小时、4 小时和 24 小时预测范围进行评估，并与持久性预测、线性回归、ARIMA、GBM 和独立深度模型比较。结果显示，该方法在 MAE 和 RMSE 上显著优于基线，并在不同地理站点上表现出较好的空间鲁棒性。

articles.title: Enhancement of machining quality in electrochemical mill-grinding of titanium matrix composites utilizing a follow-up auxiliary anode
articles.title_zh: 利用随动辅助阳极提升钛基复合材料电化学铣磨加工质量
articles.abstract: Electrochemical mill-grinding (ECMG) has the potential to be used for successive rough and finish machining of titanium matrix composites. However, severe stray corrosion occurs on the machined surface during the rough machining stage, leading to prolonged machining time in the subsequent finish machining stage. In this study, follow-up auxiliary anode electrochemical mill-grinding (FAAECMG) was innovatively proposed for enhancing the machining quality of titanium matrix composites. Dynamic electric field simulation showed that introducing the auxiliary anode with a positive potentially difference radically altered the current direction in the machined area, which significantly improved process localization. Experimental results verified that, compared with traditional ECMG, the surface flatness decreased from 322.25 µm to 152.44 µm and the surface roughness reduced from 16.76 µm to 11.84 µm when FAAECMG with a positive potential difference of 15 V was used. Compared with rough machining, the surface flatness decreased from 152.44 µm to 5.368 µm, the surface roughness reduced from 11.84 µm to 0.669 µm, and the surface residual compressive stress increased from − 116.07 MPa to -407.94 MPa after finish machining. Therefore, the newly proposed method offers advantages in improving machining accuracy and surface quality in ECMG and reducing the machining cycle of components.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出随动辅助阳极电化学铣磨（FAAECMG），用于减轻钛基复合材料粗加工阶段的杂散腐蚀并提高加工局部化。动态电场模拟表明，带正电位差的辅助阳极可显著改变已加工区域电流方向；实验显示，在15 V正电位差下，相比传统ECMG，表面平面度和粗糙度均明显降低。后续精加工进一步将表面平面度和粗糙度降至较低水平，并提高了表面残余压应力。

articles.title: Multisource Data Integration for Enhanced Wheat Yield Prediction Using Optimized Ensemble Machine Learning Approaches
articles.title_zh: 基于优化集成机器学习的多源数据融合小麦产量预测
articles.abstract: Accurate wheat yield prediction is vital for food security in the face of increasing climate variability, yet traditional models often struggle to capture the complex interactions between crops and their environment. This study evaluates a multisource prediction framework across China’s major wheat-growing regions, integrating climate and remote sensing data within stage-specific scenarios using advanced machine learning models. Random forest, extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost), and light gradient boosting machine models were optimized with improved grey wolf (IGWO) and whale (IWO) optimization algorithms and applied to twelve vegetation indices alongside key climatic variables. Results show that combining climate and remote sensing inputs significantly improves prediction accuracy over single-source data, with the best performance achieved when full-season remote sensing is paired with early-stage climate variables. Monte Carlo analysis identified water-related factors—wind speed, soil moisture, precipitation, and evaporation—as the most influential drivers of yield, while temperature variables and vegetation indices had weaker effects. Metaheuristic optimization consistently enhanced model performance, with XGBoost-IGWO achieving the highest accuracy (R² = 0.755, Willmott index = 0.833, RMSE = 0.495 t/ha). Model accuracy also varied across regions, performing better in smaller, more homogeneous areas. Overall, integrating stage-specific multisource data with optimized machine learning models improves both the reliability and interpretability of large-scale wheat yield predictions.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向中国主要小麦产区，融合气候数据与遥感数据，并在不同生育阶段场景下评估小麦产量预测框架。作者采用随机森林、XGBoost和LightGBM，并结合改进灰狼优化与鲸鱼优化算法对模型进行优化。结果表明，多源数据融合优于单一数据源，其中全季遥感数据结合早期气候变量表现最佳；蒙特卡罗分析显示风速、土壤水分、降水和蒸发等水分相关因子对产量影响更大。

articles.title: Effect of straw biochar on remediating saline-alkali soil and enhancing the quality of Chinese cabbage
articles.title_zh: 秸秆生物炭对盐碱土修复及小白菜品质提升的影响
articles.abstract: The saline-alkali soils are characterized by high salinity, high alkalinity, and low nutrient content, leading to soil structure degradation and inhibition of crop growth. Biochar has shown potential for ameliorating saline-alkali soils because of its porous structure and surface reactivity. In this study, waste straw was used to prepare biochar to improve saline-alkali soil. The practical effects of biochar on soil remediation were investigated through physicochemical characterization of biochar, combined with leaching experiments, soil amendment trials, and pot experiments. The results showed that biochar produced at 600°C exhibited an optimal pore structure, and the leachate from soil treated with this biochar had the lowest pH, EC, and sodium ion content, indicating the most effective leaching performance. With a 2% biochar application rate, soil pH, EC, total salt content, alkalinity, and Na+ concentration decreased significantly. Meanwhile, the cation exchange capacity increased by 40.17%, and the available nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium increased by 1.31%, 45.87%, and 73.21%, respectively. In pot experiments, the germination rate of Chinese cabbage increased from 0% to 93%, and the chlorophyll content and other physiological indicators were significantly improved. A pyrolysis temperature of 600°C and application rate of 2% were identified as the optimal parameters for saline-alkali soil improvement. This study demonstrates that biochar can effectively remediate saline-alkali soil through dynamic salt leaching, structural improvement, and nutrient synergy, providing both data support and practical experience for regional saline-alkali soil management and straw resource utilization.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究以废弃秸秆制备生物炭，用于改良高盐、高碱、低养分的盐碱土，并通过表征、淋洗、土壤改良和盆栽实验评估其效果。结果显示，600°C制备的生物炭孔结构较优，可降低淋洗液pH、电导率和钠离子含量；2%施用量显著降低土壤盐碱指标，同时提高阳离子交换量和速效养分含量。盆栽结果还表明，生物炭处理可改善小白菜萌发和生长表现。

articles.title: MTF-YOLO: A Steel Surface Defect Detector with Multiscale Texture Fusion and Variance-Guided Convolution
articles.title_zh: MTF-YOLO：融合多尺度纹理与方差引导卷积的钢表面缺陷检测器
articles.abstract: In industrial surface inspection, defects are often small, weakly textured, and bounded by uncertain edges—conditions under which state‑of‑the‑art detectors struggle, especially in low‑contrast scenes and for thin cracks. To address these challenges, this paper proposes MTF‑YOLO, a YOLO‑based detector that integrates three modules: Defect Variance‑Guided Convolution (DVGC), Defect Edge Enhancement (DEE), and Defect‑Oriented Texture Fusion (DOTF). Firstly, DVGC explicitly models the statistical disparity between foreground and background, improving separability for small, low‑contrast targets. Secondly, DEE sharpens contours and fine details at the feature‑level, mitigating localization drift caused by blurred boundaries. Thirdly, DOTF aggregates texture cues across multiple scales and orientations. In addition, this paper employs a Path Aggregation Network–FPN (PAN–FPN) neck together with Spatial Pyramid Pooling–Fast (SPPF) to efficiently fuse semantic and low‑level information across pyramid levels. Experiments show that MTF‑YOLO achieves mAP@0.5 scores of 84.1% and 82.7% on NEU‑DET and GC10‑DET, respectively; it strikes a favorable balance among accuracy, efficiency, and deployability, and demonstrates robust performance for steel surface defect detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文针对钢表面缺陷小尺度、弱纹理、低对比度和边界模糊等检测难题，提出基于YOLO的MTF-YOLO检测器。模型引入缺陷方差引导卷积、缺陷边缘增强和面向缺陷的纹理融合模块，以提升前景背景可分性、边界定位和多尺度纹理表达。实验显示，该方法在NEU-DET和GC10-DET数据集上分别取得84.1%和82.7%的mAP@0.5，在精度、效率和部署性之间取得较好平衡。

articles.title: Temporal Distinguishability and Measurement-Induced Order in Driven-Dissipative Qubit Networks
articles.title_zh: 驱动耗散量子比特网络中的时间可区分性与测量诱导有序性
articles.abstract: Can an open quantum system with unitary Hamiltonian dynamics and Markovian decoherence encode and process an ordered sequence of external inputs while preserving the ordinal structure of that sequence? We address this question for a driven-dissipative N-qubit network whose qubits interact via a ZZ-type Ising Hamiltonian of coupling strength β and relax through amplitude-damping channels at rate γ. Defining temporal distinguishability D(tn,tn+1) via the Bures metric, we prove an analytic upper bound: in the coherent-dominated regime ΩNδt ≫ 1, coherent oscillations suppress D as 4∥δI( n) ∥1δt/(1 + ΩNδt). We prove a coherence--order complementarity: for Hadamard initialization and β → ∞, D → 0. Projective measurements interleaved with Lindblad evolution restore distinguishability via a quantum Zeno mechanism. These results establish the scaling law β < 4NinI0/(ϵJN) as a necessary condition for ordinal processability in quantum recurrent architectures, where Nin is the number of sensory input qubits: a fixed input aperture is overwhelmed by a growing coherent bulk. Numerical illustration with a four-qubit prototype confirms the predicted suppression and γ/β crossover.
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究考察具有ZZ型伊辛相互作用和振幅阻尼退相干的开放N量子比特网络，能否在保持输入序列序结构的同时编码和处理外部输入。作者以Bures度量定义时间可区分性，并推导出相干主导区域中相干振荡会抑制可区分性的解析上界，同时证明了相干性与序处理能力之间的互补关系。研究还指出，穿插投影测量可通过量子芝诺机制恢复可区分性，并给出量子循环结构中实现序处理的必要缩放条件。

articles.title: UR-RAG: Unified Risk Calibration for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
articles.title_zh: UR-RAG：面向检索增强生成的统一风险校准
articles.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation fails when retrieval surfaces weak evidence, when generation misuses adequate evidence, or both, but most abstention methods focus primarily on the generator. We propose UR-RAG, a deployment controller that fuses four runtime signals (retrieval decisiveness, semantic entropy, cluster agreement, and answer support) into one closed-form max-aggregation score, calibrates a shipping threshold against unconditional shipped risk Pr(fail ∧ ship) via a Hoeffding upper-confidence rule, and routes each query through a cheap-then-expensive cascade. Unlike learned-fusion baselines which train a separate parametric head, UR-RAG sets its four channel weights from the same proxy failure labels CRC already consumes and no extra correctness annotations are required. We compare UR-RAG to an 8-feature learned-fusion (LF) logistic baseline on the same signals and the same conformal threshold under a K=5 cross-fit over 13 cells where each cell is a unique combination of dataset, retriever, and cheap-to-expensive generator pair (datasets: TriviaQA, SQuAD, HotpotQA, NQ-open). Three empirical patterns are most relevant: (i) We find that a single cheap-tier weight vector transfers across all nine single-hop cells. Leave-one-cell-out auto-tuning produces the cheap-tier vector (0.25, 0.25, 0, 1.0) across all 9 single-hop cells, with zero weight on cluster-agreement throughout. (ii) The cost of avoiding an additional learned correctness head is small. Within-distribution transfer trails per-cell LF by an average of 0.79 percentage points (pp) in area under the curve (AUC) with a 95% confidence interval (CI) of [0.45, 1.16] pp. The pooled-fit LF performs nearly the same as per-cell LF, suggesting the gap reflects the cost of forgoing correctness supervision. (iii) The cascade ships ~80% of shipped answers from the cheap tier and uses ~62% of always-Tier-2 token cost, while every shipping decision is attributable to a single channel and the deployment artifact is a ~200-byte JSON per tier. UR-RAG complements rather than replaces learned fusion: it trades a small AUC margin for label-free weight selection, per-channel auditability at inference, and cross-cell weight transfer. The source code is available at: https://github.com/CMU-AGAI/urrag-hallucination-detection.
articles.abstract_zh: 该论文提出UR-RAG部署控制器，用于在检索证据薄弱或生成模型误用证据时降低检索增强生成系统的输出风险。方法将检索决断性、语义熵、簇一致性和答案支持度四类运行时信号融合为闭式最大聚合评分，并利用Hoeffding上置信规则按无条件输出风险校准阈值。作者在多个问答数据集、检索器和生成器组合上与学习式融合基线比较，强调其无需额外正确性标注且可通过廉价到昂贵的级联路由实现部署控制。

articles.title: Edge spin galvanic effect in altermagnets
articles.title_zh: 交替磁体中的边缘自旋伽伐尼效应
articles.abstract: Author(s): L. E. Golub The authors predict here an edge spin galvanic effect in d -wave altermagnets, where nonequilibrium spin polarization generates an electric current flowing along the sample edge. The effect originates from the interplay of altermagnetic spin splitting and edge scattering, is sensitive to edge orientation, and reverses upon reversal of the Néel vector. The work also proposes a pure spin edge photocurrent induced by polarized radiation, analyzes its frequency dependence, and demonstrates its conversion into an electric current by an external magnetic field. [Phys. Rev. B 113, L220404] Published Thu Jun 11, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作预测了d波交替磁体中的边缘自旋伽伐尼效应，即非平衡自旋极化可在样品边缘诱导沿边电流。该效应源于交替磁自旋劈裂与边缘散射的耦合，对边缘取向敏感，并会随 Néel 矢量反转而反向。文章还提出由偏振辐射诱导的纯自旋边缘光电流，分析其频率依赖，并展示其可在外磁场作用下转化为电流。

articles.title: Toward a temperature-insensitive composite diamond clock
articles.title_zh: 迈向温度不敏感的复合金刚石钟
articles.abstract: Author(s): Sean Lourette, Andrey Jarmola, Jabir Chathanathil, Victor M. Acosta, A. Glen Birdwell, Peter Blümler, Dmitry Budker, Sebastián C. Carrasco, Tony G. Ivanov, Shimon Kolkowitz, and Vladimir S. Malinovsky Although a solid-state frequency reference based on nitrogen-vacancy (N- V ) centers in diamond is attractive for compact, multifunctional timekeeping and sensing, their strong lattice coupling produces temperature sensitivity that has precluded a stable clock. This study uses the electron’s zero-field splitting and the nitrogen’s nuclear quadrupole splitting in a composite frequency reference that cancels first-order temperature dependence, reducing thermal drift by more than an order of magnitude. The results establish a practical route toward robust, chip-scale diamond clocks that simultaneously support magnetic, electric, thermal, and inertial sensing in a single integrated platform. [Phys. Rev. Applied 25, 064046] Published Thu Jun 11, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究面向基于金刚石氮-空位中心的固态频率参考，其小型化和多功能传感潜力长期受限于强晶格耦合导致的温度敏感性。作者将电子零场分裂与氮核四极分裂组合为复合频率参考，以抵消一阶温度依赖，使热漂移降低一个数量级以上。结果为稳健的芯片级金刚石钟提供了实践路径，并有望在同一集成平台上支持磁、电、热和惯性传感。
authors: Sean Lourette, Andrey Jarmola, Jabir Chathanathil, Victor M. Acosta, A. Glen Birdwell, Peter Blümler, Dmitry Budker, Sebastián C. Carrasco, Tony G. Ivanov, Shimon Kolkowitz, and Vladimir S. Malinovsky

articles.title: Coarse-grained quantum thermodynamics: Observation-dependent quantities, observation-independent laws
articles.title_zh: 粗粒化量子热力学：依赖观测的量与不依赖观测的定律
articles.abstract: Author(s): Giulia Rubino, Časlav Brukner, and Gonzalo Manzano In both classical and quantum thermodynamics, physical quantities are typically assigned objective values defined independently of our observations. We then refer to the “work performed by a gas,” or the “entropy of the gas,” regardless of how they are evaluated. Here, we question this conception in… [Phys. Rev. Research 8, 023284] Published Thu Jun 11, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究重新审视经典与量子热力学中物理量通常被视为客观、独立于观测而定义的观念。作者提出粗粒化情形下热力学量可能依赖于观测方式，而热力学定律仍可保持观测无关的形式，从而为量子热力学中的功、熵等概念提供新的表述框架。
authors: Giulia Rubino, Časlav Brukner, and Gonzalo Manzano

articles.title: Nonstabilizerness in molecular bonding
articles.title_zh: 分子成键中的非稳定子性
articles.abstract: Author(s): Matthieu Sarkis and Alexandre Tkatchenko Fermionic nonstabilizerness, or magic, in molecular electronic ground states along diatomic bond-stretching coordinates is analyzed. For H 2 and several other dimers, magic measures form an intermediate-separation peak near rapid changes of the binding-energy curve, providing new quantum-information-theoretic insight on molecular bonding beyond entanglement. [Phys. Rev. Research 8, L022048] Published Thu Jun 11, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该工作分析了双原子分子沿键伸长坐标的电子基态中费米子非稳定子性，即量子“魔性”。在 H₂ 及若干其他二聚体中，魔性度量在中等核间距附近出现峰值，并与结合能曲线快速变化相关，为超越纠缠的分子成键信息论理解提供了新视角。

Bosyk, Pablo Crespo Del Amo, and Karol Życzkowski In this work, we introduce a comprehensive statistical framework for assessing single-qubit quantum teleportation performance beyond the conventional average-fidelity benchmark. First, we derive a closed-form expression for the full probability density function of actual teleportation fidelities and… [Phys. Rev. Applied 25, 064047] Published Thu Jun 11, 2026
articles.abstract_zh: 该研究提出一个用于评估单量子比特量子隐形传态性能的统计框架，超越传统的平均保真度基准。作者推导了实际传态保真度完整概率密度函数的闭式表达，并据此更全面地刻画不同传态方案的质量与波动特征。
